/* D-40 单组跑局器：M1「刷满」。种子 1001~1050、maxActions 2500（与 G0/G2/S1 完全一致）。
 * M1 = 每层全清怪、拿宝箱、每层商店买最贵、拿到卷轴就用。没有逃跑分支。 */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { protocol: 'D-40', mode: 'm1', strategy: { clear: true }, env: {}, summary: null, runs: [] };
  function mean(a) { if (!a.length) return 0; var s = 0; for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) s += a[i]; return Math.round((s / a.length) * 100) / 100; }
  function agg(runs) {
    var d = {
      outcomes: { win: 0, dead: 0, stuck: 0 },
      deathFloor: {},
      floors: [],
      f5: { reached: 0, states: [] },
      extrapolated: [],
      scrolls: { runsUsed: 0, total: 0 },
      bought: { total: 0, byId: {} },
      deaths: { count: 0, bySource: {} }
    };
    var perFloor = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i], m = r.m1;
      if (!m) continue;
      if (r.outcome === 'win') d.outcomes.win++;
      else if (r.outcome === 'dead') d.outcomes.dead++;
      else d.outcomes.stuck++;
      if (r.outcome !== 'win') d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] = (d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] || 0) + 1;
      for (var f = 0; f < m.floors.length; f++) {
        var z = m.floors[f];
        if (!perFloor[z.floor]) perFloor[z.floor] = { atk: [], def: [], maxHp: [], level: [], gold: [], equip: [], kills: [], exp: [], actions: [] };
        perFloor[z.floor].atk.push(z.atk); perFloor[z.floor].def.push(z.def);
        perFloor[z.floor].maxHp.push(z.maxHp); perFloor[z.floor].level.push(z.level);
        perFloor[z.floor].gold.push(z.gold); perFloor[z.floor].equip.push(z.equip);
        perFloor[z.floor].kills.push(z.kills); perFloor[z.floor].exp.push(z.expGain);
        perFloor[z.floor].actions.push(z.actions);
        if (z.floor === 5) {
          d.f5.states.push({ seed: r.seed, atk: z.atk, def: z.def, maxHp: z.maxHp, level: z.level,
            hp: z.hp, gold: z.gold, equip: z.equip, weaponId: z.weaponId, armorId: z.armorId,
            weaponPlus: z.weaponPlus, armorPlus: z.armorPlus, outcome: r.outcome });
        }
      }
      if (m.scrollsUsed > 0) { d.scrolls.runsUsed++; d.scrolls.total += m.scrollsUsed; }
      for (var b = 0; b < m.bought.length; b++) {
        d.bought.total++;
        var id = m.bought[b].id;
        d.bought.byId[id] = (d.bought.byId[id] || 0) + 1;
      }
      if (m.extrapolated) {
        d.extrapolated.push({
          seed: r.seed, diedOnFloor: m.extrapolated.diedOnFloor,
          projectedLevel: m.extrapolated.projectedLevel,
          projectedAtk: m.extrapolated.projectedAtk,
          projectedDef: m.extrapolated.projectedDef,
          projectedMaxHp: m.extrapolated.projectedMaxHp,
          avgExpPerFloor: m.extrapolated.avgExpPerFloor,
          extrapolated: true
        });
      }
      if (r.death) {
        d.deaths.count++;
        var src = r.death.source || '(unknown)';
        d.deaths.bySource[src] = (d.deaths.bySource[src] || 0) + 1;
      }
    }
    for (var k in perFloor) if (perFloor.hasOwnProperty(k)) {
      var g = perFloor[k];
      d.floors.push({
        floor: +k, n: g.atk.length,
        avgAtk: mean(g.atk), avgDef: mean(g.def), avgMaxHp: mean(g.maxHp),
        avgLevel: mean(g.level), avgGold: mean(g.gold), avgEquip: mean(g.equip),
        avgKills: mean(g.kills), avgExpGain: mean(g.exp), avgActions: mean(g.actions)
      });
    }
    d.floors.sort(function (a, b) { return a.floor - b.floor; });
    d.f5.reached = d.f5.states.length;
    return d;
  }

  try {
    var M = Game.Core.Main;
    M.init();
    M.closeGuide();
    var qs = location.search || '';
    var mn = /n=(\d+)/.exec(qs);
    var n = mn ? Math.max(1, Math.min(200, +mn[1])) : 50;
    var seeds = [];
    for (var i = 1001; i < 1001 + n; i++) seeds.push(i);
    var t0 = Date.now();
    var res = Game.Bot.batch(seeds, { maxActions: 2500, m1: out.strategy });
    out.wallMs = Date.now() - t0;
    out.env = {
      ua: navigator.userAgent,
      stepMs: Game.Bot.STEP_MS,
      actionSec: Game.Bot.ACTION_SEC,
      seeds: 'seed 1001..' + (1000 + n) + ' (固定)',
      seedList: seeds,
      maxActions: 2500,
      startPosSet: (function () {
        var s = {};
        for (var j = 0; j < res.runs.length; j++) s[res.runs[j].startPos] = 1;
        return Object.keys(s).sort();
      })()
    };
    out.summary = res.summary;
    out.summary.d40 = agg(res.runs);
    out.runs = res.runs;
    out.spy = Game.Bot.spy();
    out.ok = true;
    var a = out.summary.d40;
    document.title = 'BATCH_DONE mode=m1 runs=' + res.runs.length +
      ' win=' + res.summary.win + ' dead=' + res.summary.dead + ' stuck=' + res.summary.stuck +
      ' f5=' + a.f5.reached + ' extrap=' + a.extrapolated.length +
      ' scrolls=' + a.scrolls.total + ' wallMs=' + out.wallMs;
  } catch (e) {
    out.err = String((e && (e.message + '\n' + (e.orig || e.stack))) || e);
    document.title = 'BATCH_FAIL';
  }
  window.__D40__ = out;
  document.getElementById('report').textContent = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1);
})();

<script>
/* D-41 三组跑局器（只测量，不改游戏）：
 *   ?n=50            种子 1001..1000+n（默认 50）
 *   ?curve=60        把 Battle.expCurveBase 赋成旧值（负例 / 对照），默认用代码里的新值
 *   ?only=m1|s1|g2   只跑一组（默认三组都跑）
 * 三组口径与 D-37 / D-39 / D-40 完全一致：同种子、maxActions 2500、同一起点。 */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { protocol: 'D-41', mode: 'all', strategy: {}, env: {}, summary: null, runs: {}, agg: {}, ok: false };
  function mean(a) {
    if (!a.length) return 0;
    var s = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) s += a[i];
    return Math.round((s / a.length) * 100) / 100;
  }
  /* 每层结束快照：M1 用 m1.floors，S1 用 d39.floorEnd，G2 用 d37.floorEnd（字段同名） */
  function floorEnds(r, key) {
    if (key === 'm1') return (r.m1 && r.m1.floors) || [];
    if (key === 's1') return (r.d39 && r.d39.floorEnd) || [];
    return (r.d37 && r.d37.floorEnd) || [];
  }
  function agg(strategy, runs) {
    var d = {
      outcomes: { win: 0, dead: 0, stuck: 0 }, deathFloor: {},
      floorReach: {}, floorKills: {}, floorLevel: {}, floorHp: {},
      f5: { reached: 0, states: [], enterStates: [] },
      l5ByF3: 0, killsTotal: 0, killsPerRun: 0,
      expByFloor: {}
    };
    var perFloor = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i];
      if (r.outcome === 'win') d.outcomes.win++;
      else if (r.outcome === 'dead') d.outcomes.dead++;
      else d.outcomes.stuck++;
      if (r.outcome !== 'win') d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] = (d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] || 0) + 1;
      d.killsTotal += r.kills || 0;
      var reached = {}, best = 0, ends = floorEnds(r, strategy);
      for (var f = 0; f < ends.length; f++) {
        var z = ends[f], fl = z.floor;
        reached[fl] = 1;
        if (fl > best) best = fl;
        if (!perFloor[fl]) perFloor[fl] = { kills: [], level: [], hp: [], exp: [], n: 0 };
        perFloor[fl].n++;
        if (typeof z.kills === 'number') perFloor[fl].kills.push(z.kills);
        if (typeof z.level === 'number') perFloor[fl].level.push(z.level);
        if (typeof z.hp === 'number') perFloor[fl].hp.push(z.hp);
        if (typeof z.expGain === 'number') perFloor[fl].exp.push(z.expGain);
        if (z.floor === 5) {
          d.f5.states.push({
            seed: r.seed, hp: z.hp, maxHp: z.maxHp, mp: z.mp, maxMp: z.maxMp,
            level: z.level, gold: z.gold, atk: z.atk, def: z.def, maxHp2: z.maxHp,
            weaponId: z.weaponId || null, armorId: z.armorId || null, outcome: r.outcome
          });
        }

  'use strict';

  function mean(a) {
    if (!a.length) return 0;
    var s = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) s += a[i];
    return Math.round((s / a.length) * 100) / 100;
  }
  function pct(v, m) { return (m > 0) ? Math.round((v / m) * 1000) / 10 : null; }
  function addTo(o, k, v) { o[k] = (o[k] || 0) + v; }
  /* 与 D-42 同口径的到达/死层汇总（保证 E 组可逐项对照） */
  function aggBase(strategy, runs) {
    var d = {
      outcomes: { win: 0, dead: 0, stuck: 0 }, deathFloor: {},
      floorReach: {}, floorKills: {}, floorLevel: {}, floorHp: {},
      f5: { reached: 0, states: [], enterStates: [] },
      l5ByF3: 0, killsTotal: 0, killsPerRun: 0, boss: {}
    };
    var perFloor = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i];
      if (r.outcome === 'win') d.outcomes.win++;
      else if (r.outcome === 'dead') d.outcomes.dead++;
      else d.outcomes.stuck++;
      if (r.outcome !== 'win') d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] = (d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] || 0) + 1;
      d.killsTotal += r.kills || 0;
      var reached = {}, ends = (r.d43 && r.d43.floors) || [];
      for (var f = 0; f < ends.length; f++) {
        var z = ends[f], fl = z.floor;
        reached[fl] = 1;
        if (!perFloor[fl]) perFloor[fl] = { kills: [], level: [], hp: [], n: 0 };
        perFloor[fl].n++;
        if (typeof r.m1 === 'object' && r.m1 && r.m1.floors) {
          var mf = r.m1.floors.filter(function (x) { return x.floor === fl; })[0];
          if (mf && typeof mf.kills === 'number') perFloor[fl].kills.push(mf.kills);
        }
        perFloor[fl].level.push(z.levelOut);
        perFloor[fl].hp.push(z.hpOut);
        if (z.floor === 5) {
          d.f5.states.push({
            seed: r.seed, hp: z.hpOut, maxHp: z.maxHpOut, level: z.levelOut,
            outcome: r.outcome
          });
        }
      }
      for (var k in reached) d.floorReach[k] = (d.floorReach[k] || 0) + 1;
      if (r.d39 && r.d39.floorEnter) {
        for (var fe = 0; fe < r.d39.floorEnter.length; fe++) {
          var en = r.d39.floorEnter[fe];
          if (en.floor === 5) d.f5.enterStates.push({
            seed: r.seed, hp: en.hp, maxHp: en.maxHp, level: en.level,
            hpPct: en.maxHp ? Math.round((en.hp / en.maxHp) * 1000) / 10 : null
          });
        }
      }
      var lvF3 = 0;
      for (var q = 0; q < ends.length; q++) if (ends[q].floor <= 3 && ends[q].levelOut > lvF3) lvF3 = ends[q].levelOut;
      if (lvF3 >= 5) d.l5ByF3++;
      if (r.d42 && r.d42.boss) {
        for (var bid in r.d42.boss) {
          if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r.d42.boss, bid)) continue;
          var b = r.d42.boss[bid];
          var cur = d.boss[bid] || (d.boss[bid] = { encounters: 0, maxDealtPct: 0, bestSeed: null, killed: 0 });
          cur.encounters++;
          if (b.dealtPct > cur.maxDealtPct) { cur.maxDealtPct = b.dealtPct; cur.bestSeed = r.seed; }
          if (b.killed) cur.killed++;
        }
      }
    }
    for (var k2 in perFloor) {
      d.floorKills[k2] = mean(perFloor[k2].kills);
      d.floorLevel[k2] = mean(perFloor[k2].level);
      d.floorHp[k2] = mean(perFloor[k2].hp);
    }
    d.f5.reached = d.f5.states.length;
    d.killsPerRun = Math.round((d.killsTotal / Math.max(1, runs.length)) * 100) / 100;
    return d;
  }
  /* D-43：血量账汇总（每层承伤/回复/比值、按来源拆分、药水护栏） */
  function aggD43(runs) {
    var perFloor = {}, dmgSrc = {}, dmgByMonster = {}, healSrc = {}, absorb = 0;
    var gained = [], used = [], f3exit = [], runMaxUse = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i], d = r.d43;
      if (!d) continue;

      if (use > runMaxUse) runMaxUse = use;
      used.push(use);
      for (var s in d.totals.damage) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(d.totals.damage, s)) {

      }
      for (var ms in d.totals.damageByMonster) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(d.totals.damageByMonster, ms)) {
        addTo(dmgByMonster, ms, d.totals.damageByMonster[ms]);
      }
      for (var hs in d.totals.heal) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(d.totals.heal, hs)) {
        addTo(healSrc, hs, d.totals.heal[hs]);
      }
      absorb += d.totals.absorb;
      for (var f = 0; f < d.floors.length; f++) {

          potionsGained: 0, potionUses: 0, levelOut: 0, actions: 0, balanceBad: 0, ratioSum: 0, ratioN: 0

        p.hpIn += z.hpIn; p.hpOut += z.hpOut;

        p.potionsGained += z.potionsGained;
        p.potionUses += z.potionUses;
        p.levelOut += z.levelOut;
        p.actions += z.actions;
        p.balanceBad += (z.balance === 0) ? 0 : 1;
        if (z.ratio !== null) { p.ratioSum += z.ratio; p.ratioN++; }
        gained.push(z.potionsGained);
        if (z.floor === 3) f3exit.push({ seed: r.seed, hp: z.hpOut, maxHp: z.maxHpOut,
          hpPct: z.maxHpOut ? Math.round((z.hpOut / z.maxHpOut) * 1000) / 10 : null });
      }
    }
    var floors = [];
    for (var k in perFloor) {
      var q = perFloor[k];
      floors.push({
        floor: +k, runs: q.n,
        avgDamage: Math.round((q.damage / q.n) * 100) / 100,
        avgHeal: Math.round((q.heal / q.n) * 100) / 100,
        ratio: q.heal > 0 ? Math.round((q.damage / q.heal) * 1000) / 1000 : null,
        avgRatioOfRuns: q.ratioN ? Math.round((q.ratioSum / q.ratioN) * 1000) / 1000 : null,
        avgHpIn: Math.round((q.hpIn / q.n) * 100) / 100,
        avgHpOut: Math.round((q.hpOut / q.n) * 100) / 100,
        avgHpPctOut: Math.round((q.hpPctOut / q.n) * 10) / 10,
        avgPotionsGained: Math.round((q.potionsGained / q.n) * 100) / 100,
        avgPotionUses: Math.round((q.potionUses / q.n) * 100) / 100,
        avgLevelOut: Math.round((q.levelOut / q.n) * 100) / 100,
        balanceBad: q.balanceBad
      });
    }
    floors.sort(function (a, b) { return a.floor - b.floor; });
    var tDmg = 0;
    for (var ds in dmgSrc) tDmg += dmgSrc[ds];
    var srcShare = {};
    for (var ds2 in dmgSrc) srcShare[ds2] = tDmg ? Math.round((dmgSrc[ds2] / tDmg) * 1000) / 10 : 0;
    return {
      runs: runs.length, floors: floors,
      damageBySource: dmgSrc, damageSharePct: srcShare,
      damageByMonster: dmgByMonster, healBySource: healSrc, shieldAbsorb: absorb,

        minHpPct: f3exit.length ? Math.min.apply(null, f3exit.map(function (x) { return x.hpPct || 0; })) : null

  function statOf(res, strategy) {

/* D-44 跑局器（只测量）：
 *   ?n=50                 种子 1001..1000+n（默认 50）
 *   ?only=b1|g2|s1|m1     只跑一组（默认四组都跑）
 *   ?mode=neg             B1 的两项负例：negAvoid（不绕怪）/ negReserve（不补药）
 *   ?mode=probe           S1 seed 1014 单局 + 逐回合战斗日志（回答"48.8% 是药不够还是输出不够"）
 * 四组策略同种子 1001–1050、maxActions 2500、同一起点；不传 b1/d44log 时既有策略逐帧不变。 */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = {
    protocol: 'D-44', mode: 'all', strategy: {}, env: {}, summary: {},
    runs: {}, agg: {}, b1: {}, neg: {}, probe: null, ok: false
  };
  function mean(a) {
    if (!a.length) return 0;
    var s = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) s += a[i];
    return Math.round((s / a.length) * 100) / 100;

  function addTo(o, k, v) { o[k] = (o[k] || 0) + v; }

  /* 与 D-42/D-43 同口径的到达/死层汇总（B 组逐字段可比） */
  function aggBase(runs) {
    var d = {
      outcomes: { win: 0, dead: 0, stuck: 0 }, deathFloor: {},
      floorReach: {}, floorKills: {}, floorLevel: {}, floorHp: {},
      f5: { reached: 0, states: [] }, l5ByF3: 0,
      killsTotal: 0, killsPerRun: 0, boss: {}
    };
    var perFloor = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i];
      if (r.outcome === 'win') d.outcomes.win++;
      else if (r.outcome === 'dead') d.outcomes.dead++;
      else d.outcomes.stuck++;
      if (r.outcome !== 'win') d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] = (d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] || 0) + 1;
      d.killsTotal += r.kills || 0;
      var reached = {}, hitF5 = (r.floor === 5);
      var ends = r.floors || [];

        reached[fl] = 1;
        if (fl === 5) hitF5 = true;

        perFloor[fl].n++;
        perFloor[fl].level.push(z.level);
        perFloor[fl].hp.push(z.hp);
      }
      for (var k in reached) d.floorReach[k] = (d.floorReach[k] || 0) + 1;

          potions: (r.b1 && r.b1.enterF5) ? r.b1.enterF5.potions : null, outcome: r.outcome

      for (var q = 0; q < ends.length; q++) if (ends[q].floor <= 3 && ends[q].level > lvF3) lvF3 = ends[q].level;
      if (lvF3 >= 5) d.l5ByF3++;
      if (r.d42 && r.d42.boss) {
        for (var bid in r.d42.boss) {
          if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r.d42.boss, bid)) continue;
          var b = r.d42.boss[bid];
          var cur = d.boss[bid] || (d.boss[bid] = { encounters: 0, maxDealtPct: 0, bestSeed: null, killed: 0 });
          cur.encounters++;
          if (b.dealtPct > cur.maxDealtPct) { cur.maxDealtPct = b.dealtPct; cur.bestSeed = r.seed; }
          if (b.killed) cur.killed++;
        }
      }
    }
    for (var k2 in perFloor) {
      d.floorLevel[k2] = mean(perFloor[k2].level);
      d.floorHp[k2] = mean(perFloor[k2].hp);
    }
    d.killsPerRun = Math.round((d.killsTotal / Math.max(1, runs.length)) * 100) / 100;
    return d;
  }

  /* B1 专属汇总：主动/挡路/巡逻/ Boss 分类、进 F5 药量、每层进出状态、龙战 */
  function aggB1(runs) {
    var a = {
      runs: runs.length, active: 0, forced: 0, patrol: 0, boss: 0, battles: 0, race: 0,
      activeByFloor: {}, forcedByFloor: {},
      reserve: { need: 4, reachF5: 0, pass: 0, min: null, max: null, values: [], fails: [] },
      shop: { visits: 0, buys: 0, spent: 0, potionsBought: 0, equipBought: 0, soldCount: 0, soldGold: 0 },
      floors: { enter: {}, exit: {} },
      dragon: { attempts: 0, runs: 0, kills: 0, bestDealt: 0, bestDealtPct: 0, bestSeed: null, best: null },
      wins: [], winSequences: [],
      potionUsesMax: 0, potionUsesAvg: 0
    };
    var use = [], ent = {}, ext = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i], b = r.b1;
      if (!b) continue;
      a.battles += b.battles || 0;
      a.active += b.active || 0;
      a.forced += b.forced || 0;
      a.patrol += b.patrol || 0;
      a.race += b.race || 0;
      a.boss += b.boss || 0;
      for (var af in b.activeByFloor) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(b.activeByFloor, af)) {
        a.activeByFloor[af] = (a.activeByFloor[af] || 0) + b.activeByFloor[af];
      }
      a.shop.visits += b.shopVisits || 0;
      a.shop.buys += b.shopBuys || 0;
      a.shop.spent += b.shopSpent || 0;
      a.shop.potionsBought += b.potionsBought || 0;
      a.shop.equipBought += b.equipBought || 0;
      a.shop.soldCount += b.soldCount || 0;
      a.shop.soldGold += b.soldGold || 0;
      if (b.dragon) {
        a.dragon.attempts += b.dragon.battles || 0;
        a.dragon.runs += b.dragon.reached ? 1 : 0;
        a.dragon.kills += b.dragon.killed || 0;
        if (b.dragon.best && b.dragon.best.dealt > a.dragon.bestDealt) {
          a.dragon.bestDealt = b.dragon.best.dealt;
          a.dragon.bestDealtPct = Math.round((b.dragon.best.dealt / 260) * 1000) / 10;
          a.dragon.bestSeed = r.seed;
          a.dragon.best = b.dragon.best;
        }
      }
      var uses = 0;
      for (var e = 0; e < (b.floorExit || []).length; e++) {
        var z = b.floorExit[e];
        var pe = ext[z.floor] || (ext[z.floor] = { n: 0, hp: 0, hpPct: 0, mp: 0, level: 0, gold: 0, potions: 0, kills: 0, actions: 0 });
        pe.n++; pe.hp += z.hp; pe.hpPct += z.maxHp ? (z.hp / z.maxHp) * 100 : 0;
        pe.mp += z.mp; pe.level += z.level; pe.gold += z.gold;
        pe.potions += z.potionsOut; pe.kills += z.kills; pe.actions += z.actions;
      }
      for (var n = 0; n < (b.floorEnter || []).length; n++) {
        var y = b.floorEnter[n];
        var q = ent[y.floor] || (ent[y.floor] = { n: 0, hp: 0, hpPct: 0, mp: 0, level: 0, gold: 0, potions: 0 });
        q.n++; q.hp += y.hp; q.hpPct += y.maxHp ? (y.hp / y.maxHp) * 100 : 0;
        q.mp += y.mp; q.level += y.level; q.gold += y.gold; q.potions += y.potions;
      }
      if (b.enterF5) {
        a.reserve.reachF5++;
        a.reserve.values.push({ seed: r.seed, potions: b.enterF5.potions, pass: b.enterF5.potions >= 4 });
        if (b.enterF5.potions >= 4) a.reserve.pass++;
        else a.reserve.fails.push({ seed: r.seed, potions: b.enterF5.potions });
        if (a.reserve.min === null || b.enterF5.potions < a.reserve.min) a.reserve.min = b.enterF5.potions;
        if (a.reserve.max === null || b.enterF5.potions > a.reserve.max) a.reserve.max = b.enterF5.potions;
      }
      if (r.outcome === 'win') {
        a.wins.push(r.seed);
        if (b.winSequence) a.winSequences.push({ seed: r.seed, seq: b.winSequence });
      }
      var pu = 0, allB = (r.d44 && r.d44.battles) || [];
      for (var s = 0; s < allB.length; s++) pu += allB[s].potionUses || 0;
      use.push(pu);
      if (pu > a.potionUsesMax) a.potionUsesMax = pu;
    }
    a.potionUsesAvg = mean(use);
    function rows(src) {
      var o = {};
      for (var k in src) {
        var x = src[k];
        o[k] = {
          runs: x.n, avgHp: Math.round((x.hp / x.n) * 100) / 100,
          avgHpPct: Math.round((x.hpPct / x.n) * 10) / 10,
          avgMp: Math.round((x.mp / x.n) * 100) / 100,
          avgLevel: Math.round((x.level / x.n) * 100) / 100,
          avgGold: Math.round((x.gold / x.n) * 100) / 100,
          avgPotions: Math.round((x.potions / x.n) * 100) / 100
        };
        if (x.kills !== undefined) {
          o[k].avgKills = Math.round((x.kills / x.n) * 100) / 100;
          o[k].avgActions = Math.round((x.actions / x.n) * 100) / 100;
        }
      }
      return o;
    }
    a.floors.enter = rows(ent);
    a.floors.exit = rows(ext);
    return a;
  }

  /* 紧凑 run：四组共用字段（B 组逐项可比），B1 额外带每层快照与 F5 逐回合 */
  function trimRun(r, strategy) {
    var o = {
      seed: r.seed, outcome: r.outcome, deathFloor: r.deathFloor || r.floor, floor: r.floor,
      hp: r.hp, level: r.level, gold: r.gold, equip: r.equip, kills: r.kills,
      battles: r.battles, actions: r.actions, simSec: r.simSec,
      shopVisits: r.shopVisits, shopBuys: r.shopBuys, shopSpent: r.shopSpent,
      potions: r.potions, d42: r.d42 || null,
      death: r.death || null, deathCause: r.deathCause || null
    };
    if (strategy === 'b1') {
      o.maxHp = r.b1 ? (r.b1.enterF5 ? r.b1.enterF5.maxHp : (r.b1.final ? r.b1.final.maxHp : null)) : null;
      o.b1 = r.b1;
      o.battleSummaries = ((r.d44 && r.d44.battles) || []).map(function (b) {
        return {
          floor: b.floor, monsterId: b.monsterId, kind: b.kind, result: b.result,
          nRounds: b.nRounds, dealt: b.dealt, taken: b.taken, potionUses: b.potionUses
        };
      });
      o.f5Battles = ((r.d44 && r.d44.battles) || []).filter(function (b) {
        return b.floor === 5 || b.monsterId === 'dragon';
      });
    }
    return o;
  }

    var M = Game.Core.Main;
    M.init();
    M.closeGuide();
    var qs = location.search || '';
    var mn = /n=(\d+)/.exec(qs), mo = /only=(b1|g2|s1|m1)/.exec(qs);

    out.env.seeds = seeds;

      if (key === 'g2') return { maxActions: 2500, d37: { fireball: true, flee: true }, d42: true };
      if (key === 's1') return { maxActions: 2500, d39: { avoid: true }, d42: true };
      return { maxActions: 2500, m1: { clear: true }, d42: true };
    }

    if (/mode=probe/.test(qs)) {

      out.mode = 'probe';
      out.probe = {

      };
      out.ok = true;

      window.__D44__ = out;

      return;
    }

    if (/mode=neg/.test(qs)) {
      var nn = Math.min(n, 20);
      var negSeeds = seedsOf(nn);
      var avoid = Game.Bot.batch(negSeeds, { maxActions: 2500, b1: { reserve: 4, negAvoid: true }, d42: true });
      var reserve = Game.Bot.batch(negSeeds, { maxActions: 2500, b1: { reserve: 4, negReserve: true }, d42: true });
      out.mode = 'neg';
      out.neg = {
        seeds: negSeeds,
        avoid: { agg: aggBase(avoid.runs), b1: aggB1(avoid.runs), runs: avoid.runs.map(function (r) { return trimRun(r, 'b1'); }) },
        reserve: { agg: aggBase(reserve.runs), b1: aggB1(reserve.runs), runs: reserve.runs.map(function (r) { return trimRun(r, 'b1'); }) }
      };
      out.ok = true;
      document.title = 'NEG_DONE avoidActive=' + out.neg.avoid.b1.active +
        ' reservePass=' + out.neg.reserve.b1.reserve.pass + '/' + out.neg.reserve.b1.reserve.reachF5;
      window.__D44__ = out;
      document.getElementById('report').textContent = JSON.stringify(out);
      return;
    }

    var plan = mo ? [mo[1]] : ['b1', 'g2', 's1', 'm1'];
    var t0 = Date.now();
    for (var p = 0; p < plan.length; p++) {
      var key = plan[p], res = Game.Bot.batch(seeds, optsFor(key));
      out.runs[key] = res.runs.map(function (r) { return trimRun(r, key); });
      out.summary[key] = res.summary;
      out.agg[key] = aggBase(res.runs);
      out.strategy[key] = optsFor(key);
      if (key === 'b1') out.b1 = aggB1(res.runs);
    }
    out.wallMs = Date.now() - t0;
    out.ok = true;
    document.title = 'BATCH_DONE n=' + n +
      ' b1_f5=' + out.agg.b1.f5.reached +
      ' b1_dragon=' + out.b1.dragon.attempts +
      ' b1_kills=' + out.b1.dragon.kills +
      ' b1_reserve=' + out.b1.reserve.pass + '/' + out.b1.reserve.reachF5 +
      ' g2_f5=' + out.agg.g2.f5.reached +
      ' s1_f5=' + out.agg.s1.f5.reached +
      ' m1_f4=' + (out.agg.m1.floorReach['4'] || 0) +
      ' wallMs=' + out.wallMs;
  } catch (e) {
    out.err = String((e && (e.message + '\n' + (e.orig || e.stack))) || e);
    document.title = 'BATCH_FAIL';
  }
  window.__D44__ = out;
  document.getElementById('report').textContent = JSON.stringify(out);
})();

/* D-45 跑局器（只测量）：
 *   ?mode=main（默认）      B1 50 种子带商店遥测 + G2/S1/M1 同种子对照
 *   ?mode=tiers&seed=1042   种子 1042 的武器档位反事实（F5 起点换武器，其余不变）
 *   ?mode=neg               把商店武器档位还原成 D-44 原表后复跑 B1（负例：通关率应回到 1/50）
 * 种子 1001–1050、maxActions 2500，与 D-37/D-39..D-44 完全一致。 */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = {
    protocol: 'D-45', mode: 'main', env: {}, summary: {}, runs: {}, agg: {},
    b1: {}, d45: null, tiers: null, neg: null, ok: false
  };
  function mean(a) {
    if (!a.length) return 0;
    var s = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) s += a[i];
    return Math.round((s / a.length) * 100) / 100;
  }
  function seedsOf(n) { var a = []; for (var i = 1001; i < 1001 + n; i++) a.push(i); return a; }

  /* 与 D-44 同口径的到达/死层汇总 */
  function aggBase(runs) {
    var d = {
      outcomes: { win: 0, dead: 0, stuck: 0 }, deathFloor: {},
      floorReach: {}, floorKills: {}, floorLevel: {}, floorHp: {},
      f5: { reached: 0, states: [] }, l5ByF3: 0,
      killsTotal: 0, killsPerRun: 0, boss: {}
    };
    var perFloor = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i];
      if (r.outcome === 'win') d.outcomes.win++;
      else if (r.outcome === 'dead') d.outcomes.dead++;
      else d.outcomes.stuck++;
      if (r.outcome !== 'win') d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] = (d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] || 0) + 1;
      d.killsTotal += r.kills || 0;
      var reached = {}, hitF5 = (r.floor === 5);
      var ends = r.b1 ? (r.b1.floorExit || []) : (r.floors || []);
      for (var f = 0; f < ends.length; f++) {
        var z = ends[f], fl = z.floor;
        reached[fl] = 1;
        if (fl === 5) hitF5 = true;
        if (!perFloor[fl]) perFloor[fl] = { level: [], hp: [], n: 0 };
        perFloor[fl].n++;
        perFloor[fl].level.push(z.level);
        perFloor[fl].hp.push(z.hp);
      }
      /* B1 没走到出层（死在层内）时，floorExit 缺这一层；用 floorEnter 补到达口径 */
      if (r.b1) {
        for (var en = 0; en < (r.b1.floorEnter || []).length; en++) {
          var efl = r.b1.floorEnter[en].floor;
          reached[efl] = 1;
          if (efl === 5) hitF5 = true;
        }
      }
      for (var k in reached) d.floorReach[k] = (d.floorReach[k] || 0) + 1;
      if (hitF5) {
        d.f5.reached++;
        d.f5.states.push({
          seed: r.seed, hp: r.hp, level: r.level,
          potions: (r.b1 && r.b1.enterF5) ? r.b1.enterF5.potions : null, outcome: r.outcome
        });
      }
      var lvF3 = 0;
      for (var q = 0; q < ends.length; q++) if (ends[q].floor <= 3 && ends[q].level > lvF3) lvF3 = ends[q].level;
      if (lvF3 >= 5) d.l5ByF3++;
      if (r.d42 && r.d42.boss) {
        for (var bid in r.d42.boss) {
          if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r.d42.boss, bid)) continue;
          var b = r.d42.boss[bid];
          var cur = d.boss[bid] || (d.boss[bid] = { encounters: 0, maxDealtPct: 0, bestSeed: null, killed: 0 });
          cur.encounters++;
          if (b.dealtPct > cur.maxDealtPct) { cur.maxDealtPct = b.dealtPct; cur.bestSeed = r.seed; }
          if (b.killed) cur.killed++;
        }
      }
    }
    for (var k2 in perFloor) {
      d.floorLevel[k2] = mean(perFloor[k2].level);
      d.floorHp[k2] = mean(perFloor[k2].hp);
    }
    d.killsPerRun = Math.round((d.killsTotal / Math.max(1, runs.length)) * 100) / 100;
    return d;
  }

  /* B1 专属汇总（与 D-44 同字段，便于逐项对照） */
  function aggB1(runs) {
    var a = {
      runs: runs.length, active: 0, forced: 0, patrol: 0, boss: 0, battles: 0, race: 0,
      shop: { visits: 0, buys: 0, spent: 0, potionsBought: 0, equipBought: 0, soldCount: 0, soldGold: 0 },
      reserve: { need: 4, reachF5: 0, pass: 0, min: null, max: null },

      a.patrol += b.patrol || 0;

      a.shop.visits += b.shopVisits || 0;
      a.shop.buys += b.shopBuys || 0;
      a.shop.spent += b.shopSpent || 0;
      a.shop.potionsBought += b.potionsBought || 0;
      a.shop.equipBought += b.equipBought || 0;
      a.shop.soldCount += b.soldCount || 0;
      a.shop.soldGold += b.soldGold || 0;
      if (b.dragon) {

        a.dragon.runs += b.dragon.reached ? 1 : 0;
        a.dragon.kills += b.dragon.killed || 0;
        if (b.dragon.best && b.dragon.best.dealt > a.dragon.bestDealt) {
          a.dragon.bestDealt = b.dragon.best.dealt;
          a.dragon.bestDealtPct = Math.round((b.dragon.best.dealt / 260) * 1000) / 10;
          a.dragon.bestSeed = r.seed;
          a.dragon.best = b.dragon.best;
        }
      }
      if (b.enterF5) {
        a.reserve.reachF5++;
        if (b.enterF5.potions >= 4) a.reserve.pass++;
        if (a.reserve.min === null || b.enterF5.potions < a.reserve.min) a.reserve.min = b.enterF5.potions;
        if (a.reserve.max === null || b.enterF5.potions > a.reserve.max) a.reserve.max = b.enterF5.potions;
        a.f5Enter.push({
          seed: r.seed, potions: b.enterF5.potions, hp: b.enterF5.hp, maxHp: b.enterF5.maxHp,
          level: b.enterF5.level, gold: b.enterF5.gold, atk: b.enterF5.atk, def: b.enterF5.def,
          weaponId: b.enterF5.weaponId, armorId: b.enterF5.armorId, outcome: r.outcome
        });
      }
      if (r.outcome === 'win') a.wins.push(r.seed);
    }
    return a;
  }

  /* D-45 A 组：把每个"到 F5 的局"逐层拆开。
   * 单位 = 层商店机会（F1..F5 中真正到达的层）；每次开张按武器决策分类：
   *   bought / noStock / goldShort / priority；到达却没开张 = noEntry。 */
  function aggD45(runs) {
    var res = {
      f5Runs: 0, floorsReached: 0,
      counts: { bought: 0, noStock: 0, goldShort: 0, priority: 0, noEntry: 0 },
      failures: 0, shares: {}, rows: [], shelfWeapons: {}, equipBuys: 0
    };
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i], b = r.b1;
      if (!b || !b.enterF5) continue;
      res.f5Runs++;
      res.equipBuys += b.equipBought || 0;
      var floors = [];
      for (var e = 0; e < (b.floorEnter || []).length; e++) {
        var fl = b.floorEnter[e].floor;
        if (floors.indexOf(fl) < 0) floors.push(fl);
      }
      floors.sort();
      var shops = (r.d45 && r.d45.shops) || [];
      var missed = (r.d45 && r.d45.missed) || [];
      var row = { seed: r.seed, outcome: r.outcome, floors: [], equipBuys: b.equipBought || 0 };
      for (var fi = 0; fi < floors.length; fi++) {
        var f = floors[fi];
        res.floorsReached++;
        var visits = [];
        for (var s = 0; s < shops.length; s++) if (shops[s].floor === f) visits.push(shops[s]);
        var miss = 0;
        for (var m = 0; m < missed.length; m++) if (missed[m].floor === f) miss++;
        if (!visits.length) {
          res.counts.noEntry++;
          row.floors.push({ floor: f, visits: 0, missed: miss, reason: 'noEntry', gold: null, shelf: [] });
          continue;
        }
        for (var v = 0; v < visits.length; v++) {
          var sh = visits[v];
          res.counts[sh.reason] = (res.counts[sh.reason] || 0) + 1;
          var shelf = [];
          for (var k = 0; k < sh.stock.length; k++) {
            var it = sh.stock[k];
            if (it.type !== 'weapon' && it.type !== 'armor') continue;
            shelf.push({
              id: it.id, type: it.type, price: it.price, atk: it.atk, def: it.def,
              up: it.type === 'weapon' ? it.weaponUp : it.armorUp,
              owned: it.owned, affordable: it.affordable
            });
            if (it.type === 'weapon') {
              res.shelfWeapons[it.id] = (res.shelfWeapons[it.id] || 0) + 1;
            }
          }
          row.floors.push({
            floor: f, visits: visits.length, missed: miss,
            gold: sh.gold, goldIn: sh.goldIn, soldGold: sh.soldGold,
            weaponAtk: sh.weaponAtk, weaponId: sh.weaponId,
            reason: sh.reason, bought: sh.bought, shelf: shelf,
            goldAfter: sh.goldAfter
          });
        }
      }
      res.rows.push(row);
    }
    res.failures = res.counts.noStock + res.counts.goldShort + res.counts.priority + res.counts.noEntry;
    var keys = ['noStock', 'goldShort', 'noEntry', 'priority'];
    for (var x = 0; x < keys.length; x++) {
      res.shares[keys[x]] = res.failures ?
        Math.round((res.counts[keys[x]] / res.failures) * 1000) / 10 : 0;
    }
    var sum = 0;
    for (var y = 0; y < keys.length; y++) sum += res.shares[keys[y]];
    res.shareSum = Math.round(sum * 10) / 10;
    return res;
  }

  function trimRun(r, strategy) {
    var o = {
      seed: r.seed, outcome: r.outcome, deathFloor: r.deathFloor || r.floor, floor: r.floor,
      hp: r.hp, level: r.level, gold: r.gold, equip: r.equip, kills: r.kills,
      battles: r.battles, actions: r.actions, simSec: r.simSec,
      shopVisits: r.shopVisits, shopBuys: r.shopBuys, shopSpent: r.shopSpent,
      potions: r.potions, d42: r.d42 || null,
      death: r.death || null, deathCause: r.deathCause || null
    };
    if (strategy === 'b1') {
      o.maxHp = r.b1 ? (r.b1.enterF5 ? r.b1.enterF5.maxHp : (r.b1.final ? r.b1.final.maxHp : null)) : null;
      o.b1 = r.b1;
      o.d45 = r.d45 || null;
      o.f5Battles = ((r.d44 && r.d44.battles) || []).filter(function (b) {
        return b.floor === 5 || b.monsterId === 'dragon';
      });
    }
    return o;
  }

  /* D-44 原商店核心货架（负例用：还原武器档位后再跑，通关率应回到 1/50） */
  var D44_SHOP_STOCK = [
    ['potion_small', 'potion_large', 'knife', 'machete', 'sword_rusty', 'sword_iron', 'armor_leather'],
    ['potion_large', 'potion_mana', 'sword_steel', 'axe_war', 'bow_hunter', 'hammer', 'spear', 'chain_mail', 'robe_mage'],
    ['potion_xl', 'sword_magic', 'staff_fire', 'axe_double', 'sword_anime', 'plate_armor',
      'sword_dragon', 'sword_dragon_rare', 'sword_dragon_epic'],
    ['potion_xl', 'potion_mana', 'sword_magic_rare', 'sword_steel_epic',
      'chain_mail_rare', 'plate_armor_rare', 'robe_mage_rare', 'sword_dragon_rare'],
    ['potion_xl', 'potion_mana', 'sword_magic_epic', 'sword_dragon_epic',
      'plate_armor_epic', 'chain_mail_epic', 'robe_mage_epic', 'sword_dragon_rare']
  ];

  try {
    var M = Game.Core.Main;
    M.init();
    M.closeGuide();
    var qs = location.search || '';
    var mn = /n=(\d+)/.exec(qs), mo = /only=(b1|g2|s1|m1)/.exec(qs), ms = /seed=(\d+)/.exec(qs);
    var n = mn ? Math.max(1, Math.min(200, +mn[1])) : 50;
    out.env.maxActions = 2500;
    out.env.seeds = seedsOf(n);
    out.env.shopStock = JSON.stringify(Game.Data.SHOP_STOCK);
    out.env.chestLoot = JSON.stringify(Game.Data.CHEST_LOOT);

    /* ── tiers：武器档位反事实（seed 默认 1042） ───────────────── */
    if (/mode=tiers/.test(qs)) {
      var ts = ms ? +ms[1] : 1042;
      var TIERS = [
        { id: null, name: '自然（不换）' },
        { id: 'knife', name: 'knife atk1' },
        { id: 'sword_iron', name: 'sword_iron atk3' },
        { id: 'sword_steel', name: 'sword_steel atk5' },
        { id: 'sword_dragon', name: 'sword_dragon atk8' },
        { id: 'sword_anime', name: 'sword_anime atk12' },
        { id: 'sword_dragon_rare', name: 'sword_dragon_rare atk12' },
        { id: 'sword_magic_epic', name: 'sword_magic_epic atk16' },
        { id: 'sword_dragon_epic', name: 'sword_dragon_epic atk16' }
      ];
      out.mode = 'tiers';
      out.tiers = { seed: ts, rows: [] };
      for (var t = 0; t < TIERS.length; t++) {
        var opts = { maxActions: 2500, b1: { reserve: 4 }, d42: true, d44log: true, d45: true };
        if (TIERS[t].id) opts.d45Probe = { weapon: TIERS[t].id };
        var rr = Game.Bot.run(ts, opts);
        var dr = (rr.d44 && rr.d44.battles ? rr.d44.battles : []).filter(function (b) { return b.monsterId === 'dragon'; });
        var best = dr.length ? dr[0] : (rr.b1 && rr.b1.dragon ? rr.b1.dragon.best : null);
        out.tiers.rows.push({
          probe: TIERS[t].id, name: TIERS[t].name,
          outcome: rr.outcome, deathFloor: rr.deathFloor || rr.floor,
          enterF5: rr.b1 ? rr.b1.enterF5 : null,
          dragon: best,
          dragonHpLeft: best ? Math.max(0, 260 - best.dealt) : null,
          dealtPct: best ? Math.round((best.dealt / 260) * 1000) / 10 : null,
          win: rr.outcome === 'win'
        });
      }
      out.ok = true;
      document.title = 'TIERS_DONE seed=' + ts + ' rows=' + out.tiers.rows.length;
      window.__D45__ = out;
      document.getElementById('report').textContent = JSON.stringify(out);
      return;
    }

    /* ── ceiling：全种子 F5 起点统一换武器（上限测量：供给无限好能到哪） ── */
    if (/mode=ceiling/.test(qs)) {
      var mw = /weapon=([a-z_]+)/.exec(qs);
      var wsel = mw ? mw[1] : 'sword_dragon_epic';
      var from1 = /from1=1/.test(qs);
      out.mode = 'ceiling';
      out.ceiling = { weapon: wsel, from1: from1, runs: null, agg: null, b1: null };
      var cr = Game.Bot.batch(out.env.seeds, {
        maxActions: 2500, b1: { reserve: 4 }, d42: true, d45: true,
        d45Probe: { weapon: wsel, from1: from1 }
      });
      out.ceiling.agg = aggBase(cr.runs);
      out.ceiling.b1 = aggB1(cr.runs);
      out.ceiling.runs = cr.runs.map(function (r) { return trimRun(r, 'b1'); });
      out.ok = true;
      document.title = 'CEILING_DONE w=' + wsel + ' wins=' + out.ceiling.agg.outcomes.win +
        ' f5=' + out.ceiling.agg.f5.reached + ' dragonKills=' + out.ceiling.b1.dragon.kills +
        '/' + out.ceiling.b1.dragon.attempts;
      window.__D45__ = out;
      document.getElementById('report').textContent = JSON.stringify(out);
      return;
    }

    /* ── neg：还原 D-44 商店核心货架，复跑 B1 ───────────────────── */
    if (/mode=neg/.test(qs)) {
      Game.Data.SHOP_STOCK = D44_SHOP_STOCK;
      out.mode = 'neg';
      var negRuns = Game.Bot.batch(seedsOf(n), { maxActions: 2500, b1: { reserve: 4 }, d42: true });
      out.neg = {
        stock: D44_SHOP_STOCK,
        agg: aggBase(negRuns.runs),
        b1: aggB1(negRuns.runs),
        runs: negRuns.runs.map(function (r) { return trimRun(r, 'b1'); })
      };
      out.ok = true;
      document.title = 'NEG_DONE wins=' + out.neg.agg.outcomes.win + '/' + n +
        ' f5=' + out.neg.agg.f5.reached + ' dragonKills=' + out.neg.b1.dragon.kills;
      window.__D45__ = out;
      document.getElementById('report').textContent = JSON.stringify(out);
      return;
    }

    /* ── main：B1 全量遥测 + G2/S1/M1 同种子对照 ───────────────── */
    var OLD = { maxActions: 2500, d42: true };
    function optsFor(key) {
      if (key === 'b1') return { maxActions: 2500, b1: { reserve: 4 }, d42: true, d45: true };
      if (key === 'g2') return { maxActions: 2500, d37: { fireball: true, flee: true }, d42: true };
      if (key === 's1') return { maxActions: 2500, d39: { avoid: true }, d42: true };
      return { maxActions: 2500, m1: { clear: true }, d42: true };
    }
    var plan = mo ? [mo[1]] : ['b1', 'g2', 's1', 'm1'];
    var t0 = Date.now();
    for (var p = 0; p < plan.length; p++) {
      var key = plan[p], res = Game.Bot.batch(out.env.seeds, optsFor(key));
      out.runs[key] = res.runs.map(function (r) { return trimRun(r, key); });
      out.summary[key] = res.summary;
      out.agg[key] = aggBase(res.runs);
      if (key === 'b1') out.b1 = aggB1(res.runs);
    }
    out.d45 = aggD45(out.runs.b1 || []);
    out.wallMs = Date.now() - t0;
    out.ok = true;
    document.title = 'BATCH_DONE n=' + n +
      ' b1_win=' + out.agg.b1.outcomes.win +
      ' b1_f5=' + out.agg.b1.f5.reached +
      ' b1_dragon=' + out.b1.dragon.kills + '/' + out.b1.dragon.attempts +
      ' equipBuys=' + out.d45.equipBuys +
      ' noStock=' + out.d45.counts.noStock +
      ' goldShort=' + out.d45.counts.goldShort +
      ' noEntry=' + out.d45.counts.noEntry +
      ' priority=' + out.d45.counts.priority +
      ' m1_f4=' + (out.agg.m1 ? out.agg.m1.floorReach['4'] : '-') +
      ' wallMs=' + out.wallMs;
  } catch (e) {
    out.err = String((e && (e.message + '\n' + (e.orig || e.stack))) || e);
    document.title = 'BATCH_FAIL';
  }
  window.__D45__ = out;
  document.getElementById('report').textContent = JSON.stringify(out);
})();
</script>

<script>
/* D-46 跑局器（只测量）：
 *   ?mode=main（默认）  B1 50 种子（金币账 + 商店遥测）+ G2/S1/M1 同种子对照
 *   ?mode=neg          把奖励点还原（REWARD.floors 清空）后复跑 B1（负例：应回到 D-45 基线）
 *   ?only=b1&n=50      只跑 B1（调参时用；不改任何判据）
 * 种子 1001–1050、maxActions 2500，与 D-37..D-45 完全一致。 */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = {
    protocol: 'D-46', mode: 'main', env: {}, summary: {}, runs: {}, agg: {},
    b1: {}, d45: null, d46: null, neg: null, ok: false
  };
  function mean(a) {
    if (!a.length) return 0;
    var s = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) s += a[i];
    return Math.round((s / a.length) * 100) / 100;
  }
  function median(a) {
    if (!a.length) return null;
    var s = a.slice().sort(function (x, y) { return x - y; });
    return s[Math.floor(s.length / 2)];
  }
  function seedsOf(n) { var a = []; for (var i = 1001; i < 1001 + n; i++) a.push(i); return a; }

  /* 与 D-44/D-45 同口径的到达/死层汇总 */
  function aggBase(runs) {
    var d = {
      outcomes: { win: 0, dead: 0, stuck: 0 }, deathFloor: {},
      floorReach: {}, floorLevel: {}, floorHp: {},
      f5: { reached: 0, states: [] }, l5ByF3: 0,
      killsTotal: 0, killsPerRun: 0, boss: {}
    };
    var perFloor = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i];
      if (r.outcome === 'win') d.outcomes.win++;
      else if (r.outcome === 'dead') d.outcomes.dead++;
      else d.outcomes.stuck++;
      if (r.outcome !== 'win') d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] = (d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] || 0) + 1;
      d.killsTotal += r.kills || 0;
      var reached = {}, hitF5 = (r.floor === 5);
      var ends = r.b1 ? (r.b1.floorExit || []) : (r.floors || []);
      for (var f = 0; f < ends.length; f++) {
        var z = ends[f], fl = z.floor;
        reached[fl] = 1;
        if (fl === 5) hitF5 = true;
        if (!perFloor[fl]) perFloor[fl] = { level: [], hp: [], n: 0 };
        perFloor[fl].n++;
        perFloor[fl].level.push(z.level);
        perFloor[fl].hp.push(z.hp);
      }
      if (r.b1) {
        for (var en = 0; en < (r.b1.floorEnter || []).length; en++) {
          var efl = r.b1.floorEnter[en].floor;
          reached[efl] = 1;
          if (efl === 5) hitF5 = true;
        }
      }
      for (var k in reached) d.floorReach[k] = (d.floorReach[k] || 0) + 1;
      if (hitF5) {
        d.f5.reached++;
        d.f5.states.push({
          seed: r.seed, hp: r.hp, level: r.level,
          potions: (r.b1 && r.b1.enterF5) ? r.b1.enterF5.potions : null, outcome: r.outcome
        });
      }
      var lvF3 = 0;
      for (var q = 0; q < ends.length; q++) if (ends[q].floor <= 3 && ends[q].level > lvF3) lvF3 = ends[q].level;
      if (lvF3 >= 5) d.l5ByF3++;
      if (r.d42 && r.d42.boss) {
        for (var bid in r.d42.boss) {
          if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r.d42.boss, bid)) continue;
          var b = r.d42.boss[bid];
          var cur = d.boss[bid] || (d.boss[bid] = { encounters: 0, maxDealtPct: 0, bestSeed: null, killed: 0 });
          cur.encounters++;
          if (b.dealtPct > cur.maxDealtPct) { cur.maxDealtPct = b.dealtPct; cur.bestSeed = r.seed; }
          if (b.killed) cur.killed++;
        }
      }
    }
    for (var k2 in perFloor) {
      d.floorLevel[k2] = mean(perFloor[k2].level);
      d.floorHp[k2] = mean(perFloor[k2].hp);
    }
    d.killsPerRun = Math.round((d.killsTotal / Math.max(1, runs.length)) * 100) / 100;
    return d;
  }

  /* B1 专属汇总（与 D-44/D-45 同字段） */
  function aggB1(runs) {
    var a = {
      runs: runs.length, active: 0, forced: 0, patrol: 0, boss: 0, battles: 0, race: 0,
      shop: { visits: 0, buys: 0, spent: 0, potionsBought: 0, equipBought: 0, soldCount: 0, soldGold: 0 },
      reserve: { need: 4, reachF5: 0, pass: 0, min: null, max: null },
      dragon: { attempts: 0, runs: 0, kills: 0, bestDealt: 0, bestDealtPct: 0, bestSeed: null, best: null },
      wins: [], f5Enter: []
    };
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i], b = r.b1;
      if (!b) continue;
      a.battles += b.battles || 0;
      a.active += b.active || 0;
      a.forced += b.forced || 0;
      a.patrol += b.patrol || 0;
      a.race += b.race || 0;
      a.boss += b.boss || 0;
      a.shop.visits += b.shopVisits || 0;
      a.shop.buys += b.shopBuys || 0;
      a.shop.spent += b.shopSpent || 0;
      a.shop.potionsBought += b.potionsBought || 0;
      a.shop.equipBought += b.equipBought || 0;
      a.shop.soldCount += b.soldCount || 0;
      a.shop.soldGold += b.soldGold || 0;
      if (b.dragon) {
        a.dragon.attempts += b.dragon.battles || 0;
        a.dragon.runs += b.dragon.reached ? 1 : 0;
        a.dragon.kills += b.dragon.killed || 0;
        if (b.dragon.best && b.dragon.best.dealt > a.dragon.bestDealt) {
          a.dragon.bestDealt = b.dragon.best.dealt;
          a.dragon.bestDealtPct = Math.round((b.dragon.best.dealt / 260) * 1000) / 10;
          a.dragon.bestSeed = r.seed;
          a.dragon.best = b.dragon.best;
        }
      }
      if (b.enterF5) {
        a.reserve.reachF5++;
        if (b.enterF5.potions >= 4) a.reserve.pass++;
        if (a.reserve.min === null || b.enterF5.potions < a.reserve.min) a.reserve.min = b.enterF5.potions;
        if (a.reserve.max === null || b.enterF5.potions > a.reserve.max) a.reserve.max = b.enterF5.potions;
        a.f5Enter.push({
          seed: r.seed, potions: b.enterF5.potions, hp: b.enterF5.hp, maxHp: b.enterF5.maxHp,
          level: b.enterF5.level, gold: b.enterF5.gold, atk: b.enterF5.atk, def: b.enterF5.def,
          weaponId: b.enterF5.weaponId, armorId: b.enterF5.armorId, outcome: r.outcome
        });
      }
      if (r.outcome === 'win') a.wins.push(r.seed);
    }
    return a;
  }

  /* D-45 口径的商店决策分类（E 组逐项可比） */
  function aggD45(runs) {
    var res = {
      f5Runs: 0, floorsReached: 0,
      counts: { bought: 0, noStock: 0, goldShort: 0, priority: 0, noEntry: 0 },
      failures: 0, shares: {}, equipBuys: 0
    };
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i], b = r.b1;
      if (!b || !b.enterF5) continue;
      res.f5Runs++;
      res.equipBuys += b.equipBought || 0;
      var floors = [];
      for (var e = 0; e < (b.floorEnter || []).length; e++) {
        var fl = b.floorEnter[e].floor;
        if (floors.indexOf(fl) < 0) floors.push(fl);
      }
      floors.sort();
      var shops = (r.d45 && r.d45.shops) || [];
      var missed = (r.d45 && r.d45.missed) || [];
      for (var fi = 0; fi < floors.length; fi++) {
        var f = floors[fi];
        res.floorsReached++;
        var visits = [];
        for (var s = 0; s < shops.length; s++) if (shops[s].floor === f) visits.push(shops[s]);
        var miss = 0;
        for (var m = 0; m < missed.length; m++) if (missed[m].floor === f) miss++;
        if (!visits.length) { res.counts.noEntry++; continue; }
        for (var v = 0; v < visits.length; v++) {
          res.counts[visits[v].reason] = (res.counts[visits[v].reason] || 0) + 1;
        }
      }
    }
    res.failures = res.counts.noStock + res.counts.goldShort + res.counts.priority + res.counts.noEntry;
    var keys = ['noStock', 'goldShort', 'noEntry', 'priority'];
    for (var x = 0; x < keys.length; x++) {
      res.shares[keys[x]] = res.failures ?
        Math.round((res.counts[keys[x]] / res.failures) * 1000) / 10 : 0;
    }
    return res;
  }

  /* D-46 A/B 组：金币账 + F1/F2 首店缺口（逐局可复算） */
  function cheapestUpgrade(sh) {
    var best = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < sh.stock.length; i++) {
      var it = sh.stock[i];
      if (it.owned) continue;
      if (!(it.weaponUp || it.armorUp)) continue;
      if (best === null || it.price < best) best = it.price;
    }
    return best;
  }
  function aggD46(runs) {
    var res = {
      ledger: [], firstShop: { f1: [], f2: [] },
      gaps: { f1: {}, f2: {} }, reward: { picks: 0, gold: 0, potion: 0, byFloor: {} },
      balanceMaxAbs: 0, incomeTotal: { chest: 0, drop: 0, reward: 0, quest: 0 }, spentNet: 0
    };
    function stat(a) {
      if (!a.length) return { n: 0, avg: null, median: null, min: null, max: null };
      return {
        n: a.length, avg: Math.round((a.reduce(function (s, v) { return s + v; }, 0) / a.length) * 100) / 100,
        median: median(a), min: Math.min.apply(null, a), max: Math.max.apply(null, a)
      };
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i], L = r.d46;
      if (!L) continue;
      var inc = L.income;
      res.ledger.push({
        seed: r.seed, initial: L.initial, income: inc,
        incomeSum: inc.chest + inc.drop + inc.reward + inc.quest,
        spentGross: L.spentGross, soldGold: L.soldGold, spentNet: L.spentNet,
        finalGold: L.finalGold, balance: L.balance,
        buyCount: L.buyCount, sellCount: L.sellCount,
        rewardByFloor: L.rewardByFloor, rewardPicksByFloor: L.rewardPicksByFloor,
        sources: L.log.filter(function (x) { return x.gold > 0; })
      });
      res.incomeTotal.chest += inc.chest;
      res.incomeTotal.drop += inc.drop;
      res.incomeTotal.reward += inc.reward;
      res.incomeTotal.quest += inc.quest;
      res.spentNet += L.spentNet;
      if (Math.abs(L.balance) > res.balanceMaxAbs) res.balanceMaxAbs = Math.abs(L.balance);
      for (var g = 0; g < L.log.length; g++) {
        if (L.log[g].src !== 'reward') continue;
        res.reward.picks++;
        res.reward.gold += L.log[g].gold || 0;
        if (L.log[g].potion) res.reward.potion++;
        var fk = L.log[g].floor;
        res.reward.byFloor[fk] = (res.reward.byFloor[fk] || 0) + 1;
      }
      /* B 组：F1 / F2 首次进店 */
      var shops = (r.d45 && r.d45.shops) || [];
      for (var f = 1; f <= 2; f++) {
        var v = null;
        for (var s = 0; s < shops.length; s++) if (shops[s].floor === f) { v = shops[s]; break; }
        if (!v) continue;
        var cheap = cheapestUpgrade(v);
        var row = {
          seed: r.seed, floor: f, gold: v.goldIn, goldAtOpen: v.gold,
          cheapest: cheap, gap: (cheap === null) ? null : cheap - v.goldIn,
          weaponId: v.weaponId, weaponAtk: v.weaponAtk,
          bought: v.bought, reason: v.reason
        };
        if (f === 1) res.firstShop.f1.push(row); else res.firstShop.f2.push(row);
      }
    }
    res.gaps.f1 = stat(res.firstShop.f1.filter(function (x) { return x.gap !== null; }).map(function (x) { return x.gap; }));
    res.gaps.f2 = stat(res.firstShop.f2.filter(function (x) { return x.gap !== null; }).map(function (x) { return x.gap; }));
    return res;
  }

  function trimRun(r, strategy) {
    var o = {
      seed: r.seed, outcome: r.outcome, deathFloor: r.deathFloor || r.floor, floor: r.floor,
      hp: r.hp, level: r.level, gold: r.gold, equip: r.equip, kills: r.kills,
      battles: r.battles, actions: r.actions, simSec: r.simSec,
      shopVisits: r.shopVisits, shopBuys: r.shopBuys, shopSpent: r.shopSpent,
      potions: r.potions, d42: r.d42 || null,
      death: r.death || null, deathCause: r.deathCause || null
    };
    if (strategy === 'b1') {
      o.maxHp = r.b1 ? (r.b1.enterF5 ? r.b1.enterF5.maxHp : (r.b1.final ? r.b1.final.maxHp : null)) : null;
      o.b1 = r.b1;
      o.d45 = r.d45 || null;
      o.d46 = r.d46 || null;
      o.f5Battles = ((r.d44 && r.d44.battles) || []).filter(function (b) {
        return b.floor === 5 || b.monsterId === 'dragon';
      });
    }
    return o;
  }

  try {
    var M = Game.Core.Main;
    M.init();
    M.closeGuide();
    var qs = location.search || '';
    var mn = /n=(\d+)/.exec(qs), mo = /only=(b1|g2|s1|m1)/.exec(qs);
    var n = mn ? Math.max(1, Math.min(200, +mn[1])) : 50;
    out.env.maxActions = 2500;
    out.env.seeds = seedsOf(n);
    out.env.reward = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(Game.Data.REWARD));
    out.env.decor = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(Game.Data.DECOR));
    out.env.chestLoot = JSON.stringify(Game.Data.CHEST_LOOT);
    out.env.stock = JSON.stringify(Game.Data.SHOP_STOCK);

    var B1OPTS = { maxActions: 2500, b1: { reserve: 4 }, d42: true, d45: true, d46: true };

    /* ── neg：奖励点还原（REWARD 清空）后复跑 B1 ───────────────── */
    if (/mode=neg/.test(qs)) {
      Game.Data.REWARD = { floors: [], maxPerFloor: 2, minSpawnDist: 5, minStairDist: 3 };
      out.mode = 'neg';
      out.env.rewardNeg = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(Game.Data.REWARD));
      var nr = Game.Bot.batch(seedsOf(n), { maxActions: 2500, b1: { reserve: 4 }, d42: true, d45: true, d46: true });
      out.neg = {
        agg: aggBase(nr.runs), b1: aggB1(nr.runs), d45: aggD45(nr.runs), d46: aggD46(nr.runs),
        runs: nr.runs.map(function (r) { return trimRun(r, 'b1'); })
      };
      out.ok = true;
      document.title = 'NEG_DONE wins=' + out.neg.agg.outcomes.win + '/' + n +
        ' f5=' + out.neg.agg.f5.reached + ' dragonKills=' + out.neg.b1.dragon.kills +
        ' rewardPicks=' + out.neg.d46.reward.picks;
      window.__D46__ = out;
      document.getElementById('report').textContent = JSON.stringify(out);
      return;
    }

    /* ── main：B1 全量遥测 + G2/S1/M1 同种子对照 ───────────────── */
    function optsFor(key) {
      if (key === 'b1') return B1OPTS;
      if (key === 'g2') return { maxActions: 2500, d37: { fireball: true, flee: true }, d42: true };
      if (key === 's1') return { maxActions: 2500, d39: { avoid: true }, d42: true };
      return { maxActions: 2500, m1: { clear: true }, d42: true };
    }
    var plan = mo ? [mo[1]] : ['b1', 'g2', 's1', 'm1'];
    var t0 = Date.now();
    for (var p = 0; p < plan.length; p++) {
      var key = plan[p], res = Game.Bot.batch(out.env.seeds, optsFor(key));
      out.runs[key] = res.runs.map(function (r) { return trimRun(r, key); });
      out.summary[key] = res.summary;
      out.agg[key] = aggBase(res.runs);
      if (key === 'b1') out.b1 = aggB1(res.runs);
    }
    out.d45 = aggD45(out.runs.b1 || []);
    out.d46 = aggD46(out.runs.b1 || []);
    out.wallMs = Date.now() - t0;
    out.ok = true;
    document.title = 'BATCH_DONE n=' + n +
      ' b1_win=' + out.agg.b1.outcomes.win +
      ' b1_f5=' + out.agg.b1.f5.reached +
      ' b1_dragon=' + out.b1.dragon.kills + '/' + out.b1.dragon.attempts +
      ' equipBuys=' + out.d45.equipBuys +
      ' rewardPicks=' + out.d46.reward.picks +
      ' goldShort=' + out.d45.counts.goldShort +
      ' m1_f4=' + (out.agg.m1 ? out.agg.m1.floorReach['4'] : '-') +
      ' wallMs=' + out.wallMs;
  } catch (e) {
    out.err = String((e && (e.message + '\n' + (e.orig || e.stack))) || e);
    document.title = 'BATCH_FAIL';
  }
  window.__D46__ = out;
  document.getElementById('report').textContent = JSON.stringify(out);
})();
</script>

 *   ?mode=main（默认）  B1 默认 50 种子 + B1+NPC 50 种子 + G2/S1/M1 同种子对照

(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = {
    protocol: 'D-47', mode: 'main', env: {}, summary: {}, runs: {}, agg: {},

  };
  function seedsOf(n) { var a = []; for (var i = 1001; i < 1001 + n; i++) a.push(i); return a; }

  function aggBase(runs) {
    var d = {
      outcomes: { win: 0, dead: 0, stuck: 0 }, deathFloor: {},
      floorReach: {}, killsTotal: 0
    };
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i];
      if (r.outcome === 'win') d.outcomes.win++;
      else if (r.outcome === 'dead') d.outcomes.dead++;
      else d.outcomes.stuck++;
      if (r.outcome !== 'win') d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] = (d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] || 0) + 1;
      d.killsTotal += r.kills || 0;
      var reached = {}, hitF5 = (r.floor === 5);
      var ends = r.b1 ? (r.b1.floorExit || []) : (r.floors || []);
      for (var f = 0; f < ends.length; f++) {
        reached[ends[f].floor] = 1;
        if (ends[f].floor === 5) hitF5 = true;
      }
      if (r.b1) {
        for (var en = 0; en < (r.b1.floorEnter || []).length; en++) {
          reached[r.b1.floorEnter[en].floor] = 1;
          if (r.b1.floorEnter[en].floor === 5) hitF5 = true;
        }
      }
      for (var k in reached) d.floorReach[k] = (d.floorReach[k] || 0) + 1;
      d.f5 = d.f5 || { reached: 0 };

    }
    return d;
  }

  /* NPC 支路汇总（接取/交付/失败/状态分布/绕行步数） */
  function aggNpc(runs) {
    var a = {
      runs: runs.length, accepted: 0, delivered: 0, fails: 0, talks: 0,
      states: { unaccepted: 0, active: 0, ready: 0, done: 0 },

    };
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i], n = r.npc;
      if (!n) continue;

      if (n.accepted) { a.accepted++; a.acceptedSeeds.push(r.seed); }
      if (n.delivered) { a.delivered++; a.deliveredSeeds.push(r.seed); }
      a.fails += n.fails || 0;
      a.talks += n.talks || 0;
      a.goldTotal += n.gold || 0;
      a.detourSteps += n.detourSteps || 0;
      a.states[n.stateAtEnd || 'unaccepted'] = (a.states[n.stateAtEnd || 'unaccepted'] || 0) + 1;
    }

  }

<script>
/* D-48 跑局器（只测量，不改任何判据）：
 *   ?only=b1|g2|s1|m1&n=50  只跑一支（调参用）；默认四支全跑
 * 种子 1001–1050、maxActions 2500，与 D-37..D-47 完全一致。
 * 与本卡相关的一点：init 走"菜单启用 + skip 跳过"路径，证明首屏开关不会改变任何对局。 */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = {
    protocol: 'D-48', mode: 'main', env: {}, summary: {}, runs: {}, agg: {}, ok: false
  };
  function seedsOf(n) { var a = []; for (var i = 1001; i < 1001 + n; i++) a.push(i); return a; }

  function aggBase(runs) {
    var d = { outcomes: { win: 0, dead: 0, stuck: 0 }, deathFloor: {}, floorReach: {}, killsTotal: 0 };
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i];
      if (r.outcome === 'win') d.outcomes.win++;
      else if (r.outcome === 'dead') d.outcomes.dead++;
      else d.outcomes.stuck++;
      if (r.outcome !== 'win') d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] = (d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] || 0) + 1;
      d.killsTotal += r.kills || 0;
      var reached = {}, hitF5 = (r.floor === 5);
      var ends = r.b1 ? (r.b1.floorExit || []) : (r.floors || []);
      for (var f = 0; f < ends.length; f++) {
        reached[ends[f].floor] = 1;
        if (ends[f].floor === 5) hitF5 = true;
      }
      if (r.b1) {
        for (var en = 0; en < (r.b1.floorEnter || []).length; en++) {
          reached[r.b1.floorEnter[en].floor] = 1;
          if (r.b1.floorEnter[en].floor === 5) hitF5 = true;
        }
      }
      for (var k in reached) d.floorReach[k] = (d.floorReach[k] || 0) + 1;
      d.f5 = d.f5 || { reached: 0 };
      if (hitF5) d.f5.reached++;
    }
    return d;
  }

  function trimRun(r) {
    return {
      seed: r.seed, outcome: r.outcome, deathFloor: r.deathFloor || r.floor, floor: r.floor,
      hp: r.hp, level: r.level, gold: r.gold, equip: r.equip, kills: r.kills,
      battles: r.battles, actions: r.actions, simSec: r.simSec,
      shopVisits: r.shopVisits, shopBuys: r.shopBuys, shopSpent: r.shopSpent,
      potions: r.potions, npc: r.npc || null, d46: r.d46 || null,
      enterF5: (r.b1 && r.b1.enterF5) ? { potions: r.b1.enterF5.potions, hp: r.b1.enterF5.hp, gold: r.b1.enterF5.gold } : null
    };
  }

  try {
    var M = Game.Core.Main;
    /* 首屏开启但用 skip 参数直接进场景：与改前 init() 的落点/状态一致 */
    M.init({ menu: true, skipMenu: true });
    out.env.bootScene = M._scene;
    out.env.skipMenu = true;
    M.closeGuide();
    var qs = location.search || '';
    var mn = /n=(\d+)/.exec(qs), mo = /only=(b1|g2|s1|m1)/.exec(qs);
    var n = mn ? Math.max(1, Math.min(200, +mn[1])) : 50;
    out.env.maxActions = 2500;
    out.env.seeds = seedsOf(n);

    function optsFor(key) {
      if (key === 'b1') return { maxActions: 2500, b1: { reserve: 4 }, d42: true, d45: true, d46: true };
      if (key === 'g2') return { maxActions: 2500, d37: { fireball: true, flee: true }, d42: true };
      if (key === 's1') return { maxActions: 2500, d39: { avoid: true }, d42: true };
      return { maxActions: 2500, m1: { clear: true }, d42: true };
    }
    var plan = mo ? [mo[1]] : ['b1', 'g2', 's1', 'm1'];
    var t0 = Date.now();
    for (var p = 0; p < plan.length; p++) {
      var key = plan[p], res = Game.Bot.batch(out.env.seeds, optsFor(key));
      out.runs[key] = res.runs.map(trimRun);
      out.summary[key] = res.summary;
      out.agg[key] = aggBase(res.runs);
    }
    out.wallMs = Date.now() - t0;
    out.ok = true;
    document.title = 'BATCH_DONE n=' + n +
      ' b1_win=' + out.agg.b1.outcomes.win +
      ' b1_f5=' + out.agg.b1.f5.reached +
      ' g2_f5=' + (out.agg.g2 ? out.agg.g2.f5.reached : '-') +
      ' s1_f5=' + (out.agg.s1 ? out.agg.s1.f5.reached : '-') +
      ' m1_f4=' + (out.agg.m1 ? out.agg.m1.floorReach['4'] : '-') +
      ' wallMs=' + out.wallMs;
  } catch (e) {
    out.err = String((e && (e.message + '\n' + (e.orig || e.stack))) || e);
    document.title = 'BATCH_FAIL';
  }
  window.__D48__ = out;
  document.getElementById('report').textContent = JSON.stringify(out);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { protocol: 'D-50', mode: 'main', env: {}, summary: {}, runs: {}, agg: {}, ok: false };
  function seedsOf(n) { var a = []; for (var i = 1001; i < 1001 + n; i++) a.push(i); return a; }
  function aggBase(runs) {
    var d = { outcomes: { win: 0, dead: 0, stuck: 0 }, deathFloor: {}, floorReach: {}, killsTotal: 0,
      rescue: { runs: 0, triggers: 0, gear: 0, potion: 0, gold: 0, spent: 0, maxTriggers: 0, maxSpent: 0 } };
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i];
      if (r.outcome === 'win') d.outcomes.win++;
      else if (r.outcome === 'dead') d.outcomes.dead++;
      else d.outcomes.stuck++;
      if (r.outcome !== 'win') d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] = (d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] || 0) + 1;
      d.killsTotal += r.kills || 0;
      var reached = {}, hitF5 = (r.floor === 5);
      var ends = r.b1 ? (r.b1.floorExit || []) : (r.floors || []);
      for (var f = 0; f < ends.length; f++) {
        reached[ends[f].floor] = 1;
        if (ends[f].floor === 5) hitF5 = true;
      }
      if (r.b1) {
        for (var en = 0; en < (r.b1.floorEnter || []).length; en++) {
          reached[r.b1.floorEnter[en].floor] = 1;
          if (r.b1.floorEnter[en].floor === 5) hitF5 = true;
        }
      }
      for (var k in reached) d.floorReach[k] = (d.floorReach[k] || 0) + 1;
      d.f5 = d.f5 || { reached: 0 };
      if (hitF5) d.f5.reached++;
      var ad = r.adaptive || null;
      if (ad) {
        d.rescue.triggers += ad.triggers || 0;
        d.rescue.spent += ad.spent || 0;
        if ((ad.triggers || 0) > 0) d.rescue.runs++;
        if ((ad.triggers || 0) > d.rescue.maxTriggers) d.rescue.maxTriggers = ad.triggers;
        if ((ad.spent || 0) > d.rescue.maxSpent) d.rescue.maxSpent = ad.spent;
        for (var li = 0; li < (ad.log || []).length; li++) {
          var g = ad.log[li].grant || '';
          if (g === 'sword_rescue') d.rescue.gear++;
          else if (g.indexOf('potion') === 0) d.rescue.potion++;
          else if (g.indexOf('gold') === 0) d.rescue.gold++;
        }
      }
    }
    return d;
  }

  /* D-50 A 组：F5 死亡逐局拆解。
   * 全部量都从 d44 的逐回合实测日志里取（dealt/taken/mhp/potions），不推演。
   * 恒等式：
   *   bossMax = dealt + bossLeft                                   （输出账）
   *   hpPool  = start.hp + Σ 药水治疗（本场 potionUses 的实测回血量）  （生存账）
   *   taken ≥ hpPool                                               （死亡成立）
   *   T_need  = ceil(bossLeft / avgDealt)                           （差几回合）
   *   addTaken= T_need × avgTaken                                   （这 T_need 回合还要挨多少）
   *   gap     = addTaken - (0 + 0)  → 折算成还需多少治疗/多少瓶      （差药）
   */
  function splitF5(rec) {
    var all = (rec.d44 && rec.d44.battles) || [];
    var f5 = all.filter(function (b) { return b.floor === 5; });
    var losses = f5.filter(function (b) { return b.result !== 'win'; });
    if (!losses.length) return null;
    var b = losses[losses.length - 1];
    if (!b.rounds || !b.rounds.length) return null;
    var last = b.rounds[b.rounds.length - 1];
    var nR = b.nRounds || b.rounds.length;
    var startHp = (b.start && b.start.hp) || 0;
    var heal = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < b.rounds.length; i++) {
      var it = b.rounds[i].item;
      if (it === 'potion_large') heal += 80;
      else if (it === 'potion_small') heal += 30;
    }
    var dealt = b.dealt, taken = b.taken;
    var bossLeft = Math.max(0, last.mhp);
    var avgDealt = nR ? dealt / nR : 0;
    var avgTaken = nR ? taken / nR : 0;
    var tNeed = avgDealt > 0 ? Math.ceil(bossLeft / avgDealt) : -1;
    var addTaken = tNeed > 0 ? Math.round(tNeed * avgTaken) : 0;
    return {
      seed: rec.seed, monsterId: b.monsterId, name: b.name, boss: (b.maxHp >= 150),
      bossMax: b.maxHp, dealt: dealt, bossLeft: bossLeft, nRounds: nR,
      taken: taken, startHp: startHp, heal: heal, potionUses: b.potionUses,
      hpPool: startHp + heal, avgDealt: Math.round(avgDealt * 10) / 10,
      avgTaken: Math.round(avgTaken * 10) / 10, tNeed: tNeed, addTaken: addTaken,
      potionsLeft: (b.end && b.end.potions) || 0,
      startMp: (b.start && b.start.mp) || 0, endMp: (b.end && b.end.mp) || 0
    };
  }

  function trimRun(r) {
    var split = splitF5(r);
    var fights = ((r.d44 && r.d44.battles) || []).filter(function (b) { return b.floor === 5; })
      .map(function (b) {
        return { monsterId: b.monsterId, name: b.name, maxHp: b.maxHp, result: b.result,
          nRounds: b.nRounds, dealt: b.dealt, taken: b.taken, potionUses: b.potionUses,
          start: b.start, end: b.end,
          rounds: (b.rounds || []).map(function (x) { return [x.r, x.act, x.dealt, x.taken, x.item, x.hp, x.mhp]; }) };
      });
    return {
      seed: r.seed, outcome: r.outcome, deathFloor: r.deathFloor || r.floor, floor: r.floor,
      hp: r.hp, level: r.level, gold: r.gold, equip: r.equip, kills: r.kills,
      battles: r.battles, actions: r.actions, simSec: r.simSec,
      shopVisits: r.shopVisits, shopBuys: r.shopBuys, shopSpent: r.shopSpent,
      potions: r.potions, npc: r.npc || null, d46: r.d46 || null, adaptive: r.adaptive || null,
      enterF5: (r.b1 && r.b1.enterF5) ? { potions: r.b1.enterF5.potions, hp: r.b1.enterF5.hp, gold: r.b1.enterF5.gold } : null,
      f5split: split, f5fights: fights
    };
  }

  try {
    var M = Game.Core.Main;
    M.init({ menu: true, skipMenu: true });
    M.closeGuide();
    var qs = location.search || '';

  'use strict';
  var out = { protocol: 'D-51', mode: 'main', env: {}, summary: {}, runs: {}, agg: {}, ok: false };
  function seedsOf(n) { var a = []; for (var i = 1001; i < 1001 + n; i++) a.push(i); return a; }
  function aggBase(runs) {
    var d = { outcomes: { win: 0, dead: 0, stuck: 0 }, deathFloor: {}, floorReach: {}, killsTotal: 0,
      rescue: { runs: 0, triggers: 0, gear: 0, potion: 0, gold: 0, spent: 0, maxTriggers: 0, maxSpent: 0 } };
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var r = runs[i];
      if (r.outcome === 'win') d.outcomes.win++;
      else if (r.outcome === 'dead') d.outcomes.dead++;
      else d.outcomes.stuck++;
      if (r.outcome !== 'win') d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] = (d.deathFloor[r.deathFloor || r.floor] || 0) + 1;
      d.killsTotal += r.kills || 0;
      var reached = {}, hitF5 = (r.floor === 5);
      var ends = r.b1 ? (r.b1.floorExit || []) : (r.floors || []);
      for (var f = 0; f < ends.length; f++) {
        reached[ends[f].floor] = 1;
        if (ends[f].floor === 5) hitF5 = true;
      }
      if (r.b1) {
        for (var en = 0; en < (r.b1.floorEnter || []).length; en++) {
          reached[r.b1.floorEnter[en].floor] = 1;
          if (r.b1.floorEnter[en].floor === 5) hitF5 = true;
        }
      }
      for (var k in reached) d.floorReach[k] = (d.floorReach[k] || 0) + 1;
      d.f5 = d.f5 || { reached: 0 };
      if (hitF5) d.f5.reached++;
      var ad = r.adaptive || null;
      if (ad) {
        d.rescue.triggers += ad.triggers || 0;
        d.rescue.spent += ad.spent || 0;
        if ((ad.triggers || 0) > 0) d.rescue.runs++;
        if ((ad.triggers || 0) > d.rescue.maxTriggers) d.rescue.maxTriggers = ad.triggers;
        if ((ad.spent || 0) > d.rescue.maxSpent) d.rescue.maxSpent = ad.spent;
        for (var li = 0; li < (ad.log || []).length; li++) {
          var g = ad.log[li].grant || '';
          if (g === 'sword_rescue') d.rescue.gear++;
          else if (g.indexOf('potion') === 0) d.rescue.potion++;
          else if (g.indexOf('gold') === 0) d.rescue.gold++;
        }
      }
    }
    return d;
  }

  /* D-50 A 组：F5 死亡逐局拆解。
   * 全部量都从 d44 的逐回合实测日志里取（dealt/taken/mhp/potions），不推演。
   * 恒等式：
   *   bossMax = dealt + bossLeft                                   （输出账）
   *   hpPool  = start.hp + Σ 药水治疗（本场 potionUses 的实测回血量）  （生存账）
   *   taken ≥ hpPool                                               （死亡成立）
   *   T_need  = ceil(bossLeft / avgDealt)                           （差几回合）
   *   addTaken= T_need × avgTaken                                   （这 T_need 回合还要挨多少）
   *   gap     = addTaken - (0 + 0)  → 折算成还需多少治疗/多少瓶      （差药）
   */
  function splitF5(rec) {
    var all = (rec.d44 && rec.d44.battles) || [];
    var f5 = all.filter(function (b) { return b.floor === 5; });
    var losses = f5.filter(function (b) { return b.result !== 'win'; });
    if (!losses.length) return null;
    var b = losses[losses.length - 1];
    if (!b.rounds || !b.rounds.length) return null;
    var last = b.rounds[b.rounds.length - 1];
    var nR = b.nRounds || b.rounds.length;
    var startHp = (b.start && b.start.hp) || 0;
    var heal = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < b.rounds.length; i++) {
      var it = b.rounds[i].item;
      if (it === 'potion_large') heal += 80;
      else if (it === 'potion_small') heal += 30;
    }
    var dealt = b.dealt, taken = b.taken;
    var bossLeft = Math.max(0, last.mhp);
    var avgDealt = nR ? dealt / nR : 0;
    var avgTaken = nR ? taken / nR : 0;
    var tNeed = avgDealt > 0 ? Math.ceil(bossLeft / avgDealt) : -1;
    var addTaken = tNeed > 0 ? Math.round(tNeed * avgTaken) : 0;
    return {
      seed: rec.seed, monsterId: b.monsterId, name: b.name, boss: (b.maxHp >= 150),
      bossMax: b.maxHp, dealt: dealt, bossLeft: bossLeft, nRounds: nR,
      taken: taken, startHp: startHp, heal: heal, potionUses: b.potionUses,
      hpPool: startHp + heal, avgDealt: Math.round(avgDealt * 10) / 10,
      avgTaken: Math.round(avgTaken * 10) / 10, tNeed: tNeed, addTaken: addTaken,
      potionsLeft: (b.end && b.end.potions) || 0,
      startMp: (b.start && b.start.mp) || 0, endMp: (b.end && b.end.mp) || 0
    };
  }

  function trimRun(r) {
    var split = splitF5(r);
    var fights = ((r.d44 && r.d44.battles) || []).filter(function (b) { return b.floor === 5; })
      .map(function (b) {
        return { monsterId: b.monsterId, name: b.name, maxHp: b.maxHp, result: b.result,
          nRounds: b.nRounds, dealt: b.dealt, taken: b.taken, potionUses: b.potionUses,
          start: b.start, end: b.end,
          rounds: (b.rounds || []).map(function (x) { return [x.r, x.act, x.dealt, x.taken, x.item, x.hp, x.mhp]; }) };
      });
    return {
      seed: r.seed, outcome: r.outcome, deathFloor: r.deathFloor || r.floor, floor: r.floor,
      hp: r.hp, level: r.level, gold: r.gold, equip: r.equip, kills: r.kills,
      battles: r.battles, actions: r.actions, simSec: r.simSec,
      shopVisits: r.shopVisits, shopBuys: r.shopBuys, shopSpent: r.shopSpent,
      potions: r.potions, npc: r.npc || null, d46: r.d46 || null, adaptive: r.adaptive || null,
      enterF5: (r.b1 && r.b1.enterF5) ? { potions: r.b1.enterF5.potions, hp: r.b1.enterF5.hp, gold: r.b1.enterF5.gold } : null,
      f5split: split, f5fights: fights
    };
  }

  try {
    var M = Game.Core.Main;
    M.init({ menu: true, skipMenu: true });
    M.closeGuide();
    var qs = location.search || '';
    var mn = /n=(\d+)/.exec(qs), mo = /only=(b1|g2|s1|m1)/.exec(qs);
    var adaptOn = !/adapt=0/.test(qs);
    var form = (/form=(\w+)/.exec(qs) || [])[1] || 'd50';
    if (Game.Systems.Adaptive.setForm) Game.Systems.Adaptive.setForm(form);
    var n = mn ? Math.max(1, Math.min(200, +mn[1])) : 50;
    out.env = { maxActions: 2500, seeds: seedsOf(n), adaptive: adaptOn, form: form, bootScene: M._scene };
    function optsFor(key) {
      var base = { maxActions: 2500, adaptive: adaptOn, d44log: true };
      if (key === 'b1') { base.b1 = { reserve: 4 }; base.d42 = true; base.d45 = true; base.d46 = true; }

      var key = plan[p], res = Game.Bot.batch(out.env.seeds, optsFor(key));

      out.summary[key] = res.summary;
