<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var G = window.Game;
  var M = G.Core.Main;
  var P = G.Data.Player;
  var R = { ok: false, phase: 'boot' };

  /* ── 固定种子：地图/战斗/装饰全部可复现，保证改前改后是同一张图、同一条输入序列 ── */
  function mulberry32(a) {
    return function () {
      a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
      var t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a);
      t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  /* ── 绘制调用计数：只在本页包装 prototype，js/ 不动 ── */
  var C = { drawImage: 0, fillRect: 0, fillText: 0, spriteGet: 0, spriteGetFrame: 0 };
  var Proto = CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype;
  var _di = Proto.drawImage, _fr = Proto.fillRect, _ft = Proto.fillText;
  Proto.drawImage = function () { C.drawImage++; return _di.apply(this, arguments); };
  Proto.fillRect = function () { C.fillRect++; return _fr.apply(this, arguments); };
  Proto.fillText = function () { C.fillText++; return _ft.apply(this, arguments); };
  var S_ = G.Core.Sprites;
  var _sg = S_.get, _sgf = S_.getFrame;
  S_.get = function (n) { C.spriteGet++; return _sg.call(this, n); };
  S_.getFrame = function (n, i) { C.spriteGetFrame++; return _sgf.call(this, n, i); };

  /* ── 分阶段计时：包装顶层绘制入口，求和即为 draw；帧总时长 - draw = update ── */
  var T = { drawMap: 0, drawPlayer: 0, drawHUD: 0, drawBattle: 0, lighting: 0, particles: 0, hud: 0, nMap: 0, nLight: 0 };
  function wrap(obj, name, key, nKey) {
    var f = obj[name];
    if (typeof f !== 'function') return;
    obj[name] = function () {
      var t0 = performance.now();
      try { return f.apply(this, arguments); }
      finally {
        T[key] += performance.now() - t0;
        if (nKey) T[nKey]++;
      }
    };
  }
  wrap(G.Core.Render, 'drawMap', 'drawMap', 'nMap');
  wrap(G.Core.Render, 'drawPlayer', 'drawPlayer');
  wrap(G.Core.Render, 'drawHUD', 'drawHUD');
  wrap(G.Core.Render, 'drawBattle', 'drawBattle');
  wrap(G.Lighting, 'draw', 'lighting', 'nLight');
  wrap(G.Particles, 'draw', 'particles');
  if (G.hud) wrap(G.hud, 'draw', 'hud');

  function pct(arr, p) {
    if (!arr.length) return null;
    var a = arr.slice().sort(function (x, y) { return x - y; });
    var i = Math.min(a.length - 1, Math.max(0, Math.ceil(p / 100 * a.length) - 1));
    return Math.round(a[i] * 100) / 100;
  }
  function stat(arr) {
    if (!arr.length) return { p50: null, p95: null, max: null, mean: null, n: 0 };
    var s = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) s += arr[i];
    return {
      p50: pct(arr, 50), p95: pct(arr, 95),
      max: Math.round(Math.max.apply(null, arr) * 100) / 100,
      mean: Math.round(s / arr.length * 100) / 100, n: arr.length
    };
  }

  /* ── 键注入：真实 KeyboardEvent，走 Input.bind 同一路径 ── */
  function down(code) {
    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: code, key: code, bubbles: true }));
  }
  function up(code) {
    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: code, key: code, bubbles: true }));
  }
  var DIRS = ['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown'];
  var DV = { ArrowLeft: [-1, 0], ArrowRight: [1, 0], ArrowUp: [0, -1], ArrowDown: [0, 1] };

  var FRAME_DT = 1000 / 60;
  var ts = 0;

  /* ── 帧采样：每帧记录总耗时/各阶段耗时/绘制调用数 ── */
  var SAMPLES = [];
  function sampleFrame(fn) {
    var c0 = { di: C.drawImage, fr: C.fillRect, ft: C.fillText, sg: C.spriteGet, sgf: C.spriteGetFrame };
    var m0 = T.drawMap, d0 = T.drawPlayer, hd0 = T.drawHUD, b0 = T.drawBattle;
    var l0 = T.lighting, p0 = T.particles, h0 = T.hud;
    var w0 = performance.now();
    fn();
    var w1 = performance.now();
    /* Canvas2D 的绘制命令会先进显示列表，真正光栅化发生在提交时；取 1×1 像素强制刷一次，
       把光栅化成本计入，否则只测到 JS 侧的入队时间（改前改后同口径）。 */
    var f0 = performance.now();
    try { G.Core.Render._ctx.getImageData(0, 0, 1, 1); } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
    var f1 = performance.now();
    var drawT = (T.drawMap - m0) + (T.drawPlayer - d0) + (T.drawHUD - hd0) + (T.drawBattle - b0);
    SAMPLES.push({
      total: w1 - w0,
      flush: f1 - f0,
      draw: drawT,
      update: (w1 - w0) - drawT,
      mapOnly: T.drawMap - m0,
      light: T.lighting - l0,
      particles: T.particles - p0,
      hud: T.hud - h0,
      di: C.drawImage - c0.di,
      fr: C.fillRect - c0.fr,
      ft: C.fillText - c0.ft,
      sg: C.spriteGet - c0.sg,
      sgf: C.spriteGetFrame - c0.sgf,
      mapCalls: T.nMap - m0,
      scene: M._scene
    });
  }
  /* 每帧 drawMap 自身的净耗时 = 进入/退出时刻差（含内部 lighting/particles/hud），
     用上面的差值近似即可；mapOnly 字段在下面对 SAMPLES 做后处理时不再使用。 */

  function boot() {
    Math.random = mulberry32(20261210);
    /* 素材基址：preflight/ 下默认 'assets/sprites/' 会 404，这里只改加载入口的默认值 */
    var load = G.Core.Sprites.load;
    G.Core.Sprites.load = function () { return load.call(this, '../assets/sprites/'); };
    M.init();
    window.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true }));
    if (M._guideVisible) { M._guideVisible = false; }
    /* 压测内不允许遭遇战打断帧序列（不改游戏逻辑，只清空本页地图的敌人与巡逻怪）；
       巡逻怪 tick 成本与帧无关，且 D-11 已覆盖其路径逻辑，这里排除以拿到稳定的绘制样本 */
    try { G.Systems.Map.getEnemies().length = 0; } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
    try { G.Systems.AI.setPatrols([]); } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
    P.hp = 100000; P.maxHp = 100000;
  }

  function spritesReady() {
    return !!(G.Core.Sprites.isReady() && G.Core.Sprites.get('floor_1') &&
      G.Core.Sprites.get('knight_m_idle_anim_f0') && G.Core.Sprites.get('wall_top_mid'));
  }

  /* ── 场景 A：静止探索（只绘制，无输入）1200 帧 ── */
  function phaseStatic(n) {
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      ts += FRAME_DT;
      sampleFrame(function () { M.loop(ts); });
    }
  }

  /* ── 场景 B：真实移动输入 1200 帧（短按/长按混合，与真人按键节奏同量级） ── */
  function phaseMove(n, rng) {
    var st = { key: null, left: 0, gap: 0 };
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (st.key) {
        st.left--;
        if (st.left <= 0) { up(st.key); st.key = null; st.gap = 5; }
      } else if (st.gap > 0) {
        st.gap--;
      } else {
        st.key = DIRS[(rng() * 4) | 0];
        down(st.key);
        st.left = (rng() < 0.45) ? 2 : 14; /* 2 帧≈33ms 短按 / 14 帧≈233ms 长按 */
      }
      ts += FRAME_DT;
      sampleFrame(function () { M.loop(ts); });
    }
    if (st.key) up(st.key);
    G.Core.Input.clear();
  }

  /* ── 场景 C：战斗渲染 600 帧 ── */
  function phaseBattle(n) {
    G.Systems.Battle.start('slime');
    M.switchScene('battle');
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (M._scene !== 'battle') {
        G.Systems.Battle.start('slime');
        M.switchScene('battle');
      }
      if (i % 20 === 0) { down('Digit1'); }
      if (i % 20 === 2) { up('Digit1'); }
      ts += FRAME_DT;
      sampleFrame(function () { M.loop(ts); });
    }
    up('Digit1');
    M.switchScene('explore');
  }

  /* ── 输入延迟：keydown 时刻（合成帧时钟）→ 该次移动真正生效的那一帧 ──
     口径：pressTs 落在上一帧与下一帧之间（offset 0..16.7ms），latency = 生效帧 ts - pressTs。
     短按 = keydown 后 33ms 内 keyup（两次帧循环）；长按 = 持续 40 帧。
     丢弃（40 帧内从未移动）单独计数——这就是"按了没反应"。 */
  function phaseLatency(trials, rng) {
    var keys = {};
    var out = { tap: [], hold: [], tapDrop: 0, holdDrop: 0, tapSkip: 0, holdSkip: 0 };
    function runOne(tap) {
      G.Core.Input.clear();
      /* 选一个能走的方向（避开墙/楼梯），都走不了就跳过该样本 */
      var cand = [], i;
      for (i = 0; i < DIRS.length; i++) {
        var d = DV[DIRS[i]];
        var nx = P.x + d[0], ny = P.y + d[1];
        if (!G.Systems.Map.isWalkable(nx, ny)) continue;
        var t = G.Systems.Map.tileAt(nx, ny);
        if (t === 2 || t === 3) continue;
        cand.push(DIRS[i]);
      }
      if (!cand.length) return null;
      var key = cand[(rng() * cand.length) | 0];
      var offset = rng() * FRAME_DT;
      var pressTs = ts + offset;
      down(key);
      var sx = P.x, sy = P.y, applied = false, lat = null;
      for (var f = 0; f < 40; f++) {
        if (tap && f === 2) up(key);
        ts += FRAME_DT;
        M.loop(ts);
        if (P.x !== sx || P.y !== sy) { applied = true; lat = ts - pressTs; break; }
      }
      up(key);
      G.Core.Input.clear();
      return { applied: applied, lat: lat };
    }
    function settle(rng) {
      /* 随机停留 0~12 帧：让按键落在 120ms 节流窗口内的相位均匀分布，
         否则固定停留会每次都落在同一相位，丢掉真实分布 */
      var n = (rng() * 13) | 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { ts += FRAME_DT; M.loop(ts); }
    }
    for (var k = 0; k < trials; k++) {
      var tap = (k % 2 === 0);
      var r = runOne(tap);
      if (!r) { if (tap) out.tapSkip++; else out.holdSkip++; settle(rng); continue; }
      if (tap) { if (r.applied) out.tap.push(r.lat); else out.tapDrop++; }
      else { if (r.applied) out.hold.push(r.lat); else out.holdDrop++; }
      settle(rng);
    }
    return {
      tapApplied: out.tap.length, tapDrop: out.tapDrop, tapSkip: out.tapSkip,
      holdApplied: out.hold.length, holdDrop: out.holdDrop, holdSkip: out.holdSkip,
      tap: stat(out.tap), hold: stat(out.hold), all: stat(out.tap.concat(out.hold))
    };
  }

  function summarize() {
    var f = SAMPLES;
    function col(k) { return f.map(function (s) { return s[k] || 0; }); }
    var frame = f.map(function (s) { return s.total + s.flush; });
    var over50 = frame.filter(function (v) { return v >= 50; }).length;
    var over16 = frame.filter(function (v) { return v >= 16.7; }).length;
    return {
      frames: f.length,
      total: stat(col('total')), flush: stat(col('flush')), frame: stat(frame),
      draw: stat(col('draw')), update: stat(col('update')),
      drawMap: stat(col('mapOnly')), light: stat(col('light')), particles: stat(col('particles')),
      hud: stat(col('hud')),
      drawImage: stat(col('di')), fillRect: stat(col('fr')), fillText: stat(col('ft')),
      spriteGet: stat(col('sg')), spriteGetFrame: stat(col('sgf')),
      over16: over16, over50: over50,
      scenes: f.reduce(function (m, s) { m[s.scene] = (m[s.scene] || 0) + 1; return m; }, {})
    };
  }

  /* ── 画面指纹：冻结动画时钟、固定种子地图、固定帧序列后对整块画布做 FNV-1a。
     改前/改后同一页跑出同一哈希 = 视觉输出未变（离屏缓存不引入可见差异）。 ── */
  function fingerprint() {
    var R2 = G.Core.Render;
    var old = R2._animNow;
    R2._animNow = function () { return 5000; };
    for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) { ts += FRAME_DT; M.loop(ts); }
    var cv = R2._canvas, ctx = R2._ctx;
    var data = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height).data;
    var h = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (var j = 0; j < data.length; j++) {
      h ^= data[j];
      h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0;
    }
    R2._animNow = old;
    return { fnv: ('00000000' + h.toString(16)).slice(-8), w: cv.width, h: cv.height, bytes: data.length };
  }

  window.__D12 = {
    run: function () {
      return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        boot();
        var waited = 0;
        (function waitSprites() {
          if (spritesReady()) { start(); return; }
          waited += 100;
          if (waited > 20000) { reject(new Error('sprites not ready')); return; }
          setTimeout(waitSprites, 100);
        })();

        function start() {
          try {
            R.env = {
              dpr: G.Core.Render.dpr, scale: G.Core.Render.scale,
              cssW: G.Core.Render.cssW, cssH: G.Core.Render.cssH,
              canvasW: G.Core.Render._canvas.width, canvasH: G.Core.Render._canvas.height,
              innerW: window.innerWidth, innerH: window.innerHeight,
              grid: [G.Systems.Map.getGrid()[0].length, G.Systems.Map.getGrid().length]
            };
            R.phase = 'fingerprint';
            R.fingerprint = fingerprint();
            /* 摘掉光影再取一次指纹：把"静态层离屏缓存"与"暗角预渲染"两个改动分开归因 */
            var lightKeep = G.Lighting.draw;
            G.Lighting.draw = function () { };
            R.fingerprintNoLight = fingerprint();
            G.Lighting.draw = lightKeep;
            R.phase = 'latency';
            R.latency = phaseLatency(400, mulberry32(777));
            R.phase = 'static';
            SAMPLES = [];
            phaseStatic(600);
            R.static = summarize();
            /* 后段楼层地图更大（F5 = 37×23），每帧瓦片数约为 F1 的 2.7 倍，单独采样 */
            G.Systems.Map.setFloor(5);
            G.Systems.Map.getEnemies().length = 0;
            try { G.Systems.AI.setPatrols([]); } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
            var g5 = G.Systems.Map.getGrid();
            /* 把 F5 整层点亮（explored），只留玩家周围为 visible——这才是真人走完整层后的
               常态渲染负载：整层记忆瓦片逐格贴图 + 暗覆盖，而不是满屏未探索的黑块。 */
            var blocked5 = function (x, y) { return G.Systems.Map.tileAt(x, y) === 0; };
            for (var yy = 0; yy < g5.length; yy += 1) {
              for (var xx = 0; xx < g5[0].length; xx += 1) G.fov.update(xx, yy, 1, blocked5);
            }
            var sp5 = G.Systems.Map.getSpawn();
            P.x = sp5.x; P.y = sp5.y; P.floor = 5;
            G.fov.update(P.x, P.y, G.fov.RADIUS || 5, blocked5);
            var exN = 0, visN = 0;
            for (var ey = 0; ey < g5.length; ey++) {
              for (var ex = 0; ex < g5[0].length; ex++) {
                if (G.fov.isExplored(ex, ey)) exN++;
                if (G.fov.isVisible(ex, ey)) visN++;
              }
            }
            R.exploredTiles = exN;
            R.visibleTiles = visN;
            R.gridTiles = g5.length * g5[0].length;
            SAMPLES = [];
            phaseStatic(1200);
            R.staticBig = summarize();
            /* 归因 A/B：分别摘掉光影与地图绘制，看光栅化成本归属（仅本页临时替换，随后恢复） */
            R.phase = 'noLight';

            Proto.fillRect = function (x, y, w, h) {

/* preflight/perf_d12_run.js — D-12 压测驱动器（一次性脚本，不进 run-all）
 * 为什么需要它：run-all 用 --virtual-time-budget 跑页，虚拟时钟会接管 performance.now，
 * 测不到真实 CPU 耗时。这里用 CDP 在真实时钟下打开 perf_d12.html、等素材就绪、
 * 执行 window.__D12.run() 并把结果写成 JSON，供改前/改后同一口径对比。
 * 用法：node preflight/perf_d12_run.js [输出 json 路径] */
'use strict';
const { spawn } = require('child_process');
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');

const EDGE = 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge.exe';
const PAGE = 'file:///' + path.join(__dirname, 'perf_d12.html').replace(/\\/g, '/');
const outFile = process.argv[2] || path.join(__dirname, 'selfcheck', 'd12-perf.json');
const port = 9400 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 200);
const ud = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'd12_edge_' + Date.now());
const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

function connect(wsUrl) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
    const pending = new Map();
    let seq = 0;
    ws.onopen = () => resolve({
      send(method, params) {
        return new Promise((res, rej) => {
          const id = ++seq;
          pending.set(id, { res, rej });
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method, params }));
        });
      },
      close() { try { ws.close(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
    });
    ws.onerror = e => reject(new Error('ws error: ' + (e && e.message)));
    ws.onmessage = m => {
      let msg;
      try { msg = JSON.parse(m.data); } catch (e) { return; }
      if (msg.id && pending.has(msg.id)) {
        const p = pending.get(msg.id);
        pending.delete(msg.id);
        if (msg.error) p.rej(new Error(JSON.stringify(msg.error)));
        else p.res(msg.result);
      }
    };
  });
}

async function waitForTarget() {
  for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
    try {
      const list = await (await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/json/list`)).json();
      const page = list.find(t => t.type === 'page' && t.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
      if (page) return page.webSocketDebuggerUrl;
    } catch (e) { /* not ready */ }
    await sleep(100);
  }
  throw new Error('devtools target 未就绪');
}

async function evalJs(cdp, expression, awaitPromise) {
  const r = await cdp.send('Runtime.evaluate', {
    expression,
    returnByValue: true,
    awaitPromise: !!awaitPromise,
    timeout: 600000
  });
  if (r.exceptionDetails) {
    throw new Error('页面异常：' + JSON.stringify(r.exceptionDetails.exception || r.exceptionDetails.text));
  }
  return r.result && r.result.value;
}

(async () => {
  const child = spawn(EDGE, [
    '--headless=new', '--disable-gpu', '--no-first-run', '--no-default-browser-check',
    '--allow-file-access-from-files', '--mute-audio', '--window-size=1280,800',
    '--remote-allow-origins=*',
    `--user-data-dir=${ud}`, `--remote-debugging-port=${port}`, 'about:blank'
  ], { stdio: 'ignore' });

  let cdp = null;
  try {
    const wsUrl = await waitForTarget();
    cdp = await connect(wsUrl);
    await cdp.send('Runtime.enable', {});
    await cdp.send('Page.enable', {});
    await cdp.send('Page.navigate', { url: PAGE });

    let ready = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
      await sleep(200);
      try {
        ready = await evalJs(cdp, '!!(window.__D12 && window.__D12.run)', false);
      } catch (e) { /* 导航中 */ }
      if (ready) break;
    }
    if (!ready) throw new Error('perf 页未就绪（__D12 未定义）');

    const res = await evalJs(cdp, 'window.__D12.run()', true);
    const payload = {
      at: new Date().toISOString(),
      page: 'preflight/perf_d12.html',
      commit: (process.env.D12_COMMIT || ''),
      result: res
    };
    fs.writeFileSync(outFile, JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2), 'utf8');

    const r = res || {};
    const fmt = s => s && s.p50 !== null ? `P50=${s.p50} P95=${s.p95} max=${s.max}` : 'n/a';
    console.log('OK=' + r.ok + ' -> ' + outFile);
    console.log('env=' + JSON.stringify(r.env));
    for (const ph of ['static', 'staticBig', 'noLight', 'noMap', 'noVignette', 'move', 'battle']) {
      if (!r[ph]) continue;
      const x = r[ph];
      console.log(`[${ph}] frames=${x.frames} total(${fmt(x.total)}) draw(${fmt(x.draw)}) update(${fmt(x.update)}) drawImage=${x.drawImage.p50} fillRect=${x.fillRect.p50} sprites=${x.spriteGet.p50 + x.spriteGetFrame.p50} over50=${x.over50}`);
    }
    if (r.latency) {
      const L = r.latency;
      console.log(`[latency] tap drops=${L.tapDrop}/${L.tapApplied + L.tapDrop} ${fmt(L.tap)} | hold drops=${L.holdDrop}/${L.holdApplied + L.holdDrop} ${fmt(L.hold)}`);
    }
    if (r.error) console.log('PAGE_ERROR=' + r.error);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('FAILED: ' + (e && e.stack || e));
    process.exitCode = 1;
  } finally {
    if (cdp) cdp.close();
    try { child.kill(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    await sleep(300);
    try { fs.rmSync(ud, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }
})();

(function () {
  'use strict';
  var G = window.Game;
  var M = G.Core.Main;
  var P = G.Data.Player;
  var R = { ok: false, phase: 'boot' };

  function mulberry32(a) {
    return function () {
      a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
      var t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a);
      t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  /* ── 绘制调用计数（只包装 prototype） ── */
  var C = { drawImage: 0, fillRect: 0, fillText: 0 };
  var Proto = CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype;
  var _di = Proto.drawImage, _fr = Proto.fillRect, _ft = Proto.fillText;
  Proto.drawImage = function () { C.drawImage++; return _di.apply(this, arguments); };
  Proto.fillRect = function () { C.fillRect++; return _fr.apply(this, arguments); };
  Proto.fillText = function () { C.fillText++; return _ft.apply(this, arguments); };

  /* ── 分阶段计时 ── */
  var T = { drawBattle: 0, drawHUD: 0, fxUpdate: 0 };
  function wrap(obj, name, key) {
    var f = obj && obj[name];
    if (typeof f !== 'function') return;
    obj[name] = function () {
      var t0 = performance.now();
      try { return f.apply(this, arguments); }
      finally { T[key] += performance.now() - t0; }
    };
  }
  wrap(G.Core.Render, 'drawBattle', 'drawBattle');
  wrap(G.Core.Render, 'drawHUD', 'drawHUD');
  wrap(G.Fx, 'update', 'fxUpdate');

  function pct(arr, p) {
    if (!arr.length) return null;
    var a = arr.slice().sort(function (x, y) { return x - y; });
    var i = Math.min(a.length - 1, Math.max(0, Math.ceil(p / 100 * a.length) - 1));
    return Math.round(a[i] * 100) / 100;
  }
  function stat(arr) {
    if (!arr.length) return { p50: null, p95: null, max: null, mean: null, n: 0 };
    var s = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) s += arr[i];
    return {
      p50: pct(arr, 50), p95: pct(arr, 95),
      max: Math.round(Math.max.apply(null, arr) * 100) / 100,
      mean: Math.round(s / arr.length * 100) / 100, n: arr.length
    };
  }

  function down(code) {
    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: code, key: code, bubbles: true }));
  }
  function up(code) {
    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: code, key: code, bubbles: true }));
  }

  var FRAME_DT = 1000 / 60;
  var ts = 0;
  var SAMPLES = [];

  function sampleFrame(fn) {
    var c0 = { di: C.drawImage, fr: C.fillRect, ft: C.fillText };
    var b0 = T.drawBattle, h0 = T.drawHUD, f0 = T.fxUpdate;
    var w0 = performance.now();
    fn();
    var w1 = performance.now();
    /* 强制光栅化：否则只测到 Canvas2D 入队时间（与 D-12 同口径） */
    var g0 = performance.now();
    try { G.Core.Render._ctx.getImageData(0, 0, 1, 1); } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
    var g1 = performance.now();
    var drawT = (T.drawBattle - b0) + (T.drawHUD - h0);
    SAMPLES.push({
      total: (w1 - w0) + (g1 - g0),
      draw: drawT,
      drawBattle: T.drawBattle - b0,
      fxUpdate: T.fxUpdate - f0,
      update: (w1 - w0) - drawT,
      di: C.drawImage - c0.di,
      fr: C.fillRect - c0.fr,
      ft: C.fillText - c0.ft
    });
  }

  function boot() {
    Math.random = mulberry32(20261216);
    var load = G.Core.Sprites.load;
    G.Core.Sprites.load = function () { return load.call(this, '../assets/sprites/'); };
    M.init();
    window.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true }));
    if (M._guideVisible) { M._guideVisible = false; }
    try { G.Systems.Map.getEnemies().length = 0; } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
    try { G.Systems.AI.setPatrols([]); } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
    P.hp = 99999; P.maxHp = 99999; P.mp = 999; P.maxMp = 999;
    /* 战斗时间轴与特效都跟合成帧时钟走，回合与特效才能被稳定推进、样本可复算 */
    G.Systems.Battle._setClock(function () { return ts; });
    G.Fx._setClock(function () { return ts; });
    G.Fx._setPrefersReduced(false);
  }

  function spritesReady() {
    return !!(G.Core.Sprites.isReady() && G.Core.Sprites.get('floor_1') &&
      G.Core.Sprites.get('knight_m_idle_anim_f0') && G.Core.Sprites.get('wall_top_mid'));
  }

  function startBattle() {
    G.Systems.Battle.start('slime');
    var st = G.Systems.Battle.getState();
    if (st) { st.monster.hp = 9000; st.monster.maxHp = 9999; st.monster.atk = 0; }
    M.switchScene('battle');
  }

  /* ── 战斗场景：每 12 帧出手一次（200ms > 输入锁 150ms），全程在战斗中 ── */
  function phaseBattle(n, level) {
    G.Fx.setLevel(level);
    G.Fx._reset();
    startBattle();
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (M._scene !== 'battle') startBattle();
      if (i % 12 === 0) down('Digit1');
      if (i % 12 === 2) up('Digit1');
      ts += FRAME_DT;
      sampleFrame(function () { M.loop(ts); });
    }
    up('Digit1');
    G.Core.Input.clear();
    return summarize();
  }

  function summarize() {
    var f = SAMPLES;
    function col(k) { return f.map(function (s) { return s[k] || 0; }); }
    var frame = col('total');
    return {
      frames: f.length,
      total: stat(frame),
      draw: stat(col('draw')),
      drawBattle: stat(col('drawBattle')),
      update: stat(col('update')),
      fxUpdate: stat(col('fxUpdate')),
      drawImage: stat(col('di')).p50,
      fillRect: stat(col('fr')).p50,
      fillText: stat(col('ft')).p50,
      over50: frame.filter(function (v) { return v >= 50; }).length
    };
  }

  window.__D16 = {
    run: function () {
      return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        boot();
        var waited = 0;
        (function waitSprites() {
          if (spritesReady()) { start(); return; }
          waited += 100;
          if (waited > 20000) { reject(new Error('sprites not ready')); return; }
          setTimeout(waitSprites, 100);
        })();

        function start() {
          try {
            R.env = {
              dpr: G.Core.Render.dpr, scale: G.Core.Render.scale,
              cssW: G.Core.Render.cssW, cssH: G.Core.Render.cssH,
              innerW: window.innerWidth, innerH: window.innerHeight,
              reduced: G.Fx._state().reduced
            };
            R.phase = 'off';
            SAMPLES = [];
            R.off = phaseBattle(400, 'off');
            R.phase = 'low';
            SAMPLES = [];
            R.low = phaseBattle(400, 'low');
            R.phase = 'high';
            SAMPLES = [];
            R.high = phaseBattle(400, 'high');
            /* 预算口径：低/高三档合并（关档更便宜，不构成风险） */
            R.battle = (function () {
              var a = R.low, b = R.high;
              function merge(x, y) {
                return { p50: Math.max(x.p50, y.p50), p95: Math.max(x.p95, y.p95) };
              }
              var m = merge(a.draw, b.draw);
              var mt = merge(a.total, b.total);
              return {
                p50: m.p50, p95: m.p95,
                drawP50: a.draw.p50, drawP95: Math.max(a.draw.p95, b.draw.p95),
                totalP50: a.total.p50, totalP95: Math.max(a.total.p95, b.total.p95),
                drawImage: Math.max(a.drawImage, b.drawImage),
                fillText: Math.max(a.fillText, b.fillText),
                samples: a.frames + b.frames,
                framesLow: a.frames, framesHigh: b.frames,
                over50: a.over50 + b.over50
              };
            })();
            R.ok = true;
          } catch (e) {
            R.error = String((e && e.stack) || e);
          }
          R.phase = 'done';
          resolve(R);
        }
      });
    }
  };
})();

    fs.writeFileSync(outFile, JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2), 'utf8');

    const r = res || {};
    const fmt = s => s && s.p50 !== null ? `P50=${s.p50} P95=${s.p95} max=${s.max}` : 'n/a';
    console.log('OK=' + r.ok + ' -> ' + outFile);
    console.log('env=' + JSON.stringify(r.env));
    for (const ph of ['off', 'low', 'high']) {
      if (!r[ph]) continue;
      const x = r[ph];
      console.log(`[${ph}] frames=${x.frames} total(${fmt(x.total)}) draw(${fmt(x.draw)}) drawBattle(${fmt(x.drawBattle)}) fxUpdate(${fmt(x.fxUpdate)}) drawImage=${x.drawImage} fillText=${x.fillText} over50=${x.over50}`);
    }
    if (r.battle) console.log('[budget] ' + JSON.stringify(r.battle));
    if (r.error) console.log('PAGE_ERROR=' + r.error);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('FAILED: ' + (e && e.stack || e));
    process.exitCode = 1;
  } finally {
    if (cdp) cdp.close();
    try { child.kill(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    await sleep(300);
    try { fs.rmSync(ud, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }
})();

@@D60FILE@@ preflight/selfcheck/d21_audit.js
/* preflight/selfcheck/d21_audit.js — D-21 素材完整性审计（Node 端，只读）
 * 用途：对 assets/sprites/ 全部 PNG 逐张解码，输出尺寸/不透明像素数/颜色集合等事实，
 *       并做帧组一致性、NAMES 一致性检查，落盘 d21-audit.json 供验证页与文档消费。
 * 用法：node preflight/selfcheck/d21_audit.js [--json]
 */
'use strict';
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const zlib = require('zlib');

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const DIR = path.join(ROOT, 'assets', 'sprites');

/* ── 最小 PNG 解码（8bit / 非隔行 / colorType 0,2,3,4,6）── */
function decodePNG(buf) {
  if (buf.readUInt32BE(0) !== 0x89504e47) throw new Error('not png');
  let off = 8, w = 0, h = 0, bd = 0, ct = 0, inter = 0;
  let plte = null, trns = null;
  const idat = [];
  while (off < buf.length) {
    const len = buf.readUInt32BE(off);
    const type = buf.toString('ascii', off + 4, off + 8);
    const data = buf.slice(off + 8, off + 8 + len);
    if (type === 'IHDR') {
      w = data.readUInt32BE(0); h = data.readUInt32BE(4);
      bd = data[8]; ct = data[9]; inter = data[12];
    } else if (type === 'PLTE') plte = data;
    else if (type === 'tRNS') trns = data;
    else if (type === 'IDAT') idat.push(data);
    else if (type === 'IEND') break;
    off += 12 + len;
  }
  if (inter !== 0) throw new Error('interlaced png unsupported');
  if (bd !== 8) throw new Error('bitDepth ' + bd + ' unsupported');
  const raw = zlib.inflateSync(Buffer.concat(idat));
  const chan = { 0: 1, 2: 3, 3: 1, 4: 2, 6: 4 }[ct];
  if (!chan) throw new Error('colorType ' + ct + ' unsupported');
  const stride = w * chan;
  const out = Buffer.alloc(h * stride);
  let p = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
    const ft = raw[p++];
    const line = raw.slice(p, p + stride); p += stride;
    const cur = out.slice(y * stride, (y + 1) * stride);
    const prev = y > 0 ? out.slice((y - 1) * stride, y * stride) : null;
    for (let x = 0; x < stride; x++) {
      const a = x >= chan ? cur[x - chan] : 0;
      const b = prev ? prev[x] : 0;
      const c = (prev && x >= chan) ? prev[x - chan] : 0;
      let v = line[x];
      if (ft === 1) v += a;
      else if (ft === 2) v += b;
      else if (ft === 3) v += (a + b) >> 1;
      else if (ft === 4) {
        const pp = a + b - c;
        const pa = Math.abs(pp - a), pb = Math.abs(pp - b), pc = Math.abs(pp - c);
        v += (pa <= pb && pa <= pc) ? a : (pb <= pc ? b : c);
      }
      cur[x] = v & 255;
    }
  }
  /* 统一展开成 RGBA8 */
  const rgba = Buffer.alloc(w * h * 4);
  for (let i = 0; i < w * h; i++) {
    let r, g, b, a = 255;
    if (ct === 6) { r = out[i * 4]; g = out[i * 4 + 1]; b = out[i * 4 + 2]; a = out[i * 4 + 3]; }
    else if (ct === 2) { r = out[i * 3]; g = out[i * 3 + 1]; b = out[i * 3 + 2]; }
    else if (ct === 0) { r = g = b = out[i]; }
    else if (ct === 4) { r = g = b = out[i * 2]; a = out[i * 2 + 1]; }
    else { const idx = out[i]; r = plte[idx * 3]; g = plte[idx * 3 + 1]; b = plte[idx * 3 + 2]; a = trns && idx < trns.length ? trns[idx] : 255; }
    rgba[i * 4] = r; rgba[i * 4 + 1] = g; rgba[i * 4 + 2] = b; rgba[i * 4 + 3] = a;
  }
  return { w, h, ct, bd, rgba };
}

function stat(name, buf) {
  const img = decodePNG(buf);
  const { w, h, rgba } = img;
  let opaque = 0, full = 0, semi = 0;
  const colors = new Set();
  let minX = w, minY = h, maxX = -1, maxY = -1;
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      const i = (y * w + x) * 4, a = rgba[i + 3];
      if (a === 0) continue;
      opaque++;
      if (a === 255) full++; else semi++;
      colors.add((rgba[i] << 16) | (rgba[i + 1] << 8) | rgba[i + 2]);
      if (x < minX) minX = x; if (y < minY) minY = y;
      if (x > maxX) maxX = x; if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
    }
  }
  return {
    name, w, h, opaque, full, semi, colorCount: colors.size,
    colors: [...colors].sort((a, b) => a - b).map((v) => '#' + v.toString(16).padStart(6, '0')),
    bbox: maxX < 0 ? null : [minX, minY, maxX, maxY]
  };
}

const files = fs.readdirSync(DIR).filter((f) => f.toLowerCase().endsWith('.png')).sort();
const stats = files.map((f) => stat(f, fs.readFileSync(path.join(DIR, f))));

/* ── 帧组：name 去掉末尾 _fN ── */
const groups = {};
for (const s of stats) {
  const base = s.name.replace(/\.png$/, '');
  const m = /^(.*)_f(\d+)$/.exec(base);
  const key = m ? m[1] : base;
  const idx = m ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : null;
  (groups[key] = groups[key] || []).push({ name: base, idx, w: s.w, h: s.h, opaque: s.opaque });
}
const groupRows = Object.keys(groups).sort().map((k) => {
  const g = groups[k].slice().sort((a, b) => (a.idx ?? -1) - (b.idx ?? -1));
  const dims = [...new Set(g.map((x) => x.w + 'x' + x.h))];
  const idxs = g.map((x) => x.idx).filter((x) => x !== null);
  const expect = idxs.length ? Array.from({ length: Math.max(...idxs) + 1 }, (_, i) => i) : [];
  const missing = expect.filter((i) => !idxs.includes(i));
  const dup = idxs.filter((v, i) => idxs.indexOf(v) !== i);
  return { group: k, frames: g.length, dims, dimsOk: dims.length === 1, missing, dup, files: g.map((x) => x.name) };
});

/* ── NAMES 一致性（从 sprites.js 源抽取）── */
const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'js', 'core', 'sprites.js'), 'utf8');
const namesBlock = src.slice(src.indexOf('var NAMES ='), src.indexOf('];', src.indexOf('var NAMES =')));
const names = [...namesBlock.matchAll(/'([a-z0-9_]+)'/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
const diskSet = new Set(files.map((f) => f.replace(/\.png$/, '')));
const nameSet = new Set(names);
const missingFiles = names.filter((n) => !diskSet.has(n));
const extraFiles = [...diskSet].filter((n) => !nameSet.has(n));
const dupNames = names.filter((v, i) => names.indexOf(v) !== i);

/* ── 全量调色板（不透明像素 RGB 并集）── */
const palette = new Set();
for (const s of stats) for (const c of s.colors) palette.add(c);

/* 四类判定统一走 preflight/lib/assetcheck.js（与浏览器验证页同一套实现） */
const AC = require(path.join(__dirname, '..', 'lib', 'assetcheck.js'));
const acStats = stats.map((s) => ({ name: s.name, w: s.w, h: s.h, opaque: s.opaque, colors: s.colors }));

const empty = AC.emptyFrames(acStats);
const nearEmpty = AC.nearEmptyFrames(acStats, 5);

const report = {
  at: new Date().toISOString(),
  total: stats.length,
  paletteSize: palette.size,
  palette: [...palette].sort(),
  empty, nearEmpty,
  dimsBad: AC.dimsMismatch(acStats),
  indexBad: AC.indexIssues(acStats),
  names: Object.assign({ count: names.length }, AC.namesDiff(names, files)),
  paletteBad: AC.paletteViolations(acStats, [...palette]),
  files: stats,
  groups: groupRows
};

const argDump = process.argv.find((a) => a.startsWith('--dump='));
if (argDump) {
  const pre = argDump.split('=')[1];
  for (const s of stats.filter((x) => x.name.startsWith(pre))) {
    const img = decodePNG(fs.readFileSync(path.join(DIR, s.name)));
    console.log('\n== ' + s.name + ' ' + img.w + 'x' + img.h + ' opaque=' + s.opaque);
    for (let y = 0; y < img.h; y++) {
      let row = '';
      for (let x = 0; x < img.w; x++) {
        const i = (y * img.w + x) * 4, a = img.rgba[i + 3];
        if (a === 0) { row += '.'; continue; }
        const hex = ((img.rgba[i] << 16) | (img.rgba[i + 1] << 8) | img.rgba[i + 2]).toString(16).padStart(6, '0');
        row += /^(0{6}|f{6})$/.test(hex) ? (hex === '000000' ? 'k' : 'W') : String.fromCharCode(97 + (s.colors.indexOf('#' + hex) % 26));
      }
      console.log(String(y).padStart(2, ' ') + ' ' + row);
    }
  }
  process.exit(0);
}

if (process.argv.includes('--json')) {
  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
} else if (process.argv.includes('--md')) {
  /* 逐文件全表 + 分组表，供人工逐行核对 */
  const L = [];
  L.push('# D-21 素材完整性审计全表', '');
  L.push('- 生成时间：' + report.at);
  L.push('- 文件总数：' + report.total + '，帧组：' + groupRows.length + '，调色板：' + report.paletteSize + ' 色');
  L.push('- 空帧：' + (empty.length ? empty.join(', ') : '无') + '；近乎空帧（≤5 px）：' + (nearEmpty.length ? JSON.stringify(nearEmpty) : '无'));
  L.push('- 尺寸不符：' + (report.dimsBad.length ? JSON.stringify(report.dimsBad) : '无') + '；编号断号/重号：' + (report.indexBad.length ? JSON.stringify(report.indexBad) : '无'));
  L.push('- NAMES：注册 ' + names.length + ' / 磁盘 ' + stats.length + ' / 缺文件 ' + missingFiles.length + ' / 多文件 ' + extraFiles.length + ' / 重名 ' + dupNames.length);
  L.push('', '## 逐文件（' + stats.length + ' 行）', '');
  L.push('| # | 文件 | 尺寸 | 不透明 | 全不透明 | 半透明 | 颜色数 | 帧组 |');
  L.push('|---:|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|');
  stats.forEach((s, i) => {
    const base = s.name.replace(/\.png$/, '');
    const m = /^(.*)_f(\d+)$/.exec(base);
    L.push('| ' + (i + 1) + ' | ' + s.name + ' | ' + s.w + '×' + s.h + ' | ' + s.opaque + ' | ' + s.full + ' | ' + s.semi + ' | ' + s.colorCount + ' | ' + (m ? m[1] + ' (f' + m[2] + ')' : '—') + ' |');
  });
  L.push('', '## 帧组（' + groupRows.length + ' 组）', '');
  L.push('| 帧组 | 帧数 | 尺寸 | 尺寸一致 | 缺号 | 重号 |');
  L.push('|---|---:|---|---|---|---|');
  groupRows.forEach((g) => {
    L.push('| ' + g.group + ' | ' + g.frames + ' | ' + g.dims.join(' / ') + ' | ' + (g.dimsOk ? '✓' : '✗') + ' | ' + (g.missing.length ? g.missing.join(',') : '—') + ' | ' + (g.dup.length ? g.dup.join(',') : '—') + ' |');
  });
  L.push('', '## 调色板（' + report.paletteSize + ' 色）', '', '```');
  L.push(report.palette.join(' '));
  L.push('```');
  process.stdout.write(L.join('\n') + '\n');
} else {
  console.log('TOTAL=' + report.total + ' PALETTE=' + report.paletteSize);
  console.log('EMPTY=' + JSON.stringify(empty));
  console.log('NEAR_EMPTY=' + JSON.stringify(nearEmpty));
  console.log('DIMS_BAD=' + JSON.stringify(report.dimsBad));
  console.log('INDEX_BAD=' + JSON.stringify(report.indexBad));
  console.log('NAMES=' + JSON.stringify(report.names));
  console.log('GROUPS=' + groupRows.length);
}

@@D60FILE@@ preflight/selfcheck/d21_fix.js
/* preflight/selfcheck/d21_fix.js — D-21 坏帧修复 + 8 倍放大对照图生成（唯一会写 assets/sprites 的脚本）
 * 用法：
 *   node preflight/selfcheck/d21_fix.js --preview knight_m_hit   # 只出"修复前"预览，不写素材
 *   node preflight/selfcheck/d21_fix.js --fix                    # 修复空帧（从同组其它帧程序化派生）并出前后对照图
 */
'use strict';
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const zlib = require('zlib');

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const DIR = path.join(ROOT, 'assets', 'sprites');
const SHOTS = path.join(__dirname, 'shots');

/* ── 复用 d21_audit 的解码器 ── */
function decodePNG(buf) {
  if (buf.readUInt32BE(0) !== 0x89504e47) throw new Error('not png');
  let off = 8, w = 0, h = 0, bd = 0, ct = 0, inter = 0;
  let plte = null, trns = null;
  const idat = [];
  while (off < buf.length) {
    const len = buf.readUInt32BE(off);
    const type = buf.toString('ascii', off + 4, off + 8);
    const data = buf.slice(off + 8, off + 8 + len);
    if (type === 'IHDR') { w = data.readUInt32BE(0); h = data.readUInt32BE(4); bd = data[8]; ct = data[9]; inter = data[12]; }
    else if (type === 'PLTE') plte = data;
    else if (type === 'tRNS') trns = data;
    else if (type === 'IDAT') idat.push(data);
    else if (type === 'IEND') break;
    off += 12 + len;
  }
  if (inter !== 0 || bd !== 8) throw new Error('unsupported png');
  const raw = zlib.inflateSync(Buffer.concat(idat));
  const chan = { 0: 1, 2: 3, 3: 1, 4: 2, 6: 4 }[ct];
  const stride = w * chan;
  const out = Buffer.alloc(h * stride);
  let p = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
    const ft = raw[p++];
    const line = raw.slice(p, p + stride); p += stride;
    const cur = out.slice(y * stride, (y + 1) * stride);
    const prev = y > 0 ? out.slice((y - 1) * stride, y * stride) : null;
    for (let x = 0; x < stride; x++) {
      const a = x >= chan ? cur[x - chan] : 0;
      const b = prev ? prev[x] : 0;
      const c = (prev && x >= chan) ? prev[x - chan] : 0;
      let v = line[x];
      if (ft === 1) v += a;
      else if (ft === 2) v += b;
      else if (ft === 3) v += (a + b) >> 1;
      else if (ft === 4) {
        const pp = a + b - c;
        const pa = Math.abs(pp - a), pb = Math.abs(pp - b), pc = Math.abs(pp - c);
        v += (pa <= pb && pa <= pc) ? a : (pb <= pc ? b : c);
      }
      cur[x] = v & 255;
    }
  }
  const rgba = Buffer.alloc(w * h * 4);
  for (let i = 0; i < w * h; i++) {
    let r, g, b, a = 255;
    if (ct === 6) { r = out[i * 4]; g = out[i * 4 + 1]; b = out[i * 4 + 2]; a = out[i * 4 + 3]; }
    else if (ct === 2) { r = out[i * 3]; g = out[i * 3 + 1]; b = out[i * 3 + 2]; }
    else if (ct === 0) { r = g = b = out[i]; }
    else if (ct === 4) { r = g = b = out[i * 2]; a = out[i * 2 + 1]; }
    else { const idx = out[i]; r = plte[idx * 3]; g = plte[idx * 3 + 1]; b = plte[idx * 3 + 2]; a = trns && idx < trns.length ? trns[idx] : 255; }
    rgba[i * 4] = r; rgba[i * 4 + 1] = g; rgba[i * 4 + 2] = b; rgba[i * 4 + 3] = a;
  }
  return { w, h, rgba };
}

const CRC = (() => {
  const t = new Int32Array(256);
  for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) { let c = n; for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1; t[n] = c; }
  return (buf) => { let c = -1; for (const b of buf) c = t[(c ^ b) & 255] ^ (c >>> 8); return (c ^ -1) >>> 0; };
})();

/* 最小 PNG 编码（RGBA8，无滤波） */
function encodePNG(w, h, rgba) {
  const sig = Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10]);
  const chunk = (type, data) => {
    const len = Buffer.alloc(4); len.writeUInt32BE(data.length);
    const td = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(type, 'ascii'), data]);
    const crc = Buffer.alloc(4); crc.writeUInt32BE(CRC(td));
    return Buffer.concat([len, td, crc]);
  };
  const ihdr = Buffer.alloc(13);
  ihdr.writeUInt32BE(w, 0); ihdr.writeUInt32BE(h, 4);
  ihdr[8] = 8; ihdr[9] = 6; ihdr[10] = 0; ihdr[11] = 0; ihdr[12] = 0;
  const rows = Buffer.alloc(h * (w * 4 + 1));
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
    rows[y * (w * 4 + 1)] = 0;
    rgba.copy(rows, y * (w * 4 + 1) + 1, y * w * 4, (y + 1) * w * 4);
  }
  return Buffer.concat([sig, chunk('IHDR', ihdr), chunk('IDAT', zlib.deflateSync(rows, { level: 9 })), chunk('IEND', Buffer.alloc(0))]);
}

/* 把若干行帧横向拼成对照图：每帧 8 倍放大 + 棋盘底 + 行首标签（色块，无字体依赖） */
function renderRows(rows, scale, outPath) {
  const pad = 6, labelH = 10;
  const cols = Math.max(...rows.map((r) => r.length));
  const fw = rows[0][0].w, fh = rows[0][0].h;
  const cw = fw * scale, ch = fh * scale;
  const W = cols * (cw + pad) + pad;
  const H = rows.length * (ch + pad + labelH) + pad;
  const out = Buffer.alloc(W * H * 4);
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
      const i = (y * W + x) * 4;
      const dark = (Math.floor(x / 8) + Math.floor(y / 8)) % 2 === 0;
      const v = dark ? 40 : 56;
      out[i] = v; out[i + 1] = v; out[i + 2] = v + 6; out[i + 3] = 255;
    }
  }
  rows.forEach((frames, rn) => {
    const baseY = pad + rn * (ch + pad + labelH) + labelH;
    frames.forEach((f, n) => {
      const ox = pad + n * (cw + pad), oy = baseY;
      for (let y = 0; y < ch; y++) for (let x = 0; x < cw; x++) {
        const i = ((oy + y) * W + ox + x) * 4;
        out[i] = 24; out[i + 1] = 26; out[i + 2] = 34;
      }
      for (let y = 0; y < f.h * scale; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < f.w * scale; x++) {
          const src = ((Math.floor(y / scale)) * f.w + Math.floor(x / scale)) * 4;
          const a = f.rgba[src + 3];
          if (a === 0) continue;
          const i = ((oy + y) * W + ox + x) * 4;
          const k = a / 255;
          out[i] = Math.round(f.rgba[src] * k + out[i] * (1 - k));
          out[i + 1] = Math.round(f.rgba[src + 1] * k + out[i + 1] * (1 - k));
          out[i + 2] = Math.round(f.rgba[src + 2] * k + out[i + 2] * (1 - k));
          out[i + 3] = 255;
        }
      }
      /* 帧号：n+1 个白色小方块 */
      for (let k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
        for (let y = 0; y < 6; y++) for (let x = 0; x < 6; x++) {
          const i = ((baseY - labelH + y) * W + ox + k * 8 + x) * 4;
          out[i] = 240; out[i + 1] = 240; out[i + 2] = 240; out[i + 3] = 255;
        }
      }
    });
  });
  fs.writeFileSync(outPath, encodePNG(W, H, out));
  return { file: outPath, w: W, h: H };
}

function strip(frames, scale, outPath) { return renderRows([frames], scale, outPath); }
function compare(a, b, scale, outPath) { return renderRows([a, b], scale, outPath); }

function load(name) {
  const img = decodePNG(fs.readFileSync(path.join(DIR, name + '.png')));
  return { name, w: img.w, h: img.h, rgba: img.rgba };
}
function opaqueCount(f) {
  let n = 0;
  for (let i = 3; i < f.rgba.length; i += 4) if (f.rgba[i] > 0) n++;
  return n;
}

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const pre = (process.argv.find((a) => a.startsWith('--preview=')) || '').split('=')[1];
const doFix = args.includes('--fix');

if (pre) {
  const names = fs.readdirSync(DIR).filter((f) => f.startsWith(pre) && f.endsWith('.png')).sort();
  const frames = names.map((f) => load(f.replace(/\.png$/, '')));
  const r = strip(frames, 8, path.join(SHOTS, 'D21-' + pre.replace(/_$/, '') + '-before.png'));
  console.log('PREVIEW ' + r.file + ' ' + r.w + 'x' + r.h + ' frames=' + frames.map((f) => opaqueCount(f)).join('/'));
}

if (doFix) {
  /* 空帧判定：不透明像素为 0 */
  const bad = [];
  for (const f of fs.readdirSync(DIR).filter((x) => x.endsWith('.png'))) {
    const img = load(f.replace(/\.png$/, ''));
    if (opaqueCount(img) === 0) bad.push(img.name);
  }
  console.log('EMPTY=' + JSON.stringify(bad));

  /* 修复规则表：每个坏帧登记"从同组哪一帧、怎么派生"，不跨组借图、不新增颜色 */
  const RULES = {
    knight_m_hit_anim_f1: { from: 'knight_m_hit_anim_f0', dx: -1, dy: 1, why: '受击顿挫：整帧左下位移 1 像素，颜色与尺寸完全不变' }
  };

  const before = {};
  for (const name of bad) {
    const rule = RULES[name];
    if (!rule) { console.log('NO_RULE ' + name); continue; }
    const src = load(rule.from);
    const old = load(name);
    before[name] = old;
    /* 逐像素搬运（整数位移，透明填充），像素值原样复制 → 不产生新颜色 */
    const dst = Buffer.alloc(src.w * src.h * 4);
    for (let y = 0; y < src.h; y++) {
      for (let x = 0; x < src.w; x++) {
        const sx = x - rule.dx, sy = y - rule.dy;
        if (sx < 0 || sy < 0 || sx >= src.w || sy >= src.h) continue;
        const si = (sy * src.w + sx) * 4, di = (y * src.w + x) * 4;
        src.rgba.copy(dst, di, si, si + 4);
      }
    }
    const colsBefore = new Set();
    for (let i = 0; i < dst.length; i += 4) if (dst[i + 3] > 0) colsBefore.add(dst.readUIntBE(i, 3));
    const colsSrc = new Set();
    for (let i = 0; i < src.rgba.length; i += 4) if (src.rgba[i + 3] > 0) colsSrc.add(src.rgba.readUIntBE(i, 3));
    const newColors = [...colsBefore].filter((c) => !colsSrc.has(c));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(DIR, name + '.png'), encodePNG(src.w, src.h, dst));
    const after = { name, w: src.w, h: src.h, rgba: dst };
    console.log('FIXED ' + name + ' from=' + rule.from + ' d=' + rule.dx + ',' + rule.dy +
      ' opaque ' + opaqueCount(old) + '→' + opaqueCount(after) + ' newColors=' + JSON.stringify(newColors) +
      ' sameSize=' + (old.w === after.w && old.h === after.h));

    /* 前后对照图：上排修复前 f0..f3，下排修复后 f0..f3，8 倍放大 */
    const pre = name.replace(/_f\d+$/, '');
    const names = fs.readdirSync(DIR).filter((f) => f.startsWith(pre) && f.endsWith('.png')).sort();
    const rowBefore = names.map((f) => {
      const n = f.replace(/\.png$/, '');
      return n === name ? old : load(n);
    });
    const rowAfter = names.map((f) => load(f.replace(/\.png$/, '')));
    const out = path.join(SHOTS, 'D21-' + pre + '-before-after.png');
    const r = compare(rowBefore, rowAfter, 8, out);
    console.log('COMPARE ' + r.file + ' ' + r.w + 'x' + r.h);
  }
}

# preflight/selfcheck/d23-report.ps1 - D-23: run bot attribution batch page, dump d23-report.json
# usage: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File preflight\selfcheck\d23-report.ps1 -Runs 50
param(
  [int]$Runs = 50,
  [string]$Edge = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe'
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$page = Join-Path $root 'preflight\bot_d23.html'
$uri = ([System.Uri]$page).AbsoluteUri + ('?n=' + $Runs)
$tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('d23dom_' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 6) + '.html')
$ud = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('d23ud_' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 6))

$eargs = @(
  '--headless=new', '--disable-gpu', '--no-first-run', '--no-default-browser-check',
  '--allow-file-access-from-files', '--hide-scrollbars', "--user-data-dir=$ud",
  '--window-size=1024,640', '--virtual-time-budget=900000', '--dump-dom', $uri
)
Start-Process -FilePath $Edge -ArgumentList $eargs -NoNewWindow -Wait `
  -RedirectStandardOutput $tmp -RedirectStandardError ($tmp + '.err')

$dom = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tmp -Raw -Encoding UTF8
$m = [regex]::Match($dom, '(?s)<pre id="report">(.*?)</pre>')
if (-not $m.Success) { throw 'd23-report.ps1: page did not emit #report (BATCH_FAIL, see title)' }
$json = $m.Groups[1].Value
$json = $json.Replace('&lt;', '<').Replace('&gt;', '>').Replace('&quot;', '"').Replace('&#39;', "'").Replace('&amp;', '&')

$obj = $json | ConvertFrom-Json
if (-not $obj.ok) { throw ('d23-report.ps1: batch failed: ' + $obj.err) }

$out = Join-Path $root 'preflight\selfcheck\d23-report.json'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($out, $json, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $tmp, ($tmp + '.err') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $ud -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

$a = $obj.attribution
Write-Output ('runs=' + $obj.runs.Count + ' dead=' + $obj.summary.dead + ' deaths=' + $a.deadRuns +
  ' trap=' + $a.trapDeaths + ' noTelemetry=' + $a.noTelemetry + ' wallMs=' + $obj.wallMs)
Write-Output '--- killers (desc) ---'
foreach ($r in $a.byKiller) {
  Write-Output ('  {0,-22} {1,3}  {2,5}%  lv={3} rnd={4} pot={5} hp%={6} wp={7} ar={8}' -f `
    $r.name, $r.count, $r.pct, $r.avgLevel, $r.avgRound, $r.avgPotionsLeft, $r.avgHpPct, $r.topWeapon, $r.topArmor)
}
Write-Output '--- floors ---'
foreach ($f in $a.byFloor) { Write-Output ('  F' + $f.floor + ' = ' + $f.count) }
Write-Output ('missingFieldCounts=' + ($a.missingFieldCounts | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
Write-Output ('-> ' + $out)

# D-26 线上核验欠账清零（Pages 运行时核验）

- 基线 commit：`66a2381`（本地回归 67/67）
- 生成时间：2026-11-11T22:24:26+08:00
- 机器可读产物：`preflight/selfcheck/d26-online-verify.json`
- 页面 URL 模板：`https://codekiller-3.github.io/ai-dungeon-rpg/preflight/<page>.html?v=66a2381`

## 0. 方法与限制（先说清楚，避免误读）

1. **本机 shell 无外网**：`Test-NetConnection codekiller-3.github.io -Port 443` 对 3 个 GitHub Pages IP 全部失败，Edge headless 直连返回空 DOM、`HTTP=0`。因此**无法**用 `run-all.ps1` 那套 headless 在本机跑线上页。
2. 实际采用的通道：**会执行页面 JS 的 WebFetch**。它对 `verify_smoke.html` 返回了运行期结果（`smokeOk:true, errors:[]`），证明裁决行是运行时生成、不是静态 HTML。
3. 该通道**不暴露 HTTP 状态码**，也**不暴露 console/pageerror**。所以本表 `HTTP` 一列记 `n/a（可达=取到内容）`，`JS_ERRORS` 用 `verify_smoke` 的 `errors:[]` 作替代证据，均如实标注、不伪造。
4. 通道对**子资源**命中了旧版 `js/core/render.js`（详见 §3.1），导致引导页相关 3 页显示 FAIL —— 这是缓存伪影，不是线上文件坏了。

## 3. 三类 FAIL 的归因

### 3.1 旧子资源缓存伪影（3 页，**不是线上坏了**）

- 现象：`verify_d25` 线上 `A4_fourteenRows = 13/13/13`，即页面执行时读到的 `guideRows()` 还是 D-25 之前的 13 行。
- 反证：对同一路径 `https://codekiller-3.github.io/ai-dungeon-rpg/js/core/render.js`（带 `?v=66a2381b` 与不带 query 各取一次）**都能取到含「装备：捡到或买到武器/护甲后…」的新文件**。
- 结论：部署未回退，HTML 也是新版（d25 独有的 A1/A6 断言都在跑）；只是取证通道把旧版 `js/core/render.js` 喂给了页面。真实用户强刷即可拿到新版。
- 影响页：`verify_d20`（B7 文案=false）、`verify_d24`（C2/C4）、`verify_d25`（A1/A2/A4）。这三页的其余断言全部通过，与"只有渲染引导页那一份文件是旧的"一致。

### 3.2 依赖本地产物的元页面（5 页，线上无法判定）

`d05 / d06 / d09 / d15b / d22`：断言依赖本轮 `runId` 台账、`d22-selftest.json` 产物与 BOM 字节。线上没有"本轮运行"这回事，`runId=null`、`artifact` 与 `computed` 必然不等。**不计入线上失败**，也不代表功能回归。

### 3.3 取证通道渲染环境差异（7 页，不作线上坏处理）

`m9_2 / m9_5 / p2_3 / resize / s02a / s3_4 / selfcheck`：失败项全部集中在贴图解码、画布像素采样、画布快照、DPR 一类。同一批页面在本地 headless `run-all.ps1 -Budget 3500` 下 67/67 全过。判定为取证通道的渲染环境差异，需要一台真浏览器 + 外网才能最终定论。

## 4. 历史欠账清单（此前标"未核验"的 commit）

> Pages 只服务**最新**版本，`https://…/ai-dungeon-rpg/<path>` 没有"按 commit 取旧文件"的能力（`?v=` 只是查询串，不改变内容）。所以**旧版本身一律无法回看**。下表"间接可核验"指：该改动若仍在最新线上生效，其对应验证页在线上应 PASS。

| commit | 主题 | 旧版回看 | 本次结论 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.gitignore`（f4f9ee9） | D-05 自检工具收口 | 不能 | 不可判定：verify_d05 线上读台账，属元页面 |

| `items.js`（38fd2a3） | C-04 两件 240 档装备 | 不能 | 间接可核验：verify_c04 线上 PASS |

## 5. 结论

- 线上**可达**，67 页里 **51 页**在线上直接 PASS，说明绝大多数机制在真实部署环境成立。
- 15 个 FAIL 中，**0 个可判定为"线上真的坏了"**：3 个是旧子资源缓存伪影（且有直接 GET 反证），5 个是元页面依赖本地产物，7 个是取证通道渲染环境差异。
- **1 页**（verify_d18）本次拿不到裁决行，如实记为 NONE。
- 仍然欠着的：一台"真浏览器 + 外网 + 强刷缓存"的复跑，用来把那 3 个缓存伪影和 7 个环境差异彻底钉死。本机 shell 无外网，这条做不到。
- 落盘后的本地回归（与线上结论分开记）：`run-all.ps1 -Budget 3500` → `TOTAL=68 PASS=68 FAIL=0 NONE=0 MIXED=0`、`GUARD=OK expected=68 actual=68`；`selfcheck.js` → `FAIL=0`（1 条既有 WARN：QF-01 单文件体积）。新增 `verify_d26` 只做产物一致性校验，不重复线上取证。

function Avg-Of($runs, [string]$field) {
  $vals = @($runs | ForEach-Object { $_.$field } | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })
  if ($vals.Count -eq 0) { return $null }
  return [math]::Round((($vals | Measure-Object -Average).Average), 1)
}
function Floor-Map($attribution) {
  $h = @{}
  foreach ($f in $attribution.byFloor) { $h[[string]$f.floor] = $f.count }
  return $h
}

$a = $obj.attribution
Write-Output ('runs=' + $obj.runs.Count + ' dead=' + $obj.summary.dead + ' deaths=' + $a.deadRuns +
  ' trap=' + $a.trapDeaths + ' noTelemetry=' + $a.noTelemetry + ' wallMs=' + $obj.wallMs)
Write-Output ('missingFieldCounts=' + ($a.missingFieldCounts | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
Write-Output ('avgActions=' + (Avg-Of $obj.runs 'actions') + ' avgLevel=' + (Avg-Of $obj.runs 'level'))

$d23Path = Join-Path $self 'd23-report.json'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d23Path) {
  $d23 = Get-Content -LiteralPath $d23Path -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
  $f23 = Floor-Map $d23.attribution
  $f27 = Floor-Map $a
  Write-Output '--- D-23 -> D-27 contrast ---'
  Write-Output ('avgActions        ' + (Avg-Of $d23.runs 'actions') + ' -> ' + (Avg-Of $obj.runs 'actions'))
  Write-Output ('deaths            ' + $d23.attribution.deadRuns + ' -> ' + $a.deadRuns)
  foreach ($k in @('1','2','3','4','5')) {
    $x = if ($f23.ContainsKey($k)) { $f23[$k] } else { 0 }
    $y = if ($f27.ContainsKey($k)) { $f27[$k] } else { 0 }
    Write-Output ('deaths on F' + $k + '       ' + $x + ' -> ' + $y)
  }
  Write-Output ('weaponId:null     ' + $d23.attribution.missingFieldCounts.'weaponId:null' +
    ' -> ' + $a.missingFieldCounts.'weaponId:null')
  Write-Output ('armorId:null      ' + $d23.attribution.missingFieldCounts.'armorId:null' +
    ' -> ' + $a.missingFieldCounts.'armorId:null')
  Write-Output ('byCause D-23      ' + (($d23.attribution.byCause | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)))
  Write-Output ('byCause D-27      ' + (($a.byCause | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)))
}
Write-Output ('-> ' + $out)

  $tag = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 6)

    '--headless=new', '--disable-gpu', '--no-first-run', '--no-default-browser-check',
    '--allow-file-access-from-files', '--hide-scrollbars', "--user-data-dir=$ud",
    '--window-size=1024,640', '--virtual-time-budget=900000', '--dump-dom', $uri
  )
  Start-Process -FilePath $Edge -ArgumentList $eargs -NoNewWindow -Wait `
    -RedirectStandardOutput $tmp -RedirectStandardError ($tmp + '.err')

  $m = [regex]::Match($dom, '(?s)<pre id="report">(.*?)</pre>')

  Remove-Item $tmp, ($tmp + '.err'), $ud -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

$json = $json.Replace('&lt;', '<').Replace('&gt;', '>').Replace('&quot;', '"').Replace('&#39;', "'").Replace('&amp;', '&')
