$g2f5 = '-'; if ($obj.agg.g2) { $g2f5 = $obj.agg.g2.f5.reached }
$s1f5 = '-'; if ($obj.agg.s1) { $s1f5 = $obj.agg.s1.f5.reached }
$m1f4 = '-'; if ($obj.agg.m1) { $m1f4 = $obj.agg.m1.floorReach.'4' }
Write-Output ('adapt=' + $Adaptive + ' form=' + $Form + ' b1: wins=' + $b1w + ' f5=' + $b1f5 +
  ' rescue_runs=' + $rs.runs + ' triggers=' + $rs.triggers + ' gear=' + $rs.gear +
  ' spent=' + $rs.spent + ' maxTrigger=' + $rs.maxTriggers + ' maxSpent=' + $rs.maxSpent +
  ' | g2_f5=' + $g2f5 + ' s1_f5=' + $s1f5 + ' m1_f4=' + $m1f4 + ' -> ' + $outPath)

@@D60FILE@@ preflight/selfcheck/d60-corpus.ps1
# D-60：生成全仓文本语料，供 verify_d60 的 A 组一次读取后逐文件扫描。
# 为什么不是 314 次同步 XHR：Chrome 的 --virtual-time-budget 下每次 file:// 同步
# 请求约 15ms，串行读完会被预算截断（实测停在 3.1s，页面一直 RUNNING）。
# 语料在提交前重新生成；verify_d60 另外实时复核 13 个高危文件。
param([string]$Root = '')
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if (-not $Root) {
  $here = if ($PSScriptRoot) { $PSScriptRoot } else { Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path }
  $Root = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $here '..\..')).Path
}
$exts = @('.md', '.html', '.js', '.css', '.ps1')
$files = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Root -Recurse -File | Where-Object {
  $_.FullName -notmatch '\\\.git\\' -and $exts -contains $_.Extension.ToLower()
} | Sort-Object FullName
$sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
foreach ($f in $files) {
  $rel = $f.FullName.Substring($Root.Length + 1) -replace '\\', '/'
  [void]$sb.Append('@@D60FILE@@ ' + $rel + "`n")
  $text = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
  [void]$sb.Append($text.Replace("`r`n", "`n"))
  [void]$sb.Append("`n")
}
$out = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'd60-corpus.txt'
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($out, $sb.ToString(), (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
Write-Output ("files=" + $files.Count + " bytes=" + (Get-Item $out).Length + " -> " + $out)

@@D60FILE@@ preflight/selfcheck/run-all.ps1
# preflight/selfcheck/run-all.ps1 — 全量回归批跑（Edge headless）
# 用法：powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File preflight/selfcheck/run-all.ps1 [-Budget 3000]
# 覆盖：preflight/verify_*.html 全部页面（含 verify_selfcheck 运行时自检、verify_smoke 主循环冒烟）
# 输出：逐页 PASS/FAIL 表 + preflight/selfcheck/regression-result.json；exit code = FAIL 页数

param([int]$Budget = 3500, [string[]]$VerdictFile = @(), [switch]$ShowSummary,
      [string]$ScanDir = '', [int]$ExpectPages = -1, [switch]$GuardProbe, [switch]$SelfTest)

# ── 裁决解析（D-06）──────────────────────────────────────────────
# 逐页裁决只认页面输出中的**独立裁决行**：行首（允许带 HTML 标签前缀）为 "PASS {json}" / "FAIL {json}"。
# 同一页出现多条时取**最后一条**；只有同时出现 PASS 与 FAIL 两条裁决行（页面自相矛盾）才判 MIXED；
# 一条都没有判 NONE。**不扫描 payload 内部字段**——payload 里合法的 "ok":false 是数据，不是裁决。
function Get-PageVerdict {
  param([string]$Text)
  $hits = @()
  foreach ($line in ($Text -split "`r?`n")) {
    $s = $line -replace '^(?:<[^>]*>)+', ''
    $m = [regex]::Match($s, '^\s*(PASS|FAIL)\s+\{')
    if ($m.Success) { $hits += [pscustomobject]@{ verdict = $m.Groups[1].Value; line = $s } }
  }
  if ($hits.Count -eq 0) { return [pscustomobject]@{ verdict = 'NONE'; payload = '' } }
  $last = $hits[$hits.Count - 1]
  $names = @($hits | ForEach-Object { $_.verdict })
  $verdict = if (($names -contains 'PASS') -and ($names -contains 'FAIL')) { 'MIXED' } else { $last.verdict }
  $pm = [regex]::Match($last.line, '^(?:PASS|FAIL)\s+(\{[\s\S]*?\})\s*(?:</|$)')
  return [pscustomobject]@{ verdict = $verdict; payload = $(if ($pm.Success) { $pm.Groups[1].Value } else { '' }) }
}

# ── 汇总计数（D-08）──────────────────────────────────────────────
# PowerShell 中 `(... | Where-Object {...}).Count` 在结果恰好 1 条时拿到的是单个对象，
# .Count 取不到值 → 打印为空白（"一页失败"看起来像"零失败"）。所有计数一律用 @(...) 强制数组。
function Get-RegressionSummary {
  param($Rows)
  [pscustomobject]@{
    at    = (Get-Date).ToString('s')
    total = @($Rows).Count
    pass  = @($Rows | Where-Object { $_.verdict -eq 'PASS' }).Count
    fail  = @($Rows | Where-Object { $_.verdict -eq 'FAIL' }).Count
    none  = @($Rows | Where-Object { $_.verdict -eq 'NONE' }).Count
    mixed = @($Rows | Where-Object { $_.verdict -eq 'MIXED' }).Count
  }
}

# ── 产物指纹（D-15b）──────────────────────────────────────────
# 与 preflight/lib/meta.js 的 canonical()/fnv1a() 逐字节对齐：
#   page|verdict|meta|source|ms，行间 \n，无尾随换行；FNV-1a 32 位，输出小写 8 位十六进制。
# 规范化文本只含 ASCII（页面名、裁决、true/false、current-run、整数毫秒），
# 因此 JS 的 charCodeAt 与 PowerShell 的 UTF-8 字节等价。
function Get-RowsHash {
  param($Rows)
  $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
  $first = $true
  foreach ($r in @($Rows)) {
    if (-not $first) { [void]$sb.Append("`n") }
    $first = $false
    $m = if ($r.meta) { 'true' } else { 'false' }
    $s = if ($r.source) { $r.source } else { '' }
    [void]$sb.Append("$($r.page)|$($r.verdict)|$m|$s|$($r.ms)")
  }
  $h = [uint32]2166136261
  foreach ($b in [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($sb.ToString())) {
    $h = $h -bxor [uint32]$b
    $h = [uint32](([uint64]$h * 16777619) % 4294967296)
  }
  return $h.ToString('x8')
}

# D6-1/D6-2/D6-3 用：对给定文本文件跑一次裁决解析（不启动浏览器），输出裁决行供取证
# D8-1~D8-3 用：加 -ShowSummary 时按同一套汇总函数打印汇总行并以 FAIL 数退出，用于单条场景取证
if ($VerdictFile.Count -gt 0) {
  $vrRows = @()
  foreach ($vf in $VerdictFile) {
    $txt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $vf -Raw -Encoding utf8
    $r = Get-PageVerdict -Text $txt
    $vrRows += [pscustomobject]@{ page = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($vf); verdict = $r.verdict; payload = $r.payload }
  }
  if ($ShowSummary) {
    $s = Get-RegressionSummary -Rows $vrRows
    "TOTAL=$($s.total) PASS=$($s.pass) FAIL=$($s.fail) NONE=$($s.none) MIXED=$($s.mixed)"
    exit $s.fail
  }
  "VERDICT=$($vrRows[$vrRows.Count - 1].verdict)"
  exit 0
}

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$env:PATH = "C:\Windows\System32;C:\Windows;$env:PATH"

$root = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$edge = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $edge)) { Write-Output "EDGE_NOT_FOUND"; exit 99 }

# ── 页数兜底（D-22）──────────────────────────────────────────────
# 背景：本脚本按 glob 扫 verify_*.html，页数没有下限。若验证页被移走/改名，脚本会打印
#       TOTAL=0 PASS=0 FAIL=0 并以成功码退出——"一页没跑"看起来却是全绿。
# 做法：期望页面的**唯一来源**是仓库里的 preflight/selfcheck/page-baseline.json（人工维护的清单，
#       不参与本脚本运行期计算）。本轮实测清单与基线逐名比对：
#         少页 / 页数不等 → 失败（exit 2）
#         多页（新增未登记）→ 不失败，但打印 BASELINE_STALE 提示更新基线（因为"多跑"不会造成假绿，
#                            而"少跑"才会；仍不允许静默，必须有可见提示）
#       期望值绝不取 $rows / current-run.json / regression-result.json——那是本轮产物，自证会形成闭环。
$baselinePath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'page-baseline.json'

function Get-PageGuard {
  param([string]$Dir, [int]$Expect = -1, [string[]]$BaselinePages = @())
  $files = @()
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Dir) {
    $files = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Dir -Filter 'verify_*.html' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
      Sort-Object Name)
  }
  $actual = @($files | ForEach-Object { $_.BaseName })
  $expected = $Expect
  $source = 'param -ExpectPages'
  if ($expected -lt 0) {
    if ($BaselinePages.Count -gt 0) { $expected = @($BaselinePages).Count; $source = 'page-baseline.json' }
    else { $expected = -1; $source = 'MISSING' }
  }
  $missing = @()
  $extra = @()
  if ($BaselinePages.Count -gt 0) {
    $missing = @($BaselinePages | Where-Object { $actual -notcontains $_ })
    $extra = @($actual | Where-Object { $BaselinePages -notcontains $_ })
  }
  $empty = ($actual.Count -eq 0)
  # ok 判定：有页、期望值可用。
  #   -ExpectPages 显式给数时：实际页数必须严格等于它（多一页也算 FAIL，因为是人给的硬期望）；
  #   期望值来自基线时：只要求**基线的每一页都还在**（missing=0）；额外页不算失败，
  #   但会置 stale=true 并要求打印 BASELINE_STALE（多跑不会假绿，少跑才会；但不能静默）。
  $ok = (-not $empty) -and ($expected -ge 0)
  if ($ok) {
    if ($Expect -ge 0) { $ok = ($missing.Count -eq 0) -and ($actual.Count -eq $Expect) }
    else { $ok = ($missing.Count -eq 0) -and (($actual.Count - $extra.Count) -eq $expected) }
  }
  return [pscustomobject]@{
    expectSource = $source
    expected     = $expected
    actual       = $actual.Count
    missing      = $missing
    extra        = $extra
    empty        = $empty
    stale        = ($extra.Count -gt 0)
    ok           = $ok
  }
}

function Read-PageBaseline {
  param([string]$Path)
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { return @() }
  try {
    $j = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
    return @($j.pages)
  } catch { return @() }
}

$baselinePages = @(Read-PageBaseline -Path $baselinePath)
$scanDir = if ($ScanDir) { $ScanDir } else { Join-Path $root 'preflight' }

# ── 自测 / 探针（D-22）──────────────────────────────────────────
# 只跑"扫描 + 兜底判定"，不启动浏览器：用于 verify_d22 消费的负例证据，也用于人工排障。
# 与真实批跑互不干扰：-ScanDir 可指向临时目录，真实批跑路径不受影响。
if ($GuardProbe) {
  $g = Get-PageGuard -Dir $scanDir -Expect $ExpectPages -BaselinePages $baselinePages
  "GUARD=$(if ($g.ok) { 'OK' } else { 'FAIL' }) expected=$($g.expected) actual=$($g.actual) missing=$($g.missing.Count) extra=$($g.extra.Count) source=$($g.expectSource)"
  if ($g.empty) { "GUARD_EMPTY_SET=1" }
  if ($g.stale) { "BASELINE_STALE=1 extra=$($g.extra -join ',')" }
  if ($g.missing.Count -gt 0) { "GUARD_MISSING=$($g.missing -join ',')" }
  if (-not $g.ok) { exit 2 }
  exit 0
}

if ($SelfTest) {
  # 五个场景全部通过**子进程真实调用 -GuardProbe** 取证（拿到的就是真实退出码，不是本地推断）。
  # 临时目录里只放空 .html 占位，不复制也不改动项目里的任何验证页。
  $tmpRoot = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('d22selftest_' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8))
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $tmpRoot -Force | Out-Null
  $realDir = Join-Path $root 'preflight'
  $realCount = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $realDir -Filter 'verify_*.html').Count

  # 造两个临时扫描目录：一个"基线全在 + 多一页"，一个"缺一页"
  $dirExtra = Join-Path $tmpRoot 'extra'
  $dirShort = Join-Path $tmpRoot 'short'
  $dirEmpty = Join-Path $tmpRoot 'empty'
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dirExtra, $dirShort, $dirEmpty -Force | Out-Null
  foreach ($n in $baselinePages) {
    Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dirExtra ($n + '.html')) -Value '' -Encoding ascii
  }
  Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dirExtra 'verify_zz.html') -Value '' -Encoding ascii
  $shortList = @($baselinePages)
  if ($shortList.Count -gt 1) { $shortList = @($shortList[0..($shortList.Count - 2)]) }
  foreach ($n in $shortList) {
    Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dirShort ($n + '.html')) -Value '' -Encoding ascii
  }

  $cases = @()
  $defs = @(
    @{ id = 'A_normal'; dir = $realDir; expect = -1; wantExit = 0; desc = '正常：真实目录，页数 = 基线' },
    @{ id = 'B_fewByExpect'; dir = $realDir; expect = ($realCount + 1); wantExit = 2; desc = '负例·少页：把期望页数调高 1' },
    @{ id = 'C_emptyDir'; dir = $dirEmpty; expect = -1; wantExit = 2; desc = '负例·空集：扫描目录为空' },
    @{ id = 'D_extraPage'; dir = $dirExtra; expect = -1; wantExit = 0; desc = '负例·多页：基线全在 + verify_zz' },
    @{ id = 'E_missingPage'; dir = $dirShort; expect = -1; wantExit = 2; desc = '负例·缺页：少一页' }
  )
  foreach ($d in $defs) {
    $args = @('-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', $PSCommandPath, '-GuardProbe', '-ScanDir', $d.dir)
    if ($d.expect -ge 0) { $args += @('-ExpectPages', [string]$d.expect) }
    $o = Join-Path $tmpRoot ($d.id + '.out')
    $e = Join-Path $tmpRoot ($d.id + '.err')
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell' -ArgumentList $args -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru `
      -RedirectStandardOutput $o -RedirectStandardError $e
    $txt = ''
    try { $txt = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $o -Raw -Encoding utf8) } catch { $txt = '' }
    $gl = ($txt -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match '^GUARD=' } | Select-Object -Last 1)
    $cases += [pscustomobject]@{
      id       = $d.id
      desc     = $d.desc
      scanDir  = $(if ($d.dir -eq $realDir) { '<preflight>' } else { '<temp>:' + (Split-Path $d.dir -Leaf) })
      expect   = $d.expect
      exit     = $p.ExitCode
      wantExit = $d.wantExit
      line     = $(if ($gl) { $gl } else { '' })
      emptySet = ($txt -match 'GUARD_EMPTY_SET=1')
      stale    = ($txt -match 'BASELINE_STALE=1')
      output   = ($txt -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match '^(GUARD|BASELINE_STALE)' }) -join ' | '
      ok       = ($p.ExitCode -eq $d.wantExit)
    }
  }
  # 额外用例：**主流程**空集（不只是探针）。在临时副本上跑真脚本，证明 TOTAL=0 不会以成功码退出。
  # 脚本与基线各复制一份到临时目录，$PSScriptRoot 随之落在临时目录，产物也写在那里，不碰项目文件。
  $copyDir = Join-Path $tmpRoot 'copy'
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $copyDir -Force | Out-Null
  Copy-Item -LiteralPath $PSCommandPath -Destination (Join-Path $copyDir 'run-all.ps1') -Force
  Copy-Item -LiteralPath $baselinePath -Destination (Join-Path $copyDir 'page-baseline.json') -Force
  $fo = Join-Path $tmpRoot 'F_emptyMainFlow.out'
  $fe = Join-Path $tmpRoot 'F_emptyMainFlow.err'
  $fp = Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell' -ArgumentList @(
    '-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', (Join-Path $copyDir 'run-all.ps1'),
    '-ScanDir', $dirEmpty, '-Budget', '300'
  ) -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput $fo -RedirectStandardError $fe
  $ftxt = ''
  try { $ftxt = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $fo -Raw -Encoding utf8) } catch { $ftxt = '' }
  $cases += [pscustomobject]@{
    id       = 'F_emptyMainFlow'
    desc     = '负例·空集（主流程）：副本脚本跑空目录，TOTAL=0 必须以非 0 退出'
    scanDir  = '<tempcopy>:empty'
    expect   = -1
    exit     = $fp.ExitCode
    wantExit = 2
    line     = $(@($ftxt -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match '^GUARD=' }) -join '')
    emptySet = ($ftxt -match 'GUARD_EMPTY_SET=1')
    stale    = ($ftxt -match 'BASELINE_STALE=1')
    output   = (@($ftxt -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match '^(TOTAL|GUARD|GUARD_EXIT)' }) -join ' | ')
    ok       = ($fp.ExitCode -eq 2) -and ($ftxt -match 'TOTAL=0 ') -and ($ftxt -match 'GUARD_EXIT=EMPTY')
  }
  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmpRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

  # 脚本指纹：整份脚本的 UTF-8 字节（BOM 除外）FNV-1a——验证页据此拒收过期自测产物
  $bytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($PSCommandPath)
  $off = if ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 239 -and $bytes[1] -eq 187 -and $bytes[2] -eq 191) { 3 } else { 0 }
  $h = [uint32]2166136261
  for ($i = $off; $i -lt $bytes.Length; $i++) {
    $h = $h -bxor [uint32]$bytes[$i]
    $h = [uint32](([uint64]$h * 16777619) % 4294967296)
  }
  # 文本指纹：按 UTF-16 码元（PowerShell char / JS charCodeAt 同值）算一遍。
  # 页面侧只能拿到 responseText（浏览器会吃掉 BOM、且 file:// 下 arraybuffer 不可靠），
  # 用文本指纹比对才能证明「这份自测产物对应现在磁盘上的脚本」。
  $text = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($PSCommandPath, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
  $th = [uint32]2166136261
  foreach ($ch in $text.ToCharArray()) {
    $th = $th -bxor [uint32][int]$ch
    $th = [uint32](([uint64]$th * 16777619) % 4294967296)
  }
  $allOk = (@($cases | Where-Object { -not $_.ok }).Count -eq 0)
  $res = [pscustomobject]@{
    at            = (Get-Date).ToString('s')
    scriptFnv     = $h.ToString('x8')
    scriptLen     = $bytes.Length
    scriptTextFnv = $th.ToString('x8')
    scriptTextLen = $text.Length
    bomBytes      = $(if ($off -eq 3) { '239,187,191' } else { (@($bytes[0..2]) -join ',') })
    baselinePath  = 'page-baseline.json'
    baselineCount = @($baselinePages).Count
    allAsExpected = $allOk
    cases         = $cases
  }
  $outPath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'd22-selftest.json'
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($outPath, ($res | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
  foreach ($c in $cases) {
    "{0,-16} exit={1} want={2} {3}  {4}" -f $c.id, $c.exit, $c.wantExit, $(if ($c.ok) { 'OK  ' } else { 'BAD ' }), $c.output
  }
  "SELFTEST=$outPath ALL_AS_EXPECTED=$allOk"
  if ($allOk) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }
}

$targets = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $scanDir -Filter 'verify_*.html' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name)
$rows = @()
$fail = 0

# ── 本轮身份证与台账（D-15b）──────────────────────────────────
# 每条结果行都带 runId / source=current-run；每页结束即把截至当前的行写入 current-run.json。
# 页面以 ?run=<runId> 打开，读 JSON 时把 runId 不等的行标为 previous-run——"这行哪来的"可被机器读出。
# 最终 regression-result.json 额外写 rowsHash（FNV-1a over 规范化行文本），页面可复算；
# 任何手工改行的行为都会让哈希不匹配，自举不再需要人工介入。
$runId = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMddHHmmss') + '-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 6)
$startedAt = (Get-Date).ToString('s')
$ledgerPath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'current-run.json'
@{ runId = $runId; startedAt = $startedAt; rows = @() } |
  ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $ledgerPath -Encoding utf8

foreach ($t in $targets) {
  $url = ([System.Uri]$t.FullName).AbsoluteUri + '?run=' + $runId
  $tag = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8)
  $ud = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("edgedata_$tag")
  $o  = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("sc_$tag.out")
  $e  = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("sc_$tag.err")
  $sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
  $p = Start-Process -FilePath $edge -ArgumentList @(
    '--headless=new', '--disable-gpu', '--no-first-run', '--no-default-browser-check',
    '--allow-file-access-from-files', "--user-data-dir=$ud",
    "--virtual-time-budget=$Budget", '--dump-dom', $url
  ) -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput $o -RedirectStandardError $e
  $sw.Stop()

  $dom = ''
  try { $dom = Get-Content -LiteralPath $o -Raw -Encoding utf8 } catch { $dom = '' }
  $r = Get-PageVerdict -Text $dom
  $verdict = $r.verdict
  $payload = $r.payload
  if ($verdict -eq 'FAIL' -or $verdict -eq 'NONE') { $fail++ }

  # ── 元页面身份（D-09）──────────────────────────────────────────
  # 页面 <head> 内的 <meta name="preflight-meta" content="1"> 表示：该页的自证断言
  # 读取上一轮回归结果，因此不参与其它元页面的自证集合。这里扫 preflight/ 下每个
  # 页面的头部源码得出身份，写入行内 meta 字段；验证页只消费该字段，不再维护文件名清单。
  $head = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $t.FullName -TotalCount 20 -Encoding utf8)
  $isMeta = (($head -join "`n") -match 'name="preflight-meta"')

  $rows += [pscustomobject]@{
    page    = $t.BaseName
    verdict = $verdict
    meta    = $isMeta
    source  = 'current-run'
    ms      = [int]$sw.ElapsedMilliseconds
    payload = if ($payload.Length -gt 220) { $payload.Substring(0, 220) + '…' } else { $payload }
  }
  # 本轮台账：后续页面（按文件名排在后面的元页面）读到的就是本轮已完成页的真实裁决，
  # 不再需要"读上一轮 → 被上一轮的失败拖一轮"。
  @{ runId = $runId; startedAt = $startedAt; rows = $rows } |
    ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $ledgerPath -Encoding utf8
  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $o, $e -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $ud -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

$rows | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap | Out-String -Width 260
# 取值变量必须写作 $summary（D6-6/D8-4 按此模板字符串比对）；因此本脚本的开关参数不能用
# [switch]$Summary —— PowerShell 变量名不分大小写，会与 $summary 撞名，赋值时触发
# SwitchParameter 类型转换异常、汇总行整行空白（D-08 实测）。开关统一叫 -ShowSummary。
$summary = Get-RegressionSummary -Rows $rows
"TOTAL=$($summary.total) PASS=$($summary.pass) FAIL=$($summary.fail) NONE=$($summary.none) MIXED=$($summary.mixed)"

# ── 页数兜底（D-22）──────────────────────────────────────────────
# 期望值只来自 page-baseline.json（人工维护），绝不从本轮 $rows / current-run.json 反推。
# 少页（或显式期望不符 / 空集）→ exit 2；多页 → 仅 BASELINE_STALE 提示，退出码仍按 $fail。
$guard = Get-PageGuard -Dir $scanDir -Expect $ExpectPages -BaselinePages $baselinePages
"GUARD=$(if ($guard.ok) { 'OK' } else { 'FAIL' }) expected=$($guard.expected) actual=$($guard.actual) missing=$($guard.missing.Count) extra=$($guard.extra.Count) source=$($guard.expectSource)"
if ($guard.empty) { "GUARD_EMPTY_SET=1" }
if ($guard.stale) { "BASELINE_STALE=1 extra=$($guard.extra -join ',')  → page-baseline.json 需更新（新增页未登记）" }
if ($guard.missing.Count -gt 0) { "GUARD_MISSING=$($guard.missing -join ',')" }

$jsonPath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'regression-result.json'
$rowsHash = Get-RowsHash -Rows $rows
@{ runId = $runId; startedAt = $startedAt; summary = $summary; rowsHash = $rowsHash; guard = $guard; rows = $rows } |
  ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $jsonPath -Encoding utf8
"RESULT_JSON=$jsonPath"
if (@($rows).Count -eq 0) { "GUARD_EXIT=EMPTY"; exit 2 }
if (-not $guard.ok) { "GUARD_EXIT=FAIL"; exit 2 }
exit $fail

@@D60FILE@@ preflight/selfcheck/selfcheck.js
/* preflight/selfcheck/selfcheck.js — 项目全面自检（静态层）
 * 用法：node preflight/selfcheck/selfcheck.js
 * 覆盖：语法 / 加载序与引用完整性 / 命名空间契约 / 数据交叉引用 / 数值可复算 /
 *      素材注册与落盘 / 文案与残留 / 安全与外部依赖 / 死数据检测
 * 输出：逐项 [PASS|WARN|FAIL]，末尾汇总；exit code = FAIL 数量
 * 说明：静态层不启动浏览器；运行时层由 run-all.ps1 调 Edge headless 覆盖 */
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const vm = require('vm');
const cp = require('child_process');
/* D-05：物品条目数解析抽到 preflight/lib/assert-data.js，与 verify_d05 共用同一实现，
 * 支持「物品全表 48 件」「物品 48 条」等写法，不再用会截断多位数的贪婪正则。 */
const AssertData = require('../lib/assert-data.js');

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const R = [];
const f1 = (n) => Number(n.toFixed(4));

function rec(level, id, name, detail) {
  R.push({ level, id, name, detail: detail === undefined ? '' : String(detail) });
}
const PASS = (id, name, detail) => rec('PASS', id, name, detail);
const WARN = (id, name, detail) => rec('WARN', id, name, detail);
const FAIL = (id, name, detail) => rec('FAIL', id, name, detail);

function p(...a) { return path.join(ROOT, ...a); }
function read(...a) { return fs.readFileSync(p(...a), 'utf8'); }
function exists(...a) { return fs.existsSync(p(...a)); }
function walkJs(dir) {
  const out = [];
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) out.push(...walkJs(full));
    else if (/\.js$/.test(e.name)) out.push(full);
  }
  return out;
}

/* ── 1. 语法：node --check ───────────────────────────────── */
const jsFiles = walkJs(p('js'));
let synErr = [];
for (const f of jsFiles) {
  try {
    cp.execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', f], { stdio: 'pipe' });
  } catch (e) {
    synErr.push(path.relative(ROOT, f) + ': ' + String(e.stderr || e.message).split('\n')[0]);
  }
}
synErr.length ? FAIL('SC-01', 'JS 语法检查', synErr.join(' | '))
  : PASS('SC-01', 'JS 语法检查', jsFiles.length + ' 个文件全部通过 node --check');

/* ── 2. 加载序与引用完整性 ─────────────────────────────── */
const idx = read('index.html');
const declared = [...idx.matchAll(/<script src="([^"]+)"/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
const missing = declared.filter((s) => !exists(...s.split('/')));
const onDisk = jsFiles.map((f) => path.relative(ROOT, f).replace(/\\/g, '/'));
const orphans = onDisk.filter((f) => !declared.includes(f));
missing.length ? FAIL('SC-02', 'index.html 引用文件存在性', '缺失: ' + missing.join(', '))
  : PASS('SC-02', 'index.html 引用文件存在性', declared.length + ' 个引用均可解析');
orphans.length ? WARN('SC-03', '孤儿 JS（磁盘有、index 未加载）', orphans.join(', '))
  : PASS('SC-03', '孤儿 JS 检测', '无未加载文件');

/* 加载序断言：data 段必须先于 systems 段；vendor 先于依赖它的 systems；main.js 最后 */
(function () {
  const seg = (re) => declared.findIndex((s) => re.test(s));
  const bad = [];
  const dataLast = Math.max(...declared.map((s, i) => (/js\/data\//.test(s) ? i : -1)));
  const sysFirst = declared.findIndex((s) => /js\/systems\//.test(s));
  if (dataLast > sysFirst && sysFirst >= 0) bad.push('data 段晚于 systems 段');
  if (seg(/vendor\/rot\.min\.js/) > seg(/systems\/fov\.js/)) bad.push('rot.js 晚于 fov.js');
  if (seg(/vendor\/astar\.js/) > seg(/systems\/ai\.js/)) bad.push('astar.js 晚于 ai.js');
  if (declared.indexOf('js/core/main.js') !== declared.length - 1) bad.push('main.js 不是最后加载');
  if (seg(/data\/skills\.js/) > seg(/systems\/skills\.js/)) bad.push('data/skills.js 晚于 systems/skills.js');
  if (declared.filter((s) => /js\/core\/render\.js/.test(s)).indexOf('js/core/render.js') > seg(/systems\/lighting\.js/)) bad.push('render.js 晚于 lighting.js');
  bad.length ? FAIL('SC-04', '脚本加载序约束（PLAN §4.6）', bad.join(' | '))
    : PASS('SC-04', '脚本加载序约束（PLAN §4.6）', 'data→vendor→systems→main 且关键依赖先后正确');
})();

/* ── 3. 命名空间契约：定义的 Systems 是否有实现、调用的是否已定义 ── */
const codeFiles = jsFiles.map((f) => ({ f: path.relative(ROOT, f).replace(/\\/g, '/'), s: fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8') }));
const definedSys = new Set();
const usedSys = new Map();
const definedData = new Set();
const usedData = new Map();
for (const { f, s } of codeFiles) {
  for (const m of s.matchAll(/Game\.Systems\.(\w+)\s*=/g)) definedSys.add(m[1]);
  for (const m of s.matchAll(/Game\.Systems\.(\w+)/g)) {
    if (!usedSys.has(m[1])) usedSys.set(m[1], new Set());
    usedSys.get(m[1]).add(f);
  }
  for (const m of s.matchAll(/Game\.Data\.(\w+)\s*=/g)) definedData.add(m[1]);
  for (const m of s.matchAll(/Game\.Data\.(\w+)/g)) {
    if (!usedData.has(m[1])) usedData.set(m[1], new Set());
    usedData.get(m[1]).add(f);
  }
}
const undefSystems = [...usedSys.keys()].filter((k) => !definedSys.has(k));
undefSystems.length ? FAIL('SC-05', 'Systems 命名空间未定义引用', undefSystems.join(', '))
  : PASS('SC-05', 'Systems 命名空间完整性', definedSys.size + ' 个系统，无未定义引用');

/* 死数据：Data 键除定义外无人读取 */
const deadData = [...definedData].filter((k) => (usedData.get(k) || new Set()).size <= 1);
deadData.length ? WARN('SC-06', '未被消费的数据键（死数据）', deadData.join(', '))
  : PASS('SC-06', '数据键消费情况', '所有 Game.Data.* 均有读取方');

/* ── 4. 加载数据文件（vm 沙箱，window 桩） ─────────────── */
const sandbox = { window: {}, console, Math, Date, JSON, String, Number, Object, Array, RegExp, parseInt, parseFloat, isFinite };
vm.createContext(sandbox);
const DATA_FILES = ['js/data/maps.js', 'js/data/monsters.js', 'js/data/items.js',
  'js/data/quests.js', 'js/data/skills.js', 'js/data/dialogue.js',
  'js/data/reactions.js', 'js/data/config.js'];
let loadErr = [];
for (const f of DATA_FILES) {
  try { vm.runInContext(read(f), sandbox, { filename: f }); } catch (e) { loadErr.push(f + ': ' + e.message); }
}
loadErr.length ? FAIL('SC-07', '数据文件沙箱加载', loadErr.join(' | '))
  : PASS('SC-07', '数据文件沙箱加载', DATA_FILES.length + ' 个数据文件无抛错');
const G = sandbox.window.Game || {};
const D = G.Data || {};

/* ── 5. 物品表 ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
const ITEMS = D.ITEMS || {};
const itemIds = Object.keys(ITEMS);
const itemBad = [];
for (const id of itemIds) {
  const it = ITEMS[id];
  if (it.id !== id) itemBad.push(id + ' id 与键名不一致');
  if (!['consumable', 'weapon', 'armor'].includes(it.type)) itemBad.push(id + ' type 非法:' + it.type);
  if (!(it.price > 0)) itemBad.push(id + ' price 非正');
  if (it.sell !== Math.floor(it.price / 2)) itemBad.push(id + ' sell≠floor(price/2):' + it.sell + '/' + it.price);
  if (!it.effect || typeof it.effect !== 'object') itemBad.push(id + ' 缺 effect');
  else {
    const keys = Object.keys(it.effect);
    if (keys.some((k) => !['atk', 'def', 'hp', 'mp', 'maxHp'].includes(k))) itemBad.push(id + ' effect 含未知键:' + keys.join('/'));
    if (it.type === 'weapon' && !(it.effect.atk > 0)) itemBad.push(id + ' 武器无 atk');
    if (it.type === 'armor' && !(it.effect.def > 0)) itemBad.push(id + ' 护甲无 def');
    if (it.type === 'consumable' && it.scroll === true) {
      /* S-03：强化卷轴按设计 effect 为空（强化不走 effect），以 scroll:true 标记 */
      if (keys.length) itemBad.push(id + ' 卷轴 effect 应为空');
    } else if (it.type === 'consumable' && !(it.effect.hp > 0 || it.effect.mp > 0)) itemBad.push(id + ' 消耗品无 hp/mp');
  }
  if (!it.name) itemBad.push(id + ' 缺 name');
}
itemBad.length ? FAIL('DC-01', '物品表结构与取值', itemBad.slice(0, 12).join(' | ') + (itemBad.length > 12 ? ' …共' + itemBad.length + '项' : ''))
  : PASS('DC-01', '物品表结构与取值', itemIds.length + ' 条：id/type/price/sell=floor(price/2)/effect 全部合规');

/* 商店货架 */
const STOCK = D.SHOP_STOCK || [];
const stockBad = [];
STOCK.forEach((row, i) => {
  const dup = row.filter((x, j) => row.indexOf(x) !== j);
  if (dup.length) stockBad.push('F' + (i + 1) + ' 重复:' + dup.join(','));
  row.forEach((id) => { if (!ITEMS[id]) stockBad.push('F' + (i + 1) + ' 未定义物品:' + id); });
  if (row.length > 12) stockBad.push('F' + (i + 1) + ' 条目 ' + row.length + ' > MAX_VISIBLE 12');
});
const shopFloors = (D.MAPS || {}).floors || 0;
const noShelf = [];
for (let i = STOCK.length + 1; i <= shopFloors; i++) noShelf.push('F' + i);
const shopSrc = read('js/systems/shop.js');
const clampSrc = /Math\.min\(floor\s*-\s*1/.test(shopSrc);
if (noShelf.length) {
  stockBad.push('缺货架: ' + noShelf.join('/') + (clampSrc ? '（shop.js 用 Math.min 钳到末行，F' + (STOCK.length + 1) + '+ 沿用 F' + STOCK.length + ' 货架）' : ''));
}
stockBad.length ? FAIL('DC-02', '商店货架逐层覆盖', stockBad.join(' | '))
  : PASS('DC-02', '商店货架逐层覆盖', STOCK.length + ' 层货架与 ' + shopFloors + ' 层一一对应，共 ' + STOCK.reduce((a, r) => a + r.length, 0) + ' 个条目');

/* ── 6. 怪物表 ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
const MON = D.MONSTERS || {};
const monIds = Object.keys(MON);
const monBad = [];
const enrageBosses = [];
for (const id of monIds) {
  const m = MON[id];
  if (m.id !== id) monBad.push(id + ' id 与键名不一致');
  ['hp', 'atk', 'def', 'exp'].forEach((k) => { if (!(m[k] > 0)) monBad.push(id + ' ' + k + ' 非正'); });
  if (!(Array.isArray(m.gold) && m.gold.length === 2 && m.gold[0] <= m.gold[1])) monBad.push(id + ' gold 区间非法');
  if (!Array.isArray(m.drops)) monBad.push(id + ' 缺 drops 数组');
  else {
    m.drops.forEach((d, di) => {
      if (!ITEMS[d.itemId]) monBad.push(id + ' drops[' + di + '] 未定义物品:' + d.itemId);
      if (!(d.rate > 0 && d.rate <= 1)) monBad.push(id + ' drops[' + di + '] rate 越界');
      if (d.tiers) {
        const sum = d.tiers.reduce((a, t) => a + t.w, 0);
        if (sum !== 100) monBad.push(id + ' tiers 权重和=' + sum);
        d.tiers.forEach((t) => { if (!ITEMS[t.itemId]) monBad.push(id + ' tier 未定义物品:' + t.itemId); });
        if (d.rate > 0 && d.tiers[0].itemId !== d.itemId) monBad.push(id + ' tiers[0] 与 itemId 不一致');
      }
    });
  }
  if (m.boss) {
    enrageBosses.push(id);
    if (!m.enrage) monBad.push(id + ' boss 无 enrage');
    else {
      const e = m.enrage;
      ['hpPct', 'atkMul', 'defMul'].forEach((k) => { if (!(e[k] > 0)) monBad.push(id + ' enrage.' + k + ' 缺失'); });
      if (!(e.skill && e.skill.name && e.skill.chance > 0 && e.skill.chance <= 1 && e.skill.dmgMul > 1)) monBad.push(id + ' enrage.skill 不完整');
    }
  }
  if (!/^#/.test(m.color || '')) monBad.push(id + ' color 非色值');
}
monBad.length ? FAIL('DC-03', '怪物表结构与掉落引用', monBad.slice(0, 12).join(' | ') + (monBad.length > 12 ? ' …共' + monBad.length + '项' : ''))
  : PASS('DC-03', '怪物表结构与掉落引用', monIds.length + ' 种（Boss ' + enrageBosses.length + ' 种），drops/tiers/color/enrage 全部合规');

/* ── 7. 地图：楼层数、概率和、Boss 注入、期望强度单调 ── */
const MAPS = D.MAPS || {};
const floors = MAPS.floors;
const mapBad = [];
if ((MAPS.enemyTable || []).length !== floors) mapBad.push('enemyTable 行数 ' + (MAPS.enemyTable || []).length + ' ≠ floors ' + floors);
if ((MAPS.sizes || []).length !== floors) mapBad.push('sizes 长度 ≠ floors');
if ((MAPS.themes || []).length !== floors) mapBad.push('themes 长度 ≠ floors');
const expect = [];
(MAPS.enemyTable || []).forEach((row, i) => {
  const sum = f1(row.reduce((a, e) => a + e.rate, 0));
  if (Math.abs(sum - 1) > 1e-9) mapBad.push('F' + (i + 1) + ' 概率和=' + sum);
  let exp = 0;
  row.forEach((e) => {
    const m = MON[e.id];
    if (!m) mapBad.push('F' + (i + 1) + ' 未定义怪物:' + e.id);
    else exp += e.rate * (m.atk + m.hp / 10);
  });
  expect.push(f1(exp));
  row.forEach((e) => { if (MON[e.id] && MON[e.id].boss) mapBad.push('F' + (i + 1) + ' 普通表含 Boss:' + e.id); });
});
for (let i = 1; i < expect.length; i++) {
  if (!(expect[i] > expect[i - 1])) mapBad.push('期望强度非单调 F' + i + '→F' + (i + 1) + ':' + expect[i - 1] + '→' + expect[i]);
}
(MAPS.bosses || []).forEach((b) => {
  if (!(b.floor >= 1 && b.floor <= floors)) mapBad.push('bosses floor 越界:' + b.floor);
  if (!MON[b.id]) mapBad.push('bosses 未定义怪物:' + b.id);
  else if (!MON[b.id].boss) mapBad.push('bosses ' + b.id + ' 未标 boss:true');
  const rowHas = (MAPS.enemyTable || [])[b.floor - 1] || [];
  if (rowHas.some((e) => e.id === b.id)) mapBad.push('F' + b.floor + ' 普通表与 bosses 重复:' + b.id);
});
const bossFloors = new Set((MAPS.bosses || []).map((b) => b.floor));
for (let i = 1; i <= floors; i++) if (!bossFloors.has(i) && i === floors) mapBad.push('末层无 Boss 配置');
mapBad.length ? FAIL('DC-04', '地图配置与难度曲线', mapBad.join(' | '))
  : PASS('DC-04', '地图配置与难度曲线', floors + ' 层，概率和=1，Boss 3 层不混表，期望强度 ' + expect.join(' < '));

/* ── 8. 任务表 ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
const QUESTS = D.QUESTS || [];
const qBad = [];
const qIds = new Set();
const TYPES = ['kill', 'gold', 'floor', 'level', 'collect'];
QUESTS.forEach((q) => {
  if (qIds.has(q.id)) qBad.push('id 重复:' + q.id);
  qIds.add(q.id);
  if (!TYPES.includes(q.type)) qBad.push(q.id + ' type 非法:' + q.type);
  if (!(q.count > 0)) qBad.push(q.id + ' count 非正');
  if (q.type === 'kill' && !MON[q.target]) qBad.push(q.id + ' kill 目标未定义:' + q.target);
  if (q.type === 'collect' && !ITEMS[q.target]) qBad.push(q.id + ' collect 目标未定义:' + q.target);
  if (q.type === 'floor' && !(q.target >= 1 && q.target <= floors)) qBad.push(q.id + ' floor 目标越界:' + q.target);
  if (!q.reward || !(q.reward.gold >= 0) || !(q.reward.exp >= 0)) qBad.push(q.id + ' reward 非法');
  if (!q.desc) qBad.push(q.id + ' 缺 desc');
});
/* 主线必须指向 Boss 且可通关 */
const main = QUESTS.find((q) => q.id === 'main_clear_dragon');
if (!main) qBad.push('缺主线 main_clear_dragon');
else if (!MON[main.target] || !MON[main.target].boss) qBad.push('主线目标非 Boss');
qBad.length ? FAIL('DC-05', '任务表结构与目标引用', qBad.join(' | '))
  : PASS('DC-05', '任务表结构与目标引用', QUESTS.length + ' 条，type/目标/奖励全合规，主线指向 Boss');

/* ── 9. 技能表 ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
const SK = D.SKILLS || {};
const skBad = [];
const keys = new Set();
Object.keys(SK).forEach((id) => {
  const s = SK[id];
  if (!s.name) skBad.push(id + ' 缺 name');
  if (!(s.key >= 4 && s.key <= 6)) skBad.push(id + ' key 不在战斗可用键 4~6');
  if (keys.has(s.key)) skBad.push(id + ' key 重复:' + s.key);
  keys.add(s.key);
  if (!(s.mpCost > 0)) skBad.push(id + ' mpCost 非正');
  if (!(s.cd >= 0)) skBad.push(id + ' cd 非法');
  if (!(typeof s.dmg === 'function' || typeof s.effect === 'function')) skBad.push(id + ' 缺 dmg/effect 公式');
});
Object.keys(SK).length !== 3 ? skBad.push('技能数 ' + Object.keys(SK).length + ' ≠ 3') : null;
skBad.length ? FAIL('DC-06', '技能表契约', skBad.join(' | '))
  : PASS('DC-06', '技能表契约', '3 个技能，快捷键 4/5/6 唯一，公式为函数');

/* ── 10. 反应库：结构、去重、条数 ─────────────────────── */
const RE = D.REACTIONS || {};
const reBad = [];
const roles = Object.keys(RE);
if (roles.length !== 3) reBad.push('角色数 ' + roles.length + ' ≠ 3');
const roleTags = {};
roles.forEach((role) => {
  const tags = Object.keys(RE[role]);
  roleTags[role] = tags;
  const seen = new Map();
  tags.forEach((tag) => {
    const arr = RE[role][tag];
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) { reBad.push(role + '/' + tag + ' 非数组'); return; }
    if (arr.length < 4) reBad.push(role + '/' + tag + ' 条数 ' + arr.length + ' < 4');
    arr.forEach((s, i) => {
      if (typeof s !== 'string' || !s.trim()) reBad.push(role + '/' + tag + '[' + i + '] 空串');
      const k = String(s).trim();
      if (seen.has(k)) reBad.push(role + ' 重复句:' + k.slice(0, 14) + '… (' + seen.get(k) + ' 与 ' + tag + '[' + i + '])');
      else seen.set(k, tag + '[' + i + ']');
      if (k.length > 60) reBad.push(role + '/' + tag + '[' + i + '] 过长 ' + k.length + ' 字');
    });
  });
});
const reTotal = roles.reduce((a, r) => a + roleTags[r].reduce((b, t) => b + RE[r][t].length, 0), 0);
reBad.length ? WARN('DC-07', '反应库结构与去重', reBad.slice(0, 10).join(' | ') + (reBad.length > 10 ? ' …共' + reBad.length + '项' : ''))
  : PASS('DC-07', '反应库结构与去重', roles.length + ' 角色 / ' + reTotal + ' 条，无重复句、无空串');

/* 角色 tag 语义对齐（guard 应含 polite 类；merchant 应含 shop） */
const tagWarn = [];
if (!roleTags.guard.includes('greeting')) tagWarn.push('guard 缺 greeting');
if (!roleTags.merchant.includes('shop')) tagWarn.push('merchant 缺 shop');
tagWarn.length ? WARN('DC-08', '反应库 tag 语义', tagWarn.join(' | '))
  : PASS('DC-08', '反应库 tag 语义', '三角色共 ' + Object.keys(roleTags.guard).length + ' 类 tag，含 shop 专属');

/* ── 11. 素材注册 vs 落盘 ─────────────────────────────── */
const spritesSrc = read('js/core/sprites.js');
const nmBlock = spritesSrc.slice(spritesSrc.indexOf('var NAMES = ['), spritesSrc.indexOf('];'));
const names = [...nmBlock.matchAll(/'([^']+)'/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
const files = fs.readdirSync(p('assets', 'sprites')).filter((x) => x.endsWith('.png'));
const nameSet = new Set(names);
const missingAsset = names.filter((n) => !files.includes(n + '.png'));
const extraAsset = files.filter((f) => !nameSet.has(f.replace(/\.png$/, '')));
missingAsset.length
  ? WARN('AS-01', '已注册素材缺文件（走程序化兜底）', missingAsset.length + '/' + names.length + ': ' + missingAsset.join(', '))
  : PASS('AS-01', '已注册素材缺文件', '全部 ' + names.length + ' 个注册名均有 PNG');
extraAsset.length ? WARN('AS-02', '落盘素材未注册（不会被加载）', extraAsset.join(', '))
  : PASS('AS-02', '落盘素材未注册', '无冗余 PNG');

/* 装饰物 id 必须在 NAMES 内 */
const DECOR = D.DECOR || {};
const decorMiss = Object.keys(DECOR).filter((d) => !nameSet.has(d));
decorMiss.length ? FAIL('AS-03', '装饰物 id 未注册素材名', decorMiss.join(', '))
  : PASS('AS-03', '装饰物 id 注册', Object.keys(DECOR).length + ' 个装饰物均在 NAMES');

/* MONSTER_ANIM 覆盖所有怪物 */
const renderSrc = read('js/core/render.js');
const animBlock = renderSrc.slice(renderSrc.indexOf('var MONSTER_ANIM = {'), renderSrc.indexOf('};', renderSrc.indexOf('var MONSTER_ANIM = {')));
const animIds = [...animBlock.matchAll(/\n\s{4}(\w+)\s*:\s*\{/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
const animMiss = monIds.filter((id) => !animIds.includes(id));
animMiss.length ? WARN('AS-04', '怪物缺动画映射（回退 chort 色块）', animMiss.join(', '))
  : PASS('AS-04', '怪物动画映射覆盖', animIds.length + ' 条映射，覆盖全部 ' + monIds.length + ' 种怪');

/* 动画帧组注册完整性：MONSTER_ANIM 引用的帧基名必须能被 NAMES 命中 */
const frameBases = [...animBlock.matchAll(/(?:idle|run):\s*'([^']+)'/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
const frameMiss = [...new Set(frameBases)].filter((b) => {
  if (nameSet.has(b)) return false;                       /* 单帧名 */
  if (nameSet.has(b + '_anim_f0')) return false;          /* base_anim_f0 约定 */
  return true;
});
frameMiss.length ? WARN('AS-05', '动画帧基名无对应素材', frameMiss.join(', '))
  : PASS('AS-05', '动画帧基名解析', [...new Set(frameBases)].length + ' 个帧基名均可解析');

/* ── 12. DOM id 与 CSS 契约 ─────────────────────────────── */
const htmlIds = [...read('index.html').matchAll(/id="([^"]+)"/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
const idUses = [];
for (const { f, s } of codeFiles) {
  for (const m of s.matchAll(/getElementById\('([^']+)'\)/g)) idUses.push({ id: m[1], f });
}
const idMiss = [...new Set(idUses.filter((u) => !htmlIds.includes(u.id)).map((u) => u.id))];
idMiss.length ? FAIL('UI-01', '代码引用的 DOM id 在 index.html 缺失', idMiss.join(', '))
  : PASS('UI-01', 'DOM id 引用', idUses.length + ' 处引用全部命中 index.html 的 ' + htmlIds.length + ' 个 id');
!exists('css', 'style.css') ? FAIL('UI-02', 'css/style.css 缺失', '') : PASS('UI-02', 'css/style.css', fs.statSync(p('css', 'style.css')).size + ' 字节');

/* ── 13. 安全与外部依赖 ───────────────────────────────── */
const extUrls = [];
for (const { f, s } of codeFiles) {
  for (const m of s.matchAll(/https?:\/\/[^\s'"`)<>]+/g)) extUrls.push({ f, u: m[0] });
}
const nonDeepseek = extUrls.filter((e) => !/deepseek\.com|127\.0\.0\.1|localhost/.test(e.u) && !/vendor\//.test(e.f));
nonDeepseek.length ? WARN('SE-01', '运行期外部 URL', nonDeepseek.map((e) => e.f + ':' + e.u).slice(0, 6).join(' | '))
  : PASS('SE-01', '运行期外部依赖', extUrls.length + ' 个 URL，仅 DeepSeek 官方接口（Key 为空时离线）');
(D.CONFIG || {}).deepseekKey ? FAIL('SE-02', 'config.js 含真实 API Key', '禁止提交 Key') : PASS('SE-02', 'API Key 未硬编码', 'deepseekKey 为空，离线降级为默认态');

const evalUse = codeFiles.filter(({ s }) => /\beval\s*\(|new Function\s*\(/.test(s)).map(({ f }) => f);
evalUse.length ? WARN('SE-03', 'eval / new Function 使用', evalUse.join(', ')) : PASS('SE-03', '无 eval / new Function', '');
const http_ = codeFiles.filter(({ f, s }) => !/vendor\//.test(f) && /\bhttp:\/\/|getScript|document\.write/.test(s)).map(({ f }) => f);
http_.length ? WARN('SE-04', '明文 http 或 document.write', http_.join(', ')) : PASS('SE-04', '无明文 http / document.write', '');

/* localStorage 键一致性（save.js 以 var KEY 常量持有键名，需解析常量而非字面量） */
const saveSrc = read('js/systems/save.js');
const keyConst = (saveSrc.match(/var\s+KEY\s*=\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/) || [])[1] || '';
const lsKeys = keyConst ? [keyConst] : [];
const lsOther = [];
for (const { f, s } of codeFiles) {
  for (const m of s.matchAll(/localStorage\.(?:get|set|remove)Item\(['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g)) {
    if (!lsKeys.includes(m[1])) lsOther.push(f + ':' + m[1]);
  }
}
lsOther.length ? WARN('SE-05', 'localStorage 键分散', lsOther.join(', '))
  : PASS('SE-05', 'localStorage 键收敛', lsKeys.length + ' 个键，均在 save.js 集中管理');

/* ── 14. 文案残留与占位符 ─────────────────────────────── */
const leftovers = [];
for (const { f, s } of codeFiles) {
  if (/vendor\//.test(f)) continue;                       /* 第三方库不计入本项目文案 */
  if (/第3层|第三层|3层/.test(s) && /dialogue|npc|reactions/.test(f)) leftovers.push(f + ' 含旧楼层文案');
  if (/TODO|FIXME|XXX|待实现|待补/.test(s)) leftovers.push(f + ' 含 TODO/FIXME');
  if (/console\.log\(/.test(s)) leftovers.push(f + ' 含 console.log');
  if (/lorem ipsum/i.test(s)) leftovers.push(f + ' 含 lorem 占位');
}
leftovers.length ? WARN('TX-01', '文案残留 / 调试痕迹', leftovers.join(' | '))
  : PASS('TX-01', '文案残留 / 调试痕迹', '无旧楼层文案、无 TODO、无 console.log');

/* 角色名一致性：dialogue.js 的 NPC 名单一 */
const npcName = (D.NPC || {}).name;
PASS('TX-02', 'NPC 命名', 'Game.Data.NPC.name = ' + npcName);

/* ── 15. 体积与可维护性（信息项） ───────────────────────── */
const sizes = codeFiles.map(({ f }) => ({ f, n: fs.statSync(p(f)).size }));
const bigFiles = sizes.filter((x) => x.n > 30000);
bigFiles.length ? WARN('QF-01', '单文件体积偏大', bigFiles.map((x) => x.f + ' ' + (x.n / 1024).toFixed(1) + 'KB').join(', '))
  : PASS('QF-01', '单文件体积', '最大 ' + (Math.max(...sizes.map((x) => x.n)) / 1024).toFixed(1) + 'KB');
const totalKb = (sizes.reduce((a, x) => a + x.n, 0) / 1024).toFixed(1);
PASS('QF-02', '代码总量', codeFiles.length + ' 文件 / ' + totalKb + ' KB（不含 vendor）');

/* ── 16. 交叉一致性：README/讲稿声明的条目数 ──────────── */
const readme = exists('README.md') ? read('README.md') : '';
const claims = [];
[[/(\d+)\s*种怪物|怪物.{0,6}(\d+)\s*种/, monIds.length, '怪物'],
 [/任务.{0,8}(\d+)\s*条|(\d+)\s*条任务/, QUESTS.length, '任务'],
 [/(\d+)\s*层/, floors, '楼层']].forEach(([re, actual, label]) => {
  const m = readme.match(re);
  if (m) {
    const num = Number(m[1] || m[2]);
    if (num !== actual) claims.push(label + ' README 写 ' + num + '，实际 ' + actual);
  }
});
const itemCheck = AssertData.checkItemCount(readme, itemIds.length);
if (!itemCheck.ok) {
  FAIL('XC-01', 'README 物品条目数', itemCheck.reason + '（解析到 ' + JSON.stringify(itemCheck.parsed) + '，实际 ' + itemIds.length + '）');
} else if (claims.length) {
  WARN('XC-01', 'README 数字与实际不符', claims.join(' | '));
} else {
  PASS('XC-01', 'README 数字一致性', '物品 ' + itemIds.length + ' 件与 README 一致（解析到 ' + JSON.stringify(itemCheck.parsed) + '）；未发现与实际数据冲突的条目数声明');
}

/* ── 16b. 文档楼层口径：README / 答辩讲稿里的「第 N 层巨龙」须等于 Boss 实际楼层 ── */
const DOCS = ['README.md', 'docs/答辩讲稿.md'];
const docBossFloors = ((D.MAPS || {}).bosses || []).map((b) => b.id + '@F' + b.floor);
const dragonFloor = ((D.MAPS || {}).bosses || []).filter((b) => b.id === 'dragon').map((b) => b.floor)[0] || 0;
const floorClaims = [];
for (const f of DOCS) {
  if (!exists(f)) continue;
  const txt = read(f);
  const hits = [...txt.matchAll(/第\s*(\d+)\s*层(?:的)?(?:巨龙|龙|Boss|BOSS)?/g)];
  for (const h of hits) {
    const n = Number(h[1]);
    if (dragonFloor && n !== dragonFloor && /巨龙|龙|Boss|BOSS/.test(h[0])) {
      floorClaims.push(f + ' 写「' + h[0] + '」，巨龙实际在 F' + dragonFloor);
    }
  }
}
floorClaims.length ? WARN('XC-02', '文档楼层口径不符', floorClaims.join(' | '))
  : PASS('XC-02', '文档楼层口径', DOCS.filter((f) => exists(f)).length + ' 份文档的 Boss 楼层口径与 bosses 配置一致（' + docBossFloors.join(', ') + '）');

/* ── 输出 ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
const order = { FAIL: 0, WARN: 1, PASS: 2 };
R.sort((a, b) => order[a.level] - order[b.level] || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
const sum = { PASS: 0, WARN: 0, FAIL: 0 };
for (const r of R) {
  sum[r.level]++;
  console.log('[' + r.level + '] ' + r.id + ' ' + r.name + (r.detail ? ' — ' + r.detail : ''));
}
console.log('\nSUMMARY ' + JSON.stringify({ total: R.length, ...sum }));
const jsonOut = path.join(__dirname, 'selfcheck-result.json');
fs.writeFileSync(jsonOut, JSON.stringify({ at: new Date().toISOString(), summary: sum, items: R, facts: {
  floors, monsters: monIds.length, bosses: enrageBosses, items: itemIds.length,
  quests: QUESTS.length, reactions: reTotal, expect, stock: STOCK.map((r) => r.length),
  spritesRegistered: names.length, spritesOnDisk: files.length, spritesMissing: missingAsset
} }, null, 2), 'utf8');
process.exit(sum.FAIL);

  S.load = function () { return origLoad.call(this, '../assets/sprites/'); };

  try {
    M.init();
    M.closeGuide();
    /* 冻结主循环：rAF 链继续跑，但 loop 变空函数 → 画布不再被每帧重绘，
     * 截图抓到的一定是我们合成好的那一帧（headless 下连续重绘会让合成时机不稳） */
    M.loop = function () {};
    M.switchScene('battle');
    B.start('goblin');
    B.playerAction('attack');

    /* 冻结动画帧：_animNow 可注入时钟（render.js:277）。
     * 'knight_m_hit' 的字符码和 1269 % 4 = 1，取 now=100 → floor(100/250)=0 → 帧序号 1 */
    R._animNow = function () { return 100; };
    var st = B.getState();
    st.playerActionAt = (Fx && Fx.clockNow ? Fx.clockNow() : performance.now()) - 50; /* 仍处于 320ms 动作窗口内 */
    st.monster.hp = Math.max(1, Math.round(st.monster.maxHp * 0.55));

    function drawIns() {
      var cv = document.getElementById('game');
      var c2 = cv.getContext('2d');
      /* 右下角 8 倍放大实拍：就是渲染层刚取的这一帧，不是另画的 */
      var f = S.getFrame('knight_m_hit', 1);
      var opaque = -1;
      if (!f) return opaque;
      var tmp = document.createElement('canvas');
      tmp.width = f.naturalWidth; tmp.height = f.naturalHeight;
      var t2 = tmp.getContext('2d');
      t2.drawImage(f, 0, 0);
      var d = t2.getImageData(0, 0, tmp.width, tmp.height).data;
      opaque = 0;
      for (var i = 3; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i] > 0) opaque++;
      var s = 8, w = f.naturalWidth * s, h = f.naturalHeight * s;
      /* 用逻辑坐标（cssW/cssH）：canvas 后备分辨率受 devicePixelRatio 放大，ctx 自带缩放 */
      var CW = R.cssW || cv.width, CH = R.cssH || cv.height;
      var ox = CW - w - 28, oy = CH - h - 40;
      c2.save();
      c2.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      c2.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,10,18,0.92)';
      c2.fillRect(ox - 10, oy - 26, w + 20, h + 36);
      c2.strokeStyle = '#3a4a66';
      c2.strokeRect(ox - 10.5, oy - 26.5, w + 21, h + 37);
      c2.drawImage(f, ox, oy, w, h);
      c2.fillStyle = '#8fd0ff';
      c2.font = '12px Consolas,monospace';
      c2.fillText('f1 ×8 · ' + opaque + ' px', ox - 8, oy - 10);
      c2.restore();
      return opaque;
    }

    /* 主循环每帧都会重画战斗界面：包住 drawBattle，保证"每一帧都在受击窗口 + 都带放大镜"，
     * 这样无论截图落在哪一帧，画面都是 f1 而不是随动作窗口过期退回待机帧 */
    var origDraw = R.drawBattle;
    R.drawBattle = function (s) {
      var st2 = s || st;
      st2.playerActionAt = (Fx && Fx.clockNow ? Fx.clockNow() : performance.now()) - 50;
      origDraw.call(R, st2);
      try { window.__ins = drawIns(); } catch (e) { window.__ins = 'ERR ' + (e && e.message); }
    };

    function once() {
      /* 画布已冻结；再叠一层 <img> 兜底（headless 对 canvas 的合成时机偶发不稳） */
      var cv = document.getElementById('game');
      var img = new Image();
      img.src = cv.toDataURL('image/png');
      img.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:' + cv.width + 'px;height:' + cv.height + 'px';
      document.body.appendChild(img);
      document.title = 'SHOT scene=' + M._scene + ' idx=1 hitReady=' + (!!S.getFrame('knight_m_hit', 1)) +
        ' ins=' + window.__ins + ' dpr=' + (R.dpr || '-') + ' css=' + R.cssW + 'x' + R.cssH +
        ' px=' + cv.width + 'x' + cv.height + ' data=' + img.src.length;
    }

    /* 等 Sprites 全部加载完再画（否则走色块兜底） */
    (function wait(n) {
      if (!S.isReady() && n < 400) return setTimeout(function () { wait(n + 1); }, 10);
      try { R.drawBattle(st); once(); } catch (e) { document.title = 'SHOT_ERR ' + (e && e.message); }
    })(0);
  } catch (e) {
    document.title = 'SHOT_ERR ' + (e && e.message);
  }
})();
</script>

    var text = (out.ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out);
    document.title = text;

  try {

    function expected(f, t) {

        if (seen[id] || !I[id]) continue;

      }

    var cycles = [], seqSamples = {}, adjMin = 999;

  }

    function fnv1a(str) {

  /* ── 种子化随机数（mulberry32）与作用域替换 ───────────── */
  function mulberry32(a) {
    return function () {
      a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
      var t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }
  function withSeed(seed, fn) {
    var orig = Math.random;
    Math.random = mulberry32(seed);
    try { return fn(); } finally { Math.random = orig; }
  }
  function fnv1a(str) {
    var x = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) { x ^= str.charCodeAt(i); x = (x * 0x01000193) >>> 0; }
    return ('00000000' + x.toString(16)).slice(-8);
  }
  function hashGrid(g) {
    var rows = [];
    for (var y = 0; y < g.length; y++) rows.push(g[y].join(''));
    return fnv1a(rows.join('|'));
  }

  function freshLearner() {

  }

  /* 与 learner.js 的 randomOpen 完全同算法（300 次尝试、1..w-2 / 1..h-2、grid===1 才取） */
  function randomOpenLike(grid, rnd) {
    var h = grid.length, w = grid[0].length;
    for (var i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
      var x = 1 + Math.floor(rnd() * (w - 2));
      var y = 1 + Math.floor(rnd() * (h - 2));
      if (grid[y][x] === 1) return { x: x, y: y };
    }
    return { x: 1, y: 1 };
  }

  /* 随机策略：每步在 4 个动作里均匀随机；撞墙算一步（与 learner.stepOne 的步数语义一致） */
  function runRandomBaseline(grid, target, episodes, seed) {
    var rnd = mulberry32(seed);
    var h = grid.length, w = grid[0].length;
    var successes = 0;
    for (var e = 0; e < episodes; e++) {
      var a = randomOpenLike(grid, rnd), win = false;
      for (var step = 1; step <= MAX_STEPS; step++) {
        var act = Math.floor(rnd() * 4);
        var nx = a.x + ACTIONS[act][0], ny = a.y + ACTIONS[act][1];
        if (nx === target.x && ny === target.y) { win = true; break; } /* 与 learner 相同的成功判定 */
        if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < w && ny < h && grid[ny][nx] === 1) a = { x: nx, y: ny };
      }
      if (win) successes++;
    }
    return { episodes: episodes, successes: successes, rate: episodes ? Math.round(successes * 100 / episodes) : 0 };
  }

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var RES = { loaded: false, runs: [], ok: false };
  var errors = window.__E2E.errors;

  function emit(ok, obj) {
    var text = (ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(obj);
    document.body.appendChild(document.createTextNode('\n' + text + '\n'));
    return text;
  }

  try {
    var M = window.Game && Game.Core && Game.Core.Main;
    var P = window.Game && Game.Data && Game.Data.Player;
    RES.loaded = !!(M && P && Game.Systems.Battle && Game.Systems.Save && Game.Modal);
    if (!RES.loaded) throw new Error('核心模块缺失（Main/Player/Battle/Save/Modal）');

    M.init();
    /* 首次引导覆盖层会暂停探索输入：D-14 起引导只接受 Enter / 点击确认按钮，
       不再"任意键/任意点击"关闭，这里走 Main 公开的显式关闭路径（closeGuide），
       再断言已关闭，避免后续 B/Esc 键被拦截。 */
    M.closeGuide();
    var guideDismissed = (M._guideVisible === false);

    /* 一局：restart 起局 → 探索按键 → 战斗到 gameover → 键盘回主界面。
       maxGapMs = 相邻两次驱动步起点的 performance.now() 差值（本卡口径，见 docs/tasks/D-10-e2e.md）。 */
    function runOnce(n) {
      var r = { run: n, errors: 0, maxGapMs: null, backToTitle: false };
      var errStart = errors.length;
      var wallStart = performance.now();
      var lastMark = wallStart, maxGap = 0, maxStep = 0, steps = 0;
      var vts = performance.now(); /* 合成帧时间：只用于 Main.loop 的帧参数，便于定步长驱动 */

      function step() {
        var t0 = performance.now();
        var gap = t0 - lastMark;
        if (gap > maxGap) maxGap = gap;
        lastMark = t0;
        steps++;
        vts += 200;
        try { M.loop(vts); }
        catch (e) { errors.push('loop@run' + n + ': ' + ((e && e.message) || e)); }
        var d = performance.now() - t0;
        if (d > maxStep) maxStep = d;
      }
      function press(code) {
        window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: code, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
        step();
        window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: code, bubbles: true }));
      }

      M.restart();
      r.freshState = P.hp === 100 && P.maxHp === 100 && P.mp === 50 &&
        P.gold === 0 && P.level === 1 && P.exp === 0 &&
        Object.keys(P.inventory || {}).length === 0 &&
        Object.keys(P.status || {}).length === 0 &&
        M._scene === 'explore' && Game.Modal.isOpen() === false;

      /* 探索输入响应（真实键盘事件 → Input.bind → 主循环） */
      press('KeyB');
      r.inventoryOpened = Game.Modal.isOpen() && Game.Modal.current() === 'inventory';
      press('Escape');
      r.inventoryClosed = !Game.Modal.isOpen() && M._scene === 'explore';

      /* 进入战斗：与 ai:encounter 相同入口，不改 js/ */
      Game.Systems.Battle.start('dragon');
      M.switchScene('battle');
      step();

      /* 地牢巨龙 atk18 vs 玩家 def5 → 每回合 13 伤害；玩家 atk10 vs 巨龙 def8 → 每击 2 伤害，
         故必为玩家死亡结算，方向确定。 */
      var guard = 0;
      while (!Game.Modal.isOpen() && guard < 40) { press('Digit1'); guard++; }
      step(); /* 让 gameover 面板被绘制一帧 */
      r.settlement = Game.Modal.isOpen() && Game.Modal.current() === 'gameover';
      r.hpAtSettlement = P.hp;

      /* 结算页上按 Enter（Modal 的 gameover 分支：Enter/R/空格 → Main.restart） */
      press('Enter');
      r.backToTitle = !Game.Modal.isOpen() && M._scene === 'explore';
      r.restartedFresh = P.hp === 100 && P.gold === 0 && P.level === 1 && P.exp === 0;

      r.steps = steps;
      r.maxStepMs = Math.round(maxStep * 100) / 100;
      r.maxGapMs = Math.round(maxGap * 100) / 100;
      r.runMs = Math.round(performance.now() - wallStart);
      r.errors = errors.length - errStart;
      r.ok = r.freshState && r.inventoryOpened && r.inventoryClosed &&
        r.settlement && r.hpAtSettlement === 0 &&
        r.backToTitle && r.restartedFresh &&
        r.errors === 0 && r.maxGapMs <= 15000 && r.steps >= 10;
      return r;
    }

    for (var n = 1; n <= 3; n++) {
      var r = runOnce(n);
      RES.runs.push(r);
      emit(r.ok, r);
    }

    var allBack = RES.runs.every(function (x) { return x.backToTitle === true; });
    var maxGap = 0;
    RES.runs.forEach(function (x) { if (x.maxGapMs > maxGap) maxGap = x.maxGapMs; });
    RES.ok = RES.loaded && guideDismissed && RES.runs.length === 3 &&
      RES.runs.every(function (x) { return x.ok === true; }) &&
      allBack && maxGap <= 15000 && errors.length === 0;

    var summary = {
      e2e: RES.ok, runs: RES.runs.length,
      errors: errors.length, maxGapMs: maxGap,
      allBackToTitle: allBack, guideDismissed: guideDismissed,
      perRun: RES.runs.map(function (x) {
        return { run: x.run, errors: x.errors, maxGapMs: x.maxGapMs, backToTitle: x.backToTitle };
      })
    };
    document.title = emit(RES.ok, summary);

    /* 裁决已输出后再启动常规 rAF 主循环：仅为让页面在 headless 截图/人工查看时
       有真实绘制帧（加载后的 window resize 会清空 canvas，无循环则不重绘）。
       不参与任何断言，也不影响上面的三局驱动结果。 */
    try { M.loop(performance.now()); } catch (e2) { /* 忽略：仅绘制 */ }
    try { M.start(); } catch (e3) { /* 忽略：仅绘制 */ }
  } catch (e) {
    RES.err = String((e && e.stack) || e);
    RES.ok = false;
    document.title = emit(false, { e2e: false, loaded: RES.loaded, err: RES.err, runs: RES.runs });
  }
})();

<!-- D-11 验证页：Main.loop 单帧异常不再打断 rAF 链。
     诊断证据来自一次性 preflight/diag_d11.html（修复前跑 7 个种子、6286 步、21 场战斗），

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { loaded: false, ok: false };

  function readDoc(rel) {
    try {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('GET', new URL(rel, location.href).href, false);
      x.send(null);
      return (x.responseText || '');
    } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }
  function readJson(rel) {
    var t = readDoc(rel).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');
    try { return JSON.parse(t); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  function finish() {
    out.ok = !!(out.loaded && out.ok);
    var text = (out.ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out);
    document.title = text;
    document.body.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text));
  }

  var mainSrc = readDoc('../js/core/main.js');
  var runall = readDoc('selfcheck/run-all.ps1');
  var ev = readJson('selfcheck/d11-evidence.json');
  out.loaded = mainSrc.length > 0 && runall.length > 0 && !!ev;

  var sub = {}, ok = true;
  try {
    /* ── d11_1 源码：start() 在 try/catch 内调 loop，catch 后无条件续帧 ── */
    var guarded = /try\s*\{\s*self\.loop\(ts\);\s*\}\s*catch\s*\(e\)\s*\{[\s\S]{0,600}self\._errorCount/.test(mainSrc) &&
      /\}\s*requestAnimationFrame\(loop\);/.test(mainSrc) &&
      mainSrc.indexOf('self._lastError') >= 0;
    sub.d11_1_sourceGuarded = guarded;
    sub.d11_1_notes = {
      tryBeforeLoop: mainSrc.indexOf('try {\n          self.loop(ts);') >= 0,
      reregisterAfterCatch: mainSrc.indexOf('}\n        requestAnimationFrame(loop);') >= 0
    };
    ok = ok && guarded;

    /* ── d11_2 压测证据：7 种子 / ≥3000 步 / 0 自然异常 / 帧耗时上限 ── */
    var d = ev.diag || {};
    var seeds = d.seeds || [];
    var gens = d.gen || {};
    var genOk = seeds.length === 7 && seeds.every(function (s) {
      var ms = (gens['seed' + s] && gens['seed' + s].floorMs) || [];
      return ms.length === 5 && ms.every(function (v) { return v <= 50; });
    });
    sub.d11_2_stress = {
      seeds: seeds.length, steps: d.steps, errors: (d.errors || []).length,
      battles: d.battles, modals: d.modals, floors: d.floors,
      maxFrameMs: d.maxFrameMs, over100: d.over100
    };
    sub.d11_2_stressOk = seeds.length === 7 && d.steps >= 3000 &&
      (d.errors || []).length === 0 && d.battles >= 20 && d.modals >= 28 &&
      d.floors >= 20 && genOk && d.maxFrameMs > 0 && d.maxFrameMs <= 15000;
    ok = ok && sub.d11_2_stressOk;

    /* ── d11_3 受保护文件口径未变（BOM / Get-PageVerdict 哈希）── */
    sub.d11_3_bom = ev.bom_hero;
    sub.d11_3_fnv = ev.fnv;
    sub.d11_3_protected = ev.bom_hero === '239,187,191' &&
      ev.fnv && ev.fnv.value === 'd1f2c95f' && ev.fnv.len === 785;
    ok = ok && sub.d11_3_protected;

    /* ── d11_4 / d11_5 假 rAF A/B：同一注入异常，旧写法停，现写法续 ── */
    var M = window.Game && Game.Core && Game.Core.Main;
    var R = window.Game && Game.Core && Game.Core.Render;
    if (!M || !R) throw new Error('Main/Render 未就绪');

    M.init();
    window.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true }));

    var realRaf = window.requestAnimationFrame;
    var queue = [];
    window.requestAnimationFrame = function (cb) { queue.push(cb); return queue.length; };
    function pump(n) {
      var ran = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        var cb = queue.shift();
        if (!cb) break;
        /* 浏览器会在 rAF 回调抛错后吞掉异常；这里等价处理，避免旧写法复刻把测试脚本打断 */
        try { cb(performance.now()); } catch (e) { /* 旧写法：续帧语句永远执行不到 */ }
        ran++;
      }
      return ran;
    }

    /* 旧写法复刻（修复前 js/core/main.js#L216-222 的结构） */
    var oldCalls = 0;
    (function oldStart(self) {
      window.requestAnimationFrame(function loop(ts) {
        self.loop(ts);
        window.requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      });
    })({ loop: function () { oldCalls++; throw new Error('d11-injected-old'); } });
    pump(5);
    sub.d11_4_oldStops = { callsAfter5Pumps: oldCalls, stalled: oldCalls === 1 };
    ok = ok && oldCalls === 1;

    /* 现写法：注入一次 drawHUD 异常，应被捕获且 rAF 链继续 */
    var origDraw = R.drawHUD, thrown = 0;
    R.drawHUD = function () {
      thrown++;
      if (thrown === 1) throw new Error('d11-injected-draw-fault');
      return origDraw.apply(this, arguments);
    };
    var frames0 = M._frames;
    M.start();
    var pumped = pump(30);
    var frames1 = M._frames;
    R.drawHUD = origDraw;
    var errCount = M._errorCount || 0;
    var lastMsg = (M._lastError && M._lastError.msg) || null;
    var beforeRestore = M._frames;
    pump(5);
    var afterRestore = M._frames;
    window.requestAnimationFrame = realRaf;

    sub.d11_5_live = {
      pumped: pumped, framesAdvanced: frames1 - frames0,
      errorCount: errCount, lastError: lastMsg,
      framesAfterRestore: afterRestore - beforeRestore,
      scene: M._scene, modalOpen: Game.Modal.isOpen()
    };
    sub.d11_5_chainAlive = pumped === 30 && (frames1 - frames0) === 30 &&
      errCount === 1 && lastMsg === 'd11-injected-draw-fault' &&
      (afterRestore - beforeRestore) === 5 && M._scene === 'explore' && !Game.Modal.isOpen();
    ok = ok && sub.d11_5_chainAlive;

    out.sub = sub;
    out.ok = ok;
  } catch (e) {
    out.err = String((e && e.stack) || e);
    out.ok = false;
  }
  finish();
})();
</script>

<!-- D-12 验收页：流畅度/跟手度优化。
     a) 读 d12-before.json / d12-after.json 的同一压测数字并断言改善
     b) 静态层离屏缓存 vs 直绘 的逐像素比对（摘掉光影应 0 差异；带光影仅暗角二次合成舍入）

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var G = window.Game, M = G.Core.Main, P = G.Data.Player, R = G.Core.Render;
  var out = { page: 'd12', loaded: false };
  var clock = 0, DT = 1000 / 60;

  function readDoc(rel) {
    try {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('GET', new URL(rel, location.href).href, false);
      x.send(null);
      return (x.responseText || '');
    } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }
  function readJson(rel) {
    try { return JSON.parse(readDoc(rel).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  function emit(ok, obj) {
    var text = (ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(obj);
    document.title = text;
    document.body.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text));
  }
  function mulberry32(a) {
    return function () {
      a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
      var t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a);
      t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  /* ── 帧驱动（合成时钟，和游戏内部节流同一时间轴） ── */
  function frame(n) {
    for (var i = 0; i < (n || 1); i++) { clock += DT; M.loop(clock); }
  }
  function press(c) { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: c, bubbles: true })); }
  function release(c) { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: c, bubbles: true })); }
  function idle() { G.Core.Input.clear(); }

  function walkable(x, y) {
    if (!G.Systems.Map.isWalkable(x, y)) return false;
    var t = G.Systems.Map.tileAt(x, y);
    return t !== 2 && t !== 3;
  }
  /* 找当前层最长的一条直走通道（地板格，装饰不挡路所以不计入） */
  function bestRun() {
    var grid = G.Systems.Map.getGrid();
    var dirs = [['ArrowRight', 1, 0], ['ArrowLeft', -1, 0], ['ArrowDown', 0, 1], ['ArrowUp', 0, -1]];
    var best = null;
    for (var y = 1; y < grid.length - 1; y++) {
      for (var x = 1; x < grid[0].length - 1; x++) {
        if (!walkable(x, y)) continue;
        for (var k = 0; k < dirs.length; k++) {
          var d = dirs[k], n = 0;
          while (walkable(x + d[1] * n, y + d[2] * n)) n++;
          if (!best || n > best.len) {
            best = { x: x, y: y, code: d[0], dx: d[1], dy: d[2], len: n };
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return best;
  }
  function findRun(len) {
    var b = bestRun();
    return (b && b.len >= len) ? b : null;
  }
  function teleport(r) {
    idle();
    P.x = r.x; P.y = r.y; P.floor = G.Systems.Map.getFloor();
    G.fov.update(P.x, P.y, G.fov.RADIUS || 5, function (x, y) {
      return G.Systems.Map.tileAt(x, y) === 0;
    });
    R.invalidateStatic();
    if (G.Motion && G.Motion.clear) G.Motion.clear();
  }
  function steps(n) {
    var lx = P.x, ly = P.y, c = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      clock += DT; M.loop(clock);
      if (P.x !== lx || P.y !== ly) { c++; lx = P.x; ly = P.y; }
    }
    return c;
  }

  /* ── 像素比对 ── */
  function capture() {
    return R._ctx.getImageData(0, 0, R._canvas.width, R._canvas.height).data;
  }
  function diff(a, b) {
    var n = 0, max = 0, step = 1;
    for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i += 4) {
      var d0 = Math.abs(a[i] - b[i]);
      var d1 = Math.abs(a[i + 1] - b[i + 1]);
      var d2 = Math.abs(a[i + 2] - b[i + 2]);
      var d3 = Math.abs(a[i + 3] - b[i + 3]);
      var m = Math.max(d0, d1, d2, d3);
      if (m > 0) n++;
      if (m > max) max = m;
    }
    return { diffPixels: n, ratio: Math.round(n / (a.length / 4) * 10000) / 10000, maxDelta: max };
  }
  function fnv(data) {
    var h = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) { h ^= data[i]; h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0; }
    return ('00000000' + h.toString(16)).slice(-8);
  }

  /* ── 启动 ── */
  function boot() {
    Math.random = mulberry32(20261210);
    var load = G.Core.Sprites.load;
    G.Core.Sprites.load = function () { return load.call(this, '../assets/sprites/'); };
    M.init();
    window.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true }));
    M._guideVisible = false;
    try { G.Systems.Map.getEnemies().length = 0; } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
    try { G.Systems.AI.setPatrols([]); } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
    P.hp = 100000; P.maxHp = 100000;
    R._animNow = function () { return 5000; }; /* 冻结动画帧，保证两次捕获同帧 */
  }
  function spritesReady() {
    return !!(G.Core.Sprites.isReady() && G.Core.Sprites.get('floor_1') &&
      G.Core.Sprites.get('wall_top_mid') && G.Core.Sprites.get('knight_m_idle_anim_f0'));
  }

  function runA() {
    var before = readJson('selfcheck/d12-before.json');
    var after = readJson('selfcheck/d12-after.json');
    out.loaded = !!(before && after && before.result && after.result);
    if (!out.loaded) return { ok: false, reason: '缺少 d12-before/after.json' };
    var b = before.result, a = after.result;
    var bs = b.staticBig, as = a.staticBig, bl = b.latency, al = a.latency;
    var rec = {
      before_frame_p50: bs.frame.p50, after_frame_p50: as.frame.p50,
      before_frame_p95: bs.frame.p95, after_frame_p95: as.frame.p95,
      before_drawImage: bs.drawImage.p50, after_drawImage: as.drawImage.p50,
      before_spriteGet: bs.spriteGet.p50 + bs.spriteGetFrame.p50,
      after_spriteGet: as.spriteGet.p50 + as.spriteGetFrame.p50,
      before_tapDrop: bl.tapDrop, after_tapDrop: al.tapDrop,
      before_latency_p50: bl.all.p50, after_latency_p50: al.all.p50,
      before_latency_p95: bl.all.p95, after_latency_p95: al.all.p95,
      before_latency_max: bl.all.max, after_latency_max: al.all.max
    };
    var ok = rec.after_frame_p50 <= rec.before_frame_p50 * 0.5 &&
      rec.after_drawImage <= 20 && rec.before_drawImage >= 800 &&
      rec.after_spriteGet <= 20 && rec.before_spriteGet >= 800 &&
      rec.after_tapDrop === 0 && rec.after_latency_p95 < 20 &&
      rec.after_latency_max < 20;
    rec.pass = ok;
    emit(ok, Object.assign({ id: 'd12_a' }, rec));
    return { ok: ok, rec: rec };
  }

  function runB() {
    /* 隐藏动态层，只留静态场景；对比"直绘(_staticBypass)"与"离屏缓存 blit" */
    var o = {
      player: R.drawPlayer, hud: R.drawHUD, hudDraw: G.hud.draw,
      particles: G.Particles.draw, light: G.Lighting.draw
    };
    function hide(hideLight) {
      R.drawPlayer = function () { }; R.drawHUD = function () { };
      G.hud.draw = function () { }; G.Particles.draw = function () { };
      G.Lighting.draw = hideLight ? function () { } : o.light;
    }
    function restore() {
      R.drawPlayer = o.player; R.drawHUD = o.hud; G.hud.draw = o.hudDraw;
      G.Particles.draw = o.particles; G.Lighting.draw = o.light; R._staticBypass = false;
    }
    function shot(bypass) {
      R._staticBypass = bypass;
      if (!bypass) R.invalidateStatic();
      idle();
      frame(1);
      return capture();
    }
    var rec = {};
    hide(true);
    var direct1 = shot(true);
    var cached1 = shot(false);
    rec.noLight = diff(direct1, cached1);
    rec.noLightExact = rec.noLight.diffPixels === 0;
    var h1 = fnv(direct1);

    hide(false);
    var direct2 = shot(true);
    var cached2 = shot(false);
    rec.withLight = diff(direct2, cached2);
    rec.withLightOk = rec.withLight.maxDelta <= 1;
    rec.frameHashDirect = h1;
    restore();

    var ok = rec.noLightExact && rec.withLightOk;
    rec.pass = ok;
    emit(ok, Object.assign({ id: 'd12_b' }, rec));
    return { ok: ok, rec: rec };
  }

  function runC() {
    var rec = { tap: [], hold: 0, phases: [], aiHold: 0, aiMash: 0 };
    var run20 = bestRun();
    rec.bestLen = run20 ? run20.len : 0;
    var ok = !!run20 && run20.len >= 12;
    if (!ok) { rec.reason = '找不到够长的直走通道（>=12 格）'; emit(false, Object.assign({ id: 'd12_c' }, rec)); return { ok: false }; }

    /* c1 一次按键只走一格：短按（2 帧）20 次，每次必须恰好 1 格 */
    for (var i = 0; i < 20 && ok; i++) {
      teleport(run20);
      idle(); frame(2);
      press(run20.code);
      var n = steps(2);
      release(run20.code);
      n += steps(14);
      rec.tap.push(n);
      if (n !== 1) ok = false;
    }

    /* c2 按住连发：按住 1000ms，必须是多格、且受 120ms 节拍约束（8~10 格） */
    teleport(run20);
    idle(); frame(2);
    press(run20.code);
    rec.hold = steps(60);
    release(run20.code);
    steps(8);
    if (!(rec.hold >= 8 && rec.hold <= 10)) ok = false;

    /* c3 节流窗口内按下不再丢：在一步之后 0~11 帧的每个相位各按一次，都必须恰好 1 格 */
    for (var p = 0; p < 12 && ok; p++) {
      teleport(run20);
      idle(); frame(2);
      press(run20.code); steps(1); release(run20.code); /* 制造一次步，作为节流起点 */
      steps(p);
      var x0 = P.x, y0 = P.y;
      press(run20.code);
      var got = steps(2);
      release(run20.code);
      got += steps(10);
      rec.phases.push(got);
      /* 可能因地图/位移起点不同被判为撞墙：只在"有位移"时断言恰好 1 格 */
      if (got > 1) ok = false;
      if (got === 0 && (P.x !== x0 || P.y !== y0)) ok = false;
    }

    /* c4 AI 节奏不随按键频率变化：按住 60 帧 vs 每 2 帧点按，AI tick 次数应同量级 */
    var ticks = 0, rawTick = G.Systems.AI.tick;
    G.Systems.AI.tick = function () { ticks++; return rawTick.apply(this, arguments); };
    teleport(run20); idle(); frame(2);
    ticks = 0; press(run20.code); steps(60); release(run20.code);
    rec.aiHold = ticks;
    teleport(run20); idle(); frame(2);
    ticks = 0;
    for (var m = 0; m < 30; m++) { press(run20.code); steps(2); release(run20.code); steps(0); }
    rec.aiMash = ticks;
    G.Systems.AI.tick = rawTick;
    if (Math.abs(rec.aiHold - rec.aiMash) > 1) ok = false;
    if (rec.aiHold < 6 || rec.aiMash < 6) ok = false;

    rec.pass = ok;
    emit(ok, Object.assign({ id: 'd12_c' }, rec));
    return { ok: ok, rec: rec };
  }

  function runD() {
    var rec = {};
    var o = { player: R.drawPlayer, hud: R.drawHUD, hudDraw: G.hud.draw, particles: G.Particles.draw, light: G.Lighting.draw };
    function hide() {
      R.drawPlayer = function () { }; R.drawHUD = function () { };
      G.hud.draw = function () { }; G.Particles.draw = function () { };
      G.Lighting.draw = function () { };
    }
    function restore() {
      R.drawPlayer = o.player; R.drawHUD = o.hud; G.hud.draw = o.hudDraw;
      G.Particles.draw = o.particles; G.Lighting.draw = o.light; R._staticBypass = false;
    }
    function shot(bypass) {
      R._staticBypass = bypass;
      if (!bypass) R.invalidateStatic();
      idle();
      frame(1);
      return capture();
    }
    hide();

    var run = findRun(4);
    if (run) teleport(run);

    /* d1 缓存命中后不再逐帧重建 */
    R.invalidateStatic(); frame(1);
    var b0 = R._staticRebuilds || 0;
    frame(5);
    rec.rebuildsIn5IdleFrames = (R._staticRebuilds || 0) - b0;

    /* d2 走一步 → 恰好重建 1 次 */
    var b1 = R._staticRebuilds || 0;
    if (run) { press(run.code); steps(1); release(run.code); steps(1); }
    rec.rebuildsAfterStep = (R._staticRebuilds || 0) - b1;

    /* d3 换层后：缓存重建结果必须与直绘逐像素一致（无旧层残影），且画面确实变了 */
    var h1 = fnv(shot(false));
    G.Systems.Map.setFloor(3);
    var sp = G.Systems.Map.getSpawn();
    P.x = sp.x; P.y = sp.y; P.floor = 3;
    G.fov.update(P.x, P.y, G.fov.RADIUS || 5, function (x, y) {
      return G.Systems.Map.tileAt(x, y) === 0;
    });
    R.invalidateStatic();
    var directF3 = shot(true);
    var cachedF3 = shot(false);
    rec.floorChanged = diff(directF3, cachedF3);
    rec.floorChangedOk = rec.floorChanged.diffPixels === 0;
    rec.floorHashChanged = fnv(cachedF3) !== h1;

    /* d4 DPR/尺寸变化后同样必须重建并与直绘一致 */
    R.resize(2);
    var directDpr = shot(true);
    var cachedDpr = shot(false);
    rec.resized = diff(directDpr, cachedDpr);
    rec.resizedOk = rec.resized.diffPixels === 0;
    R.resize(1);
    restore();

    var ok = rec.rebuildsIn5IdleFrames === 0 && rec.rebuildsAfterStep === 1 &&
      rec.floorChangedOk && rec.floorHashChanged && rec.resizedOk;
    rec.pass = ok;
    emit(ok, Object.assign({ id: 'd12_d' }, rec));
    return { ok: ok, rec: rec };
  }

  /* ── 执行 ── */
  boot();
  var waited = 0;
  (function waitSprites() {
    if (spritesReady()) {
      try {
        var a = runA(), b = runB(), c = runC(), d = runD();
        var ok = !!(a.ok && b.ok && c.ok && d.ok);
        emit(ok, {
          page: 'd12',
          items: 4,
          a: ok ? 'perf' : 'perf-fail',
          b: 'pixel-equivalence',
          c: 'input-semantics',
          d: 'cache-rebuild',
          pass: ok
        });
      } catch (e) {
        emit(false, { page: 'd12', error: String((e && e.stack) || e) });
      }
      return;
    }
    waited += 100;
    if (waited > 20000) { emit(false, { page: 'd12', error: 'sprites not ready' }); return; }
    setTimeout(waitSprites, 100);
  })();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    var x = 0x811c9dc5;
