  'use strict';
  var PM = window.PreflightMeta;
  var out = { loaded: false, ok: false };

  function readDoc(rel) {
    try {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('GET', new URL(rel, location.href).href, false);
      x.send(null);
      return (x.responseText || '');
    } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }
  function readJson(rel) {
    var t = readDoc(rel).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');
    try { return JSON.parse(t); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  function fnvStr(s) { return PM.fnv1a(s); }
  function sliceFn(src, head) {
    var i = src.indexOf(head);
    if (i < 0) return '';
    var j = src.indexOf('\n}', i);
    return j > i ? src.slice(i, j + 2).replace(/\r\n/g, '\n') : '';
  }
  function guardVals(c) {

  }

  }

  var sub = {}, ok = true;
  function rec(id, cond, detail) {
    sub[id] = { ok: !!cond, detail: detail === undefined ? null : detail };
    ok = ok && !!cond;
  }

  try {

     * 台账由 run-all 在**本次运行中**逐页写入（runId 与本页 ?run= 相同）。
     * 这里**故意不断言「其它页都 PASS」**：本页只负责 D-22 的命题（页数/空集），

     * 也不校验「本轮总数」——本页自己结束时本轮还没跑完，那是自欺。 */
    var before = pages.filter(function (p) { return p < 'verify_d22'; });

    /* F5 基线缺失时必须 FAIL（source=MISSING 且期望值 <0 一律不 ok） */
    rec('F5_missingBaselineFails',
      script.indexOf("$source = 'MISSING'") >= 0 &&
      script.indexOf('$ok = (-not $empty) -and ($expected -ge 0)') >= 0,
      { missingBranch: script.indexOf("$source = 'MISSING'") >= 0 });

    /* F6 自测六个用例全部符合预期 */
    rec('F6_selftestAllAsExpected', !!st && st.allAsExpected === true && cases.length === 6 &&
      cases.every(function (c) { return c.ok === true; }),
      { allAsExpected: st && st.allAsExpected, n: cases.length });

    out.sub = sub;
    out.ok = ok;
  } catch (e) {
    out.err = String((e && e.stack) || e);
    out.ok = false;
  }
  finish();
})();
</script>

(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { ok: true, sub: {} };
  var M = Game.Core.Main, B = Game.Systems.Battle, P = Game.Data.Player, Bot = Game.Bot;

  function rec(name, ok, detail) {
    out.sub[name] = { ok: !!ok, d: detail };
    if (!ok) out.ok = false;
  }

  /* file:// 下同步读同目录文本（run-all 启动 Edge 时带 --allow-file-access-from-files） */
  function readDoc(rel) {
    try {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('GET', new URL(rel, location.href).href, false);
      x.send(null);
      return (x.responseText || '');
    } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }
  function readJson(rel) {
    var t = readDoc(rel).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');
    try { return JSON.parse(t); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  /* ── 字段契约（D-23）─────────────────────────────────────────────
   * 12 个键必须"存在"；数值键允许 number，空值场景下允许 null（C 组证明不抛错）；
   * 字符串键允许 string，拿不到时 null。负例会删键 / 改类型，必须被抓到。 */
  var DEATH_KEYS = ['result', 'source', 'monsterId', 'monsterName', 'floor', 'playerLevel',
    'roundNo', 'hpAtDeath', 'maxHp', 'potionsLeft', 'weaponId', 'armorId'];
  var NUM_KEYS = ['floor', 'playerLevel', 'roundNo', 'hpAtDeath', 'maxHp', 'potionsLeft'];
  var STR_KEYS = ['monsterId', 'monsterName', 'weaponId', 'armorId'];

  function hasAllKeys(e) {
    if (!e || typeof e !== 'object') return DEATH_KEYS.slice();
    var miss = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < DEATH_KEYS.length; i++) {
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(e, DEATH_KEYS[i])) miss.push(DEATH_KEYS[i]);
    }
    return miss;
  }
  function checkDeath(e) {
    var bad = [];
    if (!e || typeof e !== 'object') return { ok: false, bad: ['payload:notObject'] };
    var miss = hasAllKeys(e);
    for (var i = 0; i < miss.length; i++) bad.push(miss[i] + ':missing');
    if (e.result !== 'lose') bad.push('result:notLose');
    if (typeof e.source !== 'string' || !e.source) bad.push('source:notString');
    for (var j = 0; j < NUM_KEYS.length; j++) {
      var v = e[NUM_KEYS[j]];
      if (!((typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v)) || v === null)) bad.push(NUM_KEYS[j] + ':notNumberOrNull');
    }
    for (var k = 0; k < STR_KEYS.length; k++) {
      var s = e[STR_KEYS[k]];
      if (!(typeof s === 'string' || s === null)) bad.push(STR_KEYS[k] + ':notStringOrNull');
    }
    return { ok: bad.length === 0, bad: bad };
  }

  /* ── 测试时钟（同 D-16/D-19）：让回合时间轴可整除推进 ─────────── */
  var T = 100000;
  function step(ms) { T += ms; B.tick(); }
  function useClock() { B._setClock(function () { return T; }); }
  function freeClock() { B._setClock(null); }

  function eqArr(a, b) {
    if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
    for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if (a[i] !== b[i]) return false;
    return true;
  }

  var SAVE_KEY = 'ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1';

  }

  try {

    var got = null;

    var seeSnap23 = Game.Systems.AI.canSee;

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { ok: true, sub: {} };
  var M = Game.Core.Main, B = Game.Systems.Battle, P = Game.Data.Player,
      I = Game.Systems.Inventory, S = Game.Systems.Shop, R = Game.Core.Render,
      Modal = Game.Modal, IT = Game.Data.ITEMS, Bot = Game.Bot;

  function rec(name, ok, detail) {
    out.sub[name] = { ok: !!ok, d: detail };
    if (!ok) out.ok = false;
  }
  function readDoc(rel) {
    try {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('GET', new URL(rel, location.href).href, false);
      x.send(null);
      return (x.responseText || '');
    } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }
  /* 只读快照：新档装备槽 */
  function freshEquipState() {
    return { invCount: Object.keys(P.inventory || {}).length,
      weapon: P.equipment ? P.equipment.weapon : 'NO_EQ',
      armor: P.equipment ? P.equipment.armor : 'NO_EQ',
      atk: P.atk, def: P.def };
  }
  /* D-27 规格变更：新档从"无装备"变为"起手匕首（+1 攻击）、无护甲"。
   * D-24 当时断言 weapon=null / atk=10 是那时的事实；起手武器落地后该期望必须翻转，
   * 否则产品行为与断言自相矛盾。判定形状不变，只改期望值（与 D-25 对 C2 的处理同法）。 */
  function isStartingNewGame(s) {
    return s.invCount === 0 && s.weapon === 'knife' && s.armor === null && s.atk === 11 && s.def === 5;
  }
  /* 归因断言：bot 装得上且死时没有"更好的装备留在包里" */
  function equipEvidenceOk(s) {
    return s.tries > 0 && s.ok === s.tries && s.ok >= 20 && s.hadBetterW === 0 && s.hadBetterA === 0;
  }
  function bestInBag(inv, type, curId, field) {
    var best = null, bestV = (curId && IT[curId]) ? (IT[curId].effect[field] || 0) : 0;
    for (var id in inv) {
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(inv, id) || !(inv[id] > 0)) continue;
      var d = IT[id];
      if (!d || d.type !== type || !d.effect) continue;
      var v = d.effect[field] || 0;
      if (v > bestV) { bestV = v; best = id; }
    }
    return best;
  }
  /* 跑一段种子，统计装备动作 / 死时残留升级装 / 死时无武器无护甲 / 买到的装备件数
   * D-34 修补（测量口径，不是放宽）：新平衡下 50 局里出现 1 例"开宝箱当步即被拉入战斗、
   * 拿到护甲后没有任何行动机会就死亡"（种子 1021，add 与 battle:start 在同一个 keydown）。
   * 玩家在该状态下无法换装（战斗界面没有背包），把它算作"bot 没走装备指令"是假阳性。
   * 因此：只把"拿到后至少还有 1 次按键机会"的更好装备计入残留；同回合获得的数量单独打印。 */
  function probeEquip(seeds, disable) {
    var st = { tries: 0, ok: 0, hadBetterW: 0, hadBetterA: 0, noW: 0, noA: 0, equipBuys: 0, deaths: 0,
      runsWithUnequipped: 0, sameTurnGear: 0, sameTurnSeeds: [] };
    var death = null;
    var B = Game.Systems.Battle;
    var origEquip = I.equip, origBuy = S.buy, origAdd = I.add, origStart = B.start;
    var kdN = 0, fatalAt = -1, gearAdds = [];
    function onKd() { kdN++; }
    function addAt(id) {
      var last = -1;
      for (var i = 0; i < gearAdds.length; i++) if (gearAdds[i].id === id) last = gearAdds[i].at;
      return last;
    }
    function onEnd(e) {
      if (!e || e.result !== 'lose' || death) return;
      var inv = {};
      for (var k in P.inventory) {
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(P.inventory, k) && P.inventory[k] > 0) inv[k] = P.inventory[k];
      }
      var bw = bestInBag(inv, 'weapon', P.equipment.weapon, 'atk');
      var ba = bestInBag(inv, 'armor', P.equipment.armor, 'def');
      var sw = (bw && addAt(bw) === fatalAt), sa = (ba && addAt(ba) === fatalAt);
      death = { w: P.equipment.weapon, a: P.equipment.armor, inv: inv,
        betterW: sw ? null : bw, betterA: sa ? null : ba,
        sameTurn: (sw ? 1 : 0) + (sa ? 1 : 0) };
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKd, true);
    I.add = function (id) {
      var r = origAdd.apply(I, arguments);
      var d = IT[id];
      if (d && (d.type === 'weapon' || d.type === 'armor')) gearAdds.push({ id: id, at: kdN });
      return r;
    };
    B.start = function () {
      fatalAt = kdN;
      return origStart.apply(B, arguments);
    };
    I.equip = function (id) {
      st.tries++;
      if (disable) return { ok: false, msg: 'D-24 负例：禁用装备步骤' };
      var r = origEquip.apply(I, arguments);
      if (r && r.ok) st.ok++;
      return r;
    };
    S.buy = function (id) {
      var r = origBuy.apply(S, arguments);
      var d = IT[id] || {};
      if (r && r.ok && (d.type === 'weapon' || d.type === 'armor')) st.equipBuys++;
      return r;
    };
    Game.Core.EventBus.on('battle:end', onEnd);
    for (var s = 0; s < seeds.length; s++) {
      death = null; kdN = 0; fatalAt = -1; gearAdds = [];
      Bot.run(seeds[s], { maxActions: 2500 });
      if (!death) {
        if (bestInBag(P.inventory, 'weapon', P.equipment.weapon, 'atk') ||
            bestInBag(P.inventory, 'armor', P.equipment.armor, 'def')) st.runsWithUnequipped++;
        continue;
      }
      st.deaths++;
      if (!death.w) st.noW++;
      if (!death.a) st.noA++;
      if (death.betterW) st.hadBetterW++;
      if (death.betterA) st.hadBetterA++;
      if (death.betterW || death.betterA) st.runsWithUnequipped++;
      if (death.sameTurn) { st.sameTurnGear += death.sameTurn; st.sameTurnSeeds.push(seeds[s]); }
    }
    Game.Core.EventBus.off('battle:end', onEnd);
    window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKd, true);
    I.equip = origEquip;
    S.buy = origBuy;
    I.add = origAdd;
    B.start = origStart;
    return st;
  }
  function seedsOf(from, to) {
    var a = [];
    for (var i = from; i <= to; i++) a.push(i);
    return a;
  }
  /* 装备教学检测器：引导页若写了"背包 + 装备"就算教了 */
  function guideTeachesEquip(lines) {
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      var t = String(lines[i] || '');
      if (/背包[^。]*(装备|装|换)|(装备|装)[^。]*背包|Enter[^。]*装备|按\s*B[^。]*装备/.test(t)) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  /* 假 ctx：只为抓 Modal.draw 真正写出的文本 */
  function fakeCtx(sink) {
    var o = {};
    var noop = function () {};
    var fns = ['save', 'restore', 'beginPath', 'closePath', 'moveTo', 'lineTo', 'stroke', 'fill',
      'fillRect', 'strokeRect', 'clearRect', 'drawImage', 'arc', 'rect', 'roundRect',

    o.createLinearGradient = function () { return { addColorStop: noop }; };
    o.createRadialGradient = o.createLinearGradient;
    o.createPattern = function () { return {}; };
    o.measureText = function (t) { return { width: String(t).length * 7 }; };
    o.fillText = function (t) { sink.push(String(t)); };
    o.strokeText = o.fillText;
    o.getImageData = function () { return { data: [] }; };
    return o;
  }

  try {

    M.init();

    var fresh = freshEquipState();

    /* ══ D. 问题 4：赤手 vs F1 武器，单回合伤害（真实攻击测量）══ */
    var f2 = [
      { id: 'orc_warrior', name: '兽人战士', def: 6, hp: 85 },
      { id: 'orc_shaman', name: '兽人萨满', def: 4, hp: 75 },

    /* D-34 规格变更：伤害公式由 max(atk-def,1) 改为 max(1, round(atk²/(atk+def)))。
     * 本页"实测 vs 复算"的判定形状不变，只把独立实现换成新公式。 */
    var dmg = function (atk, def) { return Math.max(1, Math.round(atk * atk / (atk + def))); };
    P.level = 1; P.upg = {};
    var rows = [], dOk = true;

      if (bare !== expBare || armed !== expArm || armed <= bare) dOk = false;
      rows.push(f2[f].name + '(def' + f2[f].def + ') ' + bare + '→' + armed +
        '（+%' + Math.round((armed / bare - 1) * 100) + '，击杀回合 ' +

    }
    var battleSrc = readDoc('../js/systems/battle.js');
    var formulaOk = battleSrc.indexOf('return Math.max(1, Math.round(a * a / (a + d)));') >= 0;
    rec('D1_bareVsF1WeaponDamage', dOk && formulaOk,

      '、公式原文已是比例减伤=' + formulaOk + '；' + rows.join('；'));

    /* ══ C. 问题 3：装备动作怎么被发现 ═══════════════════════════ */
    var renderSrc = readDoc('../js/core/render.js');

    var fakeTeach = guideTeachesEquip(['按 B 打开背包，Enter 装备武器']);

    /* 负例：禁用装备步骤后，B1 的判定必须变 FAIL */
    var neg = probeEquip([1007, 1010, 1014], true);

      ' 局 → equipEvidenceOk=' + equipEvidenceOk(neg) + '（必须 false）');

  } catch (e) {
    out.ok = false;
    out.err = String((e && (e.message + '\n' + (e.stack || ''))) || e);
  }

  var keys = Object.keys(out.sub);
  var failed = keys.filter(function (k) { return !out.sub[k].ok; });

    (out.ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out) + '\n\n' +

(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { ok: true, sub: {} };
  var M = Game.Core.Main, R = Game.Core.Render, Modal = Game.Modal, P = Game.Data.Player;

  Game.Core.Input.bind();

  function rec(name, ok, detail) {
    out.sub[name] = { ok: !!ok, d: detail };
    if (!ok) out.ok = false;
  }
  function src(path) {
    try {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('GET', '../' + path, false);
      x.send(null);
      return x.responseText || '';
    } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }
  function segOf(text, startMark, endMark) {
    var i = text.indexOf(startMark);
    if (i < 0) return '';
    var j = text.indexOf(endMark, i + startMark.length);
    return text.substring(i, j > i ? j : text.length);
  }
  function kd(code) { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: code })); }
  function ku(code) { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: code })); }
  function lines() { return (R.guideLines && R.guideLines()) || []; }

  /* 「怎么装备」那一行的检测器：必须同时出现来源（武器/护甲）、键（按 B）、背包、↑↓、Enter、两种加成格式 */
  function equipLineOf(ls) {
    for (var i = 0; i < ls.length; i++) {
      var t = String(ls[i] || '');
      if (t.indexOf('装备') >= 0 && t.indexOf('背包') >= 0 && t.indexOf('↑↓') >= 0 &&
          t.indexOf('Enter') >= 0 && t.indexOf('武器/护甲') >= 0) return t;
    }
    return null;
  }
  function equipLineOk(ls) {
    var t = equipLineOf(ls);
    return !!t && /按 B/.test(t) && /攻击\+N/.test(t) && /防御\+N/.test(t);
  }

  /* 假 ctx：只为抓 Modal.draw 真正写出的文本（与 verify_d24 C1 同法） */
  function fakeCtx(sink) {
    var o = {};
    var noop = function () {};
    var fns = ['save', 'restore', 'beginPath', 'closePath', 'moveTo', 'lineTo', 'stroke', 'fill',
      'fillRect', 'strokeRect', 'clearRect', 'drawImage', 'arc', 'rect', 'roundRect',
      'setTransform', 'scale', 'translate', 'clip', 'putImageData', 'setLineDash'];
    for (var i = 0; i < fns.length; i++) o[fns[i]] = noop;
    o.createLinearGradient = function () { return { addColorStop: noop }; };
    o.createRadialGradient = o.createLinearGradient;
    o.createPattern = function () { return {}; };
    o.measureText = function (t) { return { width: String(t).length * 7 }; };
    o.fillText = function (t) { sink.push(String(t)); };
    o.strokeText = o.fillText;
    o.getImageData = function () { return { data: [] }; };
    return o;
  }

  /* 两档分辨率（窗口 CSS 尺寸）→ 逻辑视口 → 引导页实际排版几何 */
  function measure(winW, winH) {
    var scale = R._computeScale(winW, winH);
    var W = winW / scale, H = winH / scale;
    var oldW = R.cssW, oldH = R.cssH;
    R.cssW = W; R.cssH = H;
    var mt = R._guideMetrics(), lay = R._guideLayout(), rect = R._guideRect();
    var ctx = R._ctx, maxW = 0, maxLine = '';
    try {
      for (var i = 0; i < lay.length; i++) {
        ctx.font = lay[i].head ? 'bold 14px monospace' : '13px monospace';
        var w = ctx.measureText(lay[i].text).width;
        if (w > maxW) { maxW = w; maxLine = lay[i].text; }
      }
    } catch (e) { /* 降级 */ }
    R.cssW = oldW; R.cssH = oldH;
    return {
      win: winW + 'x' + winH, scale: scale, W: Math.round(W), H: Math.round(H),
      startY: mt.startY, lineH: mt.lineH, rows: lay.length,
      lastY: lay.length ? lay[lay.length - 1].y : 0,
      btnY: rect.y, btnBottom: rect.y + rect.h, hintY: rect.y + rect.h + 26,
      maxTextW: Math.round(maxW), widest: maxLine.slice(0, 16) + '…'
    };
  }

  try {

    /* 新档状态（用于"文案不许写起手有武器"的反向核对） */
    var freshGear = { w: P.equipment.weapon, a: P.equipment.armor };

    /* ══ A1. 引导页含装备说明，且位于「你需要知道的事」块内 ═════ */
    var all = lines();

    rec('A1_guideHasEquipLine', equipLineOk(all) && eqIdx > headAt && headAt >= 0,
      '第 ' + (eqIdx + 1) + '/' + all.length + ' 行（机制块起点 ' + (headAt + 1) + '）：「' + (eq || '无') + '」');

    /* ══ A2. 说明文本 ↔ 背包面板实绘文案一致 ═════════════════════ */
    var sink = [], realCtx = R._ctx, drawErr = null;

      R._ctx = fakeCtx(sink);
      P.inventory = { knife: 1, armor_leather: 1 };
      Modal.open('inventory');

    var hintText = null, wRow = null, aRow = null;
    for (var s = 0; s < sink.length; s++) {

      if (/^匕首 x1/.test(t2)) wRow = t2;
      if (/^皮革甲 x1/.test(t2)) aRow = t2;
    }
    var PANEL_HINT = '↑↓ 选择 · Enter 使用/装备 · Esc/点遮罩关闭';
    var wFmt = wRow && /攻击\+\d+/.exec(wRow);
    var aFmt = aRow && /防御\+\d+/.exec(aRow);
    var a2ok = !drawErr && hintText === PANEL_HINT && wRow === '匕首 x1   攻击+1' &&
      aRow === '皮革甲 x1   防御+3' && !!wFmt && !!aFmt &&
      !!eq && eq.indexOf('↑↓ 选择') >= 0 && eq.indexOf('Enter 使用/装备') >= 0 &&
      eq.indexOf('攻击+' + 'N') >= 0 && eq.indexOf('防御+' + 'N') >= 0;
    rec('A2_equipTextMatchesPanel', a2ok,
      drawErr ? '绘制抛错：' + drawErr :
        '面板底栏「' + (hintText || '无') + '」，武器行「' + (wRow || '无') + '」，护甲行「' +
        (aRow || '无') + '」；引导行含「↑↓ 选择」「Enter 使用/装备」「攻击+N」「防御+N」=' +
        [!!eq && eq.indexOf('↑↓ 选择') >= 0, !!eq && eq.indexOf('Enter 使用/装备') >= 0,
         !!eq && eq.indexOf('攻击+N') >= 0, !!eq && eq.indexOf('防御+N') >= 0].join('/'));

    /* ══ A3. 真实按键：B 开背包 → Enter 装备 → ↓ 换一行 → Enter 装护甲 ══ */
    P.inventory = { knife: 1, armor_leather: 1 };
    P.equipment = { weapon: null, armor: null };
    if (Modal.isOpen()) Modal.close();
    M._guideVisible = false;
    M._scene = 'explore';
    var order = Game.Systems.Inventory.list().map(function (e) { return e.id; });
    var keyErr = null, w1 = null, a1 = null, opened = false;
    try {
      kd('KeyB'); M._updateExplore(1e9); ku('KeyB');
      opened = (Modal.current() === 'inventory');
      kd('Enter'); ku('Enter');
      w1 = P.equipment.weapon;
      kd('ArrowDown'); ku('ArrowDown');
      kd('Enter'); ku('Enter');
      a1 = P.equipment.armor;
    } catch (e2) { keyErr = String(e2); }
    if (Modal.isOpen()) Modal.close();
    rec('A3_keysEquipForReal', !keyErr && opened && order[0] === 'knife' && order[1] === 'armor_leather' &&
      w1 === 'knife' && a1 === 'armor_leather',
      keyErr ? '回放抛错：' + keyErr :
        '背包序 ' + JSON.stringify(order) + '；B 打开=' + opened + '；Enter 后武器=' + w1 +
        '；↓+Enter 后护甲=' + a1);

    /* ══ A4. 行数 13 → 14（结构：3 标题 + 11 正文） ═════════════ */
    var rows = R.guideRows(), heads = 0;
    for (var r = 0; r < rows.length; r++) if (rows[r].head) heads++;
    var lay = R._guideLayout();
    rec('A4_fourteenRows', all.length === 14 && rows.length === 14 && lay.length === 14 &&
      heads === 3 && rows.length - heads === 11,
      'guideLines/guideRows/_guideLayout = ' + all.length + '/' + rows.length + '/' + lay.length +
      '；标题 ' + heads + '、正文 ' + (rows.length - heads));

    /* ══ A5. 两档分辨率：14 行全部在框内、不溢出、字号未缩 ═══════ */
    var g1 = measure(1280, 800), g2 = measure(1024, 640);
    function fits(g) {
      return g.lastY + 6 < g.btnY && g.btnBottom <= g.H - 20 && g.hintY <= g.H - 6 &&
        g.maxTextW <= g.W - 40;
    }
    var rsrc = src('js/core/render.js');
    var seg = segOf(rsrc, 'drawGuide: function', '_guideMetrics: function');
    var fsz = [], fm;
    var fre = /(\d+)px monospace/g;
    while ((fm = fre.exec(seg))) fsz.push(parseInt(fm[1], 10));
    var minFont = fsz.length ? Math.min.apply(null, fsz) : 0;
    var fontOk = minFont >= 11 && seg.indexOf("'13px monospace'") >= 0 && seg.indexOf("'12px monospace'") >= 0;
    var gDetail = [g1, g2].map(function (g) {
      return g.win + '→逻辑 ' + g.W + 'x' + g.H + '(scale ' + g.scale + ')：行 ' + g.rows +
        '，末行 y=' + g.lastY + '，按钮 y=' + g.btnY + '~' + g.btnBottom +
        '，底部提示 y=' + g.hintY + '，最宽行 ' + g.maxTextW + 'px（上限 ' + (g.W - 40) + '）';
    }).join('；');
    rec('A5_fitsTwoResolutions', fits(g1) && fits(g2) && fontOk &&
      g1.lineH === 22 && g2.lineH === 22,
      gDetail + '；引导页字号 ' + JSON.stringify(fsz) + '（最小 ' + minFont +
      'px，D-20 锁 11px，未改 13px 正文/12px 底注）');

    /* ══ A6. 负例：删掉装备那一行，同一判定必须 FAIL ════════════ */
    var without = all.filter(function (t3) { return t3 !== eq; });
    var negLine = equipLineOf(without);
    var negOk = equipLineOk(without);
    var negByIdx = all.length === 14 && without.length === 13 && !negLine && !negOk && equipLineOk(all);
    rec('A6_negativeDropLineFails', negByIdx,
      '删行后 ' + without.length + ' 行、检测器命中=' + (negLine ? '是' : '否') +
      '、判定=' + negOk + '（原 ' + all.length + ' 行判定=' + equipLineOk(all) + '）');

    /* ══ A7. 不许写当前不成立的话（起手有武器等） ═══════════════
     * D-27 规格变更：起手确实有最弱的匕首（+1），但护甲仍为空、也没有更强的起手装备；
     * 引导页文案仍不得宣称"起手有武器/护甲"（文案事实与产品事实分开断言）。 */
    var combined = all.join('\n');
    var FORBID = ['起手', '开局', '自带', '初始武器', '初始装备', '默认装备'];
    var hits = FORBID.filter(function (w) { return combined.indexOf(w) >= 0; });
    rec('A7_startingGearIsOnlyKnife', hits.length === 0 && freshGear.w === 'knife' && freshGear.a === null,
      '禁词命中 ' + JSON.stringify(hits) + '；新档实测 weapon=' + freshGear.w + '、armor=' + freshGear.a +
      '（D-27：起手只有最弱的匕首，无护甲；文案不宣称起手装备）');

  } catch (e) {
    rec('X0_exception', false, String(e && (e.stack || e.message) || e));
  }

  var pre = document.getElementById('result');
  pre.textContent = JSON.stringify(out, null, 2);
  document.title = (out.ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out);

<!-- D-26：本页读取 preflight/selfcheck/d26-online-verify.json（本轮线上核验产物）与
     page-baseline.json（页数唯一来源），因此声明为元页面（preflight-meta）。
     口径：产物缺失 / 字段不合格 / 覆盖不全 / 计数不自洽 / 产物落后于基线（新增页后未重跑线上核验）
     一律 FAIL；同时断言「入口页可达 + 最新若干页线上可判定」。 -->
<meta name="preflight-meta" content="1">
<title>D-26 线上核验欠账清零</title>
<style>
  body { background:#111; color:#ddd; font:13px/1.5 Consolas,monospace; margin:12px; }
  h1 { font-size:15px; color:#7fd1ff; margin:0 0 8px; }
  pre { white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-all; }
</style>

<body>
<h1>D-26 · 线上核验产物一致性 / 覆盖 / 计数自洽 / 失败归因 / 产物新鲜度 / 负例</h1>
<pre id="result">RUNNING</pre>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var SELF = 'verify_d26';
  var out = { ok: true, sub: {} };

  function rec(name, ok, d) {
    out.sub[name] = { ok: !!ok, d: d };
    if (!ok) out.ok = false;
  }

  /* file:// 下同步读同目录文本（run-all 启动 Edge 时带 --allow-file-access-from-files） */
  function readDoc(rel) {
    try {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('GET', new URL(rel, location.href).href, false);
      x.send(null);
      return (x.responseText || '');
    } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }
  function readJson(rel) {
    var t = readDoc(rel).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');
    try { return JSON.parse(t); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  function clone(x) { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x)); }
  function names(p) {
    var a = (p && p.pages) || [], r = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) r.push(a[i].page);
    return r;
  }
  function asSet(a) { var o = {}, i; for (i = 0; i < a.length; i++) o[a[i]] = 1; return o; }
  function uniq(a) {
    var o = {}, r = [], i;
    for (i = 0; i < a.length; i++) { if (!o[a[i]]) { o[a[i]] = 1; r.push(a[i]); } }
    return r;
  }
  function verdictOf(p, name) {
    var a = (p && p.pages) || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if (a[i].page === name) return a[i];
    return null;
  }

  /* ══ 检查项：真实产物与负例共用同一批函数 ═════════════════════ */
  function chkBaseline(b) {
    if (!b || !Array.isArray(b.pages)) return { ok: false, d: 'page-baseline.json 不可读或 pages 非数组' };
    var dup = b.pages.length !== uniq(b.pages).length;
    return {
      ok: b.count === b.pages.length && b.count > 60 && !dup,
      d: 'count=' + b.count + '，清单 ' + b.pages.length + ' 条，重复=' + dup
    };
  }

  function chkShape(p) {
    if (!p || typeof p !== 'object') return { ok: false, d: '产物不可读/缺失' };
    var bad = [];
    if (p.version !== 1) bad.push('version=' + p.version);
    if (!/^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$/.test(String(p.commit || ''))) bad.push('commit=' + p.commit);
    if (isNaN(Date.parse(String(p.generatedAt || '')))) bad.push('generatedAt=' + p.generatedAt);
    if (typeof p.channel !== 'string' || p.channel.length < 5) bad.push('channel 缺失');
    if (typeof p.method !== 'string' || p.method.length < 10) bad.push('method 缺失');
    if (typeof p.httpNote !== 'string' || p.httpNote.length < 10) bad.push('httpNote 缺失（须写明为何没有状态码）');
    if (!Array.isArray(p.pages) || !p.pages.length) bad.push('pages 为空');
    return {
      ok: bad.length === 0,
      d: bad.length ? '不合格：' + bad.join('；') :
        'version=1、commit=' + p.commit + '、generatedAt=' + p.generatedAt + '、pages=' + p.pages.length
    };
  }

  function chkCoverage(p, b) {
    if (!p || !b || !Array.isArray(p.pages)) return { ok: false, d: '产物/基线缺失' };
    var listed = asSet(b.pages), mine = asSet(names(p));
    var missing = b.pages.filter(function (n) { return n !== SELF && !mine[n]; });
    var extra = names(p).filter(function (n) { return !listed[n] || n === SELF; });
    var dup = names(p).length !== uniq(names(p)).length;
    return {
      ok: extra.length === 0 && !dup,
      missing: missing,
      d: '基线 ' + b.pages.length + ' 页；产物 ' + p.pages.length + ' 页；幽灵/越界（必须 0）' +
        (extra.join(',') || '0') + '；重复=' + dup + '；未纳入线上核验 ' + (missing.join(',') || '0')
    };
  }

  /* D-27：基线会增长，d26 产物是"66a2381 的 67 页快照"。允许产物不覆盖之后新增的页，
   * 但新增页必须全部排在 d26 生成时最后一页（verify_d25）之后——
   * 中间插页/删页仍算产物与基线错位，必须 FAIL。 */
  function chkTailOnly(p, b) {
    if (!p || !b) return { ok: false, d: '产物/基线缺失' };
    var anchor = b.pages.indexOf('verify_d25');
    var mine = asSet(names(p));
    var missing = b.pages.filter(function (n) { return n !== SELF && !mine[n]; });
    var bad = missing.filter(function (n) { return b.pages.indexOf(n) < anchor; });
    return {
      ok: anchor >= 0 && bad.length === 0,
      d: '未纳入页 ' + (missing.join(',') || '0') + '；其中排在 d25 之前（说明产物与基线错位）' +
        (bad.join(',') || '0')
    };
  }

  function chkCounts(p) {
    if (!p || !p.summary || !Array.isArray(p.pages)) return { ok: false, d: 'summary/pages 缺失' };
    var s = p.summary, cnt = { PASS: 0, FAIL: 0, NONE: 0, MIXED: 0 }, meta = 0, badV = [];
    p.pages.forEach(function (x) {
      if (!(x.verdict in cnt)) { badV.push(x.page + ':' + x.verdict); return; }
      cnt[x.verdict]++;
      if (x.meta) meta++;
    });
    var groups = (s.failStaleSubresource || 0) + (s.failMetaDependent || 0) + (s.failEnvironmentSensitive || 0);
    var bad = [];
    if (badV.length) bad.push('未知裁决 ' + badV.slice(0, 3).join(','));
    if (s.total !== p.pages.length) bad.push('total ' + s.total + '≠页数 ' + p.pages.length);
    if (s.total !== p.baselineCount) bad.push('total ' + s.total + '≠baselineCount ' + p.baselineCount);
    if (s.pass !== cnt.PASS) bad.push('pass ' + s.pass + '≠' + cnt.PASS);
    if (s.fail !== cnt.FAIL) bad.push('fail ' + s.fail + '≠' + cnt.FAIL);
    if (s.none !== cnt.NONE) bad.push('none ' + s.none + '≠' + cnt.NONE);
    if (cnt.MIXED !== 0) bad.push('MIXED=' + cnt.MIXED + '（同页双裁决必须为 0）');
    if ((s.metaTagged || 0) !== meta) bad.push('metaTagged ' + s.metaTagged + '≠' + meta);
    if (groups !== s.fail) bad.push('三类失败合计 ' + groups + '≠fail ' + s.fail);
    return {
      ok: bad.length === 0,
      d: bad.length ? bad.join('；') :
        'PASS ' + cnt.PASS + ' / FAIL ' + cnt.FAIL + ' / NONE ' + cnt.NONE + ' / MIXED 0；' +
        '元页面 ' + meta + '；三类失败 ' + groups + '＝fail ' + s.fail
    };
  }

  function chkEntry(p) {
    if (!p || !p.entry) return { ok: false, d: 'entry 缺失' };
    var e = p.entry, bad = [];
    if (e.reachable !== true) bad.push('reachable=' + e.reachable);
    if (e.http !== null) bad.push('http=' + e.http + '（本机无外网，不许伪造状态码）');
    if (typeof e.jsErrorsNote !== 'string' || e.jsErrorsNote.length < 10) bad.push('jsErrorsNote 缺失/过短');
    if (e.smokeVerdict !== 'PASS') bad.push('smokeVerdict=' + e.smokeVerdict);
    if (typeof e.url !== 'string' || e.url.indexOf('index.html') < 0) bad.push('entry.url 不是入口页');
    return {
      ok: bad.length === 0,
      d: bad.length ? bad.join('；') :
        '入口 ' + e.url + ' 可达；JS_ERRORS 替代证据＝同源 ' + e.smokePage + ' 线上 ' + e.smokeVerdict +
        '（取证通道不暴露 console/pageerror，已在 jsErrorsNote 写明）'
    };
  }

  function chkNewest(p) {
    var need = ['verify_d23', 'verify_d24', 'verify_d25'];
    var missing = [], undecided = [], pass = 0, got = [];
    need.forEach(function (n) {
      var x = verdictOf(p, n);
      if (!x) { missing.push(n); return; }
      got.push(n.replace('verify_', '') + '=' + x.verdict);
      if (x.verdict === 'PASS') pass++;
      if (x.verdict !== 'PASS' && x.verdict !== 'FAIL') undecided.push(n + ':' + x.verdict);
    });
    var e = (p && p.entry) || {};
    var ok = missing.length === 0 && undecided.length === 0 && pass >= 1 && e.reachable === true;
    return {
      ok: ok,
      d: '最新页 ' + got.join(' / ') + '（缺 ' + (missing.join(',') || '0') +
        '；无裁决 ' + (undecided.join(',') || '0') + '；PASS ' + pass + ' 页）；入口可达=' + e.reachable
    };
  }

  function chkClassification(p) {
    if (!p || !p.findings) return { ok: false, d: 'findings 缺失' };
    var bad = [], gset = {};
    var groups = ['staleSubresource', 'metaDependent', 'environmentSensitive', 'unreachable'];
    groups.forEach(function (g) {
      var f = p.findings[g];
      if (!f || !Array.isArray(f.pages) || typeof f.reason !== 'string' || f.reason.length < 10) {
        bad.push(g + ' 缺 reason/pages');
        return;
      }
      f.pages.forEach(function (n) { (gset[n] = gset[n] || []).push(g); });
    });
    var clsMap = { stale: 'staleSubresource', meta: 'metaDependent', env: 'environmentSensitive', unreachable: 'unreachable' };
    p.pages.forEach(function (x) {
      if (x.verdict === 'PASS') {
        if (x.cls !== 'ok') bad.push(x.page + ' PASS 但 cls=' + x.cls);
        return;
      }
      if (x.verdict === 'MIXED') { bad.push(x.page + ' 出现 MIXED'); return; }
      var want = clsMap[x.cls];
      if (!want) { bad.push(x.page + ' 未知 cls=' + x.cls); return; }
      if ((gset[x.page] || []).indexOf(want) < 0) bad.push(x.page + ' 未登记到 ' + want);
      if (!Array.isArray(x.failing) || (x.verdict === 'FAIL' && !x.failing.length)) bad.push(x.page + ' 无 failing 明细');
      if (typeof x.evidence !== 'string' || !x.evidence) bad.push(x.page + ' 无 evidence');
    });
    /* 卡片点名：旧子资源缓存伪影必须含 d20/d24/d25，且每个都写清"线上未回退"的证据链 */
    var stale = (p.findings.staleSubresource && p.findings.staleSubresource.pages) || [];
    ['verify_d20', 'verify_d24', 'verify_d25'].forEach(function (n) {
      if (stale.indexOf(n) < 0) bad.push('staleSubresource 缺 ' + n);
    });
    /* 元页面一类不得被算成"线上真的坏了"：meta 组必须单独成组且有 reason */
    if (!p.findings.metaDependent || p.findings.metaDependent.pages.length < 3) {
      bad.push('metaDependent 页数 < 3（元页面须单独成类）');
    }
    return {
      ok: bad.length === 0,
      d: bad.length ? bad.slice(0, 6).join('；') :
        '四组归因齐全（stale ' + (p.findings.staleSubresource.pages.length) +
        ' / meta ' + (p.findings.metaDependent.pages.length) +
        ' / env ' + (p.findings.environmentSensitive.pages.length) +
        ' / unreachable ' + (p.findings.unreachable.pages.length) +
        '）；stale 含 d20/d24/d25；meta 组独立，不计入线上失败'
    };
  }

  function chkFreshness(p, b) {
    if (!p || !b) return { ok: false, d: '产物/基线缺失' };
    var inProduct = !!asSet(names(p))[SELF];
    var diff = b.count - p.baselineCount;
    return {
      ok: diff >= 1 && b.count === b.pages.length && !inProduct,
      d: '产物 baselineCount=' + p.baselineCount + '，当前基线 ' + b.count + '（差 ' + diff +
        '，即产物生成后新增 ' + diff + ' 页）；本页出现在产物中=' + inProduct +
        '（产物缺失/字段坏仍是 FAIL；基线增长本身不算过期，但新增页须由后续卡单独核验）'
    };
  }

  var product = readJson('selfcheck/d26-online-verify.json');
  var baseline = readJson('selfcheck/page-baseline.json');

  try {
    /* ══ A1. 产物与基线都在 ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    rec('A1_artifactsLoad', !!product && !!baseline,
      'd26-online-verify.json=' + (product ? 'OK' : '缺失') + '；page-baseline.json=' + (baseline ? 'OK' : '缺失'));

    /* ══ A2. 基线自洽（count 与清单一致） ════════════════════════ */
    var rB = chkBaseline(baseline);
    rec('A2_baselineSelfConsistent', rB.ok, rB.d);

    /* ══ A3. 产物字段合格（版本/commit/时间/渠道/不伪造状态码） ═══ */
    var rS = chkShape(product);
    rec('A3_productShape', rS.ok, rS.d);

    /* ══ A4. 覆盖：无幽灵页/无重复；未纳入页须全部在 d25 之后 ═════ */
    var rC = chkCoverage(product, baseline);
    var rT = chkTailOnly(product, baseline);
    rec('A4_coverageNoGhostNoDup', rC.ok && rT.ok, rC.d + '；' + rT.d);

    /* ══ A5. 计数自洽（与逐页裁决、元页面标记互相对得上） ═══════ */
    var rN = chkCounts(product);
    rec('A5_countsSelfConsistent', rN.ok, rN.d);

    /* ══ A6. 入口页可达 + JS_ERRORS 有替代证据 ═══════════════════ */
    var rE = chkEntry(product);
    rec('A6_entryReachableNoFakeHttp', rE.ok, rE.d);

    /* ══ A7. 最新若干页线上可判定（裁决行拿到了，不是 NONE） ═════ */
    var rW = chkNewest(product);
    rec('A7_newestPagesDecidable', rW.ok, rW.d);

    /* ══ A8. 失败归因：四类分清楚，元页面不背"线上坏了"的锅 ═════ */
    var rF = chkClassification(product);
    rec('A8_failureClassified', rF.ok, rF.d);

    /* ══ A9. 产物快照自洽：差 ≥1 且本页不得混进产物 ═════════════ */
    var rR = chkFreshness(product, baseline);
    rec('A9_productSnapshotConsistent', rR.ok, rR.d);

    /* ══ A10. 负例：同一批检查函数必须抓住 7 种篡改 ══════════════ */
    var muts = [];
    function mut(name, fn, check) {
      var p2 = clone(product);
      fn(p2);
      var r = check(p2, baseline);
      muts.push({ n: name, caught: !r.ok });
    }
    /* 产物里塞基线没有的页（幽灵页）→ 覆盖检查必须 FAIL */
    mut('产物塞入幽灵页 verify_zz', function (p2) {
      p2.pages.push({ page: 'verify_zz', verdict: 'PASS', cls: 'ok', meta: false, failing: [], evidence: 'x' });
    }, chkCoverage);
    mut('summary.pass 自行加一', function (p2) { p2.summary.pass = p2.summary.pass + 1; }, chkCounts);
    mut('入口标成不可达', function (p2) { p2.entry.reachable = false; }, chkEntry);
    mut('最新页裁决改成 NONE', function (p2) {
      p2.pages.forEach(function (x) { if (x.page === 'verify_d25') { x.verdict = 'NONE'; x.cls = 'unreachable'; } });
    }, chkNewest);
    mut('stale 组漏掉 verify_d25', function (p2) {
      p2.findings.staleSubresource.pages = p2.findings.staleSubresource.pages.filter(function (n) { return n !== 'verify_d25'; });
    }, chkClassification);
    mut('commit 写成非十六进制', function (p2) { p2.commit = 'zzz'; }, chkShape);

    /* D-27：基线在 d25 之前插页（产物与基线错位）→ 尾部新增检查必须 FAIL */
    var b2 = clone(baseline);
    b2.pages.splice(b2.pages.indexOf('verify_d25'), 0, 'verify_d21b');
    b2.count = b2.pages.length;
    muts.push({ n: '基线在 d25 之前插页', caught: !chkTailOnly(product, b2).ok });
    /* 反面：只在尾部追加新页（D-27 的真实情况）→ 尾部检查必须保持 OK，不算失败 */
    var b3 = clone(baseline);
    b3.pages.push('verify_d28');
    b3.count = b3.pages.length;
    muts.push({ n: '仅尾部追加新页（应放行）', caught: chkTailOnly(product, b3).ok });

    var missed = muts.filter(function (m) { return !m.caught; }).map(function (m) { return m.n; });
    rec('A10_negativeMutantsCaught', muts.length === 8 && missed.length === 0,
      muts.length + ' 个样本，符合预期 ' + (muts.length - missed.length) +
      ' 个' + (missed.length ? '；不符：' + missed.join('、') : '（幽灵页/计数/入口/最新页/归因/字段/中间插页 7 抓 + 尾部追加 1 放行）'));

  } catch (e) {
    rec('X0_exception', false, String((e && (e.message + '\n' + (e.stack || ''))) || e));
  }

  var keys = Object.keys(out.sub);
  var failed = keys.filter(function (k) { return !out.sub[k].ok; });
  var text = (out.ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify({ ok: out.ok, n: keys.length, fail: failed });
  document.getElementById('result').textContent = text + '\n\n' +
    keys.map(function (k) { return (out.sub[k].ok ? '  ✓ ' : '  ✗ ') + k + ' — ' + out.sub[k].d; }).join('\n');
  document.title = text;
})();
</script>

(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { ok: true, sub: {} };
  var M = Game.Core.Main, B = Game.Systems.Battle, P = Game.Data.Player,
      I = Game.Systems.Inventory, IT = Game.Data.ITEMS, Save = Game.Systems.Save;
  var KEY = 'ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1';

  function rec(name, ok, detail) {
    out.sub[name] = { ok: !!ok, d: detail };
    if (!ok) out.ok = false;
  }
  /* 只读快照：装备槽 + 属性 + 背包键数 */
  function snap() {
    return {
      inv: Object.keys(P.inventory || {}).length,
      weapon: P.equipment ? P.equipment.weapon : 'NO_EQ',
      armor: P.equipment ? P.equipment.armor : 'NO_EQ',
      atk: P.atk, def: P.def
    };
  }
  function isStarting(s) {
    return s.inv === 0 && s.weapon === 'knife' && s.armor === null && s.atk === 11 && s.def === 5;
  }
  function clearSave() {
    try { localStorage.removeItem(KEY); } catch (e) { /* 存储禁用降级 */ }
  }
  function writeSave(playerObj, extra) {
    var data = { saveVersion: 2, savedAt: '2026-11-11T00:00:00.000Z', floor: 1,
      player: playerObj, bestiary: { monsters: {}, items: {} } };
    if (extra) for (var k in extra) if (extra.hasOwnProperty(k)) data[k] = extra[k];
    try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(data)); return true; } catch (e) { return false; }
  }
  /* D-34 规格变更：伤害公式改为 max(1, round(atk²/(atk+def)))；判定形状不变，只换复算实现 */
  function dmgOf(atk, def) { return Math.max(1, Math.round(atk * atk / (atk + def))); }

  try {
    Game.Core.Input.bind();

    /* ══ A1. 无存档 → init 发放起手匕首（atk 10 → 11） ═══════════ */
    clearSave();
    M.init();
    M.closeGuide();
    var fresh = snap();
    rec('A1_initNewGameGivesKnife', isStarting(fresh),
      '无存档 init 后：背包键数=' + fresh.inv + '、weapon=' + fresh.weapon +
      '、armor=' + fresh.armor + '、atk=' + fresh.atk + '、def=' + fresh.def);

    /* ══ A2. restart() 同样发放（两条初始化路径一致） ════════════ */
    M.restart();
    var restarted = snap();
    rec('A2_restartAlsoGivesKnife', isStarting(restarted),
      'restart 后：weapon=' + restarted.weapon + '、armor=' + restarted.armor +
      '、atk=' + restarted.atk + '、def=' + restarted.def + '；与 init 快照一致=' +
      (JSON.stringify(fresh) === JSON.stringify(restarted)));

    /* ══ A3. atk 增量确实来自匕首（清空 → 10，装回 → 11） ═══════ */
    P.equipment = { weapon: null, armor: null }; I.recalcEquip();
    var bareAtk = P.atk;
    P.equipment = { weapon: 'knife', armor: null }; I.recalcEquip();
    var knifeAtk = P.atk;
    rec('A3_atkDeltaIsOneFromKnife', bareAtk === 10 && knifeAtk === 11 &&
      knifeAtk - bareAtk === (IT.knife.effect.atk || 0),
      '赤手 atk=' + bareAtk + '、装匕首 atk=' + knifeAtk + '，增量=' + (knifeAtk - bareAtk) +
      '（匕首 effect.atk=' + IT.knife.effect.atk + '）');

    /* ══ A4. 旧档（有 equipment、weapon=null）读入不补发 ════════ */
    var oldOk = writeSave({
      hp: 100, maxHp: 100, mp: 50, maxMp: 50, atk: 10, def: 5,

      quests: {}, upg: {}
    });
    var loadedOld = Save.load();

    rec('A4_oldSaveNoBackfill', oldOk && !!loadedOld && afterOld.weapon === null &&
      afterOld.armor === null && afterOld.atk === 10 && afterOld.inv === 1,
      '旧档（equipment.weapon=null、背包已有匕首 x1）读入后：weapon=' + afterOld.weapon +
      '、armor=' + afterOld.armor + '、atk=' + afterOld.atk + '、背包键数=' + afterOld.inv +
      '（不自动装备、不补发；atk 仍按 10 计算）');

    /* ══ A5. 极老档（无 equipment 字段）同样落回无装备 ═══════════ */
    writeSave({ hp: 80, maxHp: 100, mp: 50, maxMp: 50, gold: 10, exp: 0, level: 1, inventory: {} });
    var loadedAncient = Save.load();
    var afterAncient = snap();
    rec('A5_ancientSaveNoInherit', !!loadedAncient && afterAncient.weapon === null &&
      afterAncient.armor === null && afterAncient.atk === 10,
      '无 equipment 字段的旧档读入后：weapon=' + afterAncient.weapon +
      '、armor=' + afterAncient.armor + '、atk=' + afterAncient.atk +
      '（不继承新档初值，避免凭空发刀）');

    /* ══ A6. 真实战斗：F2 食人魔击杀回合数下降 ═══════════════════ */
    clearSave();
    M.restart();
    P.level = 1; P.upg = {};
    B.start('ogre');
    var stMon = B.getState().monster;
    var monName = (Game.Data.MONSTERS.ogre && Game.Data.MONSTERS.ogre.name) || '食人魔';
    var monHp = stMon.hp, monDef = stMon.def;
    var hp0 = stMon.hp;
    B.playerAction('attack');
    var armedHit = hp0 - B.getState().monster.hp;
    var armedAtk = P.atk;

    P.equipment = { weapon: null, armor: null }; I.recalcEquip();
    B.start('ogre');
    var hp1 = B.getState().monster.hp;
    B.playerAction('attack');

    var roundsArmed = Math.ceil(monHp / armedHit);
    var roundsBare = Math.ceil(monHp / bareHit);
    rec('A6_ogreRoundsDrop', armedHit === dmgOf(armedAtk, monDef) &&
      bareHit === dmgOf(bareAtk2, monDef) && armedHit > bareHit &&

      bareHit + '，击杀 ' + roundsBare + ' 回合（max(1,round(atk²/(atk+def))) 复算；怪 atk=' + metaAtk + '）');

    /* ══ A7. 范围最小：不给护甲、背包无护甲、匕首数值未改 ═══════ */
    var noArmorInBag = true;
    for (var id in P.inventory) {
      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(P.inventory, id) && IT[id] && IT[id].type === 'armor') {
        noArmorInBag = false;
      }
    }
    rec('A7_scopeOnlyWeakestKnife', P.equipment.armor === null && noArmorInBag &&
      IT.knife.type === 'weapon' && IT.knife.effect.atk === 1 && IT.knife.price === 20,
      '新档 armor=' + P.equipment.armor + '、背包含护甲=' + !noArmorInBag +
      '；匕首 type=' + IT.knife.type + '、atk=' + IT.knife.effect.atk + '、price=' + IT.knife.price +
      '（商店/掉落数值未动）');

    /* ══ A8. 负例：拿掉起手武器，同一判定必须 FAIL ═══════════════ */
    clearSave();
    M.restart();
    var neg = snap();
    P.equipment = { weapon: null, armor: null }; I.recalcEquip();

(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { ok: true, sub: {} };
  var M = Game.Core.Main, P = Game.Data.Player, IT = Game.Data.ITEMS,
      I = Game.Systems.Inventory, R = Game.Core.Render, Modal = Game.Modal;
  var KEY = 'ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1';
  var RAIL_MIN_W = 700;
  var SUM_PREFIX = '已装备：';

  function rec(name, ok, d) {
    out.sub[name] = { ok: !!ok, d: d };
    if (!ok) out.ok = false;
  }
  function clearSave() {
    try { localStorage.removeItem(KEY); } catch (e) { /* 降级 */ }
  }
  function fakeCtx(sink) {
    var o = {}, noop = function () {};
    var fns = ['save', 'restore', 'beginPath', 'closePath', 'moveTo', 'lineTo', 'stroke', 'fill',
      'fillRect', 'strokeRect', 'clearRect', 'drawImage', 'arc', 'rect', 'roundRect',
      'setTransform', 'scale', 'translate', 'clip', 'putImageData', 'setLineDash'];
    for (var i = 0; i < fns.length; i++) o[fns[i]] = noop;
    o.createLinearGradient = function () { return { addColorStop: noop }; };
    o.createRadialGradient = o.createLinearGradient;
    o.createPattern = function () { return {}; };
    o.measureText = function (t) { return { width: String(t).length * 7 }; };
    o.fillText = function (t) { sink.push(String(t)); };
    o.strokeText = o.fillText;
    o.getImageData = function () { return { data: [] }; };
    return o;
  }
  function setViewport(w, h) { R.cssW = w; R.cssH = h; }
  function drawWith(kind) {
    var sink = [], real = R._ctx;
    Modal.open(kind);
    try { R._ctx = fakeCtx(sink); Modal.draw(); } catch (e) { sink.push('DRAW_ERROR:' + e); }
    R._ctx = real;
    var L = Modal._layout();
    Modal.close();
    return { sink: sink, L: L };
  }
  /* 只读探针：在某个 kind 上下文里调 _rowDelta */
  function deltaWith(kind, entry) {
    Modal.open(kind);
    var d = null;
    try { d = Modal._rowDelta(entry); } catch (e) { d = { error: String(e) }; }
    Modal.close();
    return d;
  }
  function key(code) {
    var e = new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: code, bubbles: true, cancelable: true });
    window.dispatchEvent(e);
  }
  function setup(weapon, armor, upg, inv) {
    P.inventory = inv || {};
    P.equipment = { weapon: weapon || null, armor: armor || null };
    P.upg = upg || {};
    I.recalcEquip();
  }

  try {
    Game.Core.Input.bind();
    clearSave();
    M.init();
    M.closeGuide();
    M.restart();

    /* ══ A1. ≥700：右栏存在、两槽、槽内名称/强化/实际加成与 equipment 一致 ══ */
    setup('sword_iron', null, { sword_iron: 2 }, { sword_iron: 1, potion_small: 1 });
    setViewport(1024, 640);
    var r1 = drawWith('inventory');
    var rail1 = r1.L.rail;
    var s0 = rail1 && rail1.slots[0], s1 = rail1 && rail1.slots[1];
    var a1 = !!rail1 && rail1.slots.length === 2 && rail1.selectable === false &&
      r1.L.panelW === 732 && r1.L.listW === 520 &&
      s0.slot === 'weapon' && s0.name === '铁剑' && s0.plus === 2 && s0.value === '攻+4' && !s0.empty &&
      s1.slot === 'armor' && s1.empty === true && s1.name === '空' && s1.value === '防+0' &&
      r1.sink.indexOf('装备栏（只读）') >= 0 && r1.sink.indexOf('武器') >= 0 &&
      r1.sink.indexOf('护甲') >= 0 && r1.sink.indexOf('铁剑+2') >= 0 &&
      r1.sink.indexOf('攻+4') >= 0 && r1.sink.indexOf('空') >= 0 && r1.sink.indexOf('防+0') >= 0;
    rec('A1_railWideSlotsMatchEquipment', a1,
      '1024：panelW=' + r1.L.panelW + '/listW=' + r1.L.listW +
      '；槽1=' + (s0 ? s0.name + '+' + s0.plus + ' ' + s0.value : 'null') +
      '；槽2=' + (s1 ? (s1.empty ? '空' : s1.name) + ' ' + s1.value : 'null') +
      '；实绘含 装备栏（只读）/铁剑+2/攻+4/空/防+0=' +
      (r1.sink.indexOf('装备栏（只读）') >= 0 && r1.sink.indexOf('铁剑+2') >= 0 &&
       r1.sink.indexOf('攻+4') >= 0 && r1.sink.indexOf('空') >= 0 && r1.sink.indexOf('防+0') >= 0));

    /* ══ A2. <700：右栏完全不存在（不占位）且摘要行仍在 ═══════════ */
    var narrow = [];

        panelIsSingle: r.L.panelW === r.L.listW

    var a2 = narrow.every(function (n) {
      return n.rail === null && n.panelW === n.singleW && n.panelIsSingle &&
        n.noRailText && n.hasSummary;
    });
    rec('A2_railAbsentBelow700SummaryKept', a2,
      narrow.map(function (n) {
        return n.cw + '宽：rail=' + (n.rail === null ? 'null' : 'EXISTS') +
          '、panelW=' + Math.round(n.panelW) + '（单列公式 ' + Math.round(n.singleW) + '）' +

    setup('sword_iron', 'armor_leather', { sword_iron: 1 }, {
      sword_iron: 1, armor_leather: 1, potion_small: 2

      var v = Modal._visibleRange();
      selLog.push(v.sel);
      if (v.sel < 0 || v.sel > total3 - 1) selOut = true;
    }
    for (var u = 0; u < 5; u++) {
      key('ArrowUp');
      var v2 = Modal._visibleRange();
      selLog.push(v2.sel);
      if (v2.sel < 0 || v2.sel > total3 - 1) selOut = true;
    }
    var st3 = Modal._debugState();
    var rail3 = st3.layout.rail;

    var hitArmor = rail3 ? Modal._rowAt(rail3.slots[1].x + rail3.slots[1].w / 2,

    /* 点击右栏槽位 → sel/装备/背包都不许变（只读） */
    function clickProbe() {
      var st = Modal._debugState();
      if (!st.layout.rail) return { applicable: false, changed: false };
      var sl = st.layout.rail.slots[0];
      var before = { sel: Modal._visibleRange().sel, w: P.equipment.weapon,
        inv: JSON.stringify(P.inventory) };
      Modal._handleClick(sl.x + sl.w / 2, sl.y + sl.h / 2);
      var after = { sel: Modal._visibleRange().sel, w: P.equipment.weapon,
        inv: JSON.stringify(P.inventory) };
      return { applicable: true, changed: before.sel !== after.sel || before.w !== after.w ||
        before.inv !== after.inv, before: before, after: after };
    }
    var probe3 = clickProbe();
    Modal.close();
    var a3 = !selOut && rail3 && rail3.selectable === false &&
      hitWeapon === null && hitArmor === null && probe3.applicable && probe3.changed === false &&
      selLog.length === 17;
    rec('A3_railNotSelectable', a3,
      '真实按键回放 17 次（↓×12/↑×5）sel 全程 ∈ [0,' + (total3 - 1) + ']=' + !selOut +
      '、轨迹=' + selLog.join(',') + '；rail.selectable=' + (rail3 ? rail3.selectable : 'null') +
      '；槽心命中=' + hitWeapon + '/' + hitArmor + '（必须 null）；点右栏后状态变化=' +
      probe3.changed + '（必须 false）');

    /* ══ A4. 差值徽标：正/负/持平 + maxHp 口径 + 无装备 + 卷轴 ════ */
    var cases4 = [];
    function dcase(label, weapon, armor, upg, id, expect) {
      setup(weapon, armor, upg, {});
      var d = deltaWith('inventory', { id: id, count: 1 });
      var ok = !!d && d.text === expect;
      cases4.push({ label: label, got: d ? d.text : 'null', expect: expect, ok: ok });
      return d;
    }
    var dPos = dcase('正（匕首→铁剑）', 'knife', null, {}, 'sword_iron', '▲+2');
    var dNeg = dcase('负（双刃斧→匕首）', 'axe_double', null, {}, 'knife', '▼-9');
    var dEq = dcase('持平（同件）', 'sword_iron', null, {}, 'sword_iron', '持平');
    var dHp = dcase('含 maxHp（铁剑→稀有白骨剑）', 'sword_iron', null, {}, 'sword_bone_epic', '▲+3 生命+10');
    var dHpA = dcase('护甲 maxHp（皮革甲→法袍）', null, 'armor_leather', {}, 'robe_mage', '▲+1 生命+10');
    var dZero = dcase('无装备从 0 起算', null, null, {}, 'sword_iron', '▲+3');
    var dUp = dcase('强化计入（匕首+0→钢剑+3）', 'knife', null, { sword_steel: 3 }, 'sword_steel', '▲+6');
    var dScroll = deltaWith('inventory', { id: 'scroll_upgrade', count: 1 });
    var dPotion = deltaWith('inventory', { id: 'potion_small', count: 1 });
    var a4 = cases4.every(function (c) { return c.ok; }) &&
      dHp && dHp.dMain === 3 && dHp.dHp === 10 &&

    /* ══ A5. 商店 / 图鉴：无差值徽标，也无强化实值 ═══════════════ */
    setup('sword_iron', null, { sword_iron: 2 }, { sword_iron: 1 });

      '_rowDelta(shop/quests)=' + dShop + '/' + dBag + '（必须 null）');

    /* ══ A6. _rowText 逐条与 D-28 相同 ══════════════════════════ */
    setup('sword_iron', null, { sword_iron: 2 }, { sword_iron: 1, potion_small: 1 });
    Modal.open('inventory');
    var bad6 = [], eqCount = 0;
    for (var rid in IT) {
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(IT, rid)) continue;

      var rn = (P.upg && P.upg[rid]) || 0;
      var got6 = Modal._rowText({ id: rid, count: 1 });

        var rf = rit.type === 'weapon' ? 'atk' : 'def';

        var exp6 = rit.name + (rn > 0 ? ' +' + rn : '') + ' x1   ' +

          ((rit.effect && rit.effect.maxHp) ? ' 生命+' + rit.effect.maxHp : '');
        if (got6 !== exp6) bad6.push(rid + '：' + got6 + ' ≠ ' + exp6);
      } else {
        /* 消耗品行串 = 名称 + 数量 + 描述，且不得混入差值符号 */
        if (got6.indexOf('▲') >= 0 || got6.indexOf('▼') >= 0 || got6.indexOf('持平') >= 0) {
          bad6.push(rid + '：行串混入差值');
        }
      }
    }
    Modal.close();
    rec('A6_rowTextUnchanged', bad6.length === 0 && eqCount >= 15,
      '装备类 ' + eqCount + ' 件逐条与 D-28 串重建一致=' + (bad6.length === 0) +
      '（差值/强化实值均未拼进 _rowText）' +
      (bad6.length ? '；差异 ' + bad6.slice(0, 2).join(' | ') : ''));

    /* ══ A7. 几何：700 边界、960/1024 双栏、最小字号、面板不出界 ══ */
    var geo7 = [];

    /* ══ A8. 差值徽标独立绘制且不在行串里 ═══════════════════════ */
    setup('knife', null, {}, { knife: 1, sword_iron: 1 });

      '；行串「' + rowSword + '」不含 ▲/+2=' +
      (rowSword.indexOf('▲') < 0 && rowSword.indexOf('+2') < 0));

    /* 用"未装备 + 背包第一行是武器"的状态：若右栏被当成行 0，点击会真的把它装上 */
    setup(null, null, {}, { sword_iron: 1, potion_small: 1 });
    setViewport(1024, 640);
    Modal.open('inventory');
    var probeGood = clickProbe();

      '；变异 _rowAt 后：状态变化=' + probeMut.changed + '（true，装备栏 ' +
      probeMut.before.w + '→' + probeMut.after.w +
      '，说明"右栏可选中"会被抓住）');

    /* ══ N2. 负例：宽度 <700 仍显示右栏必须 FAIL ═════════════════ */
    /* 判定器：<700 时右栏必须 null 且面板按单列公式（不占位） */
    function railGate(cw, m, L) {
      if (cw < RAIL_MIN_W) {
        return m.railVisible === false && L.rail === null &&
          L.panelW === Math.min(cw * 0.88, 520) && L.listW === L.panelW;
      }
      return m.railVisible === true && L.rail !== null;
    }
    setViewport(320, 568);
    Modal.open('inventory');
    var m320 = Modal._metrics(320);
    var L320 = Modal._layout();
    Modal.close();
    var mutantL = {
      rail: { slots: [], selectable: false }, panelW: 732, listW: 520
    };
    var n2 = railGate(320, m320, L320) === true &&
      railGate(320, { railVisible: true }, mutantL) === false;
    rec('N2_negativeRailAtNarrowFails', n2,
      '真实 320 宽判=' + railGate(320, m320, L320) + '（true）；' +
      '伪造"320 仍展开右栏"判=' + railGate(320, { railVisible: true }, mutantL) +
      '（false，说明"窄屏仍显示右栏"会被抓住）');

    /* ══ N3. 负例：差值符号写反必须 FAIL ═════════════════════════ */
    function deltaSignGate(d) {
      if (!d) return false;
      if (d.dMain === 0 && d.dHp === 0) return d.text === '持平';
      var sign = (d.dMain !== 0) ? d.dMain : d.dHp;
      return sign > 0 ? d.text.indexOf('▲') === 0 : d.text.indexOf('▼') === 0;
    }
    var goodDelta = { dMain: 2, dHp: 0, text: '▲+2' };
    var badDelta = { dMain: 2, dHp: 0, text: '▼+2' };
    var goodNeg = { dMain: -9, dHp: 0, text: '▼-9' };
    var badNeg = { dMain: -9, dHp: 0, text: '▲-9' };
    var n3 = deltaSignGate(goodDelta) === true && deltaSignGate(badDelta) === false &&
      deltaSignGate(goodNeg) === true && deltaSignGate(badNeg) === false &&
      deltaSignGate({ dMain: 0, dHp: 0, text: '持平' }) === true &&
      deltaSignGate({ dMain: 0, dHp: 0, text: '▲+0' }) === false;
    rec('N3_negativeReversedSignFails', n3,
      '正例判=' + deltaSignGate(goodDelta) + '/' + deltaSignGate(goodNeg) + '（true）；' +
      '写反判=' + deltaSignGate(badDelta) + '/' + deltaSignGate(badNeg) +
      '（false，说明"符号写反"会被抓住）；持平判=' +
      deltaSignGate({ dMain: 0, dHp: 0, text: '持平' }) + '/' +
      deltaSignGate({ dMain: 0, dHp: 0, text: '▲+0' }) + '（true/false）');

    clearSave();
  } catch (e) {
    rec('X0_exception', false, String((e && (e.message + '\n' + (e.stack || ''))) || e));
  }

  var keys = Object.keys(out.sub);
  var failed = keys.filter(function (k) { return !out.sub[k].ok; });
  var head = (out.ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify({ ok: out.ok, n: keys.length, fail: failed });
  document.getElementById('result').textContent = head + '\n\n' +
    keys.map(function (k) { return (out.sub[k].ok ? '  ✓ ' : '  ✗ ') + k + ' — ' + out.sub[k].d; }).join('\n');
  document.title = head;
})();

    x.open('GET', path, false); x.send(null);
    return x.responseText || '';
  }
  function uniq(a) {
    var s = {}, o = [];
    a.forEach(function (v) { if (!s[v]) { s[v] = 1; o.push(v); } });
    return o;
  }
  /* 假 ctx：记录 drawImage / fillText 的落笔位置，用来断言"图标在哪、文字从哪开始" */
  function fakeCtx(log) {
    var o = {}, noop = function () {};
    var fns = ['save', 'restore', 'beginPath', 'closePath', 'moveTo', 'lineTo', 'stroke', 'fill',
      'fillRect', 'strokeRect', 'clearRect', 'arc', 'rect', 'roundRect', 'setTransform',
      'scale', 'translate', 'clip', 'putImageData', 'setLineDash'];
    for (var i = 0; i < fns.length; i++) o[fns[i]] = noop;
    o.createLinearGradient = function () { return { addColorStop: noop }; };
    o.createRadialGradient = o.createLinearGradient;
    o.createPattern = function () { return {}; };
    o.measureText = function (t) { return { width: String(t).length * 7 }; };
    o.fillText = function (t, x, y) { log.push({ t: 'text', s: String(t), x: x, y: y }); };
    o.strokeText = o.fillText;
    o.drawImage = function (img, dx, dy, dw, dh) {
      log.push({ t: 'img', n: String(img && img.src || '').split('/').pop().replace(/\.png$/i, ''),
        x: dx, y: dy, w: dw, h: dh });
    };
    o.getImageData = function () { return { data: [] }; };
    return o;
  }
  function setViewport(w, h) { R.cssW = w; R.cssH = h; }

      function iconGate(cw, drawn) {

      }

      setViewport(1024, 640);
    } catch (e) {
      rec('X0_exception', false, String((e && (e.message + '\n' + (e.stack || ''))) || e));
    }

  }

  function finish() {
    var keys = Object.keys(out.sub);
    var failed = keys.filter(function (k) { return !out.sub[k].ok; });
    var head = (out.ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify({ ok: out.ok, n: keys.length, fail: failed });
    document.getElementById('result').textContent = head + '\n\n' +
      keys.map(function (k) { return (out.sub[k].ok ? '  ✓ ' : '  ✗ ') + k + ' — ' + out.sub[k].d; }).join('\n');
    document.title = head;
  }

  /* 等素材全部加载（最多 8s），再页内解码 9 张新图标 */
  S.load('../assets/sprites/');
  var t0 = Date.now();
  (function poll() {
    if (S.isReady() || (Date.now() - t0) > 8000) {
      Promise.all(NEW_ICONS.map(loadOne)).then(run);
      return;
    }
    setTimeout(poll, 60);
  })();
})();

(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { ok: true, sub: {} };
  function rec(name, ok, d) {
    out.sub[name] = { ok: !!ok, d: d };
    if (!ok) out.ok = false;
  }
  function read(path) {
    try {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('GET', path, false); x.send(null);
      return x.responseText || '';
    } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }
  var TXT = {
    readme: read('../README.md'),
    plan: read('../PLAN.md'),
    log: read('../CHANGELOG.md'),
    notices: read('../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md'),
    sprites: read('../assets/sprites/LICENSE.md'),
    d14: read('../docs/tasks/D-14-notice.md'),
    s33: read('../docs/tasks/S3-3-modal.md'),
    ignore: read('../.gitignore'),
    index: read('../index.html'),
    maps: read('../js/data/maps.js')
  };
  var DOCSET = [
    ['README.md', TXT.readme], ['PLAN.md', TXT.plan], ['CHANGELOG.md', TXT.log],
    ['THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md', TXT.notices], ['assets/sprites/LICENSE.md', TXT.sprites],
    ['docs/tasks/D-14-notice.md', TXT.d14], ['docs/tasks/S3-3-modal.md', TXT.s33],
    ['.gitignore', TXT.ignore], ['index.html', TXT.index]
  ];

  /* ── 锚点扫描（CHANGELOG 每条必须带锚点且能在代码里命中）── */
  function scanAnchors(text, fs) {
    var entries = [], bad = [], noAnchor = [];
    var lines = text.split('\n');
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      if (lines[i].indexOf('- ') !== 0) continue;
      var m = /<!--\s*锚点:\s*([^#\s]+)#([^\s]+)\s*-->/.exec(lines[i]);
      if (!m) { noAnchor.push(lines[i].slice(0, 40)); continue; }
      var body = fs[m[1]];
      if (typeof body !== 'string') { bad.push(m[1] + '（文件不存在）'); continue; }
      entries.push(m[1] + '#' + m[2]);
      if (body.indexOf(m[2]) < 0) bad.push(m[1] + '#' + m[2] + '（符号未命中）');
      /* 末尾的"条目"本身也要覆盖到：D-31 的 CHANGELOG 条目指向自身时跳过 */
      if (m[1] === 'CHANGELOG.md') entries.pop();
    }
    return { n: entries.length, bad: bad, noAnchor: noAnchor };
  }
  var FS = {};
  [
    'README.md', 'PLAN.md', 'CHANGELOG.md', 'THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md',
    'assets/sprites/LICENSE.md', 'docs/tasks/D-14-notice.md', 'docs/tasks/S3-3-modal.md',
    '.gitignore', 'index.html',

    'js/systems/inventory.js', 'js/systems/bestiary.js', 'js/systems/leaderboard.js',

    readme: (/版本\s*v(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/.exec(TXT.readme) || [])[1] || null

  var anchor = scanAnchors(TXT.log, FS);

  /* ══ A2. 版本号三处一致，且旧口径（PLAN 表 v1.0）不存在 ═════════ */
  var oldVer = /\|\s*版本\s*\|\s*v1\.0\s*\|/.test(TXT.plan);
  var a2 = !!VER.meta && VER.meta === VER.log && VER.meta === VER.readme && !oldVer;
  rec('A2_versionSingleSource', a2,

    '；PLAN 旧「| 版本 | v1.0 |」仍在=' + oldVer + '（必须 false）');

  var NEED = [

  /* ══ A4. 素材许可文件：存在 + 声明张数 = 磁盘张数 = NAMES 数 ═══ */
  var audit = null;

  rec('A4_spriteLicenseCountMatches', a4,
    'LICENSE.md 声明=' + declared + '；审计（磁盘实测）=' + (audit ? audit.total : 'n/a') +

  /* ══ A5. D-14 补记卡存在且六节齐全 ═══════════════════════════ */
  var secs = ['## 1.', '## 2.', '## 3.', '## 4.', '## 5.', '## 6.'];
  var got5 = secs.filter(function (s) { return TXT.d14.indexOf(s) === 0 || TXT.d14.indexOf('\n' + s) >= 0; });
  var a5 = TXT.d14.length > 800 && got5.length === 6;

  /* ══ A6. 8 处事实错误：旧文本必须不存在 ═══════════════════════ */
  function activeIgnore(line) { return line.indexOf('#') !== 0 && line.trim() !== ''; }
  var ignoreActive = TXT.ignore.split('\n').filter(activeIgnore).join('\n');
  var OLD = [
    ['PLAN M8 待办', /M8 内容深度（待办）/.test(TXT.plan)],

    ['.gitignore 仍忽略 shots_resize', /preflight\/shots_resize\//.test(ignoreActive)],
    ['.gitignore 仍忽略 自检报告.md', /自检报告\.md/.test(ignoreActive)]

  var stillOld = OLD.filter(function (x) { return x[1]; }).map(function (x) { return x[0]; });
  rec('A6_eightStaleFactsGone', stillOld.length === 0,
    '8 项旧文本残留=' + (stillOld.length ? stillOld.join(' ｜ ') : '0') +

  /* ══ A7. 全仓文档不再引用 rank.js / assets/img/ ═══════════════ */
  var bad7 = [];
  DOCSET.forEach(function (p) {
    if (/js\/systems\/rank\.js/.test(p[1])) bad7.push(p[0] + ':rank.js');
    if (/assets\/img\//.test(p[1])) bad7.push(p[0] + ':assets/img');
  });
  rec('A7_noDanglingPaths', bad7.length === 0,
    '扫描 ' + DOCSET.length + ' 份文档；悬空引用=' + (bad7.length ? bad7.join(',') : '0'));

  /* ══ A8. 5 层口径统一（代码唯一权威 + 文档不冲突）═══════════════ */
  var maps = Game.Data && Game.Data.MAPS;
  var codeFloors = (maps && typeof maps.floors === 'number') ? maps.floors : null;
  var bad8 = [];
  DOCSET.forEach(function (p) {
    if (/7\s*层|七层/.test(p[1])) bad8.push(p[0]);
  });
  var readmeFive = /地牢层数固定\s*\*{0,2}\s*5\s*层/.test(TXT.readme);
  rec('A8_floorsFiveConsistent', codeFloors === 5 && readmeFive && bad8.length === 0,
    'MAPS.floors=' + codeFloors + '（代码权威）；README「地牢层数固定 **5 层**」=' + readmeFive +
    '；文档出现「7 层/七层」=' + (bad8.length ? bad8.join(',') : '0'));

  /* ══ N1. 负例：CHANGELOG 塞一条假功能必须 FAIL ═══════════════ */

  var n1 = anchor.bad.length === 0 && badFake.bad.length === 1 &&
    badFake.bad[0].indexOf('js/systems/cloud.js') === 0;
  rec('N1_negativeFakeFeatureFails', n1,

    JSON.stringify(badFake.bad) + '（必须命中 js/systems/cloud.js）');

  /* ══ N2. 负例：删掉许可文件必须 FAIL ═════════════════════════ */
  var noLicense = { ok: false, d: '' };
  (function () {
    var empty = '';
    var okReal = TXT.notices.indexOf('BSD 3-Clause License') >= 0;
    var okEmpty = empty.indexOf('BSD 3-Clause License') >= 0;
    noLicense = { ok: okReal && !okEmpty, d: '真实许可命中=' + okReal + '；空文件命中=' + okEmpty };
  })();
  rec('N2_negativeMissingLicenseFails', noLicense.ok, noLicense.d);

  /* ══ N3. 负例：把旧文本改回去必须 FAIL ═══════════════════════ */
  function staleDetect(t) {
    return [/M8 内容深度（待办）/.test(t), /js\/systems\/rank\.js/.test(t), /assets\/img\//.test(t)];
  }
  var goodHits = staleDetect(TXT.plan).filter(Boolean).length;
  var mutPlan = TXT.plan + '\n| 本地排行榜 | `js/systems/rank.js` |';
  var mutHits = staleDetect(mutPlan).filter(Boolean).length;
  var n3 = goodHits === 0 && mutHits === 1;
  rec('N3_negativeStaleTextFails', n3,
    '当前 PLAN 旧文本命中=' + goodHits + '（必须 0）；把 rank.js 写回去后命中=' + mutHits +
    '（必须 1，说明检测器有效）');

  var keys = Object.keys(out.sub);
  var failed = keys.filter(function (k) { return !out.sub[k].ok; });
  var head = (out.ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify({ ok: out.ok, n: keys.length, fail: failed });
  document.getElementById('result').textContent = head + '\n\n' +
    keys.map(function (k) { return (out.sub[k].ok ? '  ✓ ' : '  ✗ ') + k + ' — ' + out.sub[k].d; }).join('\n');
  document.title = head;
})();

/* D-33 改造：
 * 1) 旧路径判定从「任意子串包含」改为「路径形态」（D-33 裁定一）——改扫描器，不改被检查的文档；
 * 2) A3 分两栏：功能性残留（必须 0）/ 历史提及（数量 + 文件），不合并成一个数字（裁定二）；
 * 3) 线上轻量模式：file:// 永远跑全量；http(s) 下 1.1s 内跑不完则退到 online-lite 并显式打印（裁定四）。
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { ok: true, sub: {} };
  function rec(name, ok, d) {
    out.sub[name] = { ok: !!ok, d: d };
    if (!ok) out.ok = false;
  }

  var LITE_FORCED = /[?&]lite=1/.test(location.search);
  var IS_FILE = location.protocol === 'file:';
  var MODE = 'full';
  var CACHE = {}, textQ = [], binQ = [];
  var LOADED = 0, TOTAL = 0, DONE = false, EMITTED = null;

  function tick() {
    LOADED++;
    if (!DONE && !EMITTED) {
      document.getElementById('result').textContent = 'LOADING ' + LOADED + '/' + (TOTAL || '?');
    }
  }
  function collectText(p) { if (!(p in CACHE)) { CACHE[p] = ''; textQ.push(p); } }
  function collectBin(p) { if (!(p in CACHE)) { CACHE[p] = null; binQ.push(p); } }
  function read(p) { return CACHE[p] || ''; }
  function readBin(p) { return CACHE[p] || null; }
  function fetchText(p, cb) {
    try {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('GET', p, true);
      x.onload = x.onerror = x.ontimeout = function () { CACHE[p] = x.responseText || ''; cb(); };
      x.send(null);
    } catch (e) { CACHE[p] = ''; cb(); }
  }
  function fetchBin(p, cb) {
    /* Window 下同步 XHR 不允许 responseType='arraybuffer'，用 x-user-defined 拿字节 */
    try {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('GET', p, true);
      try { x.overrideMimeType('text/plain; charset=x-user-defined'); } catch (e2) { /* noop */ }
      x.onload = x.onerror = x.ontimeout = function () {
        var s = x.responseText || '';
        if (!s) { CACHE[p] = null; return cb(); }
        var u8 = new Uint8Array(s.length);
        for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) u8[i] = s.charCodeAt(i) & 0xff;
        CACHE[p] = u8; cb();
      };
      x.send(null);
    } catch (e) { CACHE[p] = null; cb(); }
  }
  function runAll(list, fn, cb) {
    var n = list.length;
    if (!n) return cb();
    list.forEach(function (p) {
      fn(p, function () { tick(); n--; if (n === 0) cb(); });
    });
  }

  function fnvText(str) {
    var h = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
      h ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
      h = (h + ((h << 1) + (h << 4) + (h << 7) + (h << 8) + (h << 24))) >>> 0;
    }
    return ('00000000' + h.toString(16)).slice(-8);
  }
  function fnvBytes(u8) {
    var h = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (var i = 0; i < u8.length; i++) {
      h ^= u8[i];
      h = (h + ((h << 1) + (h << 4) + (h << 7) + (h << 8) + (h << 24))) >>> 0;
    }
    return ('00000000' + h.toString(16)).slice(-8);
  }
  var norm = function (s) { return s.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n'); };
  function utf8Len(s) {
    try { return new TextEncoder().encode(s).length; } catch (e) { return -1; }
  }

  /* ══ 旧路径判定：只认「路径形态」，不认任意子串（D-33 裁定一） ═══════
   * new   : 前缀解析为 docs/process/ —— 正确的新路径，直接放行
   * old   : 前缀是 ./ ../ / 路径片段，或行首裸名（含 file:///…/名）—— 功能性旧路径
   * bare  : 正文中以书名号 / 反引号包住的文件提及 —— 历史提及
   * 另外前后必须是边界：避免把「对标自检报告.md」里的「自检报告.md」算成一次引用。 */
  var PATH_CH = /[A-Za-z0-9_.\/~\\-]/;
  var WORD = /[A-Za-z0-9_]/;
  var CJK = /[\u3400-\u9fff]/;
  function prefixOf(text, i) {
    var s = i, lo = Math.max(0, i - 200);
    while (s > lo && PATH_CH.test(text.charAt(s - 1))) s--;
    return text.slice(s, i);
  }
  function boundaryOk(text, i, len) {
    var a = i > 0 ? text.charAt(i - 1) : '';
    var b = (i + len) < text.length ? text.charAt(i + len) : '';
    return !WORD.test(a) && !WORD.test(b) && !CJK.test(a);
  }
  function classifyAt(text, i) {
    var p = prefixOf(text, i);
    if (/(^|\/)docs\/process\/$/.test(p)) return 'new';
    if (p !== '') return 'old';
    var ls = text.lastIndexOf('\n', i - 1) + 1;
    return /^[\s>*\-|`]*$/.test(text.slice(ls, i)) ? 'old' : 'bare';
  }
  var TOKENS = ['preflight/shots_resize', '自检报告.md', '修复报告.md', '诊断报告.md', '对标自检报告.md'];
  function isHistFile(name) {
    return /^docs\/tasks\//.test(name) || /^docs\/process\//.test(name) || name === 'preflight/verify_d31.html';
  }
  function lineNo(text, i) {
    var n = 1;
    for (var k = 0; k < i && k < text.length; k++) if (text.charAt(k) === '\n') n++;
    return n;
  }
  /* 返回 { fn: [功能性残留（必须 0）], hist: {文件: 次数}, histTotal, kinds: {old,bare} } */
  function scanFiles(files) {
    var r = { fn: [], hist: {}, histTotal: 0, old: 0, bare: 0 };
    files.forEach(function (f) {
      TOKENS.forEach(function (tk) {
        var i = -1;
        while ((i = f.text.indexOf(tk, i + 1)) >= 0) {
          if (!boundaryOk(f.text, i, tk.length)) continue;
          var c = classifyAt(f.text, i);
          if (c === 'new') continue;
          if (isHistFile(f.name)) {
            r.hist[f.name] = (r.hist[f.name] || 0) + 1;
            r.histTotal++;
            if (c === 'old') r.old++; else r.bare++;
          } else {
            r.fn.push(f.name + ':' + lineNo(f.text, i) + ' ' + tk + '（' + c + '）');
          }
        }
      });
    });
    return r;
  }
  function histText(r) {
    var keys = Object.keys(r.hist).sort();
    return '共 ' + r.histTotal + ' 处［' + keys.map(function (k) { return k + '×' + r.hist[k]; }).join('、') + '］';
  }

  var MAN = null, BASE = null, SCAN = null;
  var CORE = ['PLAN.md', 'README.md', 'CHANGELOG.md', '规划-对标补齐.md'];
  var FALLBACK_MOVES = [
    { old: '自检报告.md', next: 'docs/process/自检报告.md' },
    { old: '修复报告.md', next: 'docs/process/修复报告.md' },
    { old: '诊断报告.md', next: 'docs/process/诊断报告.md' },
    { old: '对标自检报告.md', next: 'docs/process/对标自检报告.md' }
  ];
  var MUST_STAY = ['verify_d31.html', 'verify_d29.html', 'verify_d22.html'];
  var PROCESS_HTML = ['verify_d31.html', 'verify_d22.html', 'verify_d02.html'];

  /* ══ 全量模式（本地 file:// 恒走此路）═══════════════════════════ */
  function startFull() {
    MODE = 'full';
    runAll(['selfcheck/d32-move-manifest.json', 'selfcheck/page-baseline.json', 'selfcheck/d32-scanlist.json'],
      fetchText, function () {
        try { MAN = JSON.parse(read('selfcheck/d32-move-manifest.json') || 'null'); } catch (e) { MAN = null; }
        try { BASE = JSON.parse(read('selfcheck/page-baseline.json') || 'null'); } catch (e) { BASE = null; }
        try { SCAN = JSON.parse(read('selfcheck/d32-scanlist.json') || 'null'); } catch (e) { SCAN = null; }

        if (MAN) {
          MAN.moves.forEach(function (m) { collectText('../' + m.next); collectText('../' + m.old); });
          MAN.shots.files.forEach(function (f) { collectBin('artifacts/shots_resize/' + f.name); });
          collectBin('shots_resize/' + MAN.shots.files[0].name);
        }
        if (SCAN && SCAN.files) SCAN.files.forEach(function (p) { collectText('../' + p); });
        CORE.forEach(function (f) { collectText('../' + f); collectText('../docs/process/' + f); });
        MUST_STAY.forEach(function (p) { collectText(p); });
        PROCESS_HTML.forEach(function (p) { collectText('../docs/process/' + p); });
        collectText('artifacts/README.md');
        collectText('../README.md');
        collectText('../CHANGELOG.md');
        collectText('../docs/process/自检报告.md');

        TOTAL = textQ.length + binQ.length + 3;
        var waves = 2;
        function waveDone() { waves--; if (waves === 0) assertFull(); }
        runAll(textQ, fetchText, waveDone);
        runAll(binQ, fetchBin, waveDone);
      });
  }

  function assertFull() {
    if (EMITTED === 'full') return;
    DONE = true;
    out = { ok: true, sub: {} };

    /* A1 */
    var a1miss = [];
    if (!MAN) a1miss.push('台账不可读');
    else MAN.moves.forEach(function (m) { if (!read('../' + m.next)) a1miss.push(m.next); });
    rec('A1_newPathsExist', !!MAN && a1miss.length === 0,
      '台账 ' + (MAN ? MAN.moves.length : 0) + ' 份；新位置缺失=' + (a1miss.length ? a1miss.join(',') : '0'));

    /* A2 */
    var a2alive = [];

      MAN.moves.forEach(function (m) { if (read('../' + m.old)) a2alive.push('../' + m.old); });

    /* A3：两栏打印 */
    var SCANNED = [];

      '｜历史提及（不计入残留）= ' + histText(rs) + '［旧形态 ' + rs.old + ' / 正文提及 ' + rs.bare + '］');

    /* A4 */
    function coreCheck(map) { return CORE.filter(function (f) { return !(map[f] || ''); }); }

    CORE.forEach(function (f) { coreMap[f] = read('../' + f); });

    /* A5 */

    if (MAN) {
      MAN.moves.forEach(function (m) {
        var t = read('../' + m.next);
        var body = t.slice(t.indexOf('\n') + 1);
        var h = fnvText(norm(body)), n = utf8Len(body);
        if (h !== m.bodyHash || n !== m.bodyBytes) {
          a5bad.push(m.next + '：hash ' + h + '/' + m.bodyHash + '，bytes ' + n + '/' + m.bodyBytes);
        }
      });
    }
    rec('A5_movedBodiesUnchanged', !!MAN && a5bad.length === 0,
      '逐份比对「来源说明行之后的正文」与 d32-before.json 的 LF 归一 FNV-1a；不一致=' +
      (a5bad.length ? a5bad.join(' ｜ ') : '0'));

    /* A6 */
    var a6bad = [], a6ok = !!MAN && MAN.shots.count === 12;
    if (MAN) {
      MAN.shots.files.forEach(function (f) {

        if (!u8) { a6bad.push(f.name + '：读不到'); return; }

    rec('A6_twelveShotsMoved', a6ok && a6bad.length === 0,
      '台账 ' + (MAN ? MAN.shots.files.length : 0) + ' 张；新目录实测异常=' + (a6bad.length ? a6bad.join(',') : '0'));

    /* A7 */

    if (MAN) {
      MAN.moves.forEach(function (m) {
        var t = read('../' + m.next);
        if (t.indexOf(m.note) !== 0) a7bad.push(m.next + '：来源说明不在首行');
        if (t.indexOf('2026-11-12') < 0 || t.indexOf(m.old) < 0) a7bad.push(m.next + '：缺原路径或日期');
      });
    }
    var shotNote = read('artifacts/README.md');
    if (!shotNote || shotNote.indexOf('2026-11-12') < 0) a7bad.push('artifacts/README.md：缺来源说明');

    var htmlInProcess = PROCESS_HTML.filter(function (p) { return read('../docs/process/' + p); });
    rec('A8_verifyPagesUntouched', movedAway.length === 0 && htmlInProcess.length === 0,

      '；被搬进 docs/process/=' + (htmlInProcess.length ? htmlInProcess.join(',') : '0'));

    /* A9：基线页数是人工维护的硬数字——每新增一张验证页必须同步改这里
     * （D-34：74→75；D-35：75→76，新增 verify_d35；D-36：76→77，新增 verify_d36；

     *   D-39：79→80，新增 verify_d39；D-40：80→81，新增 verify_d40；D-41：81→82，新增 verify_d41；D-42：82→83，新增 verify_d42；
     *   D-43：83→84，新增 verify_d43；D-44：84→85，新增 verify_d44；D-45：85→86，新增 verify_d45；

     *   D-49：89→90，新增 verify_d49；D-50：90→91，新增 verify_d50；D-51：91→92，新增 verify_d51；
     *   D-52：92→93，新增 verify_d52；D-53：93→94，新增 verify_d53；D-54：94→95，新增 verify_d54；D-55：95→96，新增 verify_d55；D-57：96→97，新增 verify_d57；D-58：97→98，新增 verify_d58；D-59：98→99，新增 verify_d59；D-60：99→100，新增 verify_d60）。
     * 这是基线变更，不是放宽断言。 */
    var a9 = !!BASE && BASE.count === 100 && Array.isArray(BASE.pages) &&

      ' / 验证页 100 个=' + (README.indexOf('验证页 100 个') >= 0) +
      '；CHANGELOG 含 B1=' + (LOG.indexOf('阶段 B1 目录归位') >= 0) +

    /* A11：路径形态匹配器的正负例（裁定一）*/

    var posText = '../对标自检报告.md\nfile:///d:/work/自检报告.md\n诊断报告.md\n见 `修复报告.md` 与 ../preflight/shots_resize/shot_1280x720.png';

    /* N1 */

    Object.keys(coreMap).forEach(function (k) { mutMove[k] = coreMap[k]; });

  }

  /* ══ 线上轻量模式（裁定四）：≤13 次取数，明确标记 online-lite ════ */
  var LITE_FILES = ['selfcheck/d32-move-manifest.json', 'selfcheck/page-baseline.json',
    '../README.md', '../CHANGELOG.md', '../规划-对标补齐.md'];
  function startLite() {
    MODE = 'online-lite';
    var q = LITE_FILES.slice();
    (MAN ? MAN.moves : FALLBACK_MOVES).forEach(function (m) { q.push('../' + m.next); });
    CORE.forEach(function (f) { q.push('../' + f); });
    q = q.filter(function (p, i) { return q.indexOf(p) === i; });

  }
  function assertLite() {
    if (EMITTED === 'full') return;
    out = { ok: true, sub: {} };
    var man = null, base = null;
    try { man = JSON.parse(read('selfcheck/d32-move-manifest.json') || 'null'); } catch (e) { man = null; }
    try { base = JSON.parse(read('selfcheck/page-baseline.json') || 'null'); } catch (e) { base = null; }
    var names = man ? man.moves : FALLBACK_MOVES;
    var newMiss = names.filter(function (m) { return !read('../' + m.next); }).map(function (m) { return m.next; });
    rec('L1_newPathsExist', newMiss.length === 0,
      '4 份报告新路径存在=' + (names.length - newMiss.length) + '/' + names.length +

      'PLAN/README/CHANGELOG/规划 仍在根目录=' + (CORE.length - coreMiss.length) + '/4' +
      (coreMiss.length ? '；缺=' + coreMiss.join(',') : ''));

    var a9 = !!base && base.count === 83 && Array.isArray(base.pages) &&
      base.pages.length === 83 && base.pages.indexOf('verify_d32') >= 0;
    rec('L3_pageBaselineAligned', a9,
      'count=' + (base ? base.count : 'n/a') + '；含 verify_d32=' +

    var README = read('../README.md'), LOG = read('../CHANGELOG.md'), PLAN2 = read('../规划-对标补齐.md');
    rec('L4_readmeUpdated', README.indexOf('docs/process/') >= 0 && README.indexOf('preflight/artifacts/') >= 0 &&
      README.indexOf('验证页 80 个') >= 0,
      'README 关键锚点 docs/process=' + (README.indexOf('docs/process/') >= 0) +

      ' / 80 个=' + (README.indexOf('验证页 80 个') >= 0));

    rec('L5_changelogUpdated', LOG.indexOf('阶段 B1 目录归位') >= 0 && LOG.indexOf('阶段 B2') >= 0,
      'CHANGELOG 含 B1=' + (LOG.indexOf('阶段 B1 目录归位') >= 0) + ' B2=' + (LOG.indexOf('阶段 B2') >= 0));

    var cite = (PLAN2.split('\n').filter(function (l) { return l.indexOf('依据：') >= 0; })[0] || '');
    rec('L6_planCitationClickable', /\[对标自检报告\]\(docs\/process\/对标自检报告\.md\)/.test(cite),
      '依据行含可点击新路径=' + /\[对标自检报告\]\(docs\/process\/对标自检报告\.md\)/.test(cite));

    emit('online-lite');
  }

  function emit(mode) {
    if (EMITTED === 'full') return;          /* 全量已经出过裁决，轻量不得回写降级 */
    EMITTED = mode;
    var keys = Object.keys(out.sub);
    var failed = keys.filter(function (k) { return !out.sub[k].ok; });
    var head = (out.ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify({
      mode: mode, ok: out.ok, n: keys.length, fail: failed,
      attempted: mode === 'online-lite' ? (LOADED + '/' + (TOTAL || '?')) : undefined
    });
    var note = mode === 'online-lite'
      ? '\nmode=online-lite（线上轻量模式：全量 ' + (TOTAL || '?') + ' 份仍在取数，已取 ' + LOADED +
        ' 份；本裁决**只覆盖关键 ' + keys.length + ' 项，不代表全量残留扫描通过**，全量结论以本地 run-all 为准）'
      : '\nmode=full（本地全量：' + (TOTAL || '?') + ' 份取数完成）';
    document.getElementById('result').textContent = head + note + '\n\n' +
      keys.map(function (k) { return (out.sub[k].ok ? '  ✓ ' : '  ✗ ') + k + ' — ' + out.sub[k].d; }).join('\n');
    document.title = head;
  }

  /* ── 入口 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   * file://（本地 run-all）：只跑全量，绝不退轻量。
   * http(s)（线上）：两路同时起——轻量先出裁决（≤13 次取数，抓取窗口内可得），
   *   全量跑完后用 mode=full 覆盖；若全量没跑完，页面上就是线上轻量裁决 + 已取份数。 */
  if (LITE_FORCED) startLite();
  else if (IS_FILE) startFull();
  else { startLite(); startFull(); }
})();
</script>
</body>
