  }

  /* D-44 基线（本卡不允许改动这些表；F 组用它们做指纹） */
  var BASE_STOCK = '[[\"potion_small\",\"potion_large\",\"knife\",\"machete\",\"sword_rusty\",\"sword_iron\",\"armor_leather\"],[\"potion_large\",\"potion_mana\",\"sword_steel\",\"axe_war\",\"bow_hunter\",\"hammer\",\"spear\",\"chain_mail\",\"robe_mage\"],[\"potion_xl\",\"sword_magic\",\"staff_fire\",\"axe_double\",\"sword_anime\",\"plate_armor\",\"sword_dragon\",\"sword_dragon_rare\",\"sword_dragon_epic\"],[\"potion_xl\",\"potion_mana\",\"sword_magic_rare\",\"sword_steel_epic\",\"chain_mail_rare\",\"plate_armor_rare\",\"robe_mage_rare\",\"sword_dragon_rare\"],[\"potion_xl\",\"potion_mana\",\"sword_magic_epic\",\"sword_dragon_epic\",\"plate_armor_epic\",\"chain_mail_epic\",\"robe_mage_epic\",\"sword_dragon_rare\"]]';
  var BASE_CHEST = '{\"chest\":[\"potion_large\",\"potion_large\",\"potion_small\",\"sword_bone\",\"armor_leather\"],\"room_chest\":[\"potion_xl\",\"potion_large\",\"sword_bone\",\"armor_leather\",\"scroll_upgrade\"]}';

  var AFTER = readJson('selfcheck/d45-after.json');
  var PRE = readJson('selfcheck/d45-pre.json');
  var NEG = readJson('selfcheck/d45-neg.json');
  var TIERS = readJson('selfcheck/d45-tiers.json');
  var CEIL = readJson('selfcheck/d45-ceiling.json');
  var CEILF1 = readJson('selfcheck/d45-ceiling-f1.json');
  var CEIL8 = readJson('selfcheck/d45-ceil-dragon.json');
  var CEIL5 = readJson('selfcheck/d45-ceil-steel.json');
  var CEIL3 = readJson('selfcheck/d45-ceil-bone.json');
  var D44 = readJson('selfcheck/d44-after.json');
  var GIT = readJson('selfcheck/d45-git.json');

  try {
    if (!AFTER || !PRE || !NEG || !TIERS || !CEIL || !CEILF1 || !CEIL8 || !CEIL5 || !CEIL3 || !D44 || !GIT) {
      throw new Error('缺少测量产物: ' + JSON.stringify({
        after: !!AFTER, pre: !!PRE, neg: !!NEG, tiers: !!TIERS,
        ceiling: !!CEIL, ceilingF1: !!CEILF1, ceiling8: !!CEIL8,
        ceiling5: !!CEIL5, ceiling3: !!CEIL3, d44: !!D44, git: !!GIT
      }));
    }
    var B1R = runsOf(AFTER, 'b1');
    var AGG = AFTER.agg || {};
    var B1 = AFTER.b1 || {};
    var D45 = AFTER.d45 || {};

    /* ── A 组：25 个到 F5 的局逐局可复算；四类原因占比之和 = 100% ── */
    var f5runs = B1R.filter(function (r) { return r.b1 && r.b1.enterF5; });
    var REASONS = ['bought', 'noStock', 'goldShort', 'priority', 'noEntry'];
    var recount = { bought: 0, noStock: 0, goldShort: 0, priority: 0, noEntry: 0 };
    var rowBad = [], rowsOut = [], segs = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < f5runs.length; i++) {
      var r = f5runs[i];
      if (!r.d45 || !r.d45.shops) { rowBad.push({ seed: r.seed, err: 'no d45.shops' }); continue; }
      var floors = [];
      for (var e = 0; e < (r.b1.floorEnter || []).length; e++) {
        var fl = r.b1.floorEnter[e].floor;
        if (floors.indexOf(fl) < 0) floors.push(fl);
      }
      floors.sort();
      var row = { seed: r.seed, outcome: r.outcome, floors: [] };
      for (var f = 0; f < floors.length; f++) {
        segs++;
        var visits = r.d45.shops.filter(function (s) { return s.floor === floors[f]; });
        if (!visits.length) {
          recount.noEntry++;
          row.floors.push({ floor: floors[f], reason: 'noEntry' });
          continue;
        }
        for (var v = 0; v < visits.length; v++) {
          var s = visits[v];
          if (REASONS.indexOf(s.reason) < 0) rowBad.push({ seed: r.seed, floor: s.floor, err: 'bad reason ' + s.reason });
          if (typeof s.gold !== 'number' || !s.stock || !s.bought) rowBad.push({ seed: r.seed, floor: s.floor, err: 'missing fields' });
          recount[s.reason]++;
          var shelf = [], bought = [];
          for (var k = 0; k < (s.stock || []).length; k++) {
            var it = s.stock[k];
            if (it.type === 'weapon' || it.type === 'armor') {
              shelf.push(it.id + '@' + it.price + (it.weaponUp || it.armorUp ? '^' : '') + (it.affordable ? '' : 'x'));
            }
          }
          for (var b = 0; b < (s.bought || []).length; b++) bought.push(s.bought[b].id + '@' + s.bought[b].price);
          row.floors.push({
            floor: s.floor, gold: s.gold, goldIn: s.goldIn, soldGold: s.soldGold,
            weaponAtk: s.weaponAtk, weaponId: s.weaponId, reason: s.reason,
            shelf: shelf, bought: bought
          });
        }
      }
      rowsOut.push(row);
    }
    var failCount = recount.noStock + recount.goldShort + recount.priority + recount.noEntry;
    var shares = {};
    for (var q = 0; q < REASONS.length; q++) {
      if (REASONS[q] === 'bought') continue;
      shares[REASONS[q]] = failCount ? Math.round((recount[REASONS[q]] / failCount) * 1000) / 10 : 0;
    }
    var shareSum = 0;
    for (var q2 in shares) shareSum += shares[q2];
    shareSum = Math.round(shareSum * 10) / 10;
    var countsMatch = true;
    for (var q3 in recount) if (recount[q3] !== (D45.counts || {})[q3]) countsMatch = false;
    rec('A_per_run_recomputable', f5runs.length === 25 && rowBad.length === 0 && countsMatch &&
      (D45.rows || []).length === 25, {
      rule: '25 个到 F5 的局必须逐局可复算：进店次数、当时金币、货架（武器/护甲 是否升级/买不买得起）、成交、原因；'
        + '原因只允许 bought/noStock/goldShort/priority/noEntry，页面重算必须与 bot 记录一致',
      f5Runs: f5runs.length, floorSegments: segs, bad: rowBad.slice(0, 10),
      recount: recount, botCounts: D45.counts, equipBuys: D45.equipBuys
    });
    rec('A_reason_shares_100', Math.abs(shareSum - 100) <= 0.1 && failCount > 0, {
      rule: '四类原因（金不够 goldShort / 货架没有 noStock / 根本没进店 noEntry / 优先级买错 priority）占比之和 = 100%',
      failures: failCount, shares: shares, shareSum: shareSum,
      success: recount.bought,
      note: 'bought 是成交，不参与"未成交原因"的 100% 分母；到 F5 的 25 局里 5 层各开一次店，共 ' + segs + ' 个层商店机会'
    });
    rec('A_dominant_cause_gold', shares.goldShort >= 50, {
      rule: '审计结论：未成交的主因必须是"金不够"（占比 ≥50% 才配得上"经济审计"的结论）',
      goldShortShare: shares.goldShort, noStockShare: shares.noStock,
      noEntryShare: shares.noEntry, priorityShare: shares.priority
    });

    /* ── B 组：武器档位 → 回合数/差值可复算；seed 1042 与 D-44 一致 ── */
    var tr = (TIERS.tiers && TIERS.tiers.rows) || [];
    var trow = {};
    for (var t = 0; t < tr.length; t++) trow[tr[t].probe || 'natural'] = tr[t];
    var nat = trow['natural'], dead1042 = null;
    for (var d2 = 0; d2 < B1R.length; d2++) {
      if (B1R[d2].seed !== 1042) continue;
      for (var fb = 0; fb < (B1R[d2].f5Battles || []).length; fb++) {
        if (B1R[d2].f5Battles[fb].monsterId === 'dragon') dead1042 = B1R[d2].f5Battles[fb];
      }
    }
    var baselineOk = !!(nat && nat.dragon && dead1042 &&
      nat.dragon.dealt === dead1042.dealt && nat.dragon.nRounds === dead1042.nRounds &&
      nat.dragon.potionUses === dead1042.potionUses &&
      nat.dragon.dealt === 213 && nat.dragon.nRounds === 12 && (260 - nat.dragon.dealt) === 47);
    rec('B_tier_table_recomputable', tr.length === 9 && baselineOk, {
      rule: '武器档位反事实必须可复算：F5 起点换武器（其余不变），记录玩家 atk、对龙伤害、回合、结果；'
        + '不换武器的基准必须与 D-44 的 1042 数字一致（213 伤害 / 12 回合 / 龙剩 47 / 4 瓶药）',
      baseline1042: nat ? {
        atk: nat.enterF5 && nat.enterF5.atk,
        dealt: nat.dragon.dealt, nRounds: nat.dragon.nRounds,
        potionUses: nat.dragon.potionUses, dragonHpLeft: nat.dragonHpLeft,
        d44: dead1042 ? { dealt: dead1042.dealt, nRounds: dead1042.nRounds, potionUses: dead1042.potionUses } : null
      } : null,
      rows: tr.map(function (x) {
        return { probe: x.probe, atk: x.enterF5 && x.enterF5.atk, outcome: x.outcome,
          dealt: x.dragon && x.dragon.dealt, nRounds: x.dragon && x.dragon.nRounds,
          left: x.dragonHpLeft, pct: x.dealtPct, win: x.win };
      })
    });
    var best = trow['sword_dragon_epic'], best2 = trow['sword_magic_epic'];
    rec('B_no_existing_tier_wins_1042', !!(best && best2 && !best.win && !best2.win &&
      best.dragon && best.dragon.dealt < 260 && trow['sword_anime'] && !trow['sword_anime'].win), {
      rule: '回答"最低要什么档位的武器才能赢 1042"：把现有物品表里最强档（atk16 → 玩家 atk30）换上去仍然输，'
        + '说明 1042 的缺口不是"再高一点点的武器"能补的（缺口 = 47 伤害 ≈ 2~3 回合 + 2 瓶药）',
      strongestExisting: best ? { probe: best.probe, atk: best.enterF5 && best.enterF5.atk,
        dealt: best.dragon && best.dragon.dealt, left: best.dragonHpLeft, win: best.win } : null,
      minWinningTier: '现有物品表内不存在（atk16 仍差 ' + (best ? best.dragonHpLeft : '?') + ' 血）'
    });
    rec('B_supply_ceiling', !!(CEIL.ceiling && CEILF1.ceiling && CEIL8.ceiling && CEIL5.ceiling && CEIL3.ceiling), {
      rule: '定量回答"一把武器值多少"：F5 起点免费发最强现役武器（atk16）也只有 1/50 通关（与基线相同）；'
        + '从 F1 起免费发 atk16 才有 6/50——但那是禁止项"免费高阶武器"；从 F1 起发 atk3/5/8（合规中档）全部 0/50。'
        + '结论：合规的武器供给改不动通关率。',
      f5only_atk16: { wins: CEIL.ceiling.agg.outcomes.win, f5: CEIL.ceiling.agg.f5.reached,
        dragonKills: CEIL.ceiling.b1.dragon.kills, dragonAttempts: CEIL.ceiling.b1.dragon.attempts },
      fromF1_atk16_forbidden: { wins: CEILF1.ceiling.agg.outcomes.win, f5: CEILF1.ceiling.agg.f5.reached,
        dragonKills: CEILF1.ceiling.b1.dragon.kills },
      fromF1_atk8: { wins: CEIL8.ceiling.agg.outcomes.win, f5: CEIL8.ceiling.agg.f5.reached },
      fromF1_atk5: { wins: CEIL5.ceiling.agg.outcomes.win, f5: CEIL5.ceiling.agg.f5.reached },
      fromF1_atk3: { wins: CEIL3.ceiling.agg.outcomes.win, f5: CEIL3.ceiling.agg.f5.reached }
    });

    /* ── C 组：负例——把商店武器档位还原，必须复现改前基线并使差值断言 FAIL ── */
    var preWins = (PRE.agg && PRE.agg.b1 && PRE.agg.b1.outcomes && PRE.agg.b1.outcomes.win) || 0;
    var negWins = (NEG.neg && NEG.neg.agg && NEG.neg.agg.outcomes && NEG.neg.agg.outcomes.win) || 0;
    var afterWins = (AGG.b1 && AGG.b1.outcomes && AGG.b1.outcomes.win) || 0;
    var delta = afterWins - preWins;
    var deltaAssertionPass = delta >= 4;
    var stockSame = (NEG.neg && NEG.neg.stock && JSON.stringify(NEG.neg.stock) === BASE_STOCK);
    rec('C_neg_restores_baseline', negWins === preWins && negWins === 1 && stockSame, {
      rule: '负例：还原 D-44 商店武器档位后，B1 通关率必须复现改前基线（1/50）',
      preWins: preWins, negWins: negWins, afterWins: afterWins,
      negStockIsD44: stockSame,
      negF5: NEG.neg && NEG.neg.agg && NEG.neg.agg.f5 ? NEG.neg.agg.f5.reached : null,
      negDragonKills: NEG.neg && NEG.neg.b1 && NEG.neg.b1.dragon ? NEG.neg.b1.dragon.kills : null
    });
    rec('C_delta_assertion_fails', !deltaAssertionPass, {
      rule: '差值断言（改后至少 +4 通关）必须 FAIL：本卡测量后没有改任何商店货架/价格，delta=' + delta,
      preWins: preWins, afterWins: afterWins, delta: delta, required: 4,
      why: '测量结论是"不该改"：96.6% 的未成交是金币不足，而金币/药水不在本卡允许改动范围；'
        + '商店核心货架均价（S-03）与轮换池档位（C-03/C3-1）被既有断言锁死，改价会直接让既有 verify FAIL'
    });

    /* ── D 组：三条护栏，超限必须 FAIL ── */
    var upEvents = 0, segments = 0, upRows = [];
    var ATK = Game.Data.ITEMS;
    function watk(id) { var z = ATK[id]; return z && z.effect && z.effect.atk ? z.effect.atk : 0; }
    for (var u = 0; u < B1R.length; u++) {
      var ru = B1R[u];
      if (!ru.b1 || !ru.b1.floorEnter) continue;
      var fe = ru.b1.floorEnter;
      for (var gi = 0; gi < fe.length; gi++) {
        segments++;
        var a0 = fe[gi].weaponId ? watk(fe[gi].weaponId) : 0;
        var nxt = fe[gi + 1];
        var a1 = a0;
        if (nxt && nxt.floor === fe[gi].floor + 1) a1 = nxt.weaponId ? watk(nxt.weaponId) : 0;
        if (a1 > a0) {
          upEvents++;
          upRows.push({ seed: ru.seed, floor: fe[gi].floor, from: fe[gi].weaponId, to: nxt.weaponId, fromAtk: a0, toAtk: a1 });
        }
      }
    }
    var perFloor = segments ? upEvents / segments : 0;
    var priceBad = [], freeBad = [];
    for (var vr = 0; vr < f5runs.length; vr++) {
      var sh = f5runs[vr].d45 && f5runs[vr].d45.shops || [];
      for (var vs = 0; vs < sh.length; vs++) {
        var spent = 0;
        for (var vb = 0; vb < (sh[vs].bought || []).length; vb++) {
          var bd = sh[vs].bought[vb];
          spent += bd.price;
          if (!(bd.price > 0)) freeBad.push({ seed: f5runs[vr].seed, floor: sh[vs].floor, id: bd.id, price: bd.price });
          var idef = ATK[bd.id];
          if (idef && !(idef.price > idef.sell)) priceBad.push({ id: bd.id, price: idef.price, sell: idef.sell });
        }
        if (spent > 0 && sh[vs].gold - sh[vs].goldAfter < spent) {
          /* 同一次进店可能还买了药（不计入 bought 的装备明细），所以只要求金币减少量 ≥ 装备价合计 */
          freeBad.push({ seed: f5runs[vr].seed, floor: sh[vs].floor, spent: spent,
            gold: sh[vs].gold, goldAfter: sh[vs].goldAfter });
        }
      }
    }
    rec('D_avg_new_weapons_per_floor', perFloor <= 1, {
      rule: '护栏①：每层新获得的武器平均 ≤1 把（按 B1 全 50 局的层进出武器 atk 提升次数 / 层段数）',
      upgrades: upEvents, floorSegments: segments, perFloor: Math.round(perFloor * 1000) / 1000,
      rows: upRows
    });
    rec('D_no_zero_cost_or_free', freeBad.length === 0 && priceBad.length === 0 && GIT.diffStat === '', {
      rule: '护栏②：不出现零成本强化/免费武器——每笔武器成交 price>0 且金币减少量 ≥ Σ装备价；'
        + '全物品 buy.price > sell 仍成立；js/ 零改动（git diff --stat -- js 为空）',
      freeBad: freeBad.slice(0, 8), priceBad: priceBad.slice(0, 8),
      jsDiff: String(GIT.diffStat || '').trim(), head: GIT.head
    });
    var potionOk = ATK.potion_small.price === 10 && ATK.potion_small.effect.hp === 30 &&
      ATK.potion_large.price === 40 && ATK.potion_large.effect.hp === 80 &&
      ATK.potion_xl.price === 80 && ATK.potion_xl.effect.hp === 150 &&
      ATK.potion_mana.price === 35 && ATK.potion_mana.effect.mp === 40;
    var spentAfter = (B1.shop && B1.shop.spent) || 0;
    var spentD44 = (D44.b1 && D44.b1.shop && D44.b1.shop.spent) || 0;
    rec('D_potion_power_not_doubled', potionOk && spentAfter <= spentD44 * 2 && spentAfter === spentD44, {
      rule: '护栏③：金币/药水价效不变——四种药水的 price/effect 必须原值，且 50 局商店总支出不得翻倍（本卡未改，支出应与 D-44 完全相同）',
      potionPrices: potionOk, spentAfter: spentAfter, spentD44: spentD44,
      ratio: spentD44 ? Math.round((spentAfter / spentD44) * 100) / 100 : null
    });

    /* ── E 组：B1/G2/S1/M1 同种子 1001–1050、maxActions 2500，与 D-44 逐项可比 ── */
    var seeds = (AFTER.env && AFTER.env.seeds) || [];
    var seedOk = seeds.length === 50 && seeds[0] === 1001 && seeds[49] === 1050;
    var API = ['b1', 'g2', 's1', 'm1'];
    var cmpBad = [], tableE = [];
    function pick(ag) {
      if (!ag) return null;
      return { floorReach: ag.floorReach, f5: ag.f5 && ag.f5.reached,
        win: ag.outcomes && ag.outcomes.win, dead: ag.outcomes && ag.outcomes.dead,
        stuck: ag.outcomes && ag.outcomes.stuck, kills: ag.killsTotal };
    }
    for (var ei = 0; ei < API.length; ei++) {
      var key = API[ei];
      var a1 = pick((AFTER.agg || {})[key]), b1 = pick((D44.agg || {})[key]);
      var same = JSON.stringify(a1) === JSON.stringify(b1);
      if (!same) cmpBad.push({ strategy: key, after: a1, d44: b1 });
      tableE.push({ strategy: key, after: a1, d44: b1, same: same, runs: runsOf(AFTER, key).length });
    }
    var b1CmpKeys = ['visits', 'buys', 'spent', 'potionsBought', 'equipBought', 'soldCount', 'soldGold'];
    var shopBad = [];
    for (var sb = 0; sb < b1CmpKeys.length; sb++) {
      var kk = b1CmpKeys[sb];
      if ((B1.shop || {})[kk] !== (D44.b1 && D44.b1.shop ? D44.b1.shop[kk] : undefined)) {
        shopBad.push({ key: kk, after: (B1.shop || {})[kk], d44: D44.b1 && D44.b1.shop ? D44.b1.shop[kk] : null });
      }
    }
    rec('E_four_strategies_same_seeds', seedOk && cmpBad.length === 0 && shopBad.length === 0 &&
      AFTER.env.maxActions === 2500 && tableE.every(function (x) { return x.runs === 50; }), {
      rule: 'B1/G2/S1/M1 必须同种子 1001–1050、maxActions 2500，且到达/结果/击杀/商店七项与 D-44 完全一致（js/ 未改，应逐项相同）',
      seeds: { n: seeds.length, first: seeds[0], last: seeds[49] },
      maxActions: AFTER.env.maxActions, table: tableE,
      cmpBad: cmpBad, shopBad: shopBad
    });
    rec('E_targets_reported', true, {
      rule: '目标值如实对账（不参与 PASS/FAIL 的硬门槛，只记录差多少）',
      b1Win: { target: 5, actual: (AGG.b1 && AGG.b1.outcomes.win) || 0 },
      dragonKills: { target: 6, actual: B1.dragon ? B1.dragon.kills : 0, attempts: B1.dragon ? B1.dragon.attempts : 0 },
      b1F5: { target: 25, actual: AGG.b1 && AGG.b1.f5 ? AGG.b1.f5.reached : 0 },
      m1F4: { target: 27, actual: AGG.m1 && AGG.m1.floorReach ? AGG.m1.floorReach['4'] : 0 },
      equipBuys25F5: { target: 20, actual: D45.equipBuys }
    });

    /* ── F 组：怪物指纹 / 巨龙三项 / 物品 Σprice/Σsell/FNV / 买价>卖价 / 补给表未变 ── */
    var M = Game.Data.MONSTERS, I = Game.Data.ITEMS;
    var mk = Object.keys(M).sort(), mlines = [];
    for (var mi = 0; mi < mk.length; mi++) {
      var mo = M[mk[mi]];
      mlines.push(mo.id + ':' + mo.hp + ':' + mo.atk + ':' + mo.def);
    }
    var mfnv = fnv1a(mlines.join('\n'));
    var ik = Object.keys(I).sort(), ilines = [], sp = 0, ss = 0, arbBad = [];
    for (var ii = 0; ii < ik.length; ii++) {
      var it2 = I[ik[ii]];
      ilines.push(it2.id + ':' + it2.price + ':' + it2.sell);
      sp += it2.price; ss += it2.sell;
      if (!(it2.price > it2.sell)) arbBad.push(it2.id);
    }
    var ifnv = fnv1a(ilines.join('\n'));
    var dr = M.dragon;
    rec('F_monster_and_dragon_unchanged', mk.length === 18 && mfnv === 'a8f05f90' &&
      dr.hp === 260 && dr.atk === 32 && dr.def === 8 &&
      dr.enrage.hpPct === 0.5 && dr.enrage.atkMul === 1.5 && dr.enrage.defMul === 1.3 &&
      dr.enrage.skill.chance === 0.3 && dr.enrage.skill.dmgMul === 1.4, {
      rule: '怪物指纹（18 只，id:hp:atk:def 排序 FNV-1a）与巨龙三项 + 狂暴参数必须原值',
      monsterCount: mk.length, monsterFnv: mfnv, expectedFnv: 'a8f05f90',

      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };

    NQ.reset();

    }

    var del1 = NQ.deliver(npcC.id);
    states.push(snapState());
    var gold1 = P.gold;
    var del2 = NQ.deliver(npcC.id);
    states.push(snapState());
    var gold2 = P.gold;
    var stateBad = states.some(function (s) { return !s.exactlyOne; });
    var stateSeq = states.map(function (s) { return s.state; }).join('>');

      sequence: stateSeq, states: states, accept: acc, deliver: del1
    });
    rec('C_repeat_deliver_no_extra_gold', del1.ok === true && gold1 - gold0 === 60 && del2.ok === false && gold2 === gold1, {

    var gun0 = P.gold;
    NQ.deliver(npcC.id);

    P.gold += defC.quest.reward.gold;

      guardedDelta: 60, unguardedDelta: gun1 - gun0
    });

    /* ── E 组：隔离（可通行 / 不触发战斗 / 不占怪物格 / 不影响宝箱与奖励点） ── */
    var isoBad = [], rewardBad = [], isoSample = [];
    for (var ei = 0; ei < 10; ei++) {

      var s2 = genFloor1(seedsA[ei], false);

        JSON.stringify(s1.decor) + '#' + JSON.stringify(s1.enemies) + '#' + JSON.stringify(s1.traps));
      var f2 = fnv1a(s2.grid.map(function (r) { return r.join(''); }).join('|') + '#' +
        JSON.stringify(s2.decor) + '#' + JSON.stringify(s2.enemies) + '#' + JSON.stringify(s2.traps));
      var rewardCells = 0, rewardCellsOff = 0;
      for (var ry = 0; ry < s1.decor.length; ry++) {

          if (dc === 'gold_pile' || dc === 'potion_stash') rewardCells++;
          if (s1.npcs[0] && s1.npcs[0].x === rx && s1.npcs[0].y === ry) {
            if (dc) isoBad.push({ seed: s1.seed, on: dc });
          }
          var dco = (s2.decor[ry] || [])[rx];
          if (dco === 'gold_pile' || dco === 'potion_stash') rewardCellsOff++;
        }
      }
      if (f1 !== f2) isoBad.push({ seed: s1.seed, fpOn: f1, fpOff: f2 });
      if (rewardCells !== rewardCellsOff) rewardBad.push({ seed: s1.seed, on: rewardCells, off: rewardCellsOff });
      if (ei < 3) isoSample.push({ seed: s1.seed, npc: s1.npcs[0], fingerprintSame: f1 === f2, rewardCells: rewardCells, rewardCellsOff: rewardCellsOff });
    }
    /* 真实走到 NPC 格：可通行且不进战斗 */
    Map.setFloor(1);
    var npcE = Map.getNpcs()[0];
    var stepFrom = openNeighborOf(npcE);
    if (!stepFrom) throw new Error('E 组前提失败：NPC 没有可站立的邻居');
    putPlayer(stepFrom.x, stepFrom.y);
    var aiTick = Game.Systems.AI.tick;
    Game.Systems.AI.tick = function () { };
    var dxE = npcE.x - P.x, dyE = npcE.y - P.y;
    var codeE = dxE === 1 ? 'ArrowRight' : (dxE === -1 ? 'ArrowLeft' : (dyE === 1 ? 'ArrowDown' : 'ArrowUp'));
    pressExplore(codeE);
    Game.Systems.AI.tick = aiTick;
    var stepped = (P.x === npcE.x && P.y === npcE.y);
    var battle = (M._scene === 'battle');
    var trapAt = Map.getTrap(npcE.x, npcE.y);
    rec('E_isolation', isoBad.length === 0 && rewardBad.length === 0 && stepped && !battle &&
      Map.enemyAt(npcE.x, npcE.y) === null && !trapAt && Map.isWalkable(npcE.x, npcE.y), {
      rule: 'NPC 格可通行（真实按键走上去）、不触发战斗、不占怪物格；NPC 开关不改变地图/宝箱/敌人/陷阱指纹，F1 奖励点数量与关 NPC 时逐格一致',
      fingerprintBad: isoBad.slice(0, 6), rewardBad: rewardBad.slice(0, 6), sample: isoSample,
      stepped: stepped, battle: battle, enemyAt: !!Map.enemyAt(npcE.x, npcE.y), trap: trapAt
    });

    /* ── F 组：旧档兼容（D-46 存档结构：无 npcQuests / 无 map.floors[*].npcs） ── */
    Map.setFloor(1);
    P.hp = 77; P.maxHp = 100; P.gold = 123; P.level = 3; P.exp = 0;
    P.inventory = {}; P.equipment = { weapon: 'knife', armor: null }; P.upg = {}; P.quests = {};
    NQ.reset();
    Game.Systems.Save.save();
    var raw = '';
    try { raw = localStorage.getItem('ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1') || ''; } catch (e) { raw = ''; }
    var oldObj = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    var oldOk = !!oldObj;
    if (oldObj) {
      delete oldObj.player.npcQuests;
      if (oldObj.map && oldObj.map.floors) {
        for (var fk in oldObj.map.floors) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(oldObj.map.floors, fk)) delete oldObj.map.floors[fk].npcs;
      }
      try { localStorage.setItem('ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1', JSON.stringify(oldObj)); } catch (e) { oldOk = false; }
    }
    var loadErr = null, loaded = null;
    try { loaded = Game.Systems.Save.load(); } catch (e) { loadErr = String((e && e.message) || e); }
    var fGold0 = P.gold;
    var fState0 = NQ.state(NQ.defOnFloor(1) ? NQ.defOnFloor(1).id : '');
    var fNpc = Map.getNpcs();

      grid: cloneGrid(Map.getGrid()), spawn: Map.getSpawn(), enemies: Map.getEnemies(),

      traps: [], patrols: []
    }) : ['no-npc'];

    if (fNpc.length === 1) {

      for (var fy = 0; fy < gF.length && !fstair; fy++) for (var fx = 0; fx < gF[0].length; fx++) if (gF[fy][fx] === 2) { fstair = { x: fx, y: fy }; break; }
      var fadj = null;

      }
      if (!fadj) throw new Error('F 组前提失败：读档后第 1 层没有可站立的下行梯相邻格');
      P.x = fadj.x; P.y = fadj.y;
      NQ.checkPosition(fadj.x, fadj.y);
      fDeliver = NQ.deliver(fdef.id);

    rec('F_old_save_compat', oldOk && loadErr === null && loaded !== null && fGold0 === 123 &&
      fState0 === 'unaccepted' && fNpc.length === 1 && fVio.length === 0 &&
      fDeliver.ok === true && P.gold === 183, {
      rule: 'D-46 结构旧档（删掉 player.npcQuests 与 map.floors[*].npcs）读入不抛错、既有字段保留、缺字段补默认；补齐 NPC 后可正常接取/交付（+60）',
      oldSaveBuilt: oldOk, loadErr: loadErr, loadedFloor: loaded ? loaded.floor : null,
      goldPreserved: fGold0, stateAfterLoad: fState0, npcAfterLoad: fNpc, placementViolations: fVio,
      deliver: fDeliver, goldAfterDeliver: P.gold

    var NPCs = Game.Data.NPCS.list || [];
    var rwBad = [], exBad = [];

      acceptedSeeds: (npcAggD.acceptedSeeds || []).slice(0, 60)
    });

    out.ok = Object.keys(out.sub).every(function (k) { return out.sub[k].ok; });
    out.summary = {

      b: { far: farModal, near: nearModal, notice: noticed },
      c: { sequence: stateSeq, delta1: gold1 - gold0, delta2: gold2 - gold1 },

      e: { stepped: stepped, battle: battle, fingerprintBad: isoBad.length },
      f: { loadErr: loadErr, goldAfter: P.gold, deliverOk: fDeliver.ok },

    };

    /* 逐局小表 */
    var rows = (AFTER.runs && AFTER.runs.b1n) || [];
    var h = ['<table><tr><th>seed</th><th class="l">NPC 位置</th><th>距出生点</th><th>接取@动作</th><th>交付@动作</th><th>绕行步</th><th class="l">结局 / 层</th></tr>'];
    for (var rr2 = 0; rr2 < rows.length; rr2++) {

        (n2.pos ? '(' + n2.pos.x + ',' + n2.pos.y + ')' : '-') + '</td><td>' + (n2.distSpawn != null ? n2.distSpawn : '-') +
        '</td><td>' + (n2.acceptedAt != null ? n2.acceptedAt : '-') + '</td><td>' +
        (n2.deliveredAt != null ? n2.deliveredAt : '-') + '</td><td>' + (n2.detourSteps != null ? n2.detourSteps : '-') +
        '</td><td class="l">' + z.outcome + ' / F' + z.floor + '</td></tr>');
    }
    h.push('</table>');
    document.getElementById('detail').innerHTML = h.join('');
  } catch (e) {
    out.err = String((e && e.message) || e) + '\n' + ((e && e.stack) || '');
    out.ok = false;
    document.getElementById('detail').textContent = '';
  }
  out.ms = Date.now() - START;
  document.title = 'D47_DONE ' + (out.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') + ' ms=' + out.ms;
  document.getElementById('result').textContent = (out.ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out);
})();

(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { ok: false, sub: {} };
  var START = Date.now();
  function rec(name, ok, d) { out.sub[name] = { ok: !!ok, d: d }; }
  function readText(rel) {
    try {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('GET', rel, false);
      x.send(null);
      return x.responseText || '';
    } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }
  function readJson(rel) {
    try { return JSON.parse(readText(rel)); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  var M = Game.Core.Main, R = Game.Core.Render, S = Game.Systems.Save, P = Game.Data.Player;
  var KEY = 'ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1', SET_KEY = 'aiDungeon_settings_v1';

  function kd(code) {
    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: code, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
  }
  function ku(code) {
    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: code, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
  }
  /* 一次按键 = keydown → 手动驱动一帧菜单逻辑 → keyup（不依赖 rAF，确定性强） */
  function press(code) {
    kd(code);
    try { M._updateMenu(1e9); } catch (e) { window.__D48ERR.push('press ' + code + ': ' + ((e && e.message) || e)); }
    ku(code);
  }
  function setSel(n) {
    var st = M.getMenuState();
    var guard = 0;
    while (st.sel < n && guard++ < 10) { press('ArrowDown'); st = M.getMenuState(); }
    while (st.sel > n && guard++ < 10) { press('ArrowUp'); st = M.getMenuState(); }
    return st.sel;
  }
  function stored() {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SET_KEY) || 'null'); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  try {
    /* 干净起点：无存档、无设置、跳过首次引导；然后按 index.html 的冷启动路径 init({menu:true}) */
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
      localStorage.removeItem(SET_KEY);
      localStorage.setItem('aiDungeon_guided', '1');
    } catch (e) { /* 存储禁用时后续断言会如实失败 */ }

    M.init({ menu: true });
    var drawErr = null;
    try { M.loop(performance.now()); } catch (e) { drawErr = String((e && e.message) || e); }

    /* ── A：冷启动首屏 = 主菜单；skip 可直进场景；去掉 skip 必须回菜单 ── */
    var idxTxt = readText('../index.html');
    var itemsA = M._menuSpec().items;
    var menuOk = M._scene === 'menu' && M.getMenuState().page === 'root' && itemsA.length === 5 &&
      itemsA[0].label === '开始新游戏' && itemsA[1].label === '继续游戏' &&
      itemsA[2].label === '玩法说明' && itemsA[3].label === '设置' && itemsA[4].label === '关于' && drawErr === null;
    var skipPure = M.shouldShowMenu({ menu: true, skipMenu: true }) === false &&
      M.shouldShowMenu({ menu: true }) === true &&
      M.shouldShowMenu({}) === false;
    /* 负例：去掉 skipMenu 后仍返回"不显示菜单"，说明菜单可以被无条件绕过 → FAIL */
    var negBypass = M.shouldShowMenu({ menu: true, skipMenu: false }) === true;
    rec('A_cold_start_menu', menuOk && idxTxt.indexOf('__AI_DUNGEON_MENU__') >= 0 && skipPure && negBypass, {
      rule: 'index.html 显式声明首屏；冷启动 init({menu:true}) 落在 menu 场景；skipMenu 参数可跳过；去掉 skip 必须回到菜单',
      scene: M._scene, page: M.getMenuState().page, items: itemsA,
      indexDeclaresMenu: idxTxt.indexOf('__AI_DUNGEON_MENU__') >= 0, skipPure: skipPure, negBypass: negBypass, drawErr: drawErr
    });

    /* ── B：继续游戏——无档置灰 + 一行说明；有档进场景；不抛错 ── */
    var noSave = S.has() === false;
    var contA = M._menuSpec().items[1];
    var r1 = M.enterGame('continue');
    var bNo = noSave && contA.enabled === false && contA.note === '暂无存档' &&
      r1 === false && M._scene === 'menu';
    /* 旧档形状（无 saveVersion / 无 map / 无 upg / 无 npcQuests） */
    var legacy = {
      floor: 1,
      player: {
        hp: 55, maxHp: 100, atk: 13, def: 5, gold: 123, exp: 0, level: 1,
        inventory: { potion_small: 2 }, equipment: { weapon: 'knife', armor: null }, quests: {}
      }
    };
    try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(legacy)); } catch (e) { }
    var hasNow = S.has() === true;
    var contB = M._menuSpec().items[1];
    var r2 = M.enterGame('continue');
    var bYes = hasNow && contB.enabled === true && contB.note === '' &&
      r2 === true && M._scene === 'explore' && P.gold === 123 && P.hp === 55 &&
      P.inventory.potion_small === 2;
    rec('B_continue', bNo && bYes && window.__D48ERR.length === 0, {
      rule: '无档：置灰 + note「暂无存档」+ enterGame 返回 false 且留在菜单；有档：进入 explore 并恢复金币/血量/背包',
      noSave: { noSave: noSave, r1: r1, enabled: contA.enabled, note: contA.note, scene: 'menu' },
      withSave: { hasNow: hasNow, r2: r2, scene: M._scene, gold: P.gold, hp: P.hp, potions: P.inventory.potion_small }
    });

    /* ── C：键盘全导航（↑↓ 选中 / Enter 执行 / Esc 从子页返回） ── */
    M.switchScene('menu');
    setSel(0);
    press('ArrowDown');
    var c1 = M.getMenuState().sel;
    press('ArrowDown');
    var c2 = M.getMenuState().sel;
    press('ArrowUp');
    var c3 = M.getMenuState().sel;
    var cUpDown = (c1 === 1 && c2 === 2 && c3 === 1);
    /* Enter 执行：继续游戏（此时有档）→ 进场景 */
    press('Enter');
    var cEnter = (M._scene === 'explore');
    /* Esc 从子页返回：说明 / 设置 / 关于 */
    M.switchScene('menu'); setSel(2); press('Enter');
    var cHelpOpen = M.getMenuState().page === 'help';
    press('Escape');
    var cHelpBack = M.getMenuState().page === 'root';
    setSel(3); press('Enter');
    var cSetOpen = M.getMenuState().page === 'settings';
    press('ArrowDown');
    var cSetMove = M.getMenuState().settingsSel === 1;
    press('Escape');
    var cSetBack = M.getMenuState().page === 'root';
    setSel(4); press('Enter');
    var cAboutOpen = M.getMenuState().page === 'about';
    press('Escape');
    var cAboutBack = M.getMenuState().page === 'root';
    rec('C_keyboard_nav', cUpDown && cEnter && cHelpOpen && cHelpBack && cSetOpen && cSetMove && cSetBack && cAboutOpen && cAboutBack, {
      rule: '↑↓ 移动选中项；Enter 执行；Esc 从说明/设置/关于返回主菜单',
      upDown: { afterDown1: c1, afterDown2: c2, afterUp: c3, ok: cUpDown },
      enterExec: cEnter, help: [cHelpOpen, cHelpBack], settings: [cSetOpen, cSetMove, cSetBack], about: [cAboutOpen, cAboutBack]
    });

    /* ── D：说明页与源码一致（8 条逐条对照；负例：未实现功能必须被拒） ── */
    var HELP = M.HELP || [];
    var files = {};
    for (var hi = 0; hi < HELP.length; hi++) {
      for (var si = 0; si < HELP[hi].src.length; si++) {
        var f = HELP[hi].src[si];
        if (!files[f]) files[f] = readText('../' + f);
      }
    }
    function entryMissing(e) {
      var txt = '';
      for (var i = 0; i < (e.src || []).length; i++) txt += (files[e.src[i]] || '') + '\n';
      var miss = [];
      for (var j = 0; j < (e.need || []).length; j++) {
        if (txt.indexOf(e.need[j]) < 0) miss.push(e.need[j]);
      }
      return miss;
    }
    var dBad = [];
    for (var di = 0; di < HELP.length; di++) {
      var missD = entryMissing(HELP[di]);
      if (missD.length) dBad.push({ id: HELP[di].id, missing: missD });
    }
    var expectIds = 'move,fireball,flee,potion,equip,bag,shop,save';
    var idsNow = HELP.map(function (e) { return e.id; }).join(',');
    /* 负例：把一条改成未实现的功能（按 8 键治疗），同一判据必须拒绝 */
    var fake = { id: 'fake', src: HELP[0].src.slice(), need: ['Digit8', '治疗术'] };
    var fakeRejected = entryMissing(fake).length > 0;
    rec('D_help_matches_code', HELP.length === 8 && idsNow === expectIds && dBad.length === 0 && fakeRejected &&
      M._menuSpec().help.length === 8, {
      rule: '玩法说明 8 条全部只写已实现机制：每条 need 片段必须在 src 源码中字面存在；未实现功能（负例）必须对不上',
      ids: idsNow, bad: dBad, fakeMissing: entryMissing(fake), fakeRejected: fakeRejected
    });

    /* ── E：设置只含既有三项，改动即时生效并可持久化 ── */
    var spec = M._settingsSpec();
    var specIds = spec.map(function (s) { return s.id; }).join(',');
    var fxBad = M.setSetting('fx', 'ultra') === false && M.getSettings().fx === 'low';
    var fxOk = M.setSetting('fx', 'high') === true && Game.Fx.getLevel() === 'high' && stored().fx === 'high';
    var mutOk = M.setSetting('muted', true) === true && Game.Systems.Audio.isMuted() === true && stored().muted === true;
    var zoomOk = M.setSetting('zoom', '1.5') === true && R.scale === 1.5 && stored().zoom === '1.5';
    var zoomBack = M.setSetting('zoom', 'auto') === true && R.getScaleMode() === 'auto' && stored().zoom === 'auto';
    /* 留一组非默认值给"重载后仍生效"用 */
    M.setSetting('zoom', '1.25');
    rec('E_settings', spec.length === 3 && specIds === 'fx,muted,zoom' && fxBad && fxOk && mutOk && zoomOk && zoomBack, {
      rule: '设置页仅打击感 / 音效 / 画面缩放三项；非法值拒绝；三项均即时生效且写入 localStorage',
      items: spec, fxBad: fxBad, fxOk: fxOk, mutedOk: mutOk, zoomOk: zoomOk, zoomBack: zoomBack, stored: stored()
    });

    /* ── 持久化 + skip 真正落点：重载 init（菜单开启 + skip） ── */
    M.setSetting('fx', 'high'); M.setSetting('muted', true); M.setSetting('zoom', '1.25');
    M.init({ menu: true, skipMenu: true });
    var reloaded = M.getSettings();
    var skipBootOk = M._scene === 'explore' && reloaded.fx === 'high' && reloaded.muted === true && reloaded.zoom === '1.25';
    rec('E2_reload_and_skip', skipBootOk, {
      rule: '带 skipMenu 启动直接进入 explore；上一轮设置（high / 静音 / 125%）在 init 时被读回',
      scene: M._scene, settings: reloaded
    });
    /* 恢复默认，避免影响后续断言 */
    M.setSetting('fx', 'low'); M.setSetting('muted', false); M.setSetting('zoom', 'auto');

    /* ── G：旧档读入正常、存档键未变（v1 形状：无 saveVersion / map / upg / npcQuests） ── */
    try { localStorage.removeItem(KEY); } catch (e) { }
    var legacy2 = {
      floor: 1,
      player: {
        hp: 61, maxHp: 100, atk: 11, def: 5, gold: 77, exp: 0, level: 1,
        inventory: { potion_small: 1 }, equipment: { weapon: 'knife', armor: null }, quests: {}
      }
    };
    var gErr = null, gLoaded = null;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(legacy2));
      gLoaded = S.load();
    } catch (e) { gErr = String((e && e.message) || e); }
    var gOk = S.KEY === 'ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1' && gErr === null && !!gLoaded &&
      P.mp === 50 && P.gold === 77 && typeof P.upg === 'object' && typeof P.npcQuests === 'object' &&
      localStorage.getItem('ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1') !== null;
    rec('G_old_save', gOk, {
      rule: '存档键仍为 ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1；D-46 及之前的 v1 档（缺 mp/upg/npcQuests/map）读入不抛错并补默认',
      key: S.KEY, err: gErr, loaded: !!gLoaded, mp: P.mp, gold: P.gold, upg: P.upg, npcQuests: P.npcQuests
    });

    /* ── H：同种子 1001–1050、maxActions 2500 四策略不退化（对照 D-47） ── */
    var AFTER = readJson('selfcheck/d48-after.json');
    var PRE = readJson('selfcheck/d47-after.json');
    if (!AFTER || !PRE) throw new Error('缺少跑局产物: ' + JSON.stringify({ after: !!AFTER, pre: !!PRE }));
    var seeds = (AFTER.env && AFTER.env.seeds) || [];
    var seedOk = seeds.length === 50 && seeds[0] === 1001 && seeds[49] === 1050 &&
      (AFTER.env && AFTER.env.maxActions) === 2500 && AFTER.env.bootScene === 'explore';
    var b1Now = AFTER.agg.b1.outcomes.win, b1Pre = PRE.agg.b1.outcomes.win;
    var f5Now = AFTER.agg.b1.f5.reached, f5Pre = PRE.agg.b1.f5.reached;
    var preBy = {};
    ((PRE.runs && PRE.runs.b1) || []).forEach(function (r) { preBy[r.seed] = r.outcome; });
    var mismatch = [];
    ((AFTER.runs && AFTER.runs.b1) || []).forEach(function (r) {
      if (preBy[r.seed] !== undefined && preBy[r.seed] !== r.outcome) mismatch.push({ seed: r.seed, pre: preBy[r.seed], now: r.outcome });
    });
    var g2Now = AFTER.agg.g2.f5.reached, g2Pre = PRE.agg.g2.f5.reached;
    var s1Now = AFTER.agg.s1.f5.reached, s1Pre = PRE.agg.s1.f5.reached;
    var m1Now = AFTER.agg.m1.floorReach['4'], m1Pre = PRE.agg.m1.floorReach['4'];
    rec('H_no_regression', seedOk && b1Now >= 7 && b1Now >= b1Pre && f5Now >= f5Pre &&
      mismatch.length === 0 && g2Now >= g2Pre && s1Now >= s1Pre && m1Now >= m1Pre, {
      rule: 'B1 / G2 / S1 / M1 同种子 1001–1050、maxActions 2500；B1 ≥7/50 且逐局结果与 D-47 完全一致；G2/S1/M1 不退化',
      seeds: { n: seeds.length, first: seeds[0], last: seeds[49] }, bootScene: AFTER.env.bootScene,
      b1: { now: b1Now, pre: b1Pre, f5Now: f5Now, f5Pre: f5Pre, mismatch: mismatch.slice(0, 6) },
      g2: { now: g2Now, pre: g2Pre }, s1: { now: s1Now, pre: s1Pre }, m1: { now: m1Now, pre: m1Pre }
    });

    /* ── F：进入/退出菜单后只有一条 rAF 链；无 JS 错误 ── */
    var s1 = M.start();
    var chains1 = M._rafChains;
    var s2 = M.start();
    var chains2 = M._rafChains;
    M.switchScene('menu');
    M.enterGame('new');
    M.switchScene('menu');
    M.enterGame('continue');
    M.switchScene('menu');
    var chains3 = M._rafChains;
    var frameErr = null;
    try { M.loop(performance.now()); } catch (e) { frameErr = String((e && e.message) || e); }
    rec('F_single_raf', s1 === true && s2 === false && chains1 === 1 && chains2 === 1 && chains3 === 1 &&
      frameErr === null && M._scene === 'menu' && window.__D48ERR.length === 0, {
      rule: 'start() 只允许一条 rAF 链；重复调用被忽略；菜单↔场景多次往返后计数仍为 1；整帧执行无异常、无页面级 JS 错误',
      start: [s1, s2], chains: [chains1, chains2, chains3], frameErr: frameErr, scene: M._scene,
      errors: window.__D48ERR.slice(0, 6)
    });

    out.ok = Object.keys(out.sub).every(function (k) { return out.sub[k].ok; });

    /* 逐条对照小表 */
    var h = ['<table><tr><th>#</th><th>id</th><th>说明</th><th>源码</th><th>结果</th></tr>'];
    for (var ri = 0; ri < HELP.length; ri++) {
      var e = HELP[ri], miss2 = entryMissing(e);
      h.push('<tr><td>' + (ri + 1) + '</td><td>' + e.id + '</td><td>' + e.title + '<br>' +
        e.lines.join('<br>') + '</td><td>' + e.src.join('<br>') + '<br>' +
        (e.need || []).join(' · ') + '</td><td>' + (miss2.length ? '✗ ' + miss2.join(',') : '✓') + '</td></tr>');
    }
    h.push('</table>');
    document.getElementById('detail').innerHTML = h.join('');
  } catch (e) {
    out.err = String((e && e.message) || e) + '\n' + ((e && e.stack) || '');
    out.ok = false;
    document.getElementById('detail').textContent = '';
  }
  out.ms = Date.now() - START;
  document.title = 'D48_DONE ' + (out.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') + ' ms=' + out.ms;
  document.getElementById('result').textContent = (out.ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out);
})();
</script>

(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { ok: false, sub: {} };
  var START = Date.now();
  function rec(n, ok, d) { out.sub[n] = { ok: !!ok, d: d }; }
  function readText(rel) {
    try { var x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', rel, false); x.send(null); return x.responseText || ''; }
    catch (e) { return ''; }
  }
  function readJson(rel) { try { return JSON.parse(readText(rel).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')); } catch (e) { return null; } }
  function fnv1a(s) {
    var h = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h ^= s.charCodeAt(i); h = (h * 0x01000193) >>> 0; }
    return ('00000000' + h.toString(16)).slice(-8);
  }
  var AD = Game.Systems.Adaptive;
  var ITEMS = Game.Data.ITEMS;

  /* ── A：F5 触发逐局拆解（回合 / 药 / 输出），全部从逐回合实测日志复算 ── */
  var AFTER = readJson('selfcheck/d50-after.json');
  var LEG = readJson('selfcheck/d50-legacy.json');
  var OFF = readJson('selfcheck/d50-off.json');
  var D48 = readJson('selfcheck/d48-after.json');
  var D49 = readJson('selfcheck/d49-after.json');

  try {
    if (!AFTER || !LEG || !OFF || !D48) {
      throw new Error('缺少跑局产物: ' + JSON.stringify({
        after: !!AFTER, legacy: !!LEG, off: !!OFF, d48: !!D48
      }));
    }
    var runs = AFTER.runs.b1 || [];
    var rows = [], bad = [];
    for (var r = 0; r < runs.length; r++) {
      var run = runs[r];
      if (!run.f5fights || run.outcome === 'win') continue;
      var losses = run.f5fights.filter(function (b) { return b.result !== 'win'; });
      if (!losses.length) continue;
      var b = losses[losses.length - 1];
      var R = b.rounds || [];
      if (!R.length) continue;
      var dealt = 0, taken = 0, potHeal = 0, gain = 0, revive = 0, lastMhp = 0, lastHp = 0, prevHp = b.start.hp;
      for (var i = 0; i < R.length; i++) {
        dealt += R[i][2]; taken += R[i][3];
        var itemHeal = (R[i][4] === 'potion_large') ? 80 : ((R[i][4] === 'potion_small') ? 30 : 0);
        potHeal += itemHeal;
        /* 本回合实际回血 = 回合末 HP − (回合初 HP − 本回合承伤)；多出名义药量的部分只可能来自原地复活 */
        var g = R[i][5] - prevHp + R[i][3];
        if (g > 0) { gain += g; if (g - itemHeal > 0) revive += g - itemHeal; }
        prevHp = R[i][5];
        lastMhp = R[i][6];
        lastHp = R[i][5];
      }
      var bossLeft = Math.max(0, lastMhp);
      var avgD = dealt / R.length, avgT = taken / R.length;
      var tNeed = avgD > 0 ? Math.ceil(bossLeft / avgD) : -1;
      var addTaken = tNeed > 0 ? Math.round(tNeed * avgT) : 0;
      var potions = Math.ceil(addTaken / 80);
      var hpPool = b.start.hp + gain;
      var rep = run.f5split || {};
      var ok = b.maxHp - dealt === bossLeft && dealt === b.dealt && taken === b.taken &&
        R.length === b.nRounds && tNeed === rep.tNeed && addTaken === rep.addTaken &&
        hpPool - taken === lastHp && lastHp < 2 * Math.max(1, avgT);
      rows.push({ seed: run.seed, name: b.name, bossLeft: bossLeft, dealt: dealt, n: R.length,
        taken: taken, potHeal: potHeal, revive: revive, hpPool: hpPool, tNeed: tNeed,
        addTaken: addTaken, potions: potions });
      if (!ok) bad.push(rows[rows.length - 1]);
    }
    rec('A_f5_split_recomputable', rows.length >= 10 && bad.length === 0, {
      rule: '每局最后一战：bossMax−Σdealt=剩余血量；Σtaken=实测承伤；起点HP+实际回血−Σtaken=回合末HP(0)；' +
        'tNeed=ceil(剩余/每回合输出)；addTaken=tNeed×每回合承伤；三项分量与 f5split 上报值逐项相等',
      rows: rows.length, mismatches: bad,
      sample: rows.slice(0, 6)
    });

    /* ── B：150 金币等价上限（含超限负例） ── */
    function capCheck(ad) {
      if (!ad) return { ok: false, why: 'no-adaptive' };
      var sum = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < (ad.log || []).length; i++) sum += (ad.log[i].value || 0);
      return {
        ok: (ad.triggers || 0) <= 2 && (ad.spent || 0) <= 150 && sum === (ad.spent || 0) &&
          (ad.log || []).length === (ad.triggers || 0),
        triggers: ad.triggers, spent: ad.spent, sum: sum
      };
    }
    var viol = [], maxT = 0, maxS = 0;
    for (var q = 0; q < runs.length; q++) {
      var ad = runs[q].adaptive || {};
      if (!capCheck(ad).ok) viol.push({ seed: runs[q].seed, ad: ad });
      if ((ad.triggers || 0) > maxT) maxT = ad.triggers || 0;
      if ((ad.spent || 0) > maxS) maxS = ad.spent || 0;
    }
    var f3 = capCheck({ triggers: 3, spent: 120, log: [{ value: 40 }, { value: 40 }, { value: 40 }] });
    var f200 = capCheck({ triggers: 2, spent: 200, log: [{ value: 100 }, { value: 100 }] });
    var fsum = capCheck({ triggers: 1, spent: 40, log: [{ value: 60 }] });
    rec('B_cap_150', viol.length === 0 && maxT <= 2 && maxS <= 150 &&
      AD.MAX_VALUE === 150 && AD.MAX_TRIGGERS === 2 &&
      f3.ok === false && f200.ok === false && fsum.ok === false, {
      rule: '单局触发 ≤2、发放物金币等价 ≤150、Σlog=spent；三例负例（3 次 / 200 金 / 账实不符）必须 FAIL',
      maxTriggers: maxT, maxSpent: maxS, violators: viol.length,
      negative: { threeTriggers: f3.ok, over150: f200.ok, sumMismatch: fsum.ok },
      consts: { MAX_TRIGGERS: AD.MAX_TRIGGERS, MAX_VALUE: AD.MAX_VALUE }
    });

    /* ── C：负例·还原 D-49 的 F5 形态 → 必须复现 10/50 ── */
    var lruns = LEG.runs.b1 || [];

    var lF5L1 = 0, lF5L3 = 0, lMulti = [];

        if (lg[lj].level === 1) lF5L1++;
        if (lg[lj].level === 3) lF5L3++;
      }
      var firstAt5 = lg.length > 0 && lg[0].floor === 5;
      if (firstAt5 && lg[0].at !== 'death') lMulti.push(lruns[li].seed);
    }

    ((D49 && D49.runs && D49.runs.b1) || []).forEach(function (x) { d49By[x.seed] = x.outcome; });

      var s0 = lruns[lk].seed;
      if (d49By[s0] && d49By[s0] !== lruns[lk].outcome) perSeedSame = false;
    }
    rec('C_legacy_reproduces_d49', LEG.env.form === 'd49' && lw === 10 &&
      lF5L1 === 18 && lF5L3 === 20 && lMulti.length === 0 && perSeedSame, {
      rule: '把 F5 救助形态还原成 D-49（form=d49）：B1 必须回到 10/50，逐局 outcome 与 d49-after 一致，' +

      wins: lw, f5Level1: lF5L1, f5Level3: lF5L3, nonRespawnAt5: lMulti, perSeedSame: perSeedSame
    });

    var seeds = (AFTER.env && AFTER.env.seeds) || [];

      if ((runs[z].adaptive && runs[z].adaptive.triggers) || 0) continue;

      if (runs[z].outcome === 'win') zw++;
      if (d48By[runs[z].seed] === 'win') zb++;
      if (d48By[runs[z].seed] !== runs[z].outcome) zMis.push({ seed: runs[z].seed, d48: d48By[runs[z].seed], on: runs[z].outcome });

      off: { wins: OFF.agg.b1.outcomes.win }

(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { ok: false, sub: {} };
  var START = Date.now();
  function rec(n, ok, d) { out.sub[n] = { ok: !!ok, d: d }; }
  function readText(rel) {
    try { var x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', rel, false); x.send(null); return x.responseText || ''; }
    catch (e) { return ''; }
  }
  function readJson(rel) { try { return JSON.parse(readText(rel).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')); } catch (e) { return null; } }
  var M = Game.Core.Main, S = Game.Systems.Save, P = Game.Data.Player;
  var MAP = Game.Systems.Map, B = Game.Systems.Battle;
  var KEY = 'ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1', SET_KEY = 'aiDungeon_settings_v1';
  var T = 10000;
  function frame(ms) { T += (ms || 16.7); try { M.loop(T); } catch (e) { window.__D53ERR.push('frame: ' + e.message); } }
  function clearAll() {
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(KEY); localStorage.removeItem(SET_KEY);
      localStorage.setItem('aiDungeon_guided', '1');
    } catch (e) { }
  }
  function spawn() { return MAP.getSpawn(); }
  function invJson() { try { return JSON.stringify(P.inventory || {}); } catch (e) { return '{}'; } }
  function chestCount() {
    var g = MAP.getGrid(), n = 0;
    for (var y = 0; y < g.length; y++) {
      for (var x = 0; x < g[0].length; x++) {
        var d = MAP.getDecor(x, y);
        if (d === 'chest' || d === 'room_chest' || d === 'gold_pile' || d === 'potion_stash') n++;
      }
    }
    return n;
  }
  function snapshot() {
    return {
      gold: P.gold, exp: P.exp, inv: invJson(),
      enemies: MAP.getEnemies().length, chests: chestCount()
    };
  }
  function sameSnap(a, b) {
    return a.gold === b.gold && a.exp === b.exp && a.inv === b.inv &&
      a.enemies === b.enemies && a.chests === b.chests;
  }

  /* 与 map.js 同一条规则的独立 BFS（验证页自己实现，避免"用被测代码证明被测代码"） */
  var DIRS = [[0, -1], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [1, 0]];
  function inG(x, y) {
    var g = MAP.getGrid();
    return !!(g && y >= 0 && x >= 0 && y < g.length && x < g[0].length);
  }
  function landable(x, y) {
    if (!inG(x, y) || !MAP.isWalkable(x, y)) return false;
    var t = MAP.tileAt(x, y);
    if (t === 2 || t === 3) return false;
    var es = MAP.getEnemies(), ns = MAP.getNpcs(), i;
    for (i = 0; i < es.length; i++) if (es[i] && es[i].x === x && es[i].y === y) return false;
    for (i = 0; i < ns.length; i++) if (ns[i] && ns[i].x === x && ns[i].y === y) return false;
    if (MAP.getDecor(x, y)) return false;
    if (MAP.getTrap(x, y)) return false;
    return true;
  }
  function expectedLanding(sx, sy) {
    if (!inG(sx, sy)) return null;
    var seen = {}, q = [], qi = 0, i;
    function push(x, y, d) {
      if (!inG(x, y) || !MAP.isWalkable(x, y)) return;
      var k = x + ',' + y;
      if (seen[k]) return;
      seen[k] = 1; q.push({ x: x, y: y, d: d });
    }
    if (MAP.isWalkable(sx, sy)) push(sx, sy, 0);
    else {
      var seed = null;
      for (i = 0; i < DIRS.length; i++) {
        var nx = sx + DIRS[i][0], ny = sy + DIRS[i][1];
        if (inG(nx, ny) && MAP.isWalkable(nx, ny)) { seed = { x: nx, y: ny }; break; }
      }
      if (!seed) return null;
      push(seed.x, seed.y, 1);
    }
    while (qi < q.length) {
      var c = q[qi++];
      if (landable(c.x, c.y)) return { x: c.x, y: c.y, d: c.d };
      for (i = 0; i < DIRS.length; i++) push(c.x + DIRS[i][0], c.y + DIRS[i][1], c.d + 1);
    }
    return null;
  }

  try {
    clearAll();
    M.init({ menu: true, skipMenu: true });
    M.closeGuide();
    frame();

    /* ---------- A：坐标往返一致（20 组） ---------- */
    var tiles = [], g0 = MAP.getGrid();
    for (var ay = 0; ay < g0.length; ay++) {
      for (var ax = 0; ax < g0[0].length; ax++) {
        if (MAP.canLand(ax, ay)) tiles.push({ x: ax, y: ay });
      }
    }
    var sp0 = spawn();
    tiles = tiles.filter(function (t) { return !(t.x === sp0.x && t.y === sp0.y); });
    var aBad = [], aOk = 0, aSamples = [];
    for (var ai = 0; ai < 20; ai++) {
      var t = tiles[(ai * 37 + 11) % tiles.length];
      P.x = t.x; P.y = t.y; P.floor = MAP.getFloor();
      S.save();
      P.x = sp0.x; P.y = sp0.y;
      var al = S.load();
      var good = !!al && P.x === t.x && P.y === t.y && P.floor === MAP.getFloor() &&
        S.lastLanding && S.lastLanding.reason === 'saved';
      if (good) aOk++; else aBad.push({ want: t, got: { x: P.x, y: P.y }, landing: S.lastLanding });
      if (ai < 4) aSamples.push({ want: t, got: { x: P.x, y: P.y }, landing: S.lastLanding });
    }
    rec('A_coord_roundtrip', aOk === 20 && aBad.length === 0 && tiles.length > 0, {
      rule: '存 → 读 20 次，玩家 x/y/层逐项等于存档时坐标；落点 reason=saved',
      landableTiles: tiles.length, passed: aOk, failures: aBad.slice(0, 5), samples: aSamples
    });

    /* ---------- B：非法落点回退到同连通块最近可通行格（负例：出生点/不可通行必须 FAIL） ---------- */
    var es = MAP.getEnemies();
    var enemyTile = null, i, sg = spawn();
    for (i = 0; i < es.length; i++) {
      if (es[i] && MAP.isWalkable(es[i].x, es[i].y) &&
          Math.abs(es[i].x - sg.x) + Math.abs(es[i].y - sg.y) > 3) { enemyTile = es[i]; break; }
    }
    var tempEnemy = null;
    if (!enemyTile) {
      for (i = 0; i < tiles.length; i++) {
        if (Math.abs(tiles[i].x - sg.x) + Math.abs(tiles[i].y - sg.y) > 6) {
          tempEnemy = { x: tiles[i].x, y: tiles[i].y, monsterId: 'slime' };
          es.push(tempEnemy); enemyTile = tempEnemy; break;
        }
      }
    }
    var bOcc = null, bOccExp = null, bOccOk = false;
    if (enemyTile) {
      bOccExp = expectedLanding(enemyTile.x, enemyTile.y);
      bOcc = MAP.resolveLanding(enemyTile.x, enemyTile.y);
      bOccOk = !!bOccExp && !!bOcc && bOcc.reason === 'bfs' &&
        bOcc.x === bOccExp.x && bOcc.y === bOccExp.y && landable(bOcc.x, bOcc.y);
    }
    if (tempEnemy) {
      var ei = es.indexOf(tempEnemy);
      if (ei >= 0) es.splice(ei, 1);
    }
    /* 墙格：找一个远离出生点的墙，期望按同一条"上/左/下/右首个可走邻格"规则 */
    var wall = null, wallExp = null, wallHit = null, wallOk = false;
    for (var wy = 1; wy < g0.length - 1 && !wall; wy++) {
      for (var wx = 1; wx < g0[0].length - 1; wx++) {
        if (g0[wy][wx] !== 0) continue;
        if (Math.abs(wx - sg.x) + Math.abs(wy - sg.y) < 6) continue;
        var hasN = false;
        for (i = 0; i < DIRS.length; i++) {
          if (inG(wx + DIRS[i][0], wy + DIRS[i][1]) && MAP.isWalkable(wx + DIRS[i][0], wy + DIRS[i][1])) { hasN = true; break; }
        }
        if (!hasN) continue;
        wall = { x: wx, y: wy }; break;
      }
    }
    if (wall) {
      wallExp = expectedLanding(wall.x, wall.y);
      wallHit = MAP.resolveLanding(wall.x, wall.y);
      wallOk = !!wallExp && !!wallHit && wallHit.reason === 'bfs' &&
        wallHit.x === wallExp.x && wallHit.y === wallExp.y && landable(wallHit.x, wallHit.y);
    }
    var negSpawn = !!bOcc && bOcc.x === sg.x && bOcc.y === sg.y;
    var negBlocked = !!bOcc && !MAP.canLand(bOcc.x, bOcc.y);
    rec('B_illegal_landing_bfs', bOccOk && wallOk && !negSpawn && !negBlocked, {
      rule: '被怪物占用的地板 / 墙格 → 同连通块 BFS 最近可站立格；BFS 由验证页独立实现并逐格比对；' +
        '负例：回退到出生点或不可通行格必须 FAIL',
      occupiedTile: enemyTile, occupiedExpected: bOccExp, occupiedHit: bOcc, occupiedOk: bOccOk,
      wall: wall, wallExpected: wallExp, wallHit: wallHit, wallOk: wallOk,
      negative: { fellBackToSpawn: negSpawn, fellBackToBlocked: negBlocked }

    S.save();
    var rawC = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY));
    delete rawC.pos;
    rawC.player.gold = 777;
    rawC.player.inventory = { potion_small: 3, potion_mp: 1 };
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(rawC));
    var cLoad = null, cErr = null;
    try { cLoad = S.load(); } catch (e) { cErr = String(e && e.message); }
    var spC = spawn();
    var cOk = !!cLoad && !cErr && P.x === spC.x && P.y === spC.y &&
      P.gold === 777 && P.inventory.potion_small === 3 && P.inventory.potion_mp === 1 &&
      S.lastLanding && S.lastLanding.reason === 'spawn';
    rec('C_old_save_without_pos', cOk, {
      rule: '旧档删除 pos 后读档：不抛错，落点回出生点；金币 / 背包原样恢复',
      spawn: spC, got: { x: P.x, y: P.y }, landing: S.lastLanding,
      gold: P.gold, inventory: P.inventory, error: cErr
    });

    /* ---------- D：反复存读档 20 次，资源与实体计数全部不变 ---------- */
    M.restart();
    P.gold = 55; P.exp = 12; P.inventory = { potion_small: 2 };
    S.save(); S.load();
    var dBefore = snapshot(), dBad = [];
    for (var di = 0; di < 20; di++) {
      S.save();
      S.load();
      var nowS = snapshot();
      if (!sameSnap(dBefore, nowS)) dBad.push({ cycle: di, before: dBefore, after: nowS });
    }
    var dAfter = snapshot();
    rec('D_no_resource_farming', dBad.length === 0 && sameSnap(dBefore, dAfter), {
      rule: '连续 20 次「存档→读档」：金币 / 经验 / 背包 / 怪物数 / 宝箱与奖励点数全部不变',
      before: dBefore, after: dAfter, violations: dBad.slice(0, 3)
    });

    /* ---------- F：存档键与设置键未变；D-52 ending 字段仍可读 ---------- */
    var fKey = S.KEY === KEY;
    try { localStorage.setItem(SET_KEY, '{"fx":"low"}'); } catch (e) { }
    M._restoreEnding({
      cleared: true, win: true, score: 2000, grade: 'A',
      stats: { floorReached: 5, kills: 9, maxLevel: 7, turns: 40, potions: 2, rescues: 0, elapsedMs: 1000 }
    });
    S.save();
    var fRaw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY));
    var fEndingSaved = !!(fRaw.ending && fRaw.ending.cleared === true && fRaw.ending.grade === 'A');
    S.load();
    var fEndingLoaded = !!(M.getEnding() && M.getEnding().cleared === true && M.getEnding().stats.kills === 9);
    var fSetKey = localStorage.getItem(SET_KEY) !== null;
    rec('F_keys_and_d52_ending', fKey && fEndingSaved && fEndingLoaded && fSetKey, {
      rule: '存档键仍是 ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1，设置键仍是 aiDungeon_settings_v1；D-52 的 ending 字段可写可读',
      saveKey: S.KEY, settingsKeyPresent: fSetKey,
      endingSaved: fRaw.ending, endingLoaded: M.getEnding()
    });

    /* ---------- G：战斗内存档 / 读档的行为（≥2 种情形） ---------- */
    /* 情形 1：战斗中 暂停→返回主菜单 不写档（字节级不变），继续游戏回到最近的非战斗存档 */
    M.restart();
    P.x = spawn().x; P.y = spawn().y;
    S.save();
    var gRawBefore = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
    var mid = Object.keys(Game.Data.MONSTERS)[0] || 'slime';
    B.start(mid);
    M.switchScene('battle');
    var gPause = M.openPause(T);
    M._pauseReturnToMenu();
    var gRawAfter = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
    var g1SameBytes = gRawBefore === gRawAfter;
    var g1Menu = M._scene === 'menu';
    var g1NoBattle = !B.isActive();

    var g1 = g1SameBytes && g1Menu && g1NoBattle && g1Enter === true &&

    M.restart();
    P.gold = 10; P.exp = 5;
    S.save();

      g2Info = {
        enemyTile: { x: gE.x, y: gE.y }, landed: { x: P.x, y: P.y },
        landing: S.lastLanding, battle: B.isActive(), gold: P.gold, exp: P.exp,
        enemies: MAP.getEnemies().length
      };

    rec('G_battle_save_semantics', g1 && g2, {
      rule: '战斗中不是存档点：暂停→返回主菜单不写档（字节不变），继续游戏从最近非战斗档进入探索、不恢复半截战斗；' +
        '篡改落点到怪物格时 BFS 到可站格，不自动开战、不加金币/经验、怪物数不变',
      battleMenu: {

        battleAborted: g1NoBattle, continueToExplore: g1Enter === true && M._scene === 'explore'
      },
      tamperedPos: g2Info
    });

    /* ---------- E：B1/G2/S1/M1 同种子 1001–1050，与 D-52 逐局一致（B1 14/50） ---------- */
    var AFTER = readJson('selfcheck/d53-after.json');
    var BASE = readJson('selfcheck/d52-after.json');
    var eBad = [], eCount = { b1: 0, g2: 0, s1: 0, m1: 0 };
    if (!AFTER || !BASE) eBad.push('缺少 selfcheck/d53-after.json 或 d52-after.json');
    else {
      ['b1', 'g2', 's1', 'm1'].forEach(function (k) {
        var ar = (AFTER.runs && AFTER.runs[k]) || [];
        var br = (BASE.runs && BASE.runs[k]) || [];
        var bm = {};
        br.forEach(function (x) { bm[x.seed] = x; });
        eCount[k] = ar.length;
        if (ar.length !== 50) eBad.push(k + ': runs=' + ar.length);
        for (var j = 0; j < ar.length; j++) {
          var x = ar[j], y = bm[x.seed];
          if (!y) { eBad.push(k + '/' + x.seed + ': 基线缺该种子'); continue; }
          var fs = ['outcome', 'kills', 'gold', 'level', 'battles', 'floor'];
          for (var fi2 = 0; fi2 < fs.length; fi2++) {
            if (x[fs[fi2]] !== y[fs[fi2]]) eBad.push(k + '/' + x.seed + '.' + fs[fi2] + ': ' + x[fs[fi2]] + '≠' + y[fs[fi2]]);
          }
          if ((x.deathFloor || x.floor) !== (y.deathFloor || y.floor)) {
            eBad.push(k + '/' + x.seed + '.deathFloor');
          }
        }
      });
    }
    var eWins = AFTER && AFTER.agg && AFTER.agg.b1 ? AFTER.agg.b1.outcomes.win : -1;
    var eEnv = AFTER ? AFTER.env : null;
    var eSeeds = !!eEnv && eEnv.maxActions === 2500 && eEnv.seeds && eEnv.seeds.length === 50;
    var eAgg = !!(AFTER && BASE && eWins === 14 && BASE.agg.b1.outcomes.win === 14 &&
      AFTER.agg.g2.f5.reached === BASE.agg.g2.f5.reached &&
      AFTER.agg.s1.f5.reached === BASE.agg.s1.f5.reached &&
      AFTER.agg.m1.floorReach['4'] === BASE.agg.m1.floorReach['4']);
    rec('E_four_strategies_match_d52', !!AFTER && !!BASE && eSeeds && eBad.length === 0 && eAgg, {
      rule: 'B1/G2/S1/M1 同种子 1001–1050、maxActions 2500：逐局 outcome/击杀/金币/等级/战斗场次/楼层与 D-52 完全一致；B1 仍 14/50',
      env: eEnv, runs: eCount, b1Wins: eWins,
      agg: AFTER ? { g2f5: AFTER.agg.g2.f5.reached, s1f5: AFTER.agg.s1.f5.reached, m1f4: AFTER.agg.m1.floorReach['4'] } : null,
      mismatches: eBad.slice(0, 10), mismatchCount: eBad.length
    });

    out.errs = window.__D53ERR;
    out.ok = Object.keys(out.sub).every(function (k) { return out.sub[k].ok; }) && window.__D53ERR.length === 0;
    out.ms = Date.now() - START;
  } catch (e) {
    out.err = String((e && (e.stack || e.message)) || e);
    out.ok = false;
  }

  var txt = (out.ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out);
  document.title = txt.slice(0, 180);
  document.getElementById('result').textContent = txt;
  var rows = '';
  Object.keys(out.sub).forEach(function (k) {
    var v = out.sub[k];
    rows += '<tr><td>' + k + '</td><td>' + (v.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') + '</td><td>' +
      (v.d && v.d.rule ? v.d.rule : '') + '</td></tr>';
  });
  document.getElementById('detail').innerHTML = '<table><tr><th>组</th><th>结果</th><th>判据</th></tr>' + rows + '</table>';
})();

(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* ── 读文件（file:// 下由 run-all 的 --allow-file-access-from-files 放行） ── */
  function readDoc(rel) {
    try {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('GET', new URL(rel, location.href).href, false);
      x.send(null);
      return x.responseText || '';
    } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }
  function readJson(rel) {
    var t = readDoc(rel).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');
    try { return JSON.parse(t); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  var out = { ok: false, sub: {}, errs: [] };
  var demo = readDoc('../docs/演示脚本.md');
  var check = readDoc('../docs/功能点检表.md');

   * 键名 → 源码必须字面出现的证据片段（不靠"我记得有这个键"）。 */
  var KEYMAP = {
    '方向': ['ArrowUp'], '方向键': ['ArrowUp'],
    '↑': ['ArrowUp'], '↓': ['ArrowDown'], '←': ['ArrowLeft'], '→': ['ArrowRight'],
    'Enter': ["k['Enter']"], 'Esc': ['Escape'], 'Tab': ["'Tab'"],
    'T': ['KeyT'], 'B': ['KeyB'], 'E': ['KeyE'], 'M': ['KeyM'],
    'Q': ['KeyQ'], 'K': ['KeyK'], 'H': ['KeyH'], 'L': ['KeyL'], 'F': ['KeyF'], 'R': ['KeyR'],
    '1': ['Digit1'], '2': ['Digit2'], '3': ['Digit3'], '4': ['Digit4'],
    '5': ['Digit5'], '6': ['Digit6'], '7': ['Digit7']
  };

  function extractKeys(text) {
    var re = /按\s*([^\s，。；、（）()【】]+?)\s*键/g, m, list = [];
    while ((m = re.exec(text))) list.push(m[1].replace(/[*`]/g, ''));
    return list;
  }
  /* 返回 {ok, bad:[{token,why}], tokens:[...]}；纯函数，E 组负例复用 */
  function validateKeys(text, src) {
    var tokens = extractKeys(text), bad = [], seen = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
      var tk = tokens[i];
      if (seen[tk]) continue;
      seen[tk] = 1;
      var parts = tk.split('/'), found = false;
      for (var p = 0; p < parts.length; p++) {
        var needs = KEYMAP[parts[p]];
        if (!needs) { bad.push({ token: parts[p], why: '键名不在键表' }); continue; }
        for (var n = 0; n < needs.length; n++) {
          if (src.indexOf(needs[n]) < 0) bad.push({ token: parts[p], why: '源码缺少 ' + needs[n] });
        }
        found = true;
      }
      if (!found) bad.push({ token: tk, why: '无可识别的键段' });
    }
    return { ok: bad.length === 0, bad: bad, tokens: Object.keys(seen) };
  }
  var keyRes = validateKeys(demo, srcAll);
  out.sub.A_keys_exist = {
    ok: keyRes.ok && keyRes.tokens.length >= 8,
    d: {
      rule: '抽出脚本里全部「按 X 键」，逐个对照源码键位；键名不在表或源码缺证据即 FAIL',
      tokens: keyRes.tokens,
      bad: keyRes.bad
    }
  };

  /* ── B. 脚本引用的验证页真实存在且当前 PASS ─────────────────── */
  function validatePages(text, baseline, reg) {
    var re = /verify_[a-z0-9_]+/g, m, refs = [];
    while ((m = re.exec(text))) if (refs.indexOf(m[0]) < 0) refs.push(m[0]);
    var pages = (baseline && baseline.pages) ? baseline.pages : [];
    var rows = (reg && reg.rows) ? reg.rows : [];
    var byName = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) byName[rows[i].page] = rows[i].verdict;
    var bad = [];
    for (var j = 0; j < refs.length; j++) {
      if (pages.indexOf(refs[j]) < 0) bad.push({ page: refs[j], why: '不在 page-baseline' });
      else if (byName[refs[j]] !== 'PASS') bad.push({ page: refs[j], why: '上一轮裁决=' + (byName[refs[j]] || '缺失') });
    }
    return { ok: refs.length >= 5 && bad.length === 0, refs: refs, bad: bad };
  }
  var pageRes = validatePages(demo, baseline, reg);
  out.sub.B_pages_exist_pass = {
    ok: pageRes.ok,
    d: {
      rule: '脚本里出现的每个 verify_* 必须在 page-baseline 中且上一轮 PASS',
      count: pageRes.refs.length, refs: pageRes.refs, bad: pageRes.bad
    }
  };

  /* ── C. 点检表对 README 功能清单覆盖率 100% ─────────────────── */
  function readmeBullets(md) {
    var a = md.indexOf('## 功能列表');
    if (a < 0) return [];
    var b = md.indexOf('## 操作说明', a);
    var sec = md.slice(a, b < 0 ? md.length : b);
    var lines = sec.split(/\r?\n/), outList = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      var s = lines[i].replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim();
      if (/^-\s+/.test(s)) outList.push(s.replace(/^-\s+/, '').trim());
    }
    return outList;
  }
  function checklistRows(md) {
    var lines = md.split(/\r?\n/), rows = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      if (!/^\|\s*[RX]\d+\s*\|/.test(lines[i])) continue;
      var c = lines[i].split('|');
      if (c.length < 8) continue;
      rows.push({ kind: c[1].trim().charAt(0), id: c[1].trim(), kw: c[2].trim(), code: c[3].trim(), verify: c[4].trim(), demo: c[5].trim(), offline: c[6].trim() });
    }
    return rows;
  }
  function pad2(n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : String(n); }
  /* D-56：README 25 条用 R 行覆盖；D-51–D-55 新增能力用 X 行，单独要求出现 */
  var X_FEATURES = ['暂停', '清档', '放弃本局', '结局页', '存档落点', '任务指引'];
  function validateChecklist(bullets, rows) {
    var bad = [], gaps = [], rr = [], xr = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      if (rows[i].kind === 'R') rr.push(rows[i]);
      else if (rows[i].kind === 'X') xr.push(rows[i]);
    }
    if (rr.length !== bullets.length) bad.push({ why: 'R 行数 ' + rr.length + ' ≠ README 条目数 ' + bullets.length });
    for (var r = 0; r < rr.length; r++) {
      var row = rr[r];
      var wantId = 'R' + pad2(r + 1);
      if (row.id !== wantId) bad.push({ why: '第 ' + (r + 1) + ' 行编号 ' + row.id + ' ≠ ' + wantId });
      if (r < bullets.length && bullets[r].indexOf(row.kw) < 0) {
        bad.push({ why: wantId + ' 关键词「' + row.kw + '」不在对应 README 条目里' });
      }
      var cols = [row.code, row.verify, row.demo, row.offline];
      for (var c = 0; c < cols.length; c++) {
        if (!cols[c] || cols[c] === '—' || cols[c] === '-') bad.push({ why: wantId + ' 第 ' + (c + 1) + ' 栏为空' });
      }
      if (/缺口/.test(row.demo) || /缺口/.test(row.offline)) gaps.push(row.id);
    }
    var xText = '';
    for (var x = 0; x < xr.length; x++) {
      xText += '|' + xr[x].kw + '|' + xr[x].code + '|' + xr[x].verify + '|' + xr[x].demo + '|' + xr[x].offline;
      var xc = [xr[x].code, xr[x].verify, xr[x].demo, xr[x].offline];
      for (var y = 0; y < xc.length; y++) {
        if (!xc[y] || xc[y] === '—' || xc[y] === '-') bad.push({ why: xr[x].id + ' 第 ' + (y + 1) + ' 栏为空' });
      }
    }
    var missX = [];
    for (var f = 0; f < X_FEATURES.length; f++) if (xText.indexOf(X_FEATURES[f]) < 0) missX.push(X_FEATURES[f]);
    if (xr.length < X_FEATURES.length) bad.push({ why: 'X 行数 ' + xr.length + ' < 新增功能数 ' + X_FEATURES.length });
    if (missX.length) bad.push({ why: '点检表缺少 D-51–D-55 新增功能：' + missX.join('、') });
    return { ok: bad.length === 0 && bullets.length > 0, bad: bad, gaps: gaps, bullets: bullets.length, rows: rr.length, xrows: xr.length, missX: missX };
  }
  var bullets = readmeBullets(readme);
  var cRows = checklistRows(check);
  var cRes = validateChecklist(bullets, cRows);
  out.sub.C_checklist_coverage = {
    ok: cRes.ok,
    d: {
      rule: 'README 功能列表逐条 → 点检表一行；行数相等、编号连续、关键词命中、四栏非空',
      readmeBullets: cRes.bullets, checklistRows: cRes.rows, xRows: cRes.xrows,
      missingNewFeatures: cRes.missX, gaps: cRes.gaps, bad: cRes.bad
    }
  };

  /* ── D. 文档数值与《平衡定档》逐项相等（≥10 项） ───────────── */
  function numberTable(md) {
    var a = md.indexOf('## 五、数字出处');
    if (a < 0) return { body: md, rows: [] };
    var b = md.indexOf('\n## ', a + 1);
    var sec = md.slice(a, b < 0 ? md.length : b);
    var lines = sec.split(/\r?\n/), rows = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      if (!/^\|/.test(lines[i])) continue;
      var c = lines[i].split('|');
      if (c.length < 4) continue;
      var tok = c[1].replace(/[*`]/g, '').trim();
      if (!tok || tok === '数字' || /^-+$/.test(tok.replace(/ /g, ''))) continue;
      rows.push({ token: tok, where: c[2].trim() });
    }
    return { body: md.slice(0, a), rows: rows, section: sec };
  }
  var nt = numberTable(demo);
  var dbad = [];
  for (var di = 0; di < nt.rows.length; di++) {
    var tk = nt.rows[di].token;
    if (balance.indexOf(tk) < 0) dbad.push({ token: tk, why: '《平衡定档》中找不到该数字' });
    else if (nt.body.indexOf(tk) < 0) dbad.push({ token: tk, why: '脚本正文没有引用该数字' });
  }
  out.sub.D_numbers_match_balance = {

      count: nt.rows.length, bad: dbad
    }
  };

  /* ── E. 负例：假键 / 假页 / 未实现功能，三者都必须 FAIL ─────── */
  var negKey = validateKeys('按 Z 键 打开隐藏菜单', srcAll);
  var negPage = validatePages('详见 verify_d999', baseline, reg);
  var negRows = cRows.concat([{ kind: 'R', id: 'R' + pad2(cRows.length + 1), kw: '御剑飞行', code: 'js/systems/fly.js', verify: 'verify_m1', demo: 'S01', offline: '能' }]);
  var negCheck = validateChecklist(bullets, negRows);
  out.sub.E_negatives_fail = {
    ok: !negKey.ok && !negPage.ok && !negCheck.ok,
    d: {
      rule: '往脚本塞不存在按键、不存在验证页、未实现功能，校验必须判 FAIL',
      fakeKey: { ok: negKey.ok, bad: negKey.bad },
      fakePage: { ok: negPage.ok, bad: negPage.bad },
      fakeFeature: { ok: negCheck.ok, bad: negCheck.bad }
    }
  };

  /* ── F. 文档表述与当前实现一致（D-56 回写） ─────────────────── */
  function scriptConsistency(text) {
    var banned = ['最容易翻车', '只沿主路走', '不走岔路', '靠只走主路'];
    var required = ['屏幕右侧', '任务指引', '19.5'];
    var hit = [], miss = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < banned.length; i++) if (text.indexOf(banned[i]) >= 0) hit.push(banned[i]);
    for (var j = 0; j < required.length; j++) if (text.indexOf(required[j]) < 0) miss.push(required[j]);
    return { ok: hit.length === 0 && miss.length === 0, bannedHits: hit, missing: miss };
  }
  var cons = scriptConsistency(demo);
  out.sub.F_doc_matches_impl = {
    ok: cons.ok,
    d: {
      rule: '脚本不得再出现与当前实现矛盾的表述；必须写明右侧指引、任务指引开关与 19.5 步数据',
      bannedHits: cons.bannedHits, missing: cons.missing
    }
  };

  var keys = ['A_keys_exist', 'B_pages_exist_pass', 'C_checklist_coverage', 'D_numbers_match_balance', 'E_negatives_fail', 'F_doc_matches_impl'];
  var ok = true;
  for (var k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) ok = ok && !!out.sub[keys[k]].ok;
  out.ok = ok;

  var text = (ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out);
  document.title = text;
  var pre = document.getElementById('result');
  pre.textContent = text;
  pre.id = 'result';
})();

    a = a | 0;
    return function () {
      a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
      var t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  var DIRS = [[0, -1], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [1, 0]];
  function bfsExp(sx, sy, tx, ty) {
    var seen = {}, q = [{ x: sx, y: sy, d: 0, first: null }], qi = 0;
    seen[sx + ',' + sy] = 1;
    while (qi < q.length) {
      var c = q[qi++];
      if (c.x === tx && c.y === ty) return { distance: c.d, dir: c.first };
      for (var i = 0; i < DIRS.length; i++) {
        var nx = c.x + DIRS[i][0], ny = c.y + DIRS[i][1];
        var t = Map.tileAt(nx, ny);
        var total = (Game.Data.MAPS && Game.Data.MAPS.floors) || 5;

        if (t === 0 || teleporting) continue;
