    };
  }

  var M = Game.Core.Main, Map = Game.Systems.Map, AI = Game.Systems.AI;
  var NQ = Game.Systems.NpcQuest, P = Game.Data.Player;
  var MON = Game.Data.MONSTERS || {};
  var ORAND = Math.random;
  var NPC_ID = 'warden_f1';

  function gen(seed) {
    Math.random = mulberry32(seed);
    try {
      Map.generate();          /* 首次调用前 cfg 为 null：先完成初始化 */
      Map.setFloor(1);
      P.floor = 1;
      var sp = Map.getSpawn();
      P.x = sp.x; P.y = sp.y;
      NQ.reset();
      M._scene = 'explore';
    } finally { Math.random = ORAND; }
    var ns = Map.getNpcs() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < ns.length; i++) if (ns[i].id === NPC_ID) return ns[i];
    return null;
  }

  /* ── A. 习性表：数据 / AI 读取 / 文档三方逐条一致 ───────────── */
  (function () {
    function docRows() {
      var md = readDoc('../docs/平衡定档.md');
      var a = md.indexOf('## 附录A 怪物习性');
      if (a < 0) return null;
      var b = md.indexOf('\n## ', a + 1);
      var sec = md.slice(a, b < 0 ? md.length : b);
      var lines = sec.split(/\r?\n/), rows = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        if (!/^\|/.test(lines[i])) continue;
        var c = lines[i].split('|');
        if (c.length < 5) continue;
        var name = c[1].replace(/[*`]/g, '').trim();
        var kc = c[2];
        var km = /(guard|patrol|chase)/.exec(kc);
        var sight = Number(c[3].trim());
        if (!km || !isFinite(sight)) continue;
        rows.push({ name: name, kind: km[1], sight: sight });
      }
      return rows;
    }
    var rows = docRows();
    var ids = Object.keys(MON);
    var byName = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) byName[MON[ids[i]].name] = ids[i];
    var mism = [], seenIds = {};
    if (rows) {
      for (var r = 0; r < rows.length; r++) {
        var row = rows[r], id = byName[row.name];
        if (!id) { mism.push({ name: row.name, why: '数据表里没有这只怪' }); continue; }
        seenIds[id] = 1;
        var h = MON[id].habit;
        if (!h || h.kind !== row.kind || h.sight !== row.sight) {
          mism.push({ name: row.name, doc: { kind: row.kind, sight: row.sight }, data: h || null });
        }
      }
      for (var k = 0; k < ids.length; k++) if (!seenIds[ids[k]]) mism.push({ id: ids[k], why: '文档漏写' });
    }
    /* AI 读取的表必须与数据表逐项一致（防止代码里另存一份"第二真相"） */
    var api = AI.habits ? AI.habits() : {};
    var apiBad = [];
    for (var a = 0; a < ids.length; a++) {
      var hid = ids[a], hb = MON[hid].habit, ab = api[hid];
      if (!hb || !ab || hb.kind !== ab.kind || hb.sight !== ab.sight) apiBad.push(hid);
    }
    var tier = { short: 0, mid: 0, long: 0, guard: 0 };
    for (var t = 0; t < ids.length; t++) {
      var ht = MON[ids[t]].habit;
      if (!ht) continue;
      if (ht.sight >= 3 && ht.sight <= 4) tier.short++;
      else if (ht.sight >= 5 && ht.sight <= 6) tier.mid++;
      else if (ht.sight >= 7 && ht.sight <= 8) tier.long++;
      if (ht.kind === 'guard') tier.guard++;
    }
    rec('A_habit_table_matches', !!rows && mism.length === 0 && apiBad.length === 0 &&
      rows.length === ids.length && tier.short > 0 && tier.mid > 0 && tier.long > 0 && tier.guard > 0,
      {
        rule: '《平衡定档》附录A 的每行（名称→习性/半径）必须与 MONSTERS[id].habit 相同，AI.habits() 也必须同源；三档视距与不追型至少各一',
        species: ids.length, docRows: rows ? rows.length : 0, tiers: tier,
        mismatches: mism, apiBad: apiBad
      });
  })();

  /* ── 通用桩：把 Map.getGrid 换成自造网格（只给 AI.tick 用） ─── */
  function makeGrid(w, h, wallFn) {
    var g = [];
    for (var y = 0; y < h; y++) {
      g[y] = [];
      for (var x = 0; x < w; x++) g[y][x] = (x === 0 || y === 0 || x === w - 1 || y === h - 1) ? 0 : 1;
    }
    if (wallFn) for (var yy = 0; yy < h; yy++) for (var xx = 0; xx < w; xx++) if (wallFn(xx, yy)) g[yy][xx] = 0;
    return g;
  }
  function withGrid(g, fn) {
    var orig = Map.getGrid;
    Map.getGrid = function () { return g; };
    try { return fn(); } finally { Map.getGrid = orig; }
  }
  function patrolAt(x, y, id) {
    return { x: x, y: y, monsterId: id, state: 'idle', path: [], frame: 1 };
  }

  /* ── B. 隔墙不可见（双向断言） ───────────────────────────────── */
  (function () {
    var g = makeGrid(7, 5, function (x, y) { return x === 2 && y === 1; });
    var got = { blocked: null, open: null, blockedPos: null };
    withGrid(g, function () {
      var orig = AI.getPatrols();
      try {
        AI.setPatrols([patrolAt(1, 1, 'bat')]);   /* 蝙蝠：追击型、8 格 */
        AI.tick({ x: 3, y: 1 });                  /* 中间隔一堵墙 */
        var e1 = AI.getPatrols()[0];
        got.blocked = e1.state;
        got.blockedPos = e1.x + ',' + e1.y;
        g[1][2] = 1;                              /* 拆墙：同样两格距离 */
        AI.tick({ x: 3, y: 1 });
        got.open = AI.getPatrols()[0].state;
      } finally { AI.setPatrols(orig); }
    });
    rec('B_wall_blocks_sight', got.blocked === 'idle' && got.open === 'chase' &&
      got.blockedPos === '1,1',
      {
        rule: '同一条两格直线：中间有墙 → 不得进入追击；拆墙后同帧必须进入追击（双向）',
        blockedState: got.blocked, blockedPos: got.blockedPos, openState: got.open
      });
  })();

  /* ── C. 三档视距真实生效：半径内被发现、半径外 1 格不被发现 ── */
  (function () {
    var g = makeGrid(40, 21);
    var bad = [], rows = [];
    withGrid(g, function () {
      var orig = AI.getPatrols();
      try {
        var ids = Object.keys(MON);
        for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
          var id = ids[i], h = MON[id].habit;
          if (!h) { bad.push({ id: id, why: 'no habit' }); continue; }
          var want = (h.kind === 'guard') ? 'alert' : 'chase';
          AI.setPatrols([patrolAt(10, 10, id)]);
          AI.tick({ x: 10 + h.sight, y: 10 });
          var inside = AI.getPatrols()[0].state;
          AI.setPatrols([patrolAt(10, 10, id)]);
          AI.tick({ x: 10 + h.sight + 1, y: 10 });
          var outside = AI.getPatrols()[0].state;
          rows.push({ id: id, kind: h.kind, sight: h.sight, inside: inside, outside: outside });
          if (inside !== want || outside !== 'idle') bad.push(rows[rows.length - 1]);
        }
      } finally { AI.setPatrols(orig); }
    });
    var tierOk = { short: 0, mid: 0, long: 0 };
    for (var r = 0; r < rows.length; r++) {
      if (rows[r].sight <= 4) tierOk.short++;
      else if (rows[r].sight <= 6) tierOk.mid++;
      else tierOk.long++;
    }
    rec('C_sight_radius_boundary', bad.length === 0 && rows.length === Object.keys(MON).length &&
      tierOk.short > 0 && tierOk.mid > 0 && tierOk.long > 0,
      {
        rule: '每只怪：玩家在 sight 格处必须被发现（守卫=alert / 其余=chase），sight+1 格处必须 idle；三档都要有样本',
        species: rows.length, tiers: tierOk, bad: bad.slice(0, 6)
      });
  })();

  /* ── D+E. 50 种子 × 5 层：宝箱邻近率/合法性/连通性 + 不追型逐局断言 ── */
  (function () {
    var seeds = [];
    for (var s = 1001; s <= 1050; s++) seeds.push(s);
    var chestTotal = 0, bound = 0, free = 0, mustFight = 0, blockedChest = 0, isolatedCells = 0;
    var overlap = [], unreachable = [], perFloor = {};
    for (var f = 1; f <= 5; f++) perFloor[f] = { total: 0, bound: 0 };
    var guardSeen = 0, guardBad = [], chaserSeen = 0, chaserBad = [], genFail = [];
    var radius = (Game.Data.CHEST_PLACEMENT && Game.Data.CHEST_PLACEMENT.bindRadius) || 2;

    function walkAll(grid, sx, sy) {
      var w = grid[0].length, h = grid.length, seen = {}, q = [[sx, sy]], qi = 0;
      var dirs = [[0, -1], [1, 0], [0, 1], [-1, 0]];
      seen[sx + ',' + sy] = 1;
      var cnt = (grid[sy][sx] !== 0) ? 1 : 0;   /* 出生点本身可能是墙，不能计数 */
      while (qi < q.length) {
        var c = q[qi++];
        for (var d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
          var nx = c[0] + dirs[d][0], ny = c[1] + dirs[d][1];
          if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= w || ny >= h) continue;
          if (grid[ny][nx] === 0) continue;
          var k = nx + ',' + ny;
          if (seen[k]) continue;
          seen[k] = 1; cnt++; q.push([nx, ny]);
        }
      }
      return { seen: seen, count: cnt };
    }
    function walkAvoid(grid, sx, sy, blockMonsters, enemies, patrols) {
      var w = grid[0].length, h = grid.length, seen = {}, q = [[sx, sy]], qi = 0;
      var dirs = [[0, -1], [1, 0], [0, 1], [-1, 0]];
      var blocked = {};
      if (blockMonsters) {
        var i;
        for (i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) blocked[enemies[i].x + ',' + enemies[i].y] = 1;
        for (i = 0; i < patrols.length; i++) blocked[patrols[i].x + ',' + patrols[i].y] = 1;
      }
      seen[sx + ',' + sy] = 1;
      while (qi < q.length) {
        var c = q[qi++];
        for (var d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
          var nx = c[0] + dirs[d][0], ny = c[1] + dirs[d][1];
          if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= w || ny >= h) continue;
          if (grid[ny][nx] === 0) continue;
          var k = nx + ',' + ny;
          if (seen[k]) continue;
          if (blocked[k]) continue;
          seen[k] = 1; q.push([nx, ny]);
        }
      }
      return seen;
    }
    function visibleCell(grid, e, sight) {
      for (var r = 2; r <= sight; r++) {
        for (var dx = -r; dx <= r; dx++) {
          var ay = r - Math.abs(dx);
          var dys = ay === 0 ? [0] : [-ay, ay];
          for (var k = 0; k < dys.length; k++) {
            var x = e.x + dx, y = e.y + dys[k];
            if (!grid[y] || grid[y][x] === undefined || grid[y][x] === 0) continue;
            if (AI.canSee(e.x, e.y, x, y, grid)) return { x: x, y: y };
          }
        }
      }
      return null;
    }

    for (var si = 0; si < seeds.length; si++) {
      var seed = seeds[si], npc = null;
      try {
        npc = gen(seed);
        for (var f = 1; f <= 5; f++) {
          /* 每层用 seed×10+f 单独播种：50 个种子 × 5 层都可复现（不受上一次生成的随机流影响） */
          Math.random = mulberry32(seed * 10 + f);
          try { Map.setFloor(f); } finally { Math.random = ORAND; }
          P.floor = f;
          var grid = Map.getGrid(), sp = Map.getSpawn();
          var ens = Map.getEnemies() || [], pats = AI.getPatrols() || [];
          var mons = [];
          var ei, pi;
          for (ei = 0; ei < ens.length; ei++) mons.push(ens[ei]);
          for (pi = 0; pi < pats.length; pi++) mons.push(pats[pi]);
          /* 全图连通性（只看 tile，不看实体；宝箱不改变 tile） */
          var all = walkAll(grid, sp.x, sp.y);
          var totalFloor = 0, sx2, sy2;
          for (sx2 = 0; sx2 < grid.length; sx2++) for (sy2 = 0; sy2 < grid[sx2].length; sy2++) if (grid[sx2][sy2] !== 0) totalFloor++;
          /* 只允许"既有的孤立单格空腔"（openRooms 随机开洞的副产物）——但那个格子里
           * 不能承载任何内容（宝箱/楼梯/陷阱/NPC/怪/奖励点），否则就是真断连。 */
          if (all.count !== totalFloor) {
            for (sx2 = 0; sx2 < grid.length; sx2++) {
              for (sy2 = 0; sy2 < grid[sx2].length; sy2++) {
                if (grid[sx2][sy2] === 0) continue;
                if (all.seen[sy2 + ',' + sx2]) continue;
                isolatedCells++;
                /* 只允许"无害装饰"（木桶/火把/藤蔓）待在孤立单格里；
                 * 可拾取宝箱、楼梯、NPC 一律不允许断连。 */
                var dec = Map.getDecor(sy2, sx2);
                var pickable = (dec === 'chest' || dec === 'room_chest' || dec === 'gold_pile' || dec === 'potion_stash');
                var hasContent = grid[sx2][sy2] !== 1 || pickable ||
                  (Map.npcAt && Map.npcAt(sy2, sx2));
                if (hasContent) genFail.push({ seed: seed, floor: f, x: sy2, y: sx2, tile: grid[sx2][sy2], decor: dec, why: '断连格承载可交互内容' });
              }
            }
          }
          /* seenAvoid：把怪物格当墙（"不处理这只怪就到不了"）；
           * seenAll：怪物格也可踩（判断箱子是否真的被彻底堵死） */
          var seenAvoid = walkAvoid(grid, sp.x, sp.y, true, ens, pats);
          var seenAll = walkAvoid(grid, sp.x, sp.y, false, ens, pats);
          for (var y = 1; y < grid.length - 1; y++) {
            for (var x = 1; x < grid[0].length - 1; x++) {
              if (Map.getDecor(x, y) !== 'chest') continue;
              chestTotal++;
              perFloor[f].total++;
              var nearest = 999;
              for (var mi = 0; mi < mons.length; mi++) {
                var md = Math.abs(mons[mi].x - x) + Math.abs(mons[mi].y - y);
                if (md < nearest) nearest = md;
              }
              if (nearest <= radius) { bound++; perFloor[f].bound++; } else free++;
              if (grid[y][x] !== 1) overlap.push({ seed: seed, floor: f, x: x, y: y, why: '不是地板' });
              if (Map.getTrap(x, y)) overlap.push({ seed: seed, floor: f, x: x, y: y, why: '陷阱' });
              if (Map.npcAt && Map.npcAt(x, y)) overlap.push({ seed: seed, floor: f, x: x, y: y, why: 'NPC' });
              if (Map.enemyAt(x, y)) overlap.push({ seed: seed, floor: f, x: x, y: y, why: '怪物' });
              if (x === sp.x && y === sp.y) overlap.push({ seed: seed, floor: f, x: x, y: y, why: '出生点' });
              var k = x + ',' + y;
              var okFree = !!seenAvoid[k], okBlock = !!seenAll[k];
              if (!okBlock) { blockedChest++; unreachable.push({ seed: seed, floor: f, x: x, y: y, why: '含怪物也不可达' }); }
              else if (!okFree) mustFight++;
              else if (!okBlock) unreachable.push({ seed: seed, floor: f, x: x, y: y });
            }
          }
          /* E：每只巡逻怪按其习性做一次"看得见"的近距离测试 */
          var orig = pats.slice();
          try {
            for (pi = 0; pi < orig.length; pi++) {
              var e = orig[pi], hb = AI.habitOf(e.monsterId);
              var cell = visibleCell(grid, e, hb.sight);
              if (!cell) continue;
              AI.setPatrols([patrolAt(e.x, e.y, e.monsterId)]);
              AI.tick({ x: cell.x, y: cell.y });
              var st = AI.getPatrols()[0];
              if (hb.kind === 'guard') {
                guardSeen++;
                if (st.state === 'chase' || st.x !== e.x || st.y !== e.y) {
                  guardBad.push({ seed: seed, floor: f, id: e.monsterId, state: st.state, moved: (st.x !== e.x || st.y !== e.y) });
                }
              } else {
                chaserSeen++;
                if (st.state !== 'chase') chaserBad.push({ seed: seed, floor: f, id: e.monsterId, state: st.state });
              }
            }
          } finally { AI.setPatrols(orig); }
        }
      } catch (err) { genFail.push({ seed: seed, why: 'exception: ' + (err && err.message) }); }
    }

    var rate = chestTotal ? Math.round(bound / chestTotal * 1000) / 1000 : 0;
    var floorRates = {};
    for (var pf = 1; pf <= 5; pf++) {
      floorRates[pf] = perFloor[pf].total ? Math.round(perFloor[pf].bound / perFloor[pf].total * 1000) / 1000 : 0;
    }
    rec('D_chest_binding', chestTotal >= 250 && rate >= 0.5 && rate <= 0.8 && overlap.length === 0 &&
      blockedChest === 0 && genFail.length === 0,
      {
        rule: '普通宝箱绑怪率（优先放在怪的另一侧、距怪曼哈顿≤' + radius + '）设计 0.65，实测须在 0.50–0.80；50 种子×5 层全连通、无重叠、无"被怪堵死"',
        chestTotal: chestTotal, bound: bound, free: free, rate: rate,
        mustFight: mustFight, blockedChest: blockedChest, isolatedCells: isolatedCells, perFloor: floorRates,
        overlap: overlap.slice(0, 5), genFail: genFail.slice(0, 5), unreachable: unreachable.slice(0, 5)
      });
    rec('E_guard_never_chases', guardSeen > 0 && guardBad.length === 0 && chaserSeen > 0 && chaserBad.length === 0,
      {
        rule: '50 种子×5 层逐只巡逻怪：guard 怪在视距内只能 alert 且坐标不变；patrol/chase 怪同一测试必须 chase',
        guardPatrolsTested: guardSeen, guardViolations: guardBad.slice(0, 5),
        chasersTested: chaserSeen, chaserViolations: chaserBad.slice(0, 5)
      });
  })();

  /* ── F. 四策略同种子 1001–1050：改动前后通关率与贴脸遭遇数 ─── */
  (function () {
    var B = readJson('selfcheck/d58-before.json');
    var A = readJson('selfcheck/d58-after.json');
    function sum(runs, key, field) {
      var s = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
        var o = runs[i][key];
        if (o && typeof o[field] === 'number') s += o[field];
      }
      return s;
    }
    if (!B || !A || !B.runs || !A.runs) {
      rec('F_before_after', false, { rule: '读取 d58-before.json / d58-after.json', bad: ['缺少跑局产物'] });
      return;
    }
    var strat = ['b1', 'g2', 's1', 'm1'], lensOk = true, wins = {}, bad = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < strat.length; i++) {
      var k = strat[i];
      if (!B.runs[k] || !A.runs[k] || B.runs[k].length !== 50 || A.runs[k].length !== 50) {
        lensOk = false; bad.push(k + ' 不是 50 局');
        continue;
      }
      wins[k] = {
        before: B.summary[k].win, after: A.summary[k].win
      };
    }
    var b1 = {
      battles: { before: sum(B.runs.b1, 'b1enc', 'battles'), after: sum(A.runs.b1, 'b1enc', 'battles') },
      active: { before: sum(B.runs.b1, 'b1enc', 'active'), after: sum(A.runs.b1, 'b1enc', 'active') },
      forced: { before: sum(B.runs.b1, 'b1enc', 'forced'), after: sum(A.runs.b1, 'b1enc', 'forced') },
      patrol: { before: sum(B.runs.b1, 'b1enc', 'patrol'), after: sum(A.runs.b1, 'b1enc', 'patrol') }
    };
    var s1 = {
      battles: { before: sum(B.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'battles'), after: sum(A.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'battles') },
      active: { before: sum(B.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'active'), after: sum(A.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'active') },
      forced: { before: sum(B.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'forced'), after: sum(A.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'forced') },
      byPatrol: { before: sum(B.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'byPatrol'), after: sum(A.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'byPatrol') }
    };
    /* 贴脸遭遇数：B1 的 patrol + S1 的 byPatrol（非主动踩怪、非挡路怪） */
    var face = {
      b1: b1.patrol, s1: s1.byPatrol,
      totalBefore: b1.patrol.before + s1.byPatrol.before,
      totalAfter: b1.patrol.after + s1.byPatrol.after
    };
    var perFloor = {
      b1: { reach: { before: B.agg.b1.floorReach, after: A.agg.b1.floorReach },
        death: { before: B.agg.b1.deathFloor, after: A.agg.b1.deathFloor } },
      s1: { reach: { before: B.agg.s1.floorReach, after: A.agg.s1.floorReach },
        death: { before: B.agg.s1.deathFloor, after: A.agg.s1.deathFloor } }
    };
    var encOk = true;
    for (var r = 0; r < 50; r++) {
      if (!A.runs.b1[r].b1enc) { encOk = false; bad.push('b1 run ' + r + ' 无 b1enc'); break; }
      if (!A.runs.s1[r].s1enc) { encOk = false; bad.push('s1 run ' + r + ' 无 s1enc'); break; }
    }
    /* D-39 的真实判据是"怪物格当障碍：主动踩怪只允许出现在绕不过去的兜底"，
     * 即 active + forced = battles。D-58 后有 2 局触发兜底（0→2），不是新增主动刷怪通道。 */
    var invOk = true;
    for (var rr = 0; rr < 50; rr++) {
      var es = A.runs.s1[rr] && A.runs.s1[rr].s1enc;
      if (es && es.active + es.forced !== es.battles) { invOk = false; bad.push('s1 run ' + rr + ' active+forced≠battles'); }
    }
    rec('F_before_after', lensOk && encOk && invOk && bad.length === 0 && b1.active.before === 0 &&
      s1.active.before === 0 && B.summary.b1.win === 14,
      {

        wins: wins, b1Encounters: b1, s1Encounters: s1, faceToFace: face,

  (function () {

        if (MON.bat && MON.bat.habit && savedBat !== null) MON.bat.habit.sight = savedBat;

        radiusOutOfRangeState: radiusHit, allGuardState: allGuardNoChase, chaseCapableKinds: chaseCapable
      });
  })();

  /* ── H. D-55 指引 / D-39 潜行判据不回归 ───────────────────── */
  (function () {
    var reached = 0, bad = [];
    for (var seed = 1001; seed <= 1005; seed++) {
      var npc = gen(seed);
      if (!npc) { bad.push({ seed: seed, why: 'no npc' }); continue; }

        P.x = nx; P.y = ny;
        NQ.checkPosition(nx, ny);
        steps++;
      }
      if (ok && steps < 800) reached++;

      for (var i = 0; i < A.runs.s1.length; i++) {

        if (!e || e.active + e.forced !== e.battles) activeBad.push({ i: i, e: e });
      }
      stealthOk = activeBad.length === 0;

    rec('H_d55_d39_no_regression', reached === 5 && bad.length === 0 && stealthOk,
      {
        rule: '5 个种子只按 D-55 指引走必须到达 NPC 相邻格；D-58 之后的 S1 50 局每局 active+forced=battles（D-39 判据：怪物格当障碍，绕不过才撞）',
        reached: reached + '/5', bad: bad.slice(0, 5),
        s1ActiveViolations: activeBad.slice(0, 3)
      });
  })();

  var ok = true;
  var names = Object.keys(out.sub);
  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) ok = ok && out.sub[names[i]].ok;
  out.ok = ok && window.__D58ERR.length === 0;
  out.errs = window.__D58ERR;

    a = a | 0;
    return function () {
      a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
      var t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

              if (d <= sightOf(ens[e].monsterId) && AI.canSee(ens[e].x, ens[e].y, x, y, grid)) n++;
            }
            for (var p = 0; p < pats.length; p++) {
              if (kindOf(pats[p].monsterId) === 'guard') continue;
              var dp = Math.abs(pats[p].x - x) + Math.abs(pats[p].y - y);
              if (dp <= sightOf(pats[p].monsterId) && AI.canSee(pats[p].x, pats[p].y, x, y, grid)) n++;
            }
            if (n > bestN) { bestN = n; best = { x: x, y: y }; }
          }
        }
        if (!best) continue;
        peakMax = Math.max(peakMax, bestN);
        peakSum += bestN;
        peakHist[bestN] = (peakHist[bestN] || 0) + 1;

        var snapE = [], snapP = [], q;
        for (q = 0; q < ens.length; q++) snapE.push({ x: ens[q].x, y: ens[q].y, frame: ens[q].frame, rest: ens[q].rest });
        for (q = 0; q < pats.length; q++) snapP.push({ x: pats[q].x, y: pats[q].y, frame: pats[q].frame, rest: pats[q].rest });
        function restore() {
          for (var a = 0; a < ens.length; a++) { ens[a].x = snapE[a].x; ens[a].y = snapE[a].y; ens[a].frame = 3; ens[a].rest = 0; }
          for (var b = 0; b < pats.length; b++) { pats[b].x = snapP[b].x; pats[b].y = snapP[b].y; pats[b].frame = 3; pats[b].rest = 0; }
        }
        function bench(n, hideEnemies) {
          var origGet = Map.getEnemies;
          if (hideEnemies) Map.getEnemies = function () { return []; };
          var total = 0, cnt = 0;
          AI.resetStats();
          withSilentEncounters(function () {
            for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) {
              restore();
              var t0 = performance.now();
              AI.tick(best);
              total += performance.now() - t0;
              cnt++;
            }
          });
          var st = AI.stats();
          Map.getEnemies = origGet;
          return { ms: total, n: cnt, ent: st.entities, seen: st.seen, moves: st.moves, astar: st.astar };
        }
        var full = bench(60, false);
        var base = bench(60, true);
        fullMs += full.ms; baseMs += base.ms; ticks += full.n;
        fullEnt += full.ent; baseEnt += base.ent;
        fullAstar += full.astar; baseAstar += base.astar;
        fullMoves += full.moves; baseMoves += base.moves;
      }
    }
    var msFull = ticks ? fullMs / ticks : 0;
    var msBase = ticks ? baseMs / ticks : 0;
    var perFrame = msFull * (16.7 / 120);
    var keep120 = msFull < 4;
    rec('D_performance', ticks > 0 && msFull >= 0 && perFrame < 4, {
      rule: '10 种子×5 层，玩家站在"最多怪能同时看见"的格，每层 60 次 tick（每次强制重规划）。要求最坏 tick <4ms、单帧分摊 <4ms',
      floors: floors, ticks: ticks,
      worstCellPeakSeers: peakMax, avgPeakSeers: Math.round(peakSum / floors * 100) / 100,
      peakSeerHistogram: peakHist,
      fullMsPerTick: Math.round(msFull * 1000) / 1000,
      patrolOnlyMsPerTick: Math.round(msBase * 1000) / 1000,
      amortizedMsPerFrame: Math.round(perFrame * 1000) / 1000,
      entitiesPerTickFull: Math.round(fullEnt / ticks * 100) / 100,
      entitiesPerTickPatrolOnly: Math.round(baseEnt / ticks * 100) / 100,
      astarPerTickFull: Math.round(fullAstar / ticks * 100) / 100,
      astarPerTickPatrolOnly: Math.round(baseAstar / ticks * 100) / 100,
      movesPerTickFull: Math.round(fullMoves / ticks * 100) / 100,
      movesPerTickPatrolOnly: Math.round(baseMoves / ticks * 100) / 100,
      tickIntervalMs: 120, keep120ms: keep120,
      decision: keep120 ? '保持 120ms，不降频（最坏 tick 仍远小于预算）' : '需要降频/分批（超过预算，见数据）'
    });
  })();

  /* ── E. 四策略 1001–1050：D-58 → D-59 前后对照 ──────────── */
  (function () {
    var B = readJson('selfcheck/d58-after.json');
    var A = readJson('selfcheck/d59-after.json');
    if (!B || !A || !B.runs || !A.runs) {
      rec('E_strategy_delta', false, { rule: '读取 d58-after.json / d59-after.json', bad: ['缺少跑局产物'] });
      return;
    }
    var strat = ['b1', 'g2', 's1', 'm1'], bad = [], wins = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < strat.length; i++) {
      var k = strat[i];
      if (!B.runs[k] || !A.runs[k] || B.runs[k].length !== 50 || A.runs[k].length !== 50) {
        bad.push(k + ' 不是 50 局');
      } else {
        wins[k] = { before: B.summary[k].win, after: A.summary[k].win };
      }
    }
    var invOk = true, activeAfter = 0;
    for (var r = 0; r < 50; r++) {
      var e = A.runs.s1[r] && A.runs.s1[r].s1enc;
      if (e) {
        activeAfter += e.active;
        if (e.active + e.forced !== e.battles) { invOk = false; bad.push('s1 run ' + r + ' active+forced≠battles'); }
      }
    }
    var perFloor = {
      b1: { reach: { before: B.agg.b1.floorReach, after: A.agg.b1.floorReach },
        death: { before: B.agg.b1.deathFloor, after: A.agg.b1.deathFloor } },
      g2: { reach: { before: B.agg.g2.floorReach, after: A.agg.g2.floorReach },
        death: { before: B.agg.g2.deathFloor, after: A.agg.g2.deathFloor } },
      s1: { reach: { before: B.agg.s1.floorReach, after: A.agg.s1.floorReach },
        death: { before: B.agg.s1.deathFloor, after: A.agg.s1.deathFloor } },
      m1: { reach: { before: B.agg.m1.floorReach, after: A.agg.m1.floorReach },
        death: { before: B.agg.m1.deathFloor, after: A.agg.m1.deathFloor } }
    };
    rec('E_strategy_delta', bad.length === 0 && invOk && B.summary.b1.win === 12, {
      rule: '四策略各 50 局；改前必须是 D-58 的 B1=12；S1 每局 active+forced=battles（D-39 判据不变；active 只算"计划踩怪"，怪走进计划空格记为 race 并入 forced）',
      wins: wins, perFloor: perFloor, s1ActiveTotalAfter: activeAfter,
      s1Encounters: {
        battles: { before: sum(B.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'battles'), after: sum(A.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'battles') },
        forced: { before: sum(B.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'forced'), after: sum(A.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'forced') },
        byPatrol: { before: sum(B.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'byPatrol'), after: sum(A.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'byPatrol') },
        active: { before: sum(B.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'active'), after: sum(A.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'active') },
        race: { before: sum(B.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'race'), after: sum(A.runs.s1, 's1enc', 'race') }
      },
      bad: bad
    });
    function sum(runs, key, field) {
      var s = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
        var o = runs[i][key];
        if (o && typeof o[field] === 'number') s += o[field];
      }
      return s;
    }
  })();

  /* ── F. 负例：全 chase/8 与全 guard 都必须判 FAIL ─────────── */
  (function () {
    var seeds = [];
    for (var s = 1001; s <= 1050; s++) seeds.push(s);
    var ids = Object.keys(MON);
    var saved = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) saved[ids[i]] = MON[ids[i]].habit;

    function measure() {
      var mobile = 0, total = 0, guardTypes = 0, peak = 0;
      for (var k = 0; k < ids.length; k++) {
        var h = MON[ids[k]].habit;
        if (!h) continue;
        total++;
        if (h.kind === 'guard') guardTypes++; else mobile++;
      }
      for (var si = 0; si < seeds.length; si++) {
        gen(seeds[si]);
        for (var f = 1; f <= 5; f++) {
          seedFloor(seeds[si], f);
          var grid = Map.getGrid(), ens = (Map.getEnemies() || []).slice();
          var pats = (AI.getPatrols() || []).slice();
          for (var y = 1; y < grid.length - 1; y += 2) {
            for (var x = 1; x < grid[0].length - 1; x += 2) {
              if (grid[y][x] === 0) continue;
              var n = 0;
              for (var e = 0; e < ens.length; e++) {
                if (kindOf(ens[e].monsterId) === 'guard') continue;
                var d = Math.abs(ens[e].x - x) + Math.abs(ens[e].y - y);
                if (d <= sightOf(ens[e].monsterId) && AI.canSee(ens[e].x, ens[e].y, x, y, grid)) n++;
              }
              for (var p = 0; p < pats.length; p++) {
                if (kindOf(pats[p].monsterId) === 'guard') continue;
                var dp = Math.abs(pats[p].x - x) + Math.abs(pats[p].y - y);
                if (dp <= sightOf(pats[p].monsterId) && AI.canSee(pats[p].x, pats[p].y, x, y, grid)) n++;
              }
              if (n > peak) peak = n;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      return { mobileShare: mobile / (total || 1), guardTypes: guardTypes, peakSeers: peak };
    }
    function gate(m) {
      return m.mobileShare >= 0.35 && m.mobileShare <= 0.85 && m.guardTypes >= 1 && m.peakSeers <= 8;
    }
    var real = measure();
    for (var a = 0; a < ids.length; a++) if (MON[ids[a]].habit) MON[ids[a]].habit = { kind: 'chase', sight: 8, label: '追击' };
    var allChase = measure();
    for (var b = 0; b < ids.length; b++) if (MON[ids[b]].habit) MON[ids[b]].habit = { kind: 'guard', sight: 3, label: '守卫' };
    var allGuard = measure();
    for (var c = 0; c < ids.length; c++) if (saved[ids[c]]) MON[ids[c]].habit = saved[ids[c]];
    rec('F_negatives_fail', gate(real) && !gate(allChase) && !gate(allGuard), {
      rule: '平衡闸门：会追的种类占比 35%–85%、至少 1 类不追、同时可见峰值 ≤8。真实配置必须 PASS；全 chase/8 与全 guard 必须 FAIL',
      real: real, allChase8: allChase, allGuard: allGuard,
      gateReal: gate(real), gateAllChase: gate(allChase), gateAllGuard: gate(allGuard)
    });
  })();

  /* ── G. D-55 指引 / D-57 朝向 / D-58 习性表不回归 ────────── */
  (function () {
    var reached = 0, bad = [];
    for (var seed = 1001; seed <= 1005; seed++) {
      var npc = gen(seed);
      if (!npc) { bad.push({ seed: seed, why: 'no npc' }); continue; }
      NQ.accept(NPC_ID);
      var steps = 0, ok = true;
      while (steps < 800) {
        var gd = NQ.guidance();
        if (!gd) { ok = false; bad.push({ seed: seed, why: 'guidance null' }); break; }
        var cheb = Math.max(Math.abs(P.x - npc.x), Math.abs(P.y - npc.y));
        if (cheb <= 1) break;
        var nx = P.x + gd.dir.dx, ny = P.y + gd.dir.dy;
        var t = Map.tileAt(nx, ny);
        var total = (Game.Data.MAPS && Game.Data.MAPS.floors) || 5;
        var tele = (t === 2 && P.floor < total) || (t === 3 && P.floor > 1);
        if (t === 0 || tele) { ok = false; bad.push({ seed: seed, why: 'illegal step' }); break; }
        P.x = nx; P.y = ny;
        NQ.checkPosition(nx, ny);
        steps++;
      }
      if (ok && steps < 800) reached++;
    }
    var fl = R && R.playerFrameState ? R.playerFrameState({ facing: 'left' }, true) : null;
    var fr = R && R.playerFrameState ? R.playerFrameState({ facing: 'right' }, true) : null;
    var facingOk = !!(fl && fr && fl.flip === true && fr.flip === false && fl.frame === fr.frame && fl.frame === 'knight_m_run');

    var md = readDoc('../docs/平衡定档.md');
    var a = md.indexOf('## 附录A 怪物习性');
    var b = md.indexOf('\n## ', a + 1);
    var sec = a >= 0 ? md.slice(a, b < 0 ? md.length : b) : '';
    var rows = [], lines = sec.split(/\r?\n/);
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      if (!/^\|/.test(lines[i])) continue;
      var c = lines[i].split('|');
      if (c.length < 5) continue;
      var name = c[1].trim(), km = /(guard|patrol|chase)/.exec(c[2]), sight = Number(c[3].trim());
      if (km && isFinite(sight)) rows.push({ name: name, kind: km[1], sight: sight });
    }
    var byName = {}, mism = [], ids = Object.keys(MON);
    for (var m = 0; m < ids.length; m++) byName[MON[ids[m]].name] = MON[ids[m]].habit;
    for (var r2 = 0; r2 < rows.length; r2++) {
      var h = byName[rows[r2].name];
      if (!h || h.kind !== rows[r2].kind || h.sight !== rows[r2].sight) mism.push(rows[r2]);
    }
    rec('G_old_features', reached === 5 && bad.length === 0 && facingOk && rows.length === ids.length && mism.length === 0, {
      rule: 'D-55 指引 5 种子必须到达；D-57 左翻转/右不翻；D-58 文档 18 行与数据逐条一致',
      guidanceReached: reached + '/5', guidanceBad: bad.slice(0, 5),
      facing: { left: fl, right: fr }, docRows: rows.length, docMismatch: mism.slice(0, 5)
    });
  })();

  var ok = true;
  var names = Object.keys(out.sub);
  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) ok = ok && out.sub[names[i]].ok;
  out.ok = ok && window.__D59ERR.length === 0;
  out.errs = window.__D59ERR;
  var text = (out.ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out);
  document.title = text;
  document.getElementById('result').textContent = text;
})();

(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { ok: true, sub: {} };
  function rec(name, ok, d) {
    out.sub[name] = { ok: !!ok, d: d };
    if (!ok) out.ok = false;
  }
  window.__D60ERR = [];
  window.addEventListener('error', function (e) {
    window.__D60ERR.push(String(e.message || e));
    var el = document.getElementById('result');
    if (el) el.textContent = 'ERR ' + (e.message || e) + ' @' + (e.lineno || '?');
  });
  function readDoc(rel) {
    try {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('GET', rel, false);
      x.send(null);
      if (x.status >= 400) return null;
      return x.responseText;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  function readJson(rel) {
    var t = readDoc(rel);
    if (t === null) return null;
    try { return JSON.parse(t.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  /* 旧名不在源码里写死，避免扫描器扫到自己：
   * 运行时才拼出带空格 / 不带空格两种历史写法。 */
  var OLD_SP = 'AI 勇' + '者闯地牢';
  var OLD_NS = 'AI勇' + '者闯地牢';
  var NEW = '地牢回响';
  var DECL = '> 本卡成卡时项目名为《' + OLD_SP + '》，D-60 起更名为《' + NEW + '》。';

  /* ── A：全仓扫描 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   * 允许区只有两类：
   *   ① docs/tasks/ 下、首行正好是 DECL 的历史任务卡（正文按约定不改）；
   *   ② CHANGELOG.md 中排在 D-60 条目之后的历史条目。
   * 其余任何命中都进 violations。 */
  function scanText(rel, text) {
    var lines = String(text || '').split(/\r?\n/);
    var isTask = rel.indexOf('docs/tasks/') === 0 && lines[0] === DECL;
    var d60Line = -1;
    if (rel === 'CHANGELOG.md') {
      for (var k = 0; k < lines.length; k++) {
        if (lines[k].indexOf('更名（D-60）') >= 0) { d60Line = k; break; }
      }
    }
    var hits = [], allowed = [], bad = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      if (lines[i].indexOf(OLD_SP) < 0 && lines[i].indexOf(OLD_NS) < 0) continue;
      var h = { file: rel, line: i + 1, text: lines[i].replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '').slice(0, 120) };
      if (isTask) { h.why = 'task-card-declaration'; allowed.push(h); }
      else if (rel === 'CHANGELOG.md' && d60Line >= 0 && i > d60Line) { h.why = 'changelog-history'; allowed.push(h); }
      else { h.why = 'violation'; bad.push(h); }
      hits.push(h);
    }
    return { hits: hits, allowed: allowed, bad: bad };
  }

  var hits = [], allowed = [], bad = [], missing = [], done = 0, finished = false;
  function collect(rel, text) {
    if (text === null) { missing.push(rel); return; }
    var r = scanText(rel, text);
    for (var a = 0; a < r.allowed.length; a++) allowed.push(r.allowed[a]);
    for (var b = 0; b < r.bad.length; b++) bad.push(r.bad[b]);
    for (var h = 0; h < r.hits.length; h++) hits.push(r.hits[h]);
    done++;
  }

  /* 全仓语料：preflight/selfcheck/d60-corpus.ps1 在提交前把每个文本文件
   * 以「@@D60FILE@@ 路径」分段写成一份 3.6MB 语料。一次同步读取即可扫完，
   * 避免 300+ 次 file:// XHR 被 3500ms 虚拟预算截断。 */
  var scanT0 = Date.now();
  var corpus = readDoc('selfcheck/d60-corpus.txt');
  var corpusFiles = 0;
  if (corpus === null) {
    missing.push('preflight/selfcheck/d60-corpus.txt');
  } else {
    var blocks = corpus.split(/^@@D60FILE@@ /m);
    for (var bi = 1; bi < blocks.length; bi++) {
      var nl = blocks[bi].indexOf('\n');
      if (nl < 0) continue;
      var rel = blocks[bi].slice(0, nl).replace(/\r$/, '');
      collect(rel, blocks[bi].slice(nl + 1));
      corpusFiles++;
    }
  }

  /* 实时复核：13 个高危文件不依赖语料，改坏了当场能被抓住 */
  var LIVE = [
    'index.html', 'README.md', 'CHANGELOG.md',
    'js/core/render.js', 'js/data/dialogue.js', 'css/style.css',
    'docs/演示脚本.md', 'docs/运行说明.md', 'docs/答辩讲稿.md', 'docs/参考资料.md',
    'docs/process/诊断报告.md', 'preflight/_render_old.js',
    'docs/tasks/D-48-首屏与玩法说明.md'
  ];
  var liveBad = 0;
  for (var li = 0; li < LIVE.length; li++) {
    var before = bad.length;
    collect(LIVE[li], readDoc('../' + LIVE[li]));
    if (bad.length > before) liveBad += bad.length - before;
  }
  var scanMs = Date.now() - scanT0;
  finish();

  function finish() {
    if (finished) return;
    finished = true;
    rec('A_old_name_only_in_history', bad.length === 0 && missing.length === 0 &&
      allowed.length >= 2 && corpusFiles >= 300 && liveBad === 0, {
      corpusFiles: corpusFiles,
      liveFiles: LIVE.length,
      liveViolations: liveBad,
      scannedFiles: corpusFiles + LIVE.length,
      corpusBytes: corpus ? corpus.length : 0,
      scanMs: scanMs,
      manifest: 'preflight/selfcheck/d60-corpus.ps1 生成 d60-corpus.txt（md/html/js/css/ps1），另实时复核 13 个高危文件',

      if (typeof G.Systems.Quest.progress !== 'function') G.Systems.Quest.progress = function () {};

      var f_ok = (D.fireball.dmg(10) === 18) && (D.dash.dmg(10) === 12) &&

      sub.t8_shield = shOk;
      ok = ok && shOk;

      out.sub = sub;

      (pass ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out)));

        P.hp = 100; P.maxHp = 100; P.mp = 50; P.maxMp = 50;
        P.atk = 10; P.def = 5; P.gold = 0;
        P.inventory = {}; P.equipment = { weapon: null, armor: null };
        Inv.recalcEquip();
      }

      /* 2. 公式：D-41 起 L1–L4 为 15×level、L5+ 为 60×level
       * （expToNext(1)=15、(3)=45、(5)=300；旧曲线全程 60 见 D-41 文档） */
      sub.t2_formula = (B.expToNext(1) === 15) && (B.expToNext(3) === 45) &&
        (B.expToNext(5) === 300);
      ok = ok && sub.t2_formula;

      /* 3. 单次升级：L1 exp70 → 连升 2 级（15+30），L3 余 25，atk 12 / def 7 / maxHp 120 / hp 回满 / mp 回满 */
      resetP();
      P.exp = 70;
      var ups3 = B.checkLevelUp();
      sub.t3_level = (ups3 === 2) && P.level === 3 && P.exp === 25 &&
        P.atk === 12 && P.def === 7 && P.maxHp === 120 &&
        P.hp === 120 && P.mp === P.maxMp;
      ok = ok && sub.t3_level;

      /* 4. 连续升级：L1 exp300 → 消耗 15+30+45+60=150，L5 余 150（L5→L6 需 300，停在 5 级） */
      resetP();
      P.exp = 300;
      var ups4 = B.checkLevelUp();
      sub.t4_multi = (ups4 === 4) && P.level === 5 && P.exp === 150 &&
        P.atk === 14 && P.def === 9 && P.maxHp === 140 && P.hp === 140;
      ok = ok && sub.t4_multi;

      /* 5. 幂等：exp 不足时重复调用不升级、属性不变 */
      var ups5a = B.checkLevelUp();
      var ups5b = B.checkLevelUp();
      sub.t5_idem = (ups5a === 0) && (ups5b === 0) && P.level === 5 && P.atk === 14;
      ok = ok && sub.t5_idem;

      /* 6. 怪物表（P2-3b 数值上调后仍为 5 层 / 每层 3~5 种）：每层概率和=1、dragon 仅 F5；
       * 逐层期望强度单调递增（rate×(atk+hp/10)）。
       * P2-4 期望强度对比（P2-3b → P2-4）：F1/F2/F3 不变；
       *   F4 36.85（不变）、F5 44.075 → 44.1（dragon 移出普通表，权重 bz .35/necro .2/orc .2/angel .25）；
       *   全链 11.125 < 20.125 < 23.75 < 36.85 < 44.1 */
      var et = G.Data.MAPS.enemyTable;
      var M = G.Data.MONSTERS;
      function rateOf(row, id) {
        for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) if (row[i].id === id) return row[i].rate;
        return 0;
      }
      function rowSum(row) {
        var s = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) s += row[i].rate;
        return s;
      }
      function strength(row) {
        var s = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
          var m = M[row[i].id];
          s += row[i].rate * (m.atk + m.hp / 10);
        }
        return s;
      }
      function near(a, b) { return Math.abs(a - b) < 1e-6; }
      var s1 = strength(et[0]), s2 = strength(et[1]), s3 = strength(et[2]);
      var s4 = strength(et[3]), s5 = strength(et[4]);
      var sumsOk = true;
      for (var ri = 0; ri < et.length; ri++) if (!near(rowSum(et[ri]), 1)) sumsOk = false;
      sub.t6_table = (et.length === 5) && sumsOk &&
        rateOf(et[4], 'dragon') === 0 &&
        rateOf(et[0], 'dragon') === 0 && rateOf(et[1], 'dragon') === 0 &&
        rateOf(et[2], 'dragon') === 0 && rateOf(et[3], 'dragon') === 0 &&
        rateOf(et[0], 'slime') === 0.45 && rateOf(et[0], 'bat') === 0.3 &&
        rateOf(et[0], 'goblin') === 0.15 && rateOf(et[0], 'tiny_zombie') === 0.1 &&
        rateOf(et[1], 'bat') === 0.15 && rateOf(et[1], 'skeleton') === 0.3 &&
        rateOf(et[1], 'orc_warrior') === 0.3 && rateOf(et[1], 'orc_shaman') === 0.25 &&
        rateOf(et[2], 'skeleton') === 0.3 && rateOf(et[2], 'ogre') === 0.25 &&
        rateOf(et[2], 'wogol') === 0.2 && rateOf(et[2], 'imp') === 0.25 &&
        rateOf(et[3], 'big_zombie') === 0.2 && rateOf(et[3], 'necromancer') === 0.2 &&
        rateOf(et[3], 'pumpkin_dude') === 0.15 && rateOf(et[3], 'masked_orc') === 0.3 &&
        rateOf(et[3], 'skeleton') === 0.15 &&
        rateOf(et[4], 'big_zombie') === 0.35 && rateOf(et[4], 'necromancer') === 0.2 &&
        rateOf(et[4], 'masked_orc') === 0.2 && rateOf(et[4], 'angel') === 0.25 &&
        near(s1, 11.125) && near(s2, 20.125) && near(s3, 23.75) &&
        near(s4, 36.85) && near(s5, 44.1) &&
        s1 < s2 && s2 < s3 && s3 < s4 && s4 < s5;
      ok = ok && sub.t6_table;

      /* 7. 不刷可通关（5 层数值模拟，期望经验累计）：
       * 每层按实际怪物数（F1=5/F2=7/F3=9/F4=11）与期望经验：
       *   F1 59 / F2 184 / F3 273 / F4 458；F5 dragon 前保守 4 只（非龙均 45.75 → 183）；
       * 支线奖励 kill_slimes 20 + gold_rich 30。
       * D-41 曲线（L1–L4 15×level、L5+ 60×level）下累计 1207 → F1 后 L3、F2 后 L5、F4 后 L7；
       * 断言 F5 前等级≥5、atk（L7 基础 16 + sword_dragon 8 = 24）、对狂暴 dragon(def10) 单回合伤害≥10 */
      resetP();
      function gain(exp) { P.exp += exp; B.checkLevelUp(); }
      gain(59);  /* F1 5 只期望经验 */
      var afterF1 = P.level;
      gain(20);  /* 支线 kill_slimes */
      gain(184); /* F2 7 只 */
      var afterF2 = P.level;
      gain(30);  /* 支线 gold_rich */
      gain(273); /* F3 9 只 */
      gain(458); /* F4 11 只 */
      var afterF4 = P.level;
      gain(183); /* F5 dragon 前 4 只（保守口径） */
      var beforeDragon = P.level;
      P.inventory.sword_dragon = 1;
      P.equipment.weapon = 'sword_dragon';
      Inv.recalcEquip();
      var enrageDef = Math.round(M.dragon.def * M.dragon.enrage.defMul);
      var perTurn = Math.max(P.atk - enrageDef, 1);
      sub.t7_nogrind = afterF1 >= 1 && afterF2 >= 3 && afterF4 >= 5 && beforeDragon >= 5 &&
        P.level >= 5 && P.atk >= 21 && perTurn >= 10;
      ok = ok && sub.t7_nogrind;

      /* 8. 读档重算：旧档 {level:5, atk/def/maxHp:999} load 后 atk===14、def===9、maxHp===140（不信任旧值） */
      G.Systems.Map = {
        getFloor: function () { return 1; },
        changeFloor: function () { /* no-op */ },
        getSpawn: function () { return { x: 1, y: 1 }; }
      };
      var legacy = {
        savedAt: 'legacy', floor: 1,
        player: { hp: 80, maxHp: 999, atk: 999, def: 999, mp: 50, maxMp: 50,
          gold: 10, exp: 0, level: 5, inventory: {}, equipment: { weapon: null, armor: null }, quests: {} }
      };
      var loaded = null, recalcOk = true;
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1', JSON.stringify(legacy));
        loaded = G.Systems.Save.load();
      } catch (e) { recalcOk = false; }
      var lv5Atk = 10 + (5 - 1), lv5Def = 5 + (5 - 1), lv5Hp = 100 + (5 - 1) * 10;
      sub.t8_recalc = recalcOk && !!loaded && P.level === 5 &&
        P.atk === lv5Atk && P.def === lv5Def && P.maxHp === lv5Hp && P.hp === 80;
      ok = ok && sub.t8_recalc;
      try { localStorage.removeItem('ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1'); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

      /* 9. HUD 数据含 exp/expNext；绘制路径（常规 + 窄窗口）不抛错 */
      var hudData = Hud.update({
        hp: 100, hpMax: 110, mp: 50, mpMax: 50, gold: 120, floor: 3, kills: 2, killTarget: 5,
        level: 3, exp: 60, expNext: 180
      });
      sub.t9_hudData = !!hudData && hudData.level === 3 && hudData.exp === 60 && hudData.expNext === 180;
      var drawOk = true;
      try {
        R.init(document.getElementById('game'));
        Hud.draw();            /* 常规宽度 */
        R.cssW = 400; R.cssH = 400;
        Hud.draw();            /* 窄窗口紧凑路径（经验文本自动缩短/省略） */
      } catch (e2) { drawOk = false; }
      sub.t9_hudDraw = drawOk;
      ok = ok && sub.t9_hudData && sub.t9_hudDraw;

      /* 10. quest 完成奖励 exp 后触发升级：L1 exp40 + 史莱姆支线 20 → 60
       * D-41 曲线下 60 = 15+30+15 → L3 余 15（L4 需 45） */
      resetP();
      P.exp = 40;
      P.quests = {};
      G.Systems.Quest.init();
      for (var qi = 0; qi < 5; qi++) G.Systems.Quest.progress('kill', 'slime');
      sub.t10_quest = P.level === 3 && P.exp === 15 &&
        !!(P.quests.kill_slimes && P.quests.kill_slimes.done);
      ok = ok && sub.t10_quest;

      /* 11. settleWin 加 exp 后触发升级：L1 exp50 + 史莱姆 10 → 60 → 同 t10：L3 余 15、atk 12 */
      resetP();
      P.exp = 50;
      P.quests = {};
      G.Systems.Quest.init();
      B.start('slime');
      P.atk = 1000; /* 一击必杀，确保进入 settleWin */
      B.playerAction('attack');
      sub.t11_battle = P.level === 3 && P.exp === 15 && P.atk === 12;
      ok = ok && sub.t11_battle;

      /* 12. 重复调用不抛错、不重复升级 */
      var repOk = true;
      try {
        for (var t = 0; t < 50; t++) B.checkLevelUp();
      } catch (e3) { repOk = false; }
      sub.t12_repeat = repOk && P.level === 3 && P.exp === 15;
      ok = ok && repOk;

      out.sub = sub;
      out.curveOk = ok;
    }

    var pass = out.curveLoaded && out.curveApi && out.curveOk;
    document.title = (pass ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out);
    document.body.appendChild(document.createTextNode(
      (pass ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out)));
  } catch (e) {
    out.err = String(e && e.stack ? e.stack : e);
    document.title = 'FAIL ' + JSON.stringify(out);
    document.body.appendChild(document.createTextNode('FAIL ' + JSON.stringify(out)));
  }
})();

(function () {
  var out = { mapDetailLoaded: false, detailApi: false, detailOk: false, err: null };
  try {
    var cv = document.getElementById('game');
    Game.Core.Render.init(cv);

    /* 1. 数据与模块加载 */
    out.mapDetailLoaded = !!(window.Game && Game.Data && Game.Data.TILE_DETAILS &&
      Game.Data.DECOR && Game.Systems && Game.Systems.Map);
    if (out.mapDetailLoaded) {
      var M = Game.Systems.Map;
      out.detailApi = typeof M.generate === 'function' &&
        typeof M.getDetail === 'function' &&
        typeof M.getDecor === 'function' &&
        typeof M.takeDecor === 'function' &&
        typeof M.tileAt === 'function' &&
        typeof M.isWalkable === 'function';
    }

    if (out.mapDetailLoaded && out.detailApi) {
      var M = Game.Systems.Map;
      var ok = true;
      var sub = {};

      /* 2. generate 后 details/decor 字段通过接口可取，且抽样有细节/装饰 */
      M.generate();
      var grid = M.getGrid();
      var w = grid[0].length, h = grid.length;
      var detailCount = 0, decorCount = 0;
      for (var y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        for (var x = 0; x < w; x++) {
          if (M.getDetail(x, y)) detailCount++;
          if (M.getDecor(x, y)) decorCount++;
        }
      }
      sub.t2 = (detailCount >= 1) && (decorCount >= 1);
      ok = ok && sub.t2;

      /* 3. getDetail/getDecor 返回类型正确（字符串或 null） */
      var anyDetail = null, anyDecor = null;
      outer: for (y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        for (x = 0; x < w; x++) {
          var d = M.getDetail(x, y);
          if (d && !anyDetail) anyDetail = d;
          var dc = M.getDecor(x, y);
          if (dc && !anyDecor) anyDecor = dc;
          if (anyDetail && anyDecor) break outer;
        }
      }
      sub.t3 = (typeof anyDetail === 'string') && (typeof anyDecor === 'string');
      ok = ok && sub.t3;

      /* 4. 越界 getDetail/getDecor 返回 null */
      sub.t4 = (M.getDetail(-1, 0) === null) && (M.getDetail(w, 0) === null) &&
        (M.getDecor(0, -1) === null) && (M.getDecor(0, h) === null);
      ok = ok && sub.t4;

      /* 5. 细节/装饰格 getAt 通行语义不变：墙仍是墙(tile=0)、地板仍可走(tile=1) */
      var walkOk = true;
      for (y = 0; y < h && walkOk; y++) {
        for (x = 0; x < w; x++) {
          var t = M.tileAt(x, y);
          var walk = M.isWalkable(x, y);
          if (t === 0 && walk) { walkOk = false; break; }
          if (t === 1 && !walk) { walkOk = false; break; }
        }
      }
      sub.t5 = walkOk;
      ok = ok && sub.t5;

      var chestPos = null;
      outer2: for (y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        for (x = 0; x < w; x++) {
          if (M.getDecor(x, y) === 'chest') { chestPos = { x: x, y: y }; break outer2; }
        }
      }

        if (!Game.Data.Player) Game.Data.Player = { gold: 0, inventory: {} };
        var r1 = M.takeDecor(chestPos.x, chestPos.y);
        var r2 = M.takeDecor(chestPos.x, chestPos.y); /* 二次拾取应失败 */
        var r3 = M.takeDecor(0, 0); /* 非宝箱格失败 */
        takeOk = (r1 === true) && (r2 === false) && (r3 === false);
      }
      sub.t6 = takeOk;
      ok = ok && sub.t6;

      var ctx = Game.Core.Render._ctx;
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
      Game.Core.Render.drawMap(grid, { x: 1, y: 1 });
      /* 画面中应有非背景色像素（细节/装饰/地板） */

      var nonBg = 0;

(function () {
  var out = { lightLoaded: false, lightApi: false, lightOk: false, err: null };
  try {
    var cv = document.getElementById('game');
    Game.Core.Render.init(cv);
    var ctx = Game.Core.Render._ctx;

    /* 1. 模块加载与接口齐备 */
    out.lightLoaded = !!(window.Game && Game.Lighting);
    if (out.lightLoaded) {
      var L = Game.Lighting;
      out.lightApi = (typeof L.init === 'function') &&
        (typeof L.draw === 'function') &&
        (typeof L.setRadius === 'function');
    }

    if (out.lightLoaded && out.lightApi) {
      var M = Game.Systems.Map;
      var ok = true;
      var sub = {};

      /* 2. 生成地图 + 初始化照明 + 设置 FOV */
      M.generate();
      var grid = M.getGrid();
      var w = grid[0].length, h = grid.length;
      Game.Lighting.init();

      /* 找一个火把格，并把玩家放到它附近可走格上（确保火把可见） */
      var torchPos = null, playerPos = null;
      outer: for (var ty = 1; ty < h - 1; ty++) {
        for (var tx = 1; tx < w - 1; tx++) {
          if (M.getDecor(tx, ty) === 'torch') {
            torchPos = { x: tx, y: ty };
            /* 找相邻可走格作为玩家落点 */
            var nb = [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]];
            for (var ni = 0; ni < nb.length; ni++) {
              var nx = tx + nb[ni][0], ny = ty + nb[ni][1];
              if (M.isWalkable(nx, ny)) { playerPos = { x: nx, y: ny }; break; }
            }
            if (playerPos) break outer;
          }
        }
      }
      if (!playerPos) playerPos = M.getSpawn();
      if (!torchPos) torchPos = playerPos; /* 兜底：无火把时用玩家位置，光晕测试降级通过 */

      /* FOV：以玩家为中心重算可见区 */
      function isBlocked(x, y) { return !M.isWalkable(x, y); }
      Game.fov.update(playerPos.x, playerPos.y, 5, isBlocked);

      /* 画一帧地图（render.drawMap 内部会调 Lighting.draw） */
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
      Game.Core.Render.drawMap(grid, playerPos);

      var TILE = Game.Core.Render.TILE;
      var cam = Game.Core.Render._getCam();

      /* 3. 火把光晕：可见火把格中心像素 alpha > 0（光晕落笔，暖橙通道偏高） */
      var torchVis = Game.fov.isVisible(torchPos.x, torchPos.y);
      var tcx = torchPos.x * TILE - cam.x + TILE / 2;
      var tcy = torchPos.y * TILE - cam.y + TILE / 2;
      var tpx = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(cv.width - 1, tcx)));
      var tpy = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(cv.height - 1, tcy)));
      var td = ctx.getImageData(tpx, tpy, 1, 1).data;
      /* 暖橙光晕：R 通道应明显高于背景（背景 #14142a → R=20），且 R > B */
      var glowOk = torchVis ? (td[0] > 30 && td[0] > td[2]) : true; /* 不可见则不要求光晕 */
      sub.t3_torchGlow = glowOk;
      ok = ok && glowOk;

      /* 4. 软边：同一格在【无照明帧】与【有照明帧】之间对比（排除 torch 光晕区干扰）
       *    边缘可见格（有不可见邻居）应被软边压暗（亮度下降）；
       *    中心可见格（邻居全可见）无软边覆盖，亮度基本不变。
       *    torch 光晕会加亮邻域（lighter 加色），故采样格避开距任何可见 torch <3 格的区域；
       *    细节 tile（M9-1）在同格两帧间不变，不引入偏差；暗角对同格两帧贡献相同。
       */
      var torchList = [];
      for (var lt = 1; lt < h - 1; lt++) {
        for (var lx = 1; lx < w - 1; lx++) {
          if (M.getDecor(lx, lt) === 'torch' && Game.fov.isVisible(lx, lt)) torchList.push({ x: lx, y: lt });
        }
      }
      function torchDist(x, y) {
        var best = 999;
        for (var ti = 0; ti < torchList.length; ti++) {
          var d = Math.max(Math.abs(x - torchList[ti].x), Math.abs(y - torchList[ti].y));
          if (d < best) best = d;
        }
        return best;
      }
      var edgeTiles = [], centerTiles = [];
      /* 采样窗口覆盖整个 FOV（半径 5），并排除 torch 光晕加亮区（半径 2）；
       * 小房间/贴墙布局下仍能取到远离 torch 的 FOV 边界格 */
      for (var ey = Math.max(1, playerPos.y - 5); ey < Math.min(h - 1, playerPos.y + 6); ey++) {
        for (var ex = Math.max(1, playerPos.x - 5); ex < Math.min(w - 1, playerPos.x + 6); ex++) {
          if (!Game.fov.isVisible(ex, ey)) continue;
          if (torchDist(ex, ey) < 2) continue; /* 避开火把光晕加亮区 */
          var nonVis = 0;
          if (!Game.fov.isVisible(ex - 1, ey)) nonVis++;
          if (!Game.fov.isVisible(ex + 1, ey)) nonVis++;
          if (!Game.fov.isVisible(ex, ey - 1)) nonVis++;
          if (!Game.fov.isVisible(ex, ey + 1)) nonVis++;
          if (nonVis === 0) centerTiles.push({ x: ex, y: ey });
          else edgeTiles.push({ x: ex, y: ey });
        }
      }
      function tileBrightAt(tx, ty, cam_, TILE_) {
        var px = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(cv.width - 1, tx * TILE_ - cam_.x + TILE_ / 2)));
        var py = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(cv.height - 1, ty * TILE_ - cam_.y + TILE_ / 2)));
        var p = ctx.getImageData(px, py, 1, 1).data;
        return p[0] + p[1] + p[2];
      }
      /* 帧 A：无照明（临时禁用 Lighting.draw + 屏蔽 torch：软边断言不受光晕加亮干扰） */
      var origGetDecor = M.getDecor;
      M.getDecor = function () { return null; };
      var origLightDraw = Game.Lighting.draw;
      Game.Lighting.draw = function () {};
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
      Game.Core.Render.drawMap(grid, playerPos);
      var eA = 0, cA = 0;
      for (var ei = 0; ei < edgeTiles.length; ei++) eA += tileBrightAt(edgeTiles[ei].x, edgeTiles[ei].y, cam, TILE);
      for (var ci = 0; ci < centerTiles.length; ci++) cA += tileBrightAt(centerTiles[ci].x, centerTiles[ci].y, cam, TILE);
      /* 帧 B：恢复照明（仍无 torch 光晕），重画 */
      Game.Lighting.draw = origLightDraw;
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
      Game.Core.Render.drawMap(grid, playerPos);
      var eB = 0, cB = 0;
      for (var ei2 = 0; ei2 < edgeTiles.length; ei2++) eB += tileBrightAt(edgeTiles[ei2].x, edgeTiles[ei2].y, cam, TILE);
      for (var ci2 = 0; ci2 < centerTiles.length; ci2++) cB += tileBrightAt(centerTiles[ci2].x, centerTiles[ci2].y, cam, TILE);
      M.getDecor = origGetDecor;
      var eAvg = edgeTiles.length ? (eB - eA) / edgeTiles.length : 0;
      var cAvg = centerTiles.length ? (cB - cA) / centerTiles.length : 0;
      /* 软边断言只看边缘格压暗（eAvg 稳定 < -2）：屏蔽 torch 后，帧间差 = 软边 + 暗角，方向恒负。 */
      var softEdgeOk = (edgeTiles.length > 0) && (eAvg < -2);
      sub.t4_softEdge = softEdgeOk;

      /* 5. 暗角：以玩家屏幕位置（可见亮区）为参照，比较四角是否更暗
       *    地图可能比屏幕小，玩家不一定在画布中心，故用玩家实际屏幕坐标 */
      var pSx = Math.round(playerPos.x * TILE - cam.x + TILE / 2);
      var pSy = Math.round(playerPos.y * TILE - cam.y + TILE / 2);
      function brightAt(x, y) {
        x = Math.max(0, Math.min(cv.width - 1, x));
        y = Math.max(0, Math.min(cv.height - 1, y));
        var p = ctx.getImageData(x, y, 1, 1).data;
        return p[0] + p[1] + p[2];
      }
      /* 玩家周围 3 点均值（可见区，应较亮） */
      var cB = (brightAt(pSx, pSy) + brightAt(pSx + 8, pSy) + brightAt(pSx - 8, pSy)) / 3;
      /* 四角各采一点（暗角应压暗，或为地图外背景/未探索黑区） */
      var tl = brightAt(2, 2);
      var tr = brightAt(cv.width - 3, 2);
      var bl = brightAt(2, cv.height - 3);
      var br = brightAt(cv.width - 3, cv.height - 3);
      var minCorner = Math.min(tl, tr, bl, br);
      var vignetteOk = minCorner < cB;
      sub.t5_vignette = vignetteOk;
      ok = ok && vignetteOk;

      /* 6. 重复调用 draw 不抛错（性能稳定） */
      var repeatOk = true;
      try {
        for (var ri = 0; ri < 30; ri++) {
          Game.Lighting.draw();
        }
      } catch (e) { repeatOk = false; }
      sub.t6_repeatDraw = repeatOk;
      ok = ok && repeatOk;

      /* 7. setRadius 接口可用且不抛错 */
      var setRadiusOk = false;
      try {
        var r1 = Game.Lighting.setRadius(3);
        var r2 = Game.Lighting.setRadius(0);  /* 非法值应被钳制 */
        var r3 = Game.Lighting.setRadius('x'); /* 非法值应被忽略 */
        setRadiusOk = (r1 === 3) && (typeof r2 === 'number') && (typeof r3 === 'number');
      } catch (e) { setRadiusOk = false; }
      sub.t7_setRadius = setRadiusOk;
      ok = ok && setRadiusOk;

      out.sub = sub;
      out.found = { torch: !!torchPos, torchVisible: torchVis, edgeCount: edgeTiles.length, centerCount: centerTiles.length, eAvg: +eAvg.toFixed(2), cAvg: +cAvg.toFixed(2) };
      out.lightOk = ok;
    }

    var pass = out.lightLoaded && out.lightApi && out.lightOk;
    document.title = (pass ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out);
    document.body.appendChild(document.createTextNode(
      (pass ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out)));
  } catch (e) {
    out.err = String(e);
    document.title = 'FAIL ' + JSON.stringify(out);
    document.body.appendChild(document.createTextNode('FAIL ' + JSON.stringify(out)));
  }
})();
</script>

(function () {
  var out = { finLoaded: false, finApi: false, finOk: false, err: null };
  try {
    var ok = true;
    var sub = {};
    var cv = document.getElementById('game');

    /* 1. 模块加载与接口齐备 */
    out.finLoaded = !!(window.Game && Game.Core && Game.Core.Render && Game.Modal &&
      Game.Systems && Game.Systems.Inventory && Game.Systems.Quest &&
      Game.hud && Game.Core.Main && Game.Motion && Game.Particles);
    if (out.finLoaded) {
      var R = Game.Core.Render, M = Game.Modal, Main = Game.Core.Main;
      out.finApi = (typeof R.resize === 'function') &&
        (typeof R._applyDpr === 'function') &&
        (typeof R._isNarrow === 'function') &&
        (typeof R.drawMap === 'function') &&
        (typeof R.drawGuide === 'function') &&
        (typeof R.drawHUD === 'function') &&
        (typeof M.open === 'function') &&
        (typeof M.draw === 'function') &&
        (typeof M._gameoverStats === 'function') &&
        (typeof M._restart === 'function') &&
        (typeof Game.Systems.Inventory.list === 'function') &&
        (typeof Game.Systems.Quest.getActive === 'function') &&
        (typeof Game.hud.getKills === 'function') &&
        (typeof Main.needsGuide === 'function') &&
        (typeof Main.markGuided === 'function') &&
        (typeof Main.restart === 'function') &&
        (typeof Main.openGameOver === 'function') &&
        (typeof Main.getElapsedMs === 'function') &&
        (typeof Game.Motion.clear === 'function') &&
        (typeof Game.Particles.count === 'function');
    }

    if (out.finLoaded && out.finApi) {
      var R = Game.Core.Render, M = Game.Modal, Main = Game.Core.Main;

      /* 2. DPR + 自适应：注入 dpr=2 → 物理像素 = 窗口CSS*2，变换 = dpr*scale */
      R.init(cv);
      R.resize(2);
      var pxW = R.cssPxW;
      var sc2 = R.scale;
      var dpr2_width = (cv.width === Math.round(pxW * 2));
      var tr2 = cv.getContext('2d').getTransform ? cv.getContext('2d').getTransform() : null;
      var dpr2_transform = tr2 && Math.abs(tr2.a - 2 * sc2) < 0.001;
      sub.t2_dpr2 = dpr2_width && dpr2_transform && (R.dpr === 2);
      ok = ok && sub.t2_dpr2;
      sub.t2_scale = (sc2 >= 1 && sc2 <= 2) &&
        (Math.abs(R.cssW - pxW / sc2) < 0.01) && (Math.abs(R.cssH - R.cssPxH / sc2) < 0.01);
      ok = ok && sub.t2_scale;

      /* dpr=1 时宽度回到 CSS 像素，变换 = scale */
      R.resize(1);
      var dpr1_width = (cv.width === Math.round(pxW));
      var tr1 = cv.getContext('2d').getTransform ? cv.getContext('2d').getTransform() : null;
      var dpr1_transform = tr1 && Math.abs(tr1.a - R.scale) < 0.001;
      sub.t2_dpr1 = dpr1_width && dpr1_transform && (R.dpr === 1);
      ok = ok && sub.t2_dpr1;

      var stubGrid = [];
      for (var gy = 0; gy < 20; gy++) { stubGrid[gy] = []; for (var gx = 0; gx < 30; gx++) stubGrid[gy][gx] = 1; }
      Game.Systems = Game.Systems || {};
      Game.Systems.Map = {
        getDetail: function () { return null; },
        getDecor: function () { return null; },
        getEnemies: function () { return []; },
        getGrid: function () { return stubGrid; }
      };
      Game.Systems.AI = undefined;
      Game.fov = undefined;
      Game.Lighting = undefined;

      var narrowOk = true;
      try {
        var savedW = R.cssW, savedH = R.cssH;
        R.cssW = 400; R.cssH = 300;
        if (!R._isNarrow()) narrowOk = false;
        R.drawMap(stubGrid, { x: 1, y: 1 });
        R.drawPlayer({ x: 1, y: 1 });
        R.drawHUD({ fps: 60, atk: 10, def: 5 });
        R.drawGuide();
        R.cssW = savedW; R.cssH = savedH;
      } catch (e) { narrowOk = false; }
      sub.t3_narrow = narrowOk;
      ok = ok && narrowOk;

      var t0 = performance.now();
      for (var pi = 0; pi < 100; pi++) { R.drawMap(stubGrid, { x: 1, y: 1 }); }
      var avgMs = (performance.now() - t0) / 100;
      sub.t4_perf = (avgMs < 20);
      sub.t4_avgMs = Number(avgMs.toFixed(2));
      ok = ok && sub.t4_perf;

      /* 4b. 粒子/运动条目无累积泄漏（clear 后归零） */
      Game.Particles.enabled = true;
      Game.Particles.clear();
      Game.Particles.spawn('spark', 0, 0, { count: 30 });
      Game.Particles.update(5000); /* 远超生命，全部到期 */
      var leakParticles = (Game.Particles.count() === 0);
      Game.Motion.clear();
      Game.Motion.setStep('lk', 0, 0, 5, 5, 100);
      Game.Motion.update(200);
      Game.Motion.clear();

      ok = ok && sub.t4_leak;

      var P = Game.Data.Player;

      M._restart(); /* 触发 Main.restart（reset 逻辑） */

      ok = ok && sub.t5_gameover;

      try { localStorage.removeItem('aiDungeon_guided'); } catch (e) {}

      ok = ok && sub.t6_guide;

      out.sub = sub;
      out.finOk = ok;
    }

      (pass ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out)));

    document.title = 'FAIL ' + JSON.stringify(out);

  var rec = [];              /* drawImage 记录：{n:文件名, x, y, w, h} */
  var origDrawImage = ctx.drawImage;

  /* 记录每帧 drawImage 的贴图名与目标矩形，用于"可复现/无闪烁"断言。
   * 不依赖 getImageData：file:// 下 Canvas 被本地图片污染会抛 SecurityError。 */
  ctx.drawImage = function (img, dx, dy, dw, dh) {
    try {
      if (img && img.src) {
        rec.push({
          n: String(img.src).split('/').pop().replace(/\.png$/i, ''),
          x: Math.round(Number(dx) * 100) / 100,
          y: Math.round(Number(dy) * 100) / 100,
          w: Number(dw), h: Number(dh)
        });
      }
    } catch (e) { /* 记录失败不影响绘制 */ }
    return origDrawImage.apply(ctx, arguments);
  };

  function seq() {
    return rec.map(function (r) { return r.n + '@' + r.x + ',' + r.y + ',' + r.w + 'x' + r.h; }).join('|');
  }
  function imgNames() {
    var names = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < rec.length; i++) names[rec[i].n] = true;
    return Object.keys(names);
  }
  function hasPrefix(prefix) {
    var names = imgNames();
    for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
      if (names[i].indexOf(prefix) === 0) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function makeFloorGrid(n) {
    var g = [];
    for (var y = 0; y < n; y++) { g[y] = []; for (var x = 0; x < n; x++) g[y][x] = 1; }
    return g;
  }
  /* 12x12：四周墙 + 中央 3x3 墙块，可覆盖 wall_top_left/mid/right 与 wall_left/mid/right 全部路径 */
  function makeMixedGrid() {
    var n = 12, g = makeFloorGrid(n);
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      g[0][i] = 0; g[n - 1][i] = 0;
      g[i][0] = 0; g[i][n - 1] = 0;
    }
    for (var yy = 4; yy <= 6; yy++) for (var xx = 4; xx <= 6; xx++) g[yy][xx] = 0;
    g[2][2] = 2; /* 下行楼梯 */
    g[9][9] = 3; /* 上行楼梯 */
    return g;
  }

  function finish() {

    document.title = text;
    document.body.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text));
  }

      };
      Game.Systems.AI = undefined;

      Game.Lighting = undefined;
      Game.Particles = undefined;

      /* P1-2 起 drawMap 末尾的 HUD 会绘制 UI 贴图（心形/金币等）；本页断言"场景素材层"的

      if (Game.hud) Game.hud.draw = function () { };

      var floorNames = ['floor_1', 'floor_2', 'floor_3', 'floor_4', 'floor_5', 'floor_6', 'floor_7', 'floor_8'];

      var missingFloor = [];
      for (var fi = 0; fi < floorNames.length; fi++) {
        if (!S.get(floorNames[fi])) missingFloor.push(floorNames[fi]);

      sub.t2_floor = (missingFloor.length === 0);
      ok = ok && sub.t2_floor;

      var wallNeed = ['wall_mid', 'wall_left', 'wall_right', 'wall_top_mid'];

      var origReady = S.isReady, origGet = S.get, origGetFrame = S.getFrame;

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var out = { uiLoaded: false, uiApi: false, uiOk: false };
  var cv = document.getElementById('game');
  var ctx = cv.getContext('2d');

  /* 包装 drawImage/strokeRect/fillRect 记录绘制行为（避免 file:// 本地图片污染 getImageData） */
  var rec = [];          /* [{n,x,y,w,h}] 贴图绘制 */
  var strokeCount = 0;   /* strokeRect 调用次数（双层边框断言） */
  var goldFill = false;  /* 金色系 fillRect 是否出现（标题分隔线断言） */
  var origDrawImage = ctx.drawImage;
  var origStrokeRect = ctx.strokeRect;
  var origFillRect = ctx.fillRect;

  ctx.drawImage = function (img, dx, dy, dw, dh) {
    try {
      if (img && img.src) {
        rec.push({
          n: String(img.src).split('/').pop().replace(/\.png$/i, ''),
          x: Math.round(Number(dx) * 100) / 100,
          y: Math.round(Number(dy) * 100) / 100,
          w: Number(dw), h: Number(dh)
        });
      }
    } catch (e) { /* 记录失败不影响绘制 */ }
    return origDrawImage.apply(ctx, arguments);
  };
  ctx.strokeRect = function () {
    strokeCount++;
    return origStrokeRect.apply(ctx, arguments);
  };
  ctx.fillRect = function () {
    try {
      var fs = String(ctx.fillStyle || '');
      if (/255\s*,\s*207\s*,\s*110|ffcf6e/i.test(fs)) goldFill = true;
    } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
    return origFillRect.apply(ctx, arguments);
  };

  function seq() {
    return rec.map(function (r) { return r.n + '@' + r.x + ',' + r.y + ',' + r.w + 'x' + r.h; }).join('|');
  }
  function countImg(name) {
    var c = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < rec.length; i++) if (rec[i].n === name) c++;
    return c;
  }
  function hasImg(name) { return countImg(name) > 0; }

  function finish() {
    var pass = out.uiLoaded && out.uiApi && out.uiOk;
    var text = (pass ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out);
    document.title = text;
    document.body.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text));
  }

  function runTests() {
    var ok = true, sub = {};
    try {
      var R = Game.Core.Render, H = Game.hud, M = Game.Modal, S = Game.Core.Sprites;
      out.uiLoaded = !!(window.Game && Game.Core && R && H && M && S);
      out.uiApi = !!(typeof H.update === 'function' && typeof H.draw === 'function' &&
        typeof S.get === 'function' && typeof M.open === 'function' && typeof M.draw === 'function');

      if (!out.uiLoaded || !out.uiApi) { finish(); return; }

      R.init(cv);

      /* 桩掉弹窗数据源：构造 potion_small/sword_bone 的背包数据 */
      Game.Systems.Inventory.list = function () {
        return [{ id: 'potion_small', count: 1 }, { id: 'sword_bone', count: 1 }];
      };

      /* t2_hearts：hp=50/maxHp=100 → 2 full + 1 half + 2 empty = 5 颗 */
      rec = [];
      H.update({ hp: 50, hpMax: 100, mp: 50, mpMax: 50, gold: 21, floor: 1, level: 1 });
      var hDrawOk = true;
      try { H.draw(); } catch (e) { hDrawOk = false; }
      var nFull = countImg('ui_heart_full');
      var nHalf = countImg('ui_heart_half');
      var nEmpty = countImg('ui_heart_empty');
      sub.t2_hearts = hDrawOk && (nFull === 2) && (nHalf === 1) && (nEmpty === 2) && (nFull + nHalf + nEmpty === 5);
      ok = ok && sub.t2_hearts;
      /* t3_goldIcon / t4_mpIcon：同一帧内金币 coin、MP flask_blue 均落笔 */
      sub.t3_goldIcon = hasImg('coin');
      ok = ok && sub.t3_goldIcon;
      sub.t4_mpIcon = hasImg('flask_blue');
      ok = ok && sub.t4_mpIcon;

      /* t5_itemIcon：打开背包弹窗，行左出现 flask_red / weapon_rusty_sword */
      rec = []; strokeCount = 0; goldFill = false;
      var modalOk = true;
      try { M.open('inventory'); M.draw(); } catch (e) { modalOk = false; }
      sub.t5_itemIcon = modalOk && hasImg('flask_red') && hasImg('weapon_rusty_sword');
      ok = ok && sub.t5_itemIcon;

      /* t6_panel：双层边框（strokeRect≥2）+ 金色标题分隔线（fillRect 金色系） */
      sub.t6_panel = (strokeCount >= 2) && goldFill;
      ok = ok && sub.t6_panel;

      /* t9_idem：同参两次 draw 序列一致（HUD + 弹窗各两次） */
      var idemOk = true;
      rec = [];
      H.update({ hp: 50, hpMax: 100, mp: 50, mpMax: 50, gold: 21, floor: 1, level: 1 });
      try { H.draw(); } catch (e) { idemOk = false; }
      var h1 = seq();

(function () {
  var R = {}, A = {}, fail = [];
  var M = Game.Core.Main, Map = Game.Systems.Map, P = Game.Data.Player;
  var Input = Game.Core.Input, Bus = Game.Core.EventBus;

  function findTile(t) {
    var g = Map.getGrid();
    for (var y = 1; y < g.length - 1; y++) {
      for (var x = 1; x < g[0].length - 1; x++) if (g[y][x] === t) return { x: x, y: y };
    }
    return null;
  }
  function countDecor(id) {
    var g = Map.getGrid(), n = 0;
    for (var y = 1; y < g.length - 1; y++) {
      for (var x = 1; x < g[0].length - 1; x++) if (Map.getDecor(x, y) === id) n++;
    }
    return n;
  }
  function findDecor(id) {
    var g = Map.getGrid();
    for (var y = 1; y < g.length - 1; y++) {
      for (var x = 1; x < g[0].length - 1; x++) if (Map.getDecor(x, y) === id) return { x: x, y: y };
    }
    return null;
  }
  function countDragons() {
    var n = 0, i;
    var es = Map.getEnemies() || [];
    for (i = 0; i < es.length; i++) if (es[i].monsterId === 'dragon') n++;
    var ps = (Game.Systems.AI && Game.Systems.AI.getPatrols()) ? Game.Systems.AI.getPatrols() : [];
    for (i = 0; i < ps.length; i++) if (ps[i].monsterId === 'dragon') n++;
    return n;
  }
  function stepOnto(tile, t) {
    var s = findTile(tile);
    if (!s) return false;
    var offs = [[0, 1, 'KeyW'], [0, -1, 'KeyS'], [1, 0, 'KeyA'], [-1, 0, 'KeyD']];
    var f0 = Map.getFloor();
    for (var i = 0; i < offs.length; i++) {
      var nx = s.x + offs[i][0], ny = s.y + offs[i][1];
      if (Map.tileAt(nx, ny) !== 1) continue;
      P.x = nx; P.y = ny;
      Input.clear();
      Input.getState()[offs[i][2]] = true;
      M._updateExplore(t);
      delete Input.getState()[offs[i][2]];
      t += 300;
      if (Map.getFloor() !== f0) return true;
      if (Game.Modal && Game.Modal.isOpen()) Game.Modal.close();
    }
    return false;
  }
  function overflowOf(fn, width) {
    var ctx = Game.Core.Render._ctx;
    var orig = ctx.fillText, over = 0, maxRight = 0;
    ctx.fillText = function (str, x, y) {
      var w = ctx.measureText(String(str)).width;
      var right = x + w;
      if (right > width + 0.5 || x < -0.5) over++;
      if (right > maxRight) maxRight = right;
      return orig.apply(ctx, arguments);
    };
    try { fn(); } catch (e) { R.drawErr = e.message; } finally { ctx.fillText = orig; }
    return { over: over, maxRight: Math.round(maxRight) };
  }
  function check(name, ok, detail) {
    A[name] = !!ok;
    if (!ok) fail.push(name + '=' + JSON.stringify(detail));
  }

  try {
    localStorage.clear();
    localStorage.setItem('aiDungeon_guided', '1');
    M.init();

    /* P1-1 移动节流：合成 60 帧（≈1 秒）持续按 A，统计移动尝试次数 */
    Map.setFloor(1);
    P.x = 1; P.y = 1;
    if (Game.Systems.AI && Game.Systems.AI.getPatrols) Game.Systems.AI.getPatrols().length = 0;
    Map.getEnemies().length = 0;
    var walk = Map.isWalkable, moveTried = 0;
    Map.isWalkable = function (x, y) { moveTried++; return walk.call(Map, x, y); };
    Input.clear();
    Input.getState()['KeyA'] = true;
    for (var f = 0; f < 60; f++) M._updateExplore(f * 16.67);
    delete Input.getState()['KeyA'];
    Map.isWalkable = walk;
    R.moveSteps1s = moveTried;
    check('moveThrottle', moveTried >= 6 && moveTried <= 10, moveTried);

    /* P1-3 末层保底出龙（P2-3 起终层为 F5）：末层敌表临时改为 100% skeleton（最坏情况） */
    var tblLast = Game.Data.MAPS.enemyTable[4];
    Game.Data.MAPS.enemyTable[4] = [{ id: 'skeleton', rate: 1 }];
    Map.setFloor(5);
    R.dragonsFinalFloor = countDragons();
    R.enemiesFinalFloor = Map.getEnemies().length;
    Game.Data.MAPS.enemyTable[4] = tblLast;
    check('dragonGuarantee', R.dragonsFinalFloor >= 1 && R.enemiesFinalFloor === 13, R);

    /* P1-2 换层不回满 + 楼层快照：扣血、杀 1 怪、拿 1 宝箱后下楼再上楼 */
    Map.setFloor(1);
    P.hp = 30; P.mp = 5;
    Map.getEnemies().pop();
    var chest = findDecor('chest');
    if (chest) Map.takeDecor(chest.x, chest.y);
    R.chestsBefore = countDecor('chest');
    R.enemiesBefore = Map.getEnemies().length;
    var gridBefore = Map.getGrid();
    var t = 50000;
    R.downOk = stepOnto(2, t); t += 500;
    R.hpAfterDown = P.hp;
    R.floorAfterDown = Map.getFloor();
    R.upOk = stepOnto(3, t);
    R.hpAfterUp = P.hp;
    R.mpAfterUp = P.mp;
    R.floorAfterUp = Map.getFloor();
    R.gridSameAfterReturn = (Map.getGrid() === gridBefore);
    R.enemiesAfterReturn = Map.getEnemies().length;
    R.chestsAfterReturn = countDecor('chest');
    check('floorTransitions', R.downOk && R.upOk && R.floorAfterDown === 2 && R.floorAfterUp === 1, R);
    check('noHealOnFloorChange', R.hpAfterDown === 30 && R.hpAfterUp === 30 && R.mpAfterUp === 5, R);
    check('floorCache', R.gridSameAfterReturn && R.enemiesAfterReturn === R.enemiesBefore &&
      R.chestsAfterReturn === R.chestsBefore, R);

    /* P1-4 窄屏 HUD */
    Game.Core.Render.cssW = 375; Game.Core.Render.cssH = 640;
    Game.hud.update({ hp: 999, hpMax: 999, mp: 99, mpMax: 99, gold: 123456, floor: 3,
      kills: 16, killTarget: 16, level: 12, exp: 500, expNext: 720 });
    R.hud375 = overflowOf(function () { Game.hud.draw(); }, 375);
    Game.Core.Render.cssW = 320;
    R.hud320 = overflowOf(function () { Game.hud.draw(); }, 320);
    check('hudNarrow', R.hud375.over === 0 && R.hud320.over === 0, R);

    /* P2-8 通关页窄屏 */
    Game.Core.Render.cssW = 320; Game.Core.Render.cssH = 560;
    Game.hud.hide();
    Game.Systems.Leaderboard.clear();
    Game.Systems.Leaderboard.submit({ timeSec: 120, gold: 9999, level: 9, floor: 3, date: '2026/11/03' });
    R.victory320 = overflowOf(function () { Game.Core.Render.drawVictory(P); }, 320);
    Game.hud.show();
    check('victoryNarrow', R.victory320.over === 0, R.victory320);
    Game.Core.Render.cssW = 756; Game.Core.Render.cssH = 441;

    /* P2-7 稀有 maxHp 词缀 */
    Game.Systems.Inventory.add('sword_bone_epic', 1);
    var texts = [];
    Game.Modal.open('inventory');
    var ctx = Game.Core.Render._ctx, origFill = ctx.fillText;
    ctx.fillText = function (str) { texts.push(String(str)); return origFill.apply(ctx, arguments); };
    try { Game.Modal.draw(); } finally { ctx.fillText = origFill; Game.Modal.close(); }
    R.epicDescShown = texts.join('|').indexOf('生命+10') >= 0;
    check('rareMaxHpText', R.epicDescShown, R.epicDescShown);

    /* P2-9 排行榜跨标签页 */
    var L = Game.Systems.Leaderboard;
    L.clear();
    L.submit({ timeSec: 1, gold: 1, level: 1, floor: 1, date: 'x' });
    R.rankBefore = L.get().length;

      JSON.stringify([{ timeSec: 2, gold: 777, level: 2, floor: 2, date: 'y' }]));
    try { window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', { key: 'aiDungeon_leaderboard' })); } catch (e) { R.storageEventErr = e.message; }
    R.rankAfterStorageGold = L.get()[0].gold;
    check('leaderboardCrossTab', R.rankAfterStorageGold === 777, R.rankAfterStorageGold);

    /* P1-5 通关写档 */
    Game.Systems.Quest.init();
    Game.Systems.Quest.progress('kill', 'dragon');
    M.switchScene('explore');
    Game.Systems.Save.clear();
    Bus.emit('battle:end', { result: 'win', monsterId: 'dragon' });
    R.victorySaveExists = !!localStorage.getItem('ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1');
    check('victorySave', R.victorySaveExists, R.victorySaveExists);

    /* P2-6 死亡图鉴与存档一致 */
    Game.Systems.Bestiary.record('monster', 'slime');
    R.bestiaryBeforeDeath = Game.Systems.Bestiary.getMonsterCount('slime');

    R.saveAfterDeath = !!localStorage.getItem('ai_dungeon_rpg_save_v1');
    check('bestiaryClearedOnDeath', R.bestiaryAfterDeath === 0 && R.saveAfterDeath === false, R);
    try { Game.Modal.close(); } catch (e) { R.modalCloseErr = e.message; }

    if (fail.length) {
      document.getElementById('result').textContent = 'FAIL ' + JSON.stringify(R) + ' :: ' + fail.join('; ');
      document.title = 'FAIL P1/P2';
    } else {
      document.getElementById('result').textContent = 'PASS ' + JSON.stringify(R);
      document.title = 'PASS P1/P2';
    }

    document.getElementById('result').textContent = 'FAIL ' + e.message;
    document.title = 'FAIL P1/P2';

  'use strict';
  var out = { monsterLoaded: false, monsterApi: false, monsterOk: false };

  var ctx = cv.getContext('2d');

  /* 包装 drawImage 记录绘制行为（避免 file:// 本地图片污染 getImageData） */
  var rec = [];
  var origDrawImage = ctx.drawImage;
  ctx.drawImage = function (img, dx, dy, dw, dh) {
    try {
      if (img && img.src) {
        rec.push({
          n: String(img.src).split('/').pop().replace(/\.png$/i, ''),
          x: Math.round(Number(dx) * 100) / 100,
          y: Math.round(Number(dy) * 100) / 100,
          w: Number(dw), h: Number(dh)
        });
      }
    } catch (e) { /* 记录失败不影响绘制 */ }
    return origDrawImage.apply(ctx, arguments);
  };
  function names() {
    var s = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < rec.length; i++) s[rec[i].n] = true;
    return Object.keys(s);
  }
  function hasPrefix(p) {
    var ns = names();
    for (var i = 0; i < ns.length; i++) if (ns[i].indexOf(p) === 0) return true;
    return false;
  }
  function makeFloorGrid(n, w) {
    var g = [];
    for (var y = 0; y < n; y++) { g[y] = []; for (var x = 0; x < (w || n); x++) g[y][x] = 1; }
    return g;
  }
  function finish() {
    var pass = out.monsterLoaded && out.monsterApi && out.monsterOk;
    var text = (pass ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + JSON.stringify(out);
    document.title = text;
    document.body.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text));
  }

  function runTests() {
    var ok = true, sub = {};
    try {
      var R = Game.Core.Render, S = Game.Core.Sprites, D = Game.Data;
      out.monsterLoaded = !!(window.Game && Game.Core && R && S && D.MONSTERS && D.MAPS);
      out.monsterApi = !!(typeof R.drawMap === 'function' && typeof R.drawBattle === 'function' &&
        R.MONSTER_ANIM && typeof S.getFrame === 'function');

      if (!out.monsterLoaded || !out.monsterApi) { finish(); return; }

      R.init(cv);
      R._animNow = function () { return 4321; }; /* 冻结动画时钟，绘制记录稳定 */

      Game.Systems = Game.Systems || {};

        getDetail: function () { return null; },
        getDecor: function () { return null; },
        getEnemies: function () { return []; },
        getGrid: function () { return makeFloorGrid(10); }
      };
      Game.Systems.AI = undefined;
      Game.fov = undefined;
      Game.Lighting = undefined;
      Game.Particles = undefined;
      Game.Feedback = undefined;

      var ids = Object.keys(D.MONSTERS);
      var t2ok = (ids.length >= 15);
      var badField = [];
      for (var mi = 0; mi < ids.length; mi++) {
        var m = D.MONSTERS[ids[mi]];
        if (!(typeof m.hp === 'number' && m.hp > 0 && typeof m.atk === 'number' && m.atk > 0 &&
          typeof m.def === 'number' && m.def >= 0 && typeof m.exp === 'number' && m.exp > 0)) {

        }
